columns.description: Date on which the SAR study was actually completed and final data locked in the ELN. Compared against target completion date for schedule variance analysis.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

columns.name: adme_impact_summary
columns.glossary_term: Absorption Distribution Metabolism Excretion (ADME) Impact Summary
columns.description: Narrative summary of how structural modifications in this SAR study impacted ADME properties including metabolic stability, permeability, solubility, plasma protein binding, and CYP inhibition. Sourced from LIMS and ELN data.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; LIMS (LabWare/SampleManager); ICH M4 CMC; FDA ADME Guidance

columns.name: analogs_synthesized_count
columns.description: Total count of chemical analogs synthesized and tested within this SAR study. Key productivity metric for medicinal chemistry resource planning and portfolio reporting.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registration; ICH M4 CMC

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this SAR study record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); FDA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+

columns.name: data_quality_score
columns.description: Numeric score (0–100) reflecting the completeness and reliability of the experimental data captured in this SAR study, based on assay reproducibility, data completeness, and ELN audit trail integrity. Used for data governance and AI/ML model training quality gates.
columns.reference: FDA Data Integrity Guidance (2018); 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

columns.name: eln_notebook_reference
columns.description: Reference identifier or URL to the corresponding study record in the IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN). Provides traceability to the primary research data source.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

columns.name: glp_compliant
columns.description: Indicates whether this SAR study was conducted under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. True = GLP-compliant study; False = non-GLP exploratory research. Relevant for regulatory submission packages.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP); OECD GLP Principles; FDA GLP Guidance

columns.name: key_structural_features
columns.description: Free-text or structured description of the key chemical structural features (pharmacophores, functional groups, scaffolds, substituents) analyzed in this SAR study to drive potency, selectivity, or ADME properties.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4 CMC; SAR best practices

columns.name: mechanism_of_action
columns.description: Description of the biochemical mechanism by which the compounds in this series exert their pharmacological effect on the target (e.g., competitive inhibition, allosteric modulation, covalent binding).
columns.reference: ICH M4; FDA Pharmacology Review Guidance; ChEMBL MOA ontology

columns.name: metabolic_stability_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the lead compounds in this SAR study met the predefined metabolic stability criteria (e.g., microsomal half-life threshold). True = criteria met; False = criteria not met.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; LIMS; ICH M4; FDA ADME Guidance

columns.name: nce_nbe_type
columns.glossary_term: New Chemical Entity / New Biological Entity (NCE/NBE) Type
columns.description: Classification of the compound series as a New Chemical Entity (NCE, small molecule) or New Biological Entity (NBE, biologic/large molecule) or hybrid. Determines regulatory pathway and IP strategy.
columns.reference: FDA NCE/NBE Classification; ICH M4; 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA) / Part 601 (BLA)

columns.name: patent_filing_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether a patent application has been initiated for compounds or methods arising from this SAR study. True = patent filing in progress or completed; False = no patent action taken.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314; USPTO Patent Filing; ICH M4; IP Management Best Practices

columns.name: permeability_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the lead compounds demonstrated acceptable membrane permeability (e.g., Caco-2 or PAMPA assay thresholds). True = acceptable permeability achieved; False = not achieved.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; LIMS; ICH M4; FDA ADME Guidance

columns.name: potency_metric_type
columns.description: Type of biochemical potency measurement used to characterize compound activity in this SAR study (e.g., IC50 for inhibitory concentration, Ki for inhibition constant, EC50 for effective concentration).
columns.reference: IUPAC pharmacology nomenclature; ChEMBL bioactivity standards; ICH M4

columns.name: potency_range_max_nm
columns.description: Highest (least potent) IC50 or Ki value observed across all analogs in this SAR study, expressed in nanomolar (nM). Together with the minimum, defines the potency range of the series.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics assay results; ICH M4 Pharmacology; ChEMBL bioactivity standards

columns.name: potency_range_min_nm
columns.description: Lowest (most potent) IC50 or Ki value observed across all analogs in this SAR study, expressed in nanomolar (nM). Represents the best-in-series potency achieved.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics assay results; ICH M4 Pharmacology; ChEMBL bioactivity standards

columns.name: progression_decision
columns.description: Outcome decision made at the conclusion of the SAR study regarding whether the lead series should progress to the next stage of drug discovery (e.g., lead optimization, candidate selection) or be deprioritized.
columns.reference: ICH M4; ISPE Drug Discovery Stage Gate Model; FDA IND Guidance

columns.name: sar_hypothesis
columns.description: Scientific hypothesis describing the proposed relationship between structural features of the compound series and the observed or expected biological activity. Captured from the ELN study plan.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; ICH M4 CMC; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

columns.name: selectivity_findings
columns.description: Summary of selectivity data for the lead compounds against off-target proteins or related family members. Describes selectivity ratios, panel screening results, and any observed off-target liabilities.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4 Pharmacology; FDA Pharmacology/Toxicology Guidance

columns.name: selectivity_ratio
columns.description: Quantitative ratio of the compound's potency against the primary target versus the most relevant off-target (e.g., 100-fold selective over related kinase). Key metric for candidate progression decisions.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4 Pharmacology; FDA Pharmacology Guidance

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Date on which the SAR study was formally initiated, corresponding to the first experimental activity recorded in the ELN. Used for timeline tracking and portfolio planning.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

columns.name: study_name
columns.description: Descriptive title of the SAR study, typically including the lead series name and therapeutic target (e.g., 'Series-7 EGFR Kinase Inhibitor Optimization'). Used for display and search in ELN and project management tools.

columns.name: study_number
columns.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the SAR study at initiation (e.g., SAR-ONC-202401). Used for cross-system referencing in ELN, LIMS, and project tracking systems.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics study numbering convention; ICH M4 eCTD

columns.name: study_phase
columns.description: Stage of the drug discovery funnel at which this SAR study is conducted. Aligns with the hit-to-lead and lead optimization progression framework used in medicinal chemistry.
columns.reference: ICH M4; ISPE Drug Discovery Stage Gate Model

columns.name: study_report_reference
columns.description: Document identifier or Veeva Vault reference for the formal SAR study report summarizing findings, conclusions, and progression recommendations. Provides traceability to the official scientific record.
columns.reference: Veeva Vault QualityDocs / eTMF; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH M4

columns.name: study_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the SAR study. Drives workflow routing and portfolio reporting. 'terminated' indicates early discontinuation; 'archived' indicates data locked in ELN.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics study lifecycle; ICH M4

columns.name: target_completion_date
columns.description: Planned date by which the SAR study is expected to be completed and key findings reported. Used for project milestone tracking and resource scheduling.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH M4; ISPE Drug Discovery Stage Gate

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this SAR study record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); FDA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+

tables.name: lead_series
tables.description: Master record for chemical lead series progressing through hit-to-lead and lead optimization stages. Captures series name, scaffold/chemotype description, originating HTS campaign, primary target, series status (hit-to-lead, lead optimization, deprioritized, nominated), best-in-class compound identifier, potency benchmark, selectivity profile, ADME profile summary, IP landscape assessment, therapeutic area, program code, and stage-gate progression history with decision rationale. Central entity for tracking medicinal chemistry progression and compound governance decisions from hit confirmation through candidate nomination.

columns.name: lead_series_id
columns.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the lead series record. Primary key for the lead_series data product in the discovery domain.
columns.reference: ICH M10, IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics internal entity model

columns.name: best_in_class_compound_id
columns.description: Reference to the compound record representing the best-performing compound within this lead series at the current stage, used as the benchmark for potency, selectivity, and ADME profiling comparisons.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry; ICH Q8

columns.name: fto_analysis_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.fto_analysis. Business justification: Lead series advancement requires formal FTO clearance as a stage-gate requirement. IP teams conduct series-level FTO before lead optimization investment. lead_series has ip_landscape_assessment as a t

columns.name: hts_campaign_id
columns.description: Reference to the originating High-Throughput Screening (HTS) campaign from which the initial hits in this series were identified. Provides traceability from lead series back to the screening event.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics HTS module; ICH Q8

columns.name: indication_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.indication. Business justification: Lead series are optimized for specific disease indications. Linking to product.indication enables indication-level pipeline tracking and aligns lead optimization decisions with the product indication

columns.name: internal_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Lead optimization programs in pharma are funded via dedicated internal orders covering medicinal chemistry, in vivo studies, and CRO costs. Finance tracks lead series spend separately from HTS campaig

columns.name: licensing_agreement_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: Lead series may be in-licensed or out-licensed; agreement linkage tracks licensed rights, royalty obligations, milestone payments, territory restrictions, and field-of-use limitations for portfolio ma

columns.name: molecular_target_id
columns.description: Reference to the primary molecular target (e.g., protein, enzyme, receptor) against which this lead series is designed to act. Central to target-based drug discovery and SAR analysis.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics target registry; ICH Q8; UniProt

columns.name: patent_claim_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_claim. Business justification: Lead series scaffolds are covered by specific composition-of-matter patent claims. IP teams track which claims protect the lead scaffold for prosecution strategy and licensing negotiations. lead_serie

columns.name: patent_family_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Lead series represent patentable chemical scaffolds; patent family linkage tracks composition-of-matter protection, supports stage gate IP assessments, and enables portfolio prioritization based on IP

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.discovery_project. Business justification: Lead series are chemical series progressing through hit-to-lead and lead optimization stages within discovery projects. The series table currently has program_code as a denormalized STRING attribute.

columns.name: therapeutic_area_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Lead series are developed within therapeutic area programs. Linking to the master therapeutic_area entity enables TA-level pipeline reporting, stage-gate review preparation, and strategic portfolio pr

columns.name: adme_profile_summary
columns.glossary_term: Absorption Distribution Metabolism Excretion (ADME) Profile Summary
columns.description: Summary of the Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, and Excretion (ADME) profile for the lead series, including key in vitro ADME data such as microsomal stability, permeability (Caco-2/PAMPA), plasma protein binding, and CYP inhibition flags.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; ICH M3(R2); GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook ADME module

columns.name: compound_count
columns.description: Total number of discrete compounds synthesized and registered within this lead series. Indicates the breadth of SAR exploration and medicinal chemistry effort invested in the series.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry; ICH Q8

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this lead series record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GLP/21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); ICH Q8

columns.name: current_stage
columns.description: Current stage of the lead series within the drug discovery pipeline, from hit confirmation through candidate nomination. Distinct from series_status in that it reflects the scientific progression stage rather than the governance lifecycle state.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company discovery stage-gate framework; IDBS E-WorkBook

columns.name: deprioritization_date
columns.description: Date on which the lead series was formally deprioritized or stopped. Null if the series is still active. Used for portfolio analytics and resource reallocation tracking.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP

columns.name: drug_likeness_score
columns.description: Composite drug-likeness score for the best-in-class compound in the series, typically based on Lipinski Rule of Five parameters or QED (Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness). Ranges from 0 to 1; higher values indicate better drug-likeness.
columns.reference: Lipinski Rule of Five; QED (Bickerton et al.); ICH Q8; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics cheminformatics

columns.name: eln_notebook_reference
columns.description: Reference identifier linking this lead series to the primary Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) experiment or project in IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics where the originating research data is recorded. Ensures data traceability and GLP audit trail.
columns.reference: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); 21 CFR Part 11; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN

columns.name: glp_compliant
columns.description: Indicates whether the key studies supporting this lead series have been conducted under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) conditions as required for regulatory submission. True = GLP-compliant studies on record.
columns.reference: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); OECD GLP Principles; FDA GLP regulations

columns.name: ip_landscape_assessment
columns.description: Narrative assessment of the Intellectual Property (IP) landscape for the lead series, including freedom-to-operate (FTO) status, known competitor patents covering the scaffold, and patentability assessment. Classified as confidential due to competitive sensitivity.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314; ICH Q8; company IP governance policy; USPTO/EPO patent databases

columns.name: ip_status
columns.description: Current IP status of the lead series scaffold, indicating whether freedom-to-operate has been established, patents have been filed, or IP encumbrances exist. Classified as confidential.
columns.reference: USPTO; EPO; ICH Q8; company IP governance SOP

columns.name: moa_description
columns.description: Description of the Mechanism of Action (MOA) for the lead series, explaining how compounds in the series interact with the molecular target to produce the desired pharmacological effect.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; IDBS E-WorkBook pharmacology module

columns.name: modality
columns.description: Drug modality classification for the lead series, indicating the type of therapeutic molecule (e.g., small molecule, biologic, peptide). Drives CMC strategy, manufacturing approach, and regulatory pathway selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: small_molecule|biologic|peptide|oligonucleotide|cell_therapy|gene_therapy|antibody_drug_conjugate|radioligand — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH Q8; FDA CDER/CBER modality classification; EMA guidelines

columns.name: molecular_weight_da
columns.description: Molecular weight of the core scaffold or best-in-class compound in Daltons (Da). Key physicochemical property used in drug-likeness assessment (Lipinski Rule of Five: MW ≤ 500 Da for oral drugs).
columns.reference: Lipinski Rule of Five; ICH Q8; IUPAC; Dotmatics cheminformatics

columns.name: nce_nbe_classification
columns.glossary_term: New Chemical Entity / New Biological Entity (NCE/NBE) Classification
columns.description: Classification of the lead series as a New Chemical Entity (NCE), New Biological Entity (NBE), or New Molecular Entity (NME). Determines regulatory pathway, IP strategy, and data exclusivity eligibility.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314 (NCE); 21 CFR Part 601 (NBE); FDA CDER/CBER classification; ICH Q8

columns.name: nomination_date
columns.description: Date on which the lead series was formally nominated as a development candidate, marking the transition from discovery to preclinical development. Null if the series has not yet been nominated.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

columns.name: oral_bioavailability_pct
columns.description: Best-in-class oral bioavailability percentage (%F) for the lead series from preclinical in vivo PK studies. Key ADME metric for assessing drug-likeness and oral dosing feasibility.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; ICH M3(R2); GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

columns.name: pk_profile_summary
columns.description: Summary of in vivo Pharmacokinetics (PK) data for the lead series, including key parameters such as oral bioavailability (%F), half-life (t½), clearance (CL), and volume of distribution (Vd) from preclinical species studies.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; ICH M3(R2); GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook PK module

columns.name: potency_assay_type
columns.description: Type of biochemical or cellular assay used to determine the potency benchmark value (e.g., IC50, Ki, EC50, Kd). Provides context for interpreting the potency_benchmark_nm value.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook

columns.name: potency_benchmark_nm
columns.description: Best-in-class potency value (IC50 or Ki) for the lead series expressed in nanomolar (nM) concentration. Represents the principal quantitative performance metric for the series and is used in stage-gate go/no-go decisions.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook assay data

columns.name: safety_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether any significant safety liabilities (e.g., genotoxicity, hERG inhibition, reactive metabolites, phototoxicity) have been identified for compounds in this lead series. True = known safety liability requiring mitigation.
columns.reference: ICH S2(R1); ICH S7B; ICH M7; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook safety profiling

columns.name: safety_liability_notes
columns.description: Narrative description of identified safety liabilities for the lead series, including the nature of the liability, affected compounds, and proposed mitigation strategies. Populated when safety_flag is True.
columns.reference: ICH S2(R1); ICH S7B; ICH M7; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

columns.name: sar_maturity_level
columns.description: Qualitative assessment of the maturity of the Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR) understanding for the lead series, from early (limited data) to mature (well-defined SAR with predictive models). Used in stage-gate assessments.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; IDBS E-WorkBook SAR module; company medicinal chemistry SOP

columns.name: scaffold_description
columns.description: Textual description of the core chemical scaffold or chemotype defining the lead series, including key structural features relevant to Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR) analysis. Captured from ELN records.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics; ICH Q8; SAR analysis standards

columns.name: selectivity_profile_summary
columns.description: Narrative summary of the selectivity profile for the lead series, describing off-target activity, selectivity ratios against related targets, and any known liabilities identified through selectivity panels (e.g., kinase selectivity panel, GPCR panel).
columns.reference: ICH Q8; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); IDBS E-WorkBook selectivity data

columns.name: series_code
columns.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the lead series within the compound governance system (e.g., ONCO-SER-00042). Used as the business identifier across ELN, LIMS, and medicinal chemistry platforms.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registration standards; ICH Q8

columns.name: series_name
columns.description: Human-readable name assigned to the lead series, typically reflecting the chemotype or scaffold class (e.g., 'Pyrimidine Kinase Inhibitor Series A'). Used in medicinal chemistry reports and stage-gate presentations.

columns.name: series_start_date
columns.description: Date on which the lead series was formally initiated following hit confirmation from the originating HTS campaign. Marks the beginning of the hit-to-lead phase and is used for timeline and cycle-time analytics.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

columns.name: series_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the lead series within the drug discovery pipeline. Governs stage-gate decisions and resource allocation. Values: hit_to_lead (active hit confirmation and early profiling), lead_optimization (active medicinal chemistry optimization), deprioritized (paused or stopped), nominated (candidate nominated for development), on_hold (temporarily paused pending decision).
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

columns.name: smiles_scaffold
columns.description: Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System (SMILES) string representing the core scaffold structure of the lead series. Enables cheminformatics analysis, substructure searching, and computational chemistry workflows.
columns.reference: IUPAC SMILES notation standard; Dotmatics / IDBS E-WorkBook cheminformatics module

columns.name: stage_gate_date
columns.description: Date on which the most recent stage-gate committee decision was made for this lead series. Used for tracking progression timelines and portfolio reporting.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP

columns.name: stage_gate_decision
columns.description: Most recent stage-gate committee decision for the lead series, indicating whether the series has been approved to progress (go), stopped (no_go), placed on hold, or conditionally approved pending specific criteria.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; IDBS E-WorkBook

columns.name: stage_gate_rationale
columns.description: Documented rationale for the most recent stage-gate decision, capturing the scientific, strategic, and risk-based reasoning of the decision committee. Supports audit trail and portfolio governance.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; company stage-gate governance SOP; GLP (21 CFR Part 58)

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this lead series record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (21 CFR Part 58); ICH Q8

tables.name: compound_synthesis
tables.description: Transactional record capturing the synthesis of individual compounds by medicinal chemistry teams. Captures compound identifier, synthesis route identifier, synthetic method, reagents used, reaction conditions (temperature, solvent, catalyst), yield percentage, purity by HPLC/NMR, batch number, synthesis date, synthesizing chemist, ELN experiment reference from IDBS/Dotmatics, and GLP compliance flag. Tracks the manufacturing provenance of discovery compounds.

columns.name: compound_synthesis_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each compound synthesis record in the discovery domain. Primary key for the compound_synthesis data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete synthesis event with its own lifecycle, reagents, conditions, and outcomes.
columns.reference: ICH Q11 (Development and Manufacture of Drug Substances)

columns.name: compound_id
columns.description: Reference to the compound entity that was synthesized in this experiment. Links the synthesis record to the master compound registry (NCE/NBE catalogue).
columns.reference: ICH Q11; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry

columns.name: cost_center_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: Synthesis activities consume reagents, labor, and equipment charged to cost centers for project costing, resource planning, and financial reporting. Essential for medicinal chemistry budget management

columns.name: fto_analysis_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.fto_analysis. Business justification: FTO on synthesis routes is a standard pharma IP process — IP teams assess whether a synthesis method infringes third-party process patents before scale-up. This is especially critical for API manufact

columns.name: internal_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Individual synthesis activities are charged to internal orders for cost-per-compound tracking, essential for portfolio economics, make-vs-buy decisions, and CRO cost benchmarking in pharmaceutical dis

columns.name: lead_series_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.lead_series. Business justification: Compound synthesis efforts by medicinal chemistry teams are organized by lead series. Each synthesis produces an analog within a specific chemical series. The synthesis table currently has series_code

columns.name: master_batch_record_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.master_batch_record. Business justification: GMP-compliant preclinical supply synthesis is governed by a master batch record. Pharma domain experts expect compound_synthesis records for GMP batches to reference the controlling MBR for regulatory

columns.name: molecular_target_id
columns.description: Reference to the biological target (protein, enzyme, receptor, or pathway) against which this compound was synthesized. Links synthesis provenance to target identification and MOA studies in the discovery domain.
columns.reference: ChEMBL target classification; UniProt; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

columns.name: patent_family_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Process patent families protect synthesis routes globally across jurisdictions. IP teams track synthesis-to-patent-family linkage for global manufacturing FTO and licensing strategy. Family-level trac

columns.name: patent_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Synthesis routes are protected by process patents. IP teams track which synthesis methods are covered by patents for manufacturing freedom-to-operate and licensing. Pharma IP experts routinely link sy

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Reference to the drug discovery project under which this synthesis was conducted. Enables project-level portfolio reporting, resource tracking, and compound series management.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics project management

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.site. Business justification: Kilo-scale and GMP preclinical supply synthesis is performed at designated manufacturing sites (pilot plants, kilo labs). Pharma operations track which manufacturing site executed each synthesis batch

columns.name: storage_location_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.storage_location. Business justification: Synthesized compound storage location tracking is required for chain of custody, GMP compliance, and controlled substance scheduling. 'storage_location' plain attribute is a denormalized reference to

columns.name: synthesis_cro_business_partner_id
columns.glossary_term: Synthesis Cro Business Partner Id (Foreign Key)
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.business_partner. Business justification: Contract synthesis outsourced to CROs/CMOs requires linking synthesis records to the qualified business partner for vendor management, GMP audit trails, and regulatory batch record requirements. Disti

columns.name: synthesis_plant_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: GMP batch records and regulatory submissions require knowing which plant performed compound synthesis. Role prefix 'synthesis_' distinguishes from manufacturing plant context. No existing plant FK on

columns.name: approval_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the synthesis record received formal electronic approval in the ELN by the supervising scientist. Distinct from record creation; captures the GLP-required second-person review event for data integrity.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); OECD Series on Principles of GLP

columns.name: batch_number
columns.description: Alphanumeric batch identifier assigned to the synthesized compound lot. Used for inventory tracking, biological testing assignment, and downstream traceability through the discovery pipeline. Aligns with SAP MM batch management.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.68; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA MM module

columns.name: catalyst
columns.description: Name and loading of the catalyst or catalytic system used in the reaction (e.g., Pd(PPh3)4, Pd2(dba)3/XPhos, DMAP). Null if the reaction is uncatalysed. Critical for SAR and process chemistry knowledge management.

columns.name: compound_type
columns.description: Classification of the synthesized compound by modality. Distinguishes New Chemical Entities (NCE), New Biological Entities (NBE), peptides, oligonucleotides, PROTACs, fragments, and natural product derivatives. Drives downstream development pathway and regulatory strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NCE|NBE|peptide|oligonucleotide|PROTAC|fragment|natural_product_derivative — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH M9; FDA CDER Drug Classification; EMA Guideline on the Investigation of Bioequivalence

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this synthesis record was first created in the system (ELN or data lakehouse). Mandatory audit field for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and GLP data integrity requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

columns.name: eln_experiment_ref
columns.description: Unique experiment identifier from the Electronic Lab Notebook system (IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics) that documents the full experimental procedure, observations, and raw data for this synthesis. Provides traceability back to the authoritative source record.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

columns.name: failure_reason
columns.description: Free-text description of the reason for synthesis failure or cancellation when synthesis_status is 'failed' or 'cancelled'. Captures root cause information (e.g., no reaction observed, product decomposition, purification failure, starting material unavailable) to support process learning and SAR knowledge management.
columns.reference: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

columns.name: glp_compliant
columns.description: Indicates whether this synthesis was conducted in full compliance with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations. GLP-compliant syntheses are required for compounds entering formal preclinical safety studies. True = GLP compliant; False = non-GLP (exploratory research).
columns.reference: OECD Principles of GLP; 21 CFR Part 58; OECD Series on Principles of GLP and Compliance Monitoring

columns.name: hazard_classification
columns.description: GHS/CLP hazard classification of the synthesized compound based on its physicochemical and toxicological properties. Governs safe handling, storage, and disposal procedures in the laboratory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_hazardous|flammable|toxic|corrosive|oxidising|highly_toxic|environmental_hazard — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: GHS (Globally Harmonised System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals); EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008; OSHA HazCom 2012

columns.name: hplc_purity_percent
columns.description: Purity of the synthesized compound as determined by High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC), expressed as area percentage. A Critical Quality Attribute (CQA) for compound registration and screening eligibility. Compounds typically require ≥95% purity for HTS submission.
columns.reference: ICH Q6A (Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); USP <621>

columns.name: molecular_formula
columns.description: Empirical molecular formula of the synthesized compound (e.g., C18H21N3O2). Derived from structural confirmation data. Used for compound identity verification, registry matching, and regulatory documentation.
columns.reference: IUPAC nomenclature; ICH Q6A; Dotmatics / IDBS compound registry

columns.name: molecular_weight
columns.description: Calculated molecular weight of the synthesized compound in grams per mole (g/mol), derived from the confirmed chemical structure. Used for stoichiometric calculations, Lipinski rule-of-five assessment, and compound library profiling.
columns.reference: ICH Q6A; IUPAC; Dotmatics / IDBS compound registry

columns.name: nmr_purity_percent
columns.description: Purity of the synthesized compound as determined by quantitative Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, expressed as percentage. Orthogonal purity assessment to HPLC; used for structural confirmation and identity verification per GLP requirements.
columns.reference: ICH Q6A; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); USP <761>

columns.name: product_mass_mg
columns.description: Actual mass of isolated compound product in milligrams. Used to determine availability for biological screening, ADME assays, and compound library registration. Directly linked to synthesis scale and yield.
columns.reference: ICH Q11; LIMS (LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager)

columns.name: purification_method
columns.description: Method used to purify the crude reaction product to achieve the required purity specification (e.g., column chromatography, preparative HPLC, recrystallisation, trituration). Influences final yield and purity outcomes and informs process development decisions.
columns.reference: ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

columns.name: reaction_duration_hours
columns.description: Total elapsed time of the synthesis reaction in hours. A Critical Process Parameter (CPP) used in reaction optimization and SAR/process correlation studies.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

columns.name: reaction_temperature_c
columns.description: Temperature at which the synthesis reaction was conducted, expressed in degrees Celsius. A Critical Process Parameter (CPP) that directly influences reaction selectivity, yield, and purity. Captured from ELN experimental conditions.
columns.reference: ICH Q8 (Pharmaceutical Development); ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

columns.name: reagents_description
columns.description: Free-text or structured description of the key reagents and their stoichiometric equivalents used in the synthesis (e.g., 'K2CO3 (2.0 eq), Pd(OAc)2 (5 mol%), SPhos (10 mol%)'). Supports reproducibility and GLP documentation requirements.
columns.reference: GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); 21 CFR Part 58; ICH Q11

columns.name: registered_in_library
columns.description: Indicates whether the synthesized compound has been registered in the corporate compound library for HTS and biological screening. True = registered and available for screening; False = not yet registered or failed registration criteria (e.g., purity < 95%).
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics compound registry; LIMS (LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager)

columns.name: smiles_notation
columns.description: Canonical SMILES (Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System) string representing the two-dimensional chemical structure of the synthesized compound. Machine-readable format used for cheminformatics, SAR analysis, and compound database registration in Dotmatics.
columns.reference: Daylight Chemical Information Systems SMILES specification; ICH Q6A; Dotmatics / IDBS

columns.name: solvent
columns.description: Name of the primary solvent or solvent system used in the synthesis reaction (e.g., DMF, THF, DCM, EtOH, water). Influences reaction kinetics, selectivity, and downstream purification strategy. Relevant to ICH Q3C solvent classification for later-stage development.
columns.reference: ICH Q3C (Residual Solvents); ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

columns.name: storage_condition
columns.description: Required storage condition for the synthesized compound to maintain stability and integrity (e.g., room temperature, 2–8°C, −20°C, −80°C, nitrogen atmosphere, desiccator). Derived from compound physicochemical properties and stability data.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A (Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products); LIMS (LabWare / Thermo Fisher SampleManager)

columns.name: structural_confirmation_method
columns.description: Analytical technique(s) used to confirm the chemical structure of the synthesized compound (e.g., 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR, LCMS, HRMS, IR, X-ray crystallography). Structural confirmation is mandatory for compound registration and GLP compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1H-NMR|13C-NMR|LCMS|HRMS|IR|X-ray|multiple — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH Q6A; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); 21 CFR Part 58

columns.name: synthesis_date
columns.description: Calendar date on which the synthesis reaction was initiated. Principal business event date for this transaction record. Used for timeline tracking, GLP compliance dating, and SAR trend analysis.
columns.reference: GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); 21 CFR Part 58; ICH Q11

columns.name: synthesis_number
columns.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for this synthesis event, typically assigned by the ELN (IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics). Follows site-specific numbering conventions (e.g., MED-SYN-000123). Used for cross-referencing in lab notebooks, SAR databases, and regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; 21 CFR Part 11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

columns.name: synthesis_purpose
columns.description: Scientific purpose for which this compound was synthesized. Classifies the synthesis within the drug discovery workflow (e.g., hit confirmation from HTS, lead optimisation, SAR exploration, ADME probe, tool compound, library synthesis). Enables portfolio analytics and resource allocation reporting.
columns.reference: ICH Q8; FDA Guidance for Industry: Drug Interaction Studies; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

columns.name: synthesis_scale_mmol
columns.description: Molar scale of the synthesis reaction expressed in millimoles (mmol). Determines reagent quantities, expected yield mass, and suitability for downstream biological screening (e.g., HTS vs. focused assay).
columns.reference: ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP)

columns.name: synthesis_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the synthesis experiment. Tracks progression from planned through execution to completion or failure. Drives workflow routing in the medicinal chemistry pipeline.
columns.reference: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

columns.name: synthetic_method
columns.description: Name or classification of the synthetic methodology applied (e.g., Suzuki coupling, reductive amination, Buchwald-Hartwig amination, solid-phase synthesis). Enables SAR analysis by correlating method with yield and purity outcomes.
columns.reference: ICH Q11; IUPAC nomenclature; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this synthesis record. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance and data integrity monitoring in GLP environments.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); ICH Q10

columns.name: yield_percent
columns.description: Isolated yield of the target compound expressed as a percentage of the theoretical maximum based on the limiting reagent. A primary quantitative outcome metric for synthesis efficiency and SAR optimization. Range: 0.00–100.00.
columns.reference: ICH Q11; GLP (OECD Principles of GLP); IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics

tables.name: adme_profile
tables.description: Transactional record capturing ADME (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion) profiling results for compounds under evaluation. Captures compound identifier, assay panel used, solubility value, permeability (Caco-2/PAMPA), plasma protein binding, microsomal stability (human/rat liver microsomes), CYP inhibition profile, P-glycoprotein substrate flag, blood-brain barrier penetration, half-life, clearance rate, bioavailability estimate, assay date, and ADME scientist. Critical for compound progression decisions.

columns.name: adme_profile_id
columns.glossary_term: Absorption Distribution Metabolism Excretion (ADME) Profile ID
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ADME profiling record in the discovery domain. Primary key for the adme_profile data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — captures a discrete ADME assay event with its own lifecycle and results.
columns.reference: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: compound_id
columns.description: Reference to the compound under ADME evaluation, linking to the compound master record in the discovery compound library. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category (compound is the principal resource being profiled).

columns.name: cro_business_partner_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.business_partner. Business justification: DMPK/ADME studies are routinely outsourced to CROs; regulatory submissions (IND) require identifying the performing laboratory as a qualified business partner. No existing CRO link on adme_profile; cr

columns.name: drug_substance_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_substance. Business justification: ADME profiles are directly associated with drug substances for IND/NDA regulatory submissions (Module 2.6 pharmacokinetics). Regulatory affairs and CMC teams require direct adme_profile→drug_substance

columns.name: lead_series_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.lead_series. Business justification: ADME profiling is conducted specifically to support lead series optimization and progression decisions. adme_profile already has compound_id and project_id, but lacks a direct FK to the lead_series be

columns.name: method_validation_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to quality.method_validation. Business justification: ICH M3 and FDA BMV guidance require ADME data submitted in IND/NDA to reference validated bioanalytical methods. adme_profile already has submission_id; linking to method_validation enables regulatory

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Reference to the drug discovery project under which this ADME profiling was conducted, enabling project-level aggregation of ADME data for compound progression decisions.

columns.name: adme_risk_score
columns.description: Composite numerical risk score (e.g., 0–100) summarizing overall ADME liability across solubility, permeability, metabolic stability, and DDI risk dimensions. Used for compound ranking and portfolio prioritization in discovery.
columns.reference: ICH Q6A; internal compound scoring framework; FDA IND Guidance

columns.name: assay_concentration_um
columns.description: Concentration of the compound used in the ADME assay incubation, expressed in micromolar (µM). Required for result interpretation and inter-assay comparability; standard concentrations are typically 1–10 µM.
columns.reference: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LabWare LIMS; ICH M10

columns.name: assay_date
columns.description: Calendar date on which the ADME assay panel was executed in the laboratory. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (day-level precision for assay scheduling and trending).

columns.name: bbb_kp_uu
columns.description: Unbound brain-to-plasma concentration ratio (Kp,uu,brain), the quantitative measure of CNS penetration accounting for plasma protein binding. Values >0.3 indicate meaningful CNS exposure; used in CNS drug discovery programs.
columns.reference: FDA CNS Drug Development Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

columns.name: bbb_penetration
columns.description: Indicates whether the compound demonstrates blood-brain barrier penetration based on in vitro BBB assay (e.g., MDCK-MDR1, hCMEC/D3) or in vivo brain-to-plasma ratio. Critical for CNS-targeted and CNS-safety assessments.
columns.reference: FDA CNS Drug Development Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics; ICH S7A

columns.name: bioavailability_pct
columns.description: Estimated oral bioavailability percentage (%F) derived from permeability, solubility, and metabolic stability data using predictive ADME models. Key compound progression criterion for oral drug candidates.
columns.reference: FDA BCS Guidance; ICH M9; EMA BCS-based Biowaiver Guideline

columns.name: clearance_ml_min_kg
columns.description: Predicted in vivo hepatic clearance in mL/min/kg, scaled from in vitro microsomal intrinsic clearance using the well-stirred liver model. Used to estimate dose and dosing interval in early drug discovery.
columns.reference: ICH M10; FDA Pharmacokinetics Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this ADME profile record was first created in the system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail.

columns.name: cyp2c9_inhibition_ic50_um
columns.description: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) for CYP2C9 enzyme inhibition in µM. CYP2C9 metabolizes warfarin and NSAIDs; inhibition is a critical DDI safety signal for regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

columns.name: cyp2d6_inhibition_ic50_um
columns.description: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) for CYP2D6 enzyme inhibition in µM. CYP2D6 metabolizes ~25% of marketed drugs; inhibition is a major DDI liability assessed by FDA and EMA.
columns.reference: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

columns.name: cyp3a4_inhibition_ic50_um
columns.description: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) for CYP3A4 enzyme inhibition in µM. CYP3A4 metabolizes ~50% of marketed drugs; inhibition predicts drug-drug interaction (DDI) liability. Key regulatory safety flag.
columns.reference: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

columns.name: cyp_inhibition_flag
columns.description: Composite boolean flag indicating whether the compound exhibits significant CYP inhibition risk (any CYP isoform IC50 below the regulatory concern threshold, typically <10 µM). Used for rapid compound triage and progression gating.
columns.reference: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance (2020); EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

columns.name: efflux_ratio
columns.description: Ratio of basolateral-to-apical (B→A) over apical-to-basolateral (A→B) permeability in Caco-2 assay. Values >2 indicate active efflux transport (e.g., P-gp substrate), impacting oral bioavailability and CNS penetration.
columns.reference: FDA BCS Guidance; ICH M9; EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions

columns.name: eln_notebook_reference
columns.description: Reference identifier linking this ADME profile to the corresponding experiment entry in the Electronic Lab Notebook (IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics), providing traceability to raw experimental data and GLP documentation.
columns.reference: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; 21 CFR Part 11; IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN

columns.name: half_life_h
columns.description: Predicted or measured plasma half-life of the compound in hours, derived from in vitro microsomal clearance data using allometric scaling or measured directly in in vivo PK studies. Informs dosing frequency predictions.
columns.reference: ICH M10; FDA Pharmacokinetics Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

columns.name: hlm_clint_ul_min_mg
columns.description: Intrinsic metabolic clearance measured in human liver microsomes (HLM), expressed as µL/min/mg protein. Used to predict in vivo hepatic clearance and half-life via well-stirred liver model. Critical for dose prediction.
columns.reference: ICH M10; FDA Drug Metabolism Guidance; EMA Guideline on Drug Interactions

columns.name: lims_sample_code
columns.glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Sample ID
columns.description: Sample identifier assigned by the LIMS (LabWare or Thermo Fisher SampleManager) for the compound sample used in this ADME assay. Enables traceability from ADME result back to physical sample chain of custody.
columns.reference: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; LabWare LIMS; Thermo Fisher SampleManager

columns.name: metabolic_stability_class
columns.description: Categorical classification of compound metabolic stability based on microsomal half-life thresholds (e.g., low: t½ <30 min, medium: 30–60 min, high: >60 min). Used in compound progression scoring and SAR triage.
columns.reference: ICH Q6A; FDA Drug Metabolism Guidance; internal SAR triage criteria

columns.name: microsomal_half_life_min
columns.description: In vitro half-life of the compound in liver microsome incubation (human or rat), expressed in minutes. Derived from substrate depletion kinetics; used to classify metabolic stability as low/medium/high.
columns.reference: ICH M10; FDA Drug Metabolism Guidance

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-text field for ADME scientist observations, anomalies, assay deviations, or contextual notes relevant to interpreting the ADME profile results. Supports GLP documentation requirements.

columns.name: permeability_caco2_nm_s
columns.description: Apparent permeability coefficient (Papp A→B) measured in Caco-2 cell monolayer assay, expressed in nm/s. Predicts intestinal absorption and oral bioavailability. Key ADME parameter for BCS classification.
columns.reference: FDA BCS Guidance; ICH M9; EMA BCS-based Biowaiver Guideline

columns.name: permeability_pampa_nm_s
columns.glossary_term: Parallel Artificial Membrane Permeability Assay (PAMPA) Permeability (nm/s)
columns.description: Passive transcellular permeability measured by PAMPA assay in nm/s. Complements Caco-2 data by isolating passive diffusion component, informing SAR optimization for membrane permeability.

columns.name: pgp_substrate
columns.description: Indicates whether the compound is identified as a P-glycoprotein (P-gp / MDR1) efflux transporter substrate based on Caco-2 bidirectional permeability or dedicated P-gp inhibition assay. Impacts CNS penetration and oral bioavailability predictions.
columns.reference: FDA Drug Interaction Guidance; EMA Guideline on Investigation of Drug Interactions; ICH M12

columns.name: plasma_protein_binding_pct
columns.description: Percentage of compound bound to plasma proteins (albumin, alpha-1-acid glycoprotein) measured by equilibrium dialysis or ultrafiltration. Determines free fraction available for pharmacological activity and clearance.
columns.reference: ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

columns.name: ppb_method
columns.description: Analytical method used to determine plasma protein binding percentage. Rapid equilibrium dialysis (RED) is the industry standard; method choice affects result interpretation and cross-study comparability.
columns.reference: ICH M10; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance

columns.name: profile_code
columns.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this ADME profiling run, used in ELN (IDBS/Dotmatics) and LIMS cross-referencing. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
columns.reference: IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics ELN; LabWare LIMS

columns.name: profile_status
columns.description: Current workflow state of the ADME profile record from data entry through scientific review and approval. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|completed|reviewed|approved|invalidated — promote to reference product if additional states are needed]
columns.reference: GLP 21 CFR Part 58; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl / TrackWise QMS

columns.name: progression_recommendation
columns.description: Scientific recommendation for compound progression based on the overall ADME profile assessment. Drives hit-to-lead and lead optimization decisions. Assigned by the ADME scientist upon profile review and approval.
columns.reference: ICH Q6A; internal drug discovery stage-gate criteria; FDA IND Guidance 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: rlm_clint_ul_min_mg
columns.description: Intrinsic metabolic clearance measured in rat liver microsomes (RLM), expressed as µL/min/mg protein. Supports cross-species PK scaling and preclinical-to-clinical translation of metabolic stability data.
columns.reference: ICH S7A; FDA Preclinical Safety Guidance; GLP 21 CFR Part 58

columns.name: solubility_method
columns.description: Analytical method used to determine aqueous solubility, distinguishing kinetic from thermodynamic measurements which have different interpretive implications for drug development.

columns.name: solubility_um
columns.description: Measured aqueous solubility of the compound in micromolar (µM), typically from kinetic or thermodynamic solubility assay. Critical for assessing oral bioavailability and formulation feasibility. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
columns.reference: ICH Q6A; FDA Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS)

columns.name: species
columns.description: Biological species from which the biological matrix (microsomes, plasma, cells) was derived for this ADME assay. Enables cross-species PK comparison and allometric scaling for preclinical-to-clinical translation.
columns.reference: ICH S7A; GLP 21 CFR Part 58; EMA Preclinical Guideline

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this ADME profile record. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.

columns.name: volume_of_distribution_l_kg
columns.description: Predicted or measured apparent volume of distribution (Vd) in L/kg, reflecting the extent of compound distribution into tissues versus plasma. Informs PK/PD modeling and dose prediction.
columns.reference: ICH M10; FDA Pharmacokinetics Guidance; EMA Guideline on Pharmacokinetics

tables.name: project
tables.description: Master record for drug discovery research projects organized around one or more therapeutic targets or disease indications. Captures project name, project code, therapeutic area, disease indication (ICD-10/MeSH reference), primary and secondary target identifiers (supporting multi-target programs), project phase (target identification, target validation, hit identification, hit-to-lead, lead optimization, candidate nomination), project status, start date, projected candidate nomination date, project leader, team members, budget allocation, strategic priority tier, external collaboration references, and portfolio governance decisions. Top-level organizational entity for the discovery domain providing project-centric views of all discovery activities.

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the drug discovery research project record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for all downstream joins within the discovery domain.

columns.name: budget_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: R&D portfolio budgeting: each discovery project has an allocated budget in finance for planning, variance reporting, and portfolio prioritization. Pharma finance controllers track project-level R&D sp

columns.name: drug_substance_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_substance. Business justification: Discovery projects are anchored to a drug substance (the active ingredient under development). Direct project→drug_substance linkage is required for CMC project tracking, regulatory strategy planning,

columns.name: fto_analysis_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.fto_analysis. Business justification: Discovery projects require FTO clearance at stage gates (target validation, lead optimization, candidate nomination); analysis linkage supports portfolio decisions, risk assessment, and strategic plan

columns.name: indication_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.indication. Business justification: Discovery projects are organized around specific disease indications. Linking to product.indication enables indication-level portfolio management, regulatory pathway planning, and alignment of discove

columns.name: internal_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: In SAP-based pharma R&D, a discovery project maps to a top-level internal order for cost settlement and program-level financial reporting. Child activities (HTS, SAR, synthesis) already carry internal

columns.name: licensing_agreement_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: Discovery projects often operate under collaboration or in-licensing agreements; linkage tracks licensed rights, diligence obligations, milestone triggers, and royalty terms for financial planning and

columns.name: medicinal_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Portfolio lineage tracking: connects research program to marketed medicine for ROI analysis, pipeline reporting, strategic planning. Essential for investment decisions, productivity metrics, and comme

columns.name: molecular_target_id
columns.description: Standardized identifier for the primary biological target (e.g., UniProt accession, HGNC gene symbol) the project is designed to modulate. Central to SAR analysis and MOA documentation in IDBS/Dotmatics ELN.
columns.reference: UniProt; HGNC; ChEMBL target nomenclature; ICH S7A/S7B safety pharmacology

columns.name: owning_org_unit_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Discovery projects are owned and managed by specific organizational units for governance, resource allocation, headcount planning, and portfolio management. Essential for matrix reporting and accounta

columns.name: strategy_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.strategy. Business justification: Every discovery project has a corresponding regulatory strategy defining its development pathway, designation targets, and submission sequence. Pharma portfolio governance requires tracing each discov

columns.name: therapeutic_area_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Discovery projects are organized and budgeted by therapeutic area. Linking to the master therapeutic_area entity is fundamental for portfolio management, strategic prioritization reporting, and TA-lev

columns.name: actual_candidate_nomination_date
columns.description: Date on which the development candidate was formally nominated and the project transitioned to preclinical development. Nullable until nomination occurs. Used for cycle time analytics and portfolio performance measurement.
columns.reference: ICH Q8(R2); 21 CFR 312; ISPE Drug Discovery guidelines

columns.name: atc_code
columns.description: WHO ATC classification code assigned to the intended drug product based on its therapeutic target and mechanism. Used for market analysis, competitive intelligence, and regulatory classification.
columns.reference: WHO ATC/DDD Index; EMA product classification; INN guidelines

columns.name: collaboration_partner_name
columns.description: Name of the primary external collaboration partner (CRO, academic institution, or partner pharma company) if external_collaboration_flag is true. Classified confidential as it reveals strategic partnership information.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; GDPR Article 28; SOX Section 302

columns.name: collaboration_type
columns.description: Classification of the external collaboration arrangement. Determines applicable contractual, IP, and regulatory frameworks governing data sharing and compound rights.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; GDPR Article 28; IP licensing frameworks

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the discovery project record was first created in the system of record (IDBS/Dotmatics or portfolio management system). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (MHRA Data Integrity Guidance); ICH E6(R2)

columns.name: eln_project_code
columns.description: Reference identifier for this discovery project in the IDBS E-WorkBook or Dotmatics ELN system. Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the authoritative source system for raw experimental data.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); ALCOA+ data integrity principles; IDBS E-WorkBook

columns.name: external_collaboration_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the project involves external partners such as CROs, academic institutions, or other pharmaceutical companies. Triggers additional data governance, IP agreement, and confidentiality controls.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; GDPR Article 28 (data processor agreements); 21 CFR 312

columns.name: glp_compliance_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the project's studies are conducted under GLP regulations as required for regulatory submission. GLP-compliant studies are required for safety data submitted in IND applications.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP); OECD Principles of GLP; EMA GLP guidelines

columns.name: hts_campaign_count
columns.description: Number of HTS campaigns executed under this discovery project. Provides a summary indicator of screening activity volume for portfolio reporting and resource utilization analysis.
columns.reference: ISPE Drug Discovery guidelines; ICH Q8(R2)

columns.name: icd10_code
columns.glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code
columns.description: Standardized ICD-10 disease classification code for the primary disease indication. Enables cross-domain linkage to clinical, regulatory, and medical affairs data and supports regulatory submissions.

columns.name: ip_strategy_note
columns.description: Brief description of the IP strategy for the project, including patentability assessment, freedom-to-operate (FTO) status, and filing intentions. Classified confidential as it contains pre-filing IP strategy.
columns.reference: USPTO; EPO; ICH Q10; SOX Section 302

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the discovery project record. Required for data lineage tracking, change control auditing, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (MHRA Data Integrity Guidance); ICH E6(R2)

columns.name: moa_description
columns.description: Scientific description of the proposed mechanism by which the drug candidate modulates the target to achieve therapeutic effect. Captured from ELN records in IDBS/Dotmatics. Critical for IND and NDA/BLA submissions.
columns.reference: ICH M4 (eCTD); FDA IND 21 CFR 312.23; EMA scientific guidelines

columns.name: modality
columns.description: Type of therapeutic modality being pursued in the project. Determines applicable regulatory pathway (NDA vs BLA), manufacturing approach (CMO vs CDMO), and GLP/GMP requirements. Distinguishes NCE from NBE programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: small_molecule|biologic|antibody|cell_therapy|gene_therapy|oligonucleotide|peptide — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR 312 (IND); EMA CHMP guidelines; ICH Q11 (biologics)

columns.name: phase
columns.description: Current stage of the drug discovery workflow. Progresses from target identification through candidate nomination, representing the standard industry gate-based progression model. Used for portfolio stage-gate reporting and resource planning.
columns.reference: ICH Q8(R2) Pharmaceutical Development; ISPE Drug Discovery guidelines

columns.name: portfolio_decision
columns.description: Most recent portfolio governance committee decision for the project. Recorded at each stage-gate review and drives resource reallocation and pipeline reporting.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; ISPE Drug Discovery; SOX Section 302

columns.name: portfolio_decision_date
columns.description: Date of the most recent portfolio governance committee decision. Used for audit trail and decision history tracking in conjunction with portfolio_decision.

columns.name: project_code
columns.description: Externally-known alphanumeric project identifier assigned by the portfolio governance office (e.g., DISC-20240001). Used as the business key across IDBS/Dotmatics ELN, SAP project structures, and regulatory submissions. Aligns with the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER canonical category.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; IDBS E-WorkBook naming conventions

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: Human-readable name of the drug discovery project (e.g., 'KRAS G12C Inhibitor Program'). Classified confidential as it may reveal pipeline strategy prior to public disclosure. Aligns with the IDENTITY_LABEL canonical category.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; SOX Section 302 (pipeline disclosure controls)

columns.name: project_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the discovery project as managed in the portfolio governance system. Drives portfolio dashboards and resource allocation decisions. Aligns with the LIFECYCLE_STATUS canonical category.
columns.reference: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System; FDA IND regulations 21 CFR 312

columns.name: project_type
columns.description: Classification of the discovery project by the nature of the entity being developed. NCE (New Chemical Entity) and NBE (New Biological Entity) drive distinct regulatory and IP strategies. Aligns with CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE canonical category.
columns.reference: FDA PDUFA; EMA CHMP; ICH Q11; 21 CFR 314 (NDA) and 21 CFR 601 (BLA)

columns.name: projected_candidate_nomination_date
columns.description: Target date by which a development candidate is expected to be nominated and handed off to preclinical development. Key milestone for pipeline planning, IND filing timelines, and portfolio forecasting.
columns.reference: ICH Q8(R2); FDA IND 21 CFR 312; ISPE Drug Discovery guidelines

columns.name: sap_wbs_element
columns.description: SAP Project System WBS element code that maps this discovery project to the financial controlling structure in SAP S/4HANA. Enables cost allocation, budget tracking, and financial reporting at the project level.
columns.reference: SAP PS (Project System) module; SAP CO; SOX Section 302

columns.name: sponsor
columns.description: Senior executive or therapeutic area head who sponsors and champions the project at the portfolio governance level. Distinct from the project leader who manages day-to-day execution.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Official date on which the discovery project was formally initiated and approved by portfolio governance. Used for project duration calculations, milestone tracking, and portfolio timeline reporting.

columns.name: strategic_priority_tier
columns.description: Portfolio governance classification indicating the strategic importance of the project (Tier 1 = highest priority, Tier 3 = exploratory). Drives resource allocation, budget prioritization, and executive reporting. Classified confidential as it reflects pipeline strategy.
columns.reference: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System; SOX Section 302

columns.name: target_organism
columns.description: Primary biological system or organism used in discovery assays and preclinical models. Relevant for GLP study design, species selection justification in IND applications, and ADME/PK modeling.
columns.reference: ICH S5(R3); ICH S6(R1); 21 CFR 58 (GLP); OECD GLP Principles

columns.name: termination_reason
columns.description: Documented reason for project termination or discontinuation (e.g., safety signal, lack of efficacy, strategic reprioritization, IP conflict). Nullable for active projects. Critical for lessons-learned analysis and portfolio retrospectives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety_signal|lack_of_efficacy|strategic_reprioritization|ip_conflict|resource_constraints|competitive_landscape|regulatory_concern — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH Q10; FDA IND 21 CFR 312.38 (IND withdrawal); EMA scientific advice

tables.name: candidate_nomination
tables.description: Transactional record capturing the formal nomination of a development candidate (DC) compound for progression from discovery into preclinical development. Captures nominated compound identifier, lead series identifier, discovery project identifier, nomination date, therapeutic area, target, proposed indication, key efficacy data summary, key safety data summary, ADME/PK profile summary, IP status, CMC feasibility assessment, nomination decision (approved, deferred, rejected), decision committee, and handoff date to preclinical team. Critical milestone event linking discovery to clinical development pipeline.

columns.name: candidate_nomination_id
columns.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the development candidate (DC) nomination record. Primary key for this transactional milestone event in the discovery-to-preclinical pipeline.

columns.name: adme_profile_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.adme_profile. Business justification: candidate_nomination has a text field adme_pk_summary capturing ADME/PK data in free text. Adding adme_profile_id FK normalizes this to point to the actual structured ADME profile record, enabling pre

columns.name: budget_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Candidate nomination is a formal stage gate that triggers IND-enabling budget allocation in pharma R&D finance. The nomination event initiates a new budget line for preclinical development. Finance an

columns.name: compound_id
columns.description: Reference to the nominated compound record in the compound library or ELN (IDBS E-WorkBook / Dotmatics). Links the nomination to the specific chemical or biological entity being advanced.

columns.name: drug_master_file_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.drug_master_file. Business justification: DMF filing strategy for the API is initiated at candidate nomination as part of IND preparation. The intellectual.drug_master_file tracks the confidentiality and IP instrument for the API. Pharma regu

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: Candidate nomination includes CMC feasibility assessment for the target drug product formulation. Direct candidate_nomination→drug_product linkage is required for formulation development planning, IND

columns.name: drug_substance_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_substance. Business justification: Candidate nomination triggers creation of the drug substance record for IND CMC sections. Direct candidate_nomination→drug_substance linkage is required for CMC feasibility assessment handoff and regu

columns.name: fto_analysis_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.fto_analysis. Business justification: FTO clearance is a mandatory formal requirement at candidate nomination before IND filing. The nomination package must include IP clearance documentation. Every pharma company tracks the FTO analysis

columns.name: hts_campaign_id
columns.description: Reference to the High-Throughput Screening (HTS) campaign in LIMS (LabWare or SampleManager) from which the hit compound was originally identified prior to lead optimization. Provides full traceability from HTS hit to development candidate.
columns.reference: GLP (21 CFR Part 58); LIMS SOP; ICH M4S

columns.name: indication_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.indication. Business justification: Candidate nominations are proposed for specific disease indications. Linking to product.indication enables indication-level pipeline tracking, regulatory pathway planning, and orphan drug designation

columns.name: internal_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Candidate nomination packages require cost tracking for the nomination process itself (committee meetings, documentation preparation, regulatory strategy) via internal orders for stage-gate cost analy

columns.name: lead_series_id
columns.description: Reference to the lead chemical series from which the nominated development candidate was optimized. Supports Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR) traceability and series-level portfolio analysis.

columns.name: licensing_agreement_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: In-licensed compounds nominated as candidates require tracking of the governing licensing agreement for milestone payment obligations and diligence requirements triggered at nomination. Pharma busines

columns.name: manufacturing_plant_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Candidate nominations assess manufacturing feasibility at specific plants for CMC planning, capacity assessment, and tech transfer readiness. Links discovery candidates to manufacturing infrastructure

columns.name: molecular_target_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.molecular_target. Business justification: candidate_nomination has a STRING field named 'molecular_target' which is a denormalized text reference to the molecular target entity. Adding molecular_target_id FK normalizes this to a proper refere

columns.name: patent_claim_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_claim. Business justification: The IP section of a candidate nomination package cites specific patent claims covering the nominated compound (composition of matter, method of use). IP teams formally document claim coverage at nomin

columns.name: patent_family_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Nominated candidates require robust patent protection assessment for IND readiness; patent family linkage supports IP due diligence, regulatory exclusivity strategy, and go/no-go decisions at nominati

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Reference to the parent drug discovery project under which this candidate was identified and optimized. Links the nomination to the originating research program in the discovery portfolio.
columns.reference: ICH M4; 21 CFR Part 312; Internal R&D Portfolio Governance SOP

columns.name: sar_study_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.sar_study. Business justification: A candidate nomination is the formal culmination of SAR work — the nomination committee reviews SAR study findings (potency, selectivity, ADME impact) before approving a development candidate. candida

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.site. Business justification: Candidate nomination CMC feasibility assessment and preclinical supply planning are tied to a specific manufacturing site. Pharma domain experts expect candidate_nomination to identify the designated

columns.name: therapeutic_area_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Candidate nominations are reviewed and prioritized by therapeutic area portfolio committees. Linking to the master therapeutic_area entity is required for TA-level portfolio gate review reporting and

columns.name: trademark_id
