columns.description: Flag indicating whether the subject is included in the modified Intent-to-Treat (mITT) analysis population. Criteria for mITT inclusion are protocol-defined (e.g., received at least one dose). Supports secondary efficacy analyses.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Section 5.2; ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; 21 CFR Part 314

columns.name: pp_population_flag
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the subject is included in the Per-Protocol (PP) analysis population. True = subject completed the trial per protocol without major deviations. Used for sensitivity analyses in NDA/BLA/MAA submissions.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Section 5.2; ICH E9(R1); 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Guideline on Statistical Principles

columns.name: randomization_code
columns.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned by the RTSM system at the point of randomization, linking the subject to their treatment arm assignment within the randomization schedule. Confidential during blinded phase; revealed only upon unblinding. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM.
columns.reference: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

columns.name: randomization_date
columns.description: Date on which the subject was randomized and assigned to a treatment arm via the RTSM system. May differ from enrollment_date in trials with a run-in period. Null for screen-failed or non-randomized subjects.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: rave_subject_key
columns.description: The natural/business key for this subject enrollment record as assigned by Medidata Rave EDC/RTSM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing back to the authoritative EDC source system.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: screen_failure_reason
columns.description: Coded or free-text reason why a subject failed screening and was not enrolled. Populated only when enrollment_status = screen_failed. Used for protocol feasibility analysis and site performance monitoring. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC screen failure CRF.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; CDISC CDASH Standard

columns.name: screening_date
columns.description: Date on which the subject first presented at the investigational site for screening assessments. Marks the start of the eligibility evaluation period. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: screening_number
columns.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a subject at the point of screening, prior to eligibility confirmation. Format is site-specific and assigned sequentially by the RTSM system in Medidata Rave. Used to track screen failures and pre-enrollment activity.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: stratification_factor_1
columns.description: Value of the first stratification factor used to balance treatment arm assignments across key prognostic variables (e.g., disease stage, geographic region, biomarker status). Defined in the trial protocol and captured at randomization in RTSM.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Section 2.3; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

columns.name: stratification_factor_2
columns.description: Value of the second stratification factor used to balance treatment arm assignments (e.g., prior therapy, performance status, age group). Null if the trial uses fewer than two stratification factors. Captured at randomization in RTSM.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Section 2.3; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

columns.name: stratification_factor_3
columns.description: Value of the third stratification factor used to balance treatment arm assignments (e.g., country, mutation status, weight band). Null if the trial uses fewer than three stratification factors. Captured at randomization in RTSM.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Section 2.3; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

columns.name: subject_number
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a subject upon successful enrollment into the trial. Typically formatted as site-number-sequential-ID (e.g., 001-001). Assigned by Medidata Rave RTSM upon eligibility confirmation and enrollment confirmation.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: treatment_arm_code
columns.description: Code identifying the treatment arm (e.g., active drug, placebo, comparator, dose level) to which the subject was assigned at randomization. Confidential in blinded trials. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM randomization schedule.
columns.reference: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: treatment_arm_description
columns.description: Human-readable description of the treatment arm assignment (e.g., 'Drug A 100mg QD', 'Placebo', 'Drug B 200mg BID'). Confidential in blinded trials. Complements treatment_arm_code for reporting and analysis.
columns.reference: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH Standard

columns.name: unblinding_date
columns.description: Date on which the subject's treatment assignment was unblinded. Populated only when blinding_status = unblinded. Emergency unblinding events must be documented per GCP. Null for blinded or open-label subjects.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Guideline on Blinding

columns.name: unblinding_reason
columns.description: Coded reason for the unblinding of the subject's treatment assignment. Emergency unblinding (e.g., for medical management of a Serious Adverse Event) must be documented and reported per GCP and pharmacovigilance requirements. Null for blinded or open-label subjects.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on Blinding

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified in the source system. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: withdrawal_date
columns.description: Date on which the subject withdrew from the trial or was discontinued. Populated only when enrollment_status = withdrawn. Used for survival analysis (censoring) and dropout rate reporting.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC CDASH Standard

columns.name: withdrawal_reason
columns.description: Coded or free-text reason for subject withdrawal or discontinuation from the trial (e.g., adverse event, consent withdrawal, lost to follow-up, protocol deviation, investigator decision). Null for active or completed subjects. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: adverse_event|consent_withdrawal|lost_to_follow_up|protocol_deviation|investigator_decision|sponsor_decision|death|other — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9; CDISC CDASH Standard; 21 CFR Part 312

tables.name: visit
tables.description: Transactional record for each scheduled or unscheduled patient visit within a clinical trial, as captured in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Tracks visit number, visit name per protocol schedule of assessments, planned visit date, actual visit date, visit window compliance, visit type (screening, treatment, follow-up, end-of-study), visit status, and deviations noted. Forms the backbone of the clinical data collection timeline.
tables.reference: Visit Record / Schedule of Assessments (Medidata Rave EDC)

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each patient visit record within the clinical trial data product on the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP); 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: clinical_enrollment_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.enrollment. Business justification: Patient visits occur within the context of a specific enrollment. While visit already has participant_id, trial_id, and site_id, linking to enrollment provides the complete enrollment context includin

columns.name: clinical_supply_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.clinical_supply_order. Business justification: At each dispensing visit, the IRT system fulfills a clinical supply order. Linking visit to clinical_supply_order supports per-visit IMP dispensation accountability logs required under GCP and IMP acc

columns.name: investigational_site_id
columns.description: Reference to the investigational site where the visit took place. Links to the site master record in CTMS (Oracle/Siebel).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

columns.name: investigator_id
columns.description: Reference to the principal investigator or sub-investigator who conducted or supervised this visit. Links to the investigator master record in CTMS (Oracle/Siebel).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Form 1572

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) who attended this visit. Links to the subject/patient master record in the EDC (Medidata Rave) and CTMS (Oracle/Siebel).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

columns.name: protocol_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial protocol version that governs the schedule of assessments for this visit. Links to the protocol master record.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E8; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical study (trial) under which this visit was conducted. Links to the study master record in CTMS.

columns.name: actual_date
columns.description: The date on which the visit actually occurred as recorded in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Corresponds to the CDISC CDASH VISDAT field. Null if the visit was missed or cancelled.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH VISDAT; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

columns.name: ae_reported_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether one or more Adverse Events (AEs) were reported at or since the previous visit (True) or not (False). Triggers downstream pharmacovigilance workflows in Argus Safety / Oracle AERS.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

columns.name: arm_name
columns.description: The name of the treatment arm or study arm to which the subject was assigned at the time of this visit (e.g., 'Drug A 100mg', 'Placebo', 'Drug A + Drug B Combination'). Sourced from CTMS and EDC randomization records.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM v3.3 TA Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9

columns.name: blinding_status
columns.description: Indicates the blinding status of the subject and/or investigator at the time of this visit. Unblinded records are restricted to authorized personnel only and are critical for data integrity in double-blind trials.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Blinding

columns.name: completion_pct
columns.description: The percentage of protocol-required assessments and procedures that were completed at this visit (0.00–100.00). Supports partial visit analysis and data completeness reporting for regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: conmed_updated_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the subject's concomitant medication list was reviewed and updated at this visit (True) or not (False). Supports safety and drug-drug interaction analysis.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH CM Domain; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this visit record was first created in the source EDC system (Medidata Rave). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: data_entry_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when the visit data was first entered into the EDC system (Medidata Rave) by the site staff. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC

columns.name: data_lock_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when the visit record was locked in the EDC (Medidata Rave), preventing further data entry or modification without an authorized unlock. Null if the record has not yet been locked.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC

columns.name: day_from_reference
columns.description: The study day number calculated from the subject's reference date (typically first dose date or randomization date) to the actual visit date. Corresponds to the CDISC VISITDY variable. Negative values indicate pre-dose visits.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM v3.3 VISITDY; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: deviation_category
columns.description: Classification of the protocol deviation severity at this visit: major (could affect subject safety or data integrity), minor (unlikely to affect safety or data integrity), or administrative (procedural/documentation only).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations (2023); EMA GCP Inspections

columns.name: deviation_description
columns.description: Free-text description of the protocol deviation(s) noted at this visit, as recorded by the site in the EDC or CTMS. Null when deviation_flag is False.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

columns.name: deviation_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether one or more protocol deviations were recorded for this visit (True) or not (False). A True value triggers linkage to the protocol deviation register in the CTMS or eTMF (Veeva Vault).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

columns.name: early_termination_reason
columns.description: The reason the subject discontinued the study at or before this visit, if applicable. Null for non-termination visits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: adverse_event|withdrawal_of_consent|lost_to_follow_up|protocol_violation|sponsor_decision|death|other — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH DS Domain; 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E9

columns.name: edc_visit_oid
columns.glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Visit Object Identifier (OID)
columns.description: The unique object identifier (OID) assigned to this visit record within the Medidata Rave EDC system. Used for traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the source EDC system.
columns.reference: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC ODM v1.3; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: epoch
columns.description: The trial epoch during which this visit occurred, as defined in the CDISC SDTM Trial Design model (e.g., Screening, Run-In, Treatment, Follow-Up, Post-Study). Supports epoch-level analysis.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM v3.3 TE Domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

columns.name: informed_consent_verified
columns.description: Indicates whether the subject's current informed consent form (ICF) was verified as valid and current at the time of this visit (True) or not (False). Critical for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC; GDPR Article 7

columns.name: planned_date
columns.description: The date on which the visit was scheduled to occur per the protocol Schedule of Assessments and the subject's randomization or enrollment anchor date.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH VISDAT; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: query_open_count
columns.description: The number of data queries (discrepancies) currently open against this visit record in the EDC (Medidata Rave). A non-zero value indicates outstanding data cleaning actions required before database lock.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC Data Management

columns.name: randomization_number
columns.description: The unique randomization number assigned to the subject at the time of randomization, as recorded in the Interactive Response Technology (IRT) system. Confidential as it may reveal treatment assignment in blinded trials.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC CDASH RNDM

columns.name: sae_reported_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether one or more Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) were reported at this visit (True) or not (False). SAEs require expedited reporting to health authorities per ICH E2A and 21 CFR Part 312.32.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; ICH E6(R2) GCP

columns.name: source_verified_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) has been completed for this visit by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or monitor (True) or not (False). Critical for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18.3; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this visit record was last modified in the source EDC system (Medidata Rave) or during Silver Layer processing. Supports audit trail and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: visit_name
columns.description: Human-readable label for the visit as defined in the protocol Schedule of Assessments (e.g., 'Screening', 'Cycle 1 Day 1', 'Week 12 Follow-Up', 'End of Study'). Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC visit folder name.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; Medidata Rave EDC

columns.name: visit_number
columns.description: Sequential numeric identifier for the visit as defined in the protocol Schedule of Assessments (SoA). Unscheduled visits may carry a non-integer or supplemental numbering convention captured separately.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: visit_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the visit record indicating whether the visit was completed, missed, partially completed, cancelled, or rescheduled. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC and CTMS.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; Medidata Rave EDC

columns.name: visit_type
columns.description: Classification of the visit according to its role in the trial timeline. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: screening|baseline|treatment|follow_up|end_of_study|unscheduled|early_termination — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH v2.0; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: window_lower_day
columns.description: The number of days before the planned visit date that defines the lower boundary of the acceptable visit window per the protocol. Used to assess visit window compliance.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: window_upper_day
columns.description: The number of days after the planned visit date that defines the upper boundary of the acceptable visit window per the protocol. Used to assess visit window compliance.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: within_window_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the actual visit date fell within the protocol-defined visit window (True) or outside it (False). Derived at ingestion from planned_date, actual_date, window_lower_day, and window_upper_day; stored for analytical efficiency.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312

tables.name: crf_form
tables.description: Master record for each Case Report Form (CRF) design used in a trial, representing the electronic data capture instrument definition in Medidata Rave. Captures form name, form OID, associated visit, data domain (SDTM domain mapping), version, validation rules, completion requirements, and approval status. Distinct from CRF data (captured in subject_observation) — this is the instrument definition, not the collected data.

columns.name: crf_form_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CRF form definition record in the Medidata Rave electronic data capture system. Primary key for the crf_form data product.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: protocol_id
columns.description: Reference to the specific trial protocol version under which this CRF form definition was created and approved. Ensures form-to-protocol traceability.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial for which this CRF form definition was designed. Links the instrument definition to its parent study in the CTMS.

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled visit with which this CRF form is associated in the study schedule of events. Null for common forms appearing across all visits.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM TV Domain

columns.name: annotation_text
columns.description: Annotated CRF text describing the SDTM variable mappings, derivation rules, and coding instructions associated with each field on this form. Used by data management and programming teams for SDTM dataset creation.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

columns.name: approval_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle approval state of the CRF form definition. 'draft' indicates design in progress; 'under_review' indicates pending sponsor/CRO review; 'approved' indicates GCP-compliant sign-off; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'retired' indicates no longer in use.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: approved_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when this CRF form definition received formal GCP-compliant approval. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

columns.name: cdash_domain
columns.glossary_term: Clinical Data Acquisition Standards Harmonization (CDASH) Domain
columns.description: CDISC CDASH domain code indicating the data collection standard this form adheres to (e.g., 'AE', 'VS', 'CM'). Ensures harmonized data collection aligned with CDASH implementation guides.
columns.reference: CDISC CDASH Implementation Guide v2.0; ICH E6(R2)

columns.name: completion_instructions
columns.description: Detailed instructions for site staff on how to complete this CRF form, including definitions, coding conventions, and data source guidance. Embedded in the EDC and printed CRF booklet.

columns.name: completion_requirement
columns.description: Specifies whether completion of this CRF form is mandatory for all subjects, optional, or conditional on specific criteria (e.g., only if a prior form field triggers it). Drives data completeness monitoring and query generation.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when this CRF form definition record was first created in the system. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: data_entry_mode
columns.description: Specifies the data entry mode configured for this CRF form in Medidata Rave. 'single' requires one entry; 'double' requires independent dual entry for critical data; 'auto' is populated programmatically from device or lab feeds.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; Medidata Rave Configuration Guide

columns.name: edit_check_count
columns.description: Total number of programmed edit checks (validation rules) configured for this CRF form in Medidata Rave. Provides a measure of form complexity and data quality control coverage.
columns.reference: CDISC Edit Check Specification; Medidata Rave Study Design

columns.name: effective_end_date
columns.glossary_term: Case Report Form (CRF) Effective End Date
columns.description: Date on which this CRF form version was retired or superseded. Null for currently active versions. Supports version lifecycle management and historical data traceability.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: effective_start_date
columns.glossary_term: Case Report Form (CRF) Effective Start Date
columns.description: Date from which this CRF form version is active and available for data entry at investigational sites. Supports version management and ensures sites use the correct form version.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; Medidata Rave Study Design

columns.name: field_count
columns.description: Total number of data fields (questions/items) defined on this CRF form. Used for form complexity assessment, site burden estimation, and data management planning.
columns.reference: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Study Design Specification

columns.name: form_label
columns.description: Short display label for the CRF form used in the EDC user interface and printed CRF booklets. May differ from form_name for brevity in UI contexts.
columns.reference: CDISC CDASH; Medidata Rave Study Design

columns.name: form_name
columns.description: Human-readable name of the CRF form as displayed in Medidata Rave and study documentation. Examples: 'Adverse Event Form', 'Vital Signs', 'Concomitant Medications'.

columns.name: form_oid
columns.description: Unique Object Identifier (OID) for the CRF form as defined in Medidata Rave and conforming to CDISC ODM standards. Used for cross-system referencing and SDTM mapping. Example: 'AE_FORM_V2'.
columns.reference: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide

columns.name: form_order
columns.description: Numeric sequence order of this form within its associated visit or study schedule of events. Determines the display order in the EDC and printed CRF booklet.
columns.reference: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; Medidata Rave Study Design

columns.name: form_type
columns.description: Classification of the CRF form by its data collection pattern in Medidata Rave. 'scheduled' forms appear at predefined visits; 'unscheduled' are event-driven; 'common' appear across all visits; 'log' forms capture repeating events (e.g., AE log); 'repeating' forms allow multiple instances per visit.
columns.reference: Medidata Rave Study Design Specification; CDISC CDASH

columns.name: form_version
columns.description: Version identifier of the CRF form definition, following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', '3.0.1'). Tracks design changes over the trial lifecycle and supports audit trail requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

columns.name: is_blinded
columns.description: Indicates whether this CRF form contains blinded data (e.g., treatment assignment, randomization code) that must be restricted from unblinded personnel during the trial. Supports GCP-compliant blinding controls.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: is_repeating
columns.description: Indicates whether this CRF form allows multiple instances per subject per visit (e.g., an Adverse Event log form where each AE is a separate instance). Drives EDC configuration in Medidata Rave.
columns.reference: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; Medidata Rave Study Design Specification

columns.name: is_sdv_required
columns.description: Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) is required for data entered on this CRF form. Critical forms (e.g., primary endpoints, safety data) typically require 100% SDV; others may be risk-based.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based Quality Management

columns.name: is_signature_required
columns.description: Indicates whether an electronic signature (e-signature) is required on this CRF form by the investigator or site staff upon completion, as mandated by 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

columns.name: itt_population_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this CRF form contributes data to the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population definition. ITT-relevant forms are critical for primary efficacy analysis and regulatory review.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on ITT Principle

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when this CRF form definition record was last modified. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, change control, and GCP compliance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: primary_endpoint_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this CRF form captures data for the trial's primary efficacy or safety endpoint (e.g., ORR, PFS, OS). Primary endpoint forms receive heightened monitoring, SDV, and data review scrutiny.
columns.reference: ICH E9(R1) Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

columns.name: rave_form_draft_version
columns.description: The internal Medidata Rave draft version number for this CRF form, distinct from the business version. Tracks incremental design changes within the Rave study build environment prior to promotion to production.
columns.reference: Medidata Rave Study Design Specification; 21 CFR Part 11; CSV Validation

columns.name: rave_study_name
columns.description: The study name as configured in Medidata Rave EDC system, used to identify the parent study context for this CRF form. Supports cross-referencing between the data lakehouse and the source EDC system.
columns.reference: Medidata Rave Study Design Specification; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: regulatory_submission_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether data collected on this CRF form is included in regulatory submissions (NDA/BLA/MAA/IND). Drives SDTM dataset inclusion and eCTD packaging requirements.
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH M4E; eCTD Specification

columns.name: safety_form_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this CRF form is designated as a safety-critical form (e.g., Adverse Event, Serious Adverse Event, SUSAR reporting). Safety forms trigger expedited review workflows and pharmacovigilance data feeds.
columns.reference: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

columns.name: sdtm_domain
columns.description: Two-letter CDISC SDTM domain code to which this CRF form maps for regulatory submission (e.g., 'AE' for Adverse Events, 'VS' for Vital Signs, 'CM' for Concomitant Medications, 'LB' for Laboratory). Drives SDTM dataset generation for NDA/BLA/MAA submissions.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

columns.name: sdv_percentage
columns.description: The percentage of data points on this CRF form subject to Source Data Verification (SDV) under the risk-based monitoring plan. Ranges from 0.00 (no SDV) to 100.00 (full SDV). Supports risk-based monitoring strategy.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18.3; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

columns.name: source_system_form_code
columns.description: Native identifier of this CRF form record in the source EDC system (Medidata Rave). Enables lineage tracing from the Silver Layer back to the operational system of record.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data; Data Lineage Best Practices

columns.name: validation_rule_set
columns.glossary_term: Case Report Form (CRF) Validation Rule Set
columns.description: Identifier or name of the edit check / validation rule set applied to this CRF form in Medidata Rave. References the programmed edit checks that enforce data quality, range checks, and cross-form consistency rules.
columns.reference: CDISC Edit Check Specification; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: visit_oid
columns.description: CDISC ODM-compliant OID of the study visit to which this form is assigned, as defined in Medidata Rave. Supports cross-system visit-form linkage without requiring a resolved FK at this stage.
columns.reference: CDISC ODM 1.3.2; Medidata Rave Study Design

tables.name: subject_observation
tables.description: Core transactional table capturing all clinical data collected per subject per visit per CRF form in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Stores data point value, unit, SDTM variable mapping, collection date, data entry date, query status, source data verification (SDV) status, and audit trail reference. Represents the atomic unit of clinical trial data — the foundation for efficacy and safety endpoint derivation (ORR, PFS, OS, QoL) and CDISC SDTM/ADaM dataset generation.
tables.reference: EDC Data Record (Medidata Rave / CDISC SDTM)

columns.name: subject_observation_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each subject observation record in the EDC (Medidata Rave). Represents the atomic unit of clinical trial data collected per subject per visit per Case Report Form (CRF) field.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: clinical_enrollment_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.enrollment. Business justification: Clinical observations are collected for enrolled subjects. Linking subject_observation to enrollment provides treatment arm context and enables filtering observations by analysis population (ITT, mITT

columns.name: crf_form_id
columns.description: Reference to the CRF form definition from which this observation originates. Identifies the instrument (e.g., Vital Signs, Lab Results, Adverse Events) used to collect the data point.
columns.reference: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: investigational_site_id
columns.description: Reference to the investigational site where the observation was collected. Supports site-level data quality monitoring, SDV tracking, and regulatory inspection readiness.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Reference to the enrolled trial subject (patient) from whom this observation was collected. Enables subject-level data aggregation for ITT, PP, and safety analyses.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

columns.name: protocol_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.protocol. Business justification: Clinical observations are collected according to protocol-defined data collection standards and edit checks. Linking subject_observation to protocol enables verification that observations were collect

columns.name: quality_deviation_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Protocol deviations identified in subject observations (protocol_deviation_flag=true) must be formally escalated to quality deviation records per GCP requirements. This FK enables direct traceability

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial (study) under which this observation was collected. Links the observation to the parent trial protocol, phase, and regulatory submission context.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Subject observations record numeric clinical measurements requiring standardized UoM for CDISC/SDTM regulatory submissions and cross-trial data analysis. unit and standard_unit are denormalized plain-

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which this observation was collected. Supports visit-level data alignment and protocol deviation detection.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG

columns.name: analysis_population_flag
columns.description: Indicates the analysis population(s) to which this observation contributes: Intent-to-Treat (ITT), Per Protocol (PP), Safety population, or excluded. Drives statistical analysis dataset (ADaM) construction and primary/secondary endpoint derivation.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM IG; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle; EMA Guideline on Missing Data

columns.name: audit_trail_reference
columns.description: Reference identifier linking this observation to its complete audit trail record in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Enables traceability of all data changes, user actions, and timestamps per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 1.45; EMA Reflection Paper on Expectations for Electronic Source Data

columns.name: collection_date
columns.description: The calendar date on which the observation was collected from the subject at the investigational site. Corresponds to SDTM --DTC variable. Critical for visit window compliance, protocol deviation assessment, and time-to-event endpoint calculations.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM IG (--DTC); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: collection_timestamp
columns.description: The precise date and time at which the observation was collected, including time zone offset. Required for time-sensitive measurements (e.g., PK sampling, ECG) and for accurate SDTM --STDTC derivation.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM IG (--STDTC); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: crf_field_name
columns.description: The name of the specific CRF field (data point) within the form from which this observation was collected (e.g., SYSBP, WEIGHT, AESTDTC). Corresponds to the EDC field label in Medidata Rave.
columns.reference: CDISC CDASH IG; CDISC SDTM IG; ICH E6(R2)

columns.name: data_lock_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this observation record has been locked in the EDC system as part of the database lock process, preventing further modifications. Locked records are used for final statistical analysis and regulatory submission datasets.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Database Lock

columns.name: edc_record_reference
columns.description: Native record identifier assigned by the EDC system (Medidata Rave) for this observation. Used for source system traceability, audit trail reconciliation, and data migration validation.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave Data Model

columns.name: entry_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time at which the data was first entered into the EDC system (Medidata Rave) by the site user. Used for data entry timeliness monitoring, audit trail compliance, and GCP inspection readiness per ICH E6(R2).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave Audit Trail

columns.name: is_baseline
columns.description: Indicates whether this observation represents the baseline measurement for the subject, used as the reference value for change-from-baseline calculations in efficacy endpoint derivation (e.g., tumor size at baseline for ORR). Corresponds to SDTM ABLFL flag in ADaM datasets.
columns.reference: CDISC ADaM IG (ABLFL); ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Guidance on Efficacy Endpoints

columns.name: is_unscheduled
columns.description: Indicates whether this observation was collected during an unscheduled visit (not defined in the protocol schedule of assessments). Unscheduled observations may be excluded from primary efficacy analyses per the statistical analysis plan.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; Protocol Schedule of Assessments

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time of the most recent modification to this observation record in the EDC system. Supports audit trail tracking, data change monitoring, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave Audit Trail

columns.name: normal_range_high
columns.description: The upper bound of the reference (normal) range for this observation type as defined by the central laboratory or clinical standard. Used for out-of-range flagging, safety signal detection, and SDTM STNRHI derivation.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM IG (STNRHI); ICH E3 Clinical Study Report; FDA Safety Reporting Guidelines

columns.name: normal_range_low
columns.description: The lower bound of the reference (normal) range for this observation type as defined by the central laboratory or clinical standard. Used for out-of-range flagging, safety signal detection, and SDTM STNRLO derivation.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM IG (STNRLO); ICH E3 Clinical Study Report; FDA Safety Reporting Guidelines

columns.name: numeric_value
columns.description: The numeric representation of the observation value after unit standardization, corresponding to the SDTM STRESN variable. Used for quantitative analyses, endpoint derivation (ORR, PFS, OS), and statistical modeling in ADaM datasets.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM IG (STRESN); CDISC ADaM IG; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

columns.name: observation_status
columns.description: Current workflow status of the observation record within the EDC system lifecycle. Drives data cleaning workflows, lock readiness assessment, and database lock milestones. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entered|verified|locked|queried|resolved|deleted — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave Workflow

columns.name: out_of_range_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the numeric observation value falls outside the defined normal reference range (low or high). Triggers safety review workflows, potential AE/SAE reporting, and DSMB notification processes.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); ICH E3; FDA Safety Reporting Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: protocol_deviation_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this observation is associated with a protocol deviation (e.g., collected outside the visit window, wrong procedure performed). Flagged observations may be excluded from Per Protocol (PP) analysis populations.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

columns.name: query_status
columns.description: Status of any data query (discrepancy) raised against this observation in the EDC system. Open queries must be resolved prior to database lock. Supports data cleaning metrics and site performance monitoring.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

columns.name: query_text
columns.description: The text of the most recent data query raised against this observation, describing the discrepancy or clarification required from the site. Supports data management review and site communication workflows.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Guidelines

columns.name: raw_value
columns.description: The verbatim data value as entered by the site user in the EDC system (Medidata Rave), prior to any derivation or standardization. Stored as STRING to accommodate all data types (numeric, text, coded). Represents the source data for SDV and audit trail purposes.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM ORRES variable convention

columns.name: reason_for_change
columns.description: The documented reason provided by the site user when modifying a previously entered observation value in the EDC system. Mandatory per 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP requirements for any post-entry data correction. Stored as the most recent change reason.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9.3; EMA GCP Guidelines

columns.name: sdtm_domain
columns.description: CDISC SDTM domain code to which this observation maps (e.g., VS for Vital Signs, LB for Laboratory, AE for Adverse Events, EX for Exposure). Critical for SDTM dataset generation and regulatory submission packages (NDA/BLA/MAA).
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM IG v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

columns.name: sdtm_variable
columns.glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Variable Name
columns.description: The specific CDISC SDTM variable name to which this CRF field maps (e.g., VSSTRESN, LBORRES, AEDECOD). Enables automated SDTM dataset generation and submission-ready data transformation.
columns.reference: CDISC SDTM IG v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

columns.name: sdv_date
columns.description: The date on which Source Data Verification (SDV) was completed for this observation. Used for monitoring visit planning, SDV coverage reporting, and GCP audit trail documentation.

columns.name: sdv_status
columns.description: Status of Source Data Verification (SDV) for this observation, indicating whether the EDC-entered value has been verified against the original source document (e.g., medical record, lab report) by the CRA or site monitor. Critical for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

columns.name: toxicity_grade
columns.glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Toxicity Grade
columns.description: The NCI CTCAE toxicity grade assigned to this observation when it represents an adverse finding (Grade 1=Mild, Grade 2=Moderate, Grade 3=Severe, Grade 4=Life-threatening, Grade 5=Death). Critical for safety endpoint reporting, dose modification decisions, and regulatory safety narratives.
columns.reference: NCI CTCAE v5.0; ICH E3; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting; CDISC SDTM AE Domain

columns.name: verified_by
columns.description: The username or identifier of the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or monitor who performed Source Data Verification (SDV) for this observation. Supports GCP compliance documentation and monitoring visit reports.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

tables.name: trial_adverse_event
tables.description: Transactional record for each Adverse Event (AE) reported by a subject during a clinical trial, as captured in the EDC and CTMS. Captures AE term (MedDRA coded), onset date, resolution date, severity grade (CTCAE), seriousness flag (SAE), causality assessment, action taken (dose modification, discontinuation), outcome, and SAE/SUSAR reporting status. Distinct from the pharmacovigilance domain's ICSR — this is the trial-level AE record feeding into safety reporting workflows.
tables.reference: AE/SAE Record (Medidata Rave / ICH E2A / CTCAE)

columns.name: trial_adverse_event_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each adverse event record reported by a subject during a clinical trial. Primary key for this transactional entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting

columns.name: ae_accounts_payable_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: SAE processing triggers vendor invoices for emergency labs, imaging, hospitalization, and specialist consultations. Required for trial cost reconciliation, safety budget tracking, and sponsor financia

columns.name: brand_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: Adverse event surveillance requires brand-level aggregation for pharmacovigilance, periodic safety update reports (PSURs), label updates, and commercial risk assessment. Essential for post-marketing s

columns.name: clinical_enrollment_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.enrollment. Business justification: Adverse events are reported for enrolled subjects and must be analyzed by treatment arm for safety assessment. Linking trial_adverse_event to enrollment enables treatment arm stratification of AE data

columns.name: crf_form_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.crf_form. Business justification: Adverse events are captured via specific CRF forms (AE CRF) in the EDC system. Linking trial_adverse_event to crf_form enables traceability to the data collection instrument, supports source data veri

columns.name: icsr_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacovigilance.icsr. Business justification: EDC-to-safety reconciliation (ICH E2B, FDA 21 CFR 312.32) requires linking each trial AE to its corresponding ICSR in the PV system. argus_case_reference is a denormalized text reference to the ICSR t

columns.name: inventory_lot_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: SUSAR and SAE causality assessments require identifying the exact inventory lot dispensed to the subject. ICH E6 GCP and pharmacovigilance regulations mandate lot-level traceability for adverse events

columns.name: investigational_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.investigational_product. Business justification: Adverse events require causality assessment to specific investigational products. While concomitant_medication field exists, there is no structured link to the IMP that may have caused the AE. This FK

columns.name: investigational_site_id
columns.description: Reference to the investigational site where the adverse event was reported and the subject is enrolled.

columns.name: labeling_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.labeling. Business justification: Unexpected SAEs and SUSARs trigger label update workflows — the AE must be assessed against the current approved labeling to determine if it is 'unexpected'. Pharmacovigilance and regulatory affairs r

columns.name: master_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to hcp.hcp_master. Business justification: Adverse events are often reported by treating physicians who are not the principal investigator. Regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA) require traceability of the reporting healthcare professional for cau

columns.name: medicinal_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: AE causality assessment requires product identification. Mandatory for pharmacovigilance (21 CFR 312.32), PSUR/PBRER preparation, product labeling updates, and regulatory safety reporting. Critical fo

columns.name: patient_adverse_event_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to patient.adverse_event. Business justification: Pharmacovigilance reconciliation requires linking trial CRF-captured AEs (trial_adverse_event) to patient safety database records (patient.adverse_event) for SUSAR/SAE reporting, signal detection, and

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) who experienced the adverse event. Links to the subject/patient master record in the CTMS.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Clinical / Siebel CTMS

columns.name: product_complaint_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to quality.complaint. Business justification: Product complaints reported during clinical trials (packaging defects, appearance issues, administration problems) are tracked in quality complaint system per 21 CFR 820.198. Enables trend analysis an

columns.name: protocol_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.protocol. Business justification: Adverse event reporting criteria, grading scales (CTCAE), and expectedness assessments are defined in the protocol. Linking AE to protocol version enables correct application of protocol-defined AE as

columns.name: pv_adverse_reaction_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacovigilance.pv_adverse_reaction. Business justification: EDC-safety reconciliation (GVP Module VI) requires matching each trial AE verbatim term to its MedDRA-coded pv_adverse_reaction. meddra_preferred_term, meddra_pt_code, meddra_system_organ_class on tri

columns.name: regulatory_submission_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Serious unexpected adverse events (SUSARs) trigger mandatory expedited regulatory reporting obligations. Pharmacovigilance teams must track which AEs resulted in expedited safety reports (15-day alert

columns.name: reporting_investigator_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to hcp.investigator. Business justification: Regulatory AE reporting (MedWatch, EudraVigilance) requires identifying the reporting investigator by role, not just the HCP master. This FK enables investigator-level safety signal tracking, GCP comp

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial (study) in which the adverse event was reported. Links to the trial protocol master record.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Clinical / Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.visit. Business justification: Adverse events are typically reported during specific patient visits. Linking AE to visit provides temporal and operational context for when the event was observed and documented. The onset_date captu

columns.name: action_taken
columns.description: Action taken with the investigational medicinal product (IMP) in response to the adverse event (e.g., Dose not changed, Dose reduced, Drug interrupted, Drug withdrawn, Not applicable). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Dose not changed|Dose reduced|Drug interrupted|Drug withdrawn|Not applicable|Unknown — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: ae_number
columns.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier for the adverse event as assigned in the EDC system (Medidata Rave). Used for cross-referencing in CRFs, safety narratives, and regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: ae_reporting_category
columns.description: Regulatory reporting classification of the adverse event: AE (non-serious), SAE (Serious Adverse Event), SUSAR (Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction), or AESI (Adverse Event of Special Interest). Drives reporting timelines and workflows.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on Safety Reporting

columns.name: ae_severity
columns.description: Descriptive severity classification of the adverse event as recorded in the CRF. Corresponds to CTCAE grade but expressed as a categorical label for reporting and filtering.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; NCI CTCAE v5.0; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: ae_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the adverse event, indicating whether it is still ongoing, has resolved, resolved with residual effects, or resulted in death.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: ae_term_verbatim
columns.description: The exact verbatim term as reported by the investigator or subject in the CRF prior to MedDRA coding. Preserved for audit and coding reconciliation purposes.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; MedDRA; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: aesi_flag
columns.glossary_term: Adverse Event of Special Interest (AESI) Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse event has been designated as an Adverse Event of Special Interest (AESI) per the trial protocol or regulatory guidance, requiring enhanced monitoring and reporting.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; FDA Guidance on AESI; EMA Guideline on Safety Reporting

columns.name: causality_assessment
columns.description: Investigator's assessment of the causal relationship between the adverse event and the investigational medicinal product (IMP). Used in safety reporting and benefit-risk evaluation.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment Criteria; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: concomitant_medication
columns.description: Name or description of any concomitant medication administered to treat or manage the adverse event. Free-text field as captured in the CRF.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Medidata Rave EDC; ICH E6(R2)

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the adverse event record was first created in the EDC or source system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

columns.name: ctcae_grade
columns.glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Grade
columns.description: Severity grade of the adverse event per NCI CTCAE grading scale (1=Mild, 2=Moderate, 3=Severe, 4=Life-threatening, 5=Death). Mandatory for oncology trials and widely used across therapeutic areas.
columns.reference: NCI CTCAE v5.0; ICH E2A; FDA Guidance on Safety Reporting

columns.name: dechallenge_result
columns.description: Result of withdrawing or reducing the investigational product dose in response to the adverse event. Positive dechallenge (AE improved on withdrawal) supports causal relationship.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment Criteria

columns.name: ha_report_due_date
columns.description: The regulatory deadline by which the SAE or SUSAR must be reported to the relevant health authority (e.g., FDA 7-day or 15-day, EMA 7-day or 15-day). Calculated from sponsor_aware_date.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on SUSAR Reporting

columns.name: ha_reported_date
columns.description: The actual date on which the SAE or SUSAR was submitted to the health authority. Used to assess compliance with regulatory reporting timelines.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on SUSAR Reporting; FDA

columns.name: initial_report_date
columns.description: The date on which the adverse event was first reported by the investigator or site to the sponsor. Day 0 for regulatory reporting clock calculations (7-day/15-day timelines).
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on Safety Reporting

columns.name: is_serious
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse event meets the regulatory definition of a Serious Adverse Event (SAE) per ICH E2A criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, or other medically important condition).
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on Safety Reporting

columns.name: is_susar
columns.glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this adverse event has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), triggering expedited 7-day or 15-day regulatory reporting obligations to health authorities.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on SUSAR Reporting; Directive 2001/20/EC

columns.name: is_unexpected
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse event is unexpected — i.e., not listed in the current Investigator's Brochure (IB) or Reference Safety Information (RSI). A serious, unexpected, related AE constitutes a SUSAR requiring expedited reporting.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on SUSAR Reporting

columns.name: led_to_discontinuation
columns.glossary_term: AE Led to Study Discontinuation Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse event led to the subject's permanent discontinuation from the clinical trial. Critical for ITT and safety analysis populations.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 312; Medidata Rave EDC

columns.name: medical_review_status
columns.description: Current status of the medical monitor's review of the adverse event record. Tracks the safety review workflow from initial entry through medical sign-off.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC; Oracle Clinical / Siebel CTMS

columns.name: medical_reviewer
columns.description: Name or identifier of the sponsor medical monitor or physician who reviewed and assessed the adverse event record.

columns.name: narrative
columns.description: Free-text medical narrative describing the adverse event, its clinical course, management, and outcome. Used in ICSR submissions and clinical study reports (CSR).
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); Argus Safety / Oracle AERS; FDA MedWatch

columns.name: onset_date
columns.description: The date on which the adverse event first began or was first observed by the subject or investigator. Principal real-world event date for the AE lifecycle.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: The final or current clinical outcome of the adverse event as assessed by the investigator. Used in ICSR generation and aggregate safety reporting.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Argus Safety / Oracle AERS; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA

columns.name: rave_subject_key
columns.description: The subject key as assigned in Medidata Rave EDC, used to cross-reference the adverse event record back to the source EDC system for data reconciliation and audit trail purposes.
columns.reference: Medidata Rave EDC; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: rechallenge_result
columns.description: Result of re-administering the investigational product after the adverse event resolved, to assess causality. Positive rechallenge strengthens causal relationship.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; WHO Causality Assessment Criteria

columns.name: resolution_date
columns.description: The date on which the adverse event resolved or returned to baseline. Null if the event is ongoing at the time of data cut.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: sae_criteria
columns.description: The specific ICH E2A seriousness criterion or criteria met by this SAE (e.g., Death, Life-threatening, Hospitalization required, Persistent disability, Congenital anomaly, Medically significant). Multiple criteria may apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Death|Life-threatening|Hospitalization required|Persistent disability|Congenital anomaly|Medically significant|Other — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on Safety Reporting

columns.name: sponsor_aware_date
columns.description: The date on which the sponsor first became aware of the serious adverse event. Starts the regulatory reporting clock for SAE/SUSAR expedited reporting to health authorities.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on Safety Reporting; 21 CFR Part 314.81

columns.name: treatment_given
columns.glossary_term: Concomitant Treatment Given for AE Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether concomitant medication or other treatment was administered to manage or treat the adverse event.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Medidata Rave EDC; ICH E6(R2)

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the adverse event record was most recently modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

tables.name: trial_consent
tables.description: Transactional record capturing each informed consent event for a trial subject, including consent form version, consent date, re-consent date (if protocol amended), subject signature confirmation, legally authorized representative details (if applicable), consent withdrawal date, and IRB/IEC approval reference for the consent version used. Ensures GCP-compliant documentation of subject autonomy and regulatory traceability.
tables.reference: Informed Consent Form (ICH E6 GCP / 21 CFR 50)

columns.name: trial_consent_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each informed consent event record in the clinical trial. Primary key for the trial_consent data product.

columns.name: clinical_enrollment_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.enrollment. Business justification: Informed consent is obtained during the enrollment process. Linking trial_consent to enrollment provides the complete enrollment context and enables verification that consent was obtained before enrol

columns.name: crf_form_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.crf_form. Business justification: Informed consent may be captured via CRF form (consent CRF) in the EDC system, especially for electronic consent (eConsent) workflows. Linking trial_consent to crf_form enables traceability to the dat

columns.name: informed_consent_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to patient.informed_consent. Business justification: GCP compliance and GDPR/HIPAA data privacy audits require reconciliation between trial CRF consent records (trial_consent in eTMF/EDC) and patient-level consent management records (patient.informed_co

columns.name: investigational_site_id
columns.description: Reference to the investigational site where the consent event occurred. Links to the site master record in the CTMS.

columns.name: investigator_id
columns.description: Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) or sub-investigator who conducted the informed consent discussion and signed the consent form. Links to the investigator master record in the CTMS.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) who provided informed consent. Links to the subject master record in the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9

columns.name: protocol_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.protocol. Business justification: Informed consent forms are version-controlled per protocol version. The trial_consent table has protocol_version as a string, but linking to protocol table provides the authoritative protocol version

columns.name: rems_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.rems. Business justification: REMS programs mandate specific patient consent elements and consent form language (e.g., iPLEDGE pregnancy prevention counseling, Clozapine agranulocytosis risk disclosure). Regulatory and clinical te

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial for which this consent was obtained. Links to the trial master record in the CTMS.

columns.name: visit_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.visit. Business justification: Informed consent is typically obtained at the screening visit. Linking trial_consent to visit provides the visit context and enables verification that consent was obtained before any protocol-specific

columns.name: comments
columns.description: Free-text field for additional notes or comments related to the consent event, such as special circumstances, deviations from standard consent procedures, or clarifications noted by the investigator or study coordinator.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

columns.name: consent_date
columns.description: Date on which the subject (or LAR) signed and dated the informed consent form, confirming voluntary agreement to participate in the trial. This is the principal business event date for the consent transaction.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27(a); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: consent_form_version
columns.description: Version identifier of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) used for this consent event, as approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Critical for regulatory traceability when protocol amendments trigger re-consent.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.27; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

columns.name: consent_language
columns.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the ICF was presented and signed by the subject, ensuring the subject received information in their native language per GCP requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.6; 21 CFR Part 50.25; ISO 639-1

columns.name: consent_number
columns.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this consent event, used for regulatory traceability and audit purposes. Typically generated by the CTMS or EDC system (e.g., Medidata Rave or Oracle Clinical).
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25

columns.name: consent_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the consent record. 'Active' indicates valid consent in force; 'withdrawn' indicates subject has revoked consent; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer consent version; 'pending' indicates awaiting subject signature; 'expired' indicates consent period has lapsed.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 7; 21 CFR Part 50

columns.name: consent_timestamp
columns.description: Precise date and time at which the consent was electronically captured or recorded in the EDC/CTMS system (e.g., Medidata Rave), supporting 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA Electronic Records Guidance

columns.name: consent_type
columns.description: Classification of the consent event: initial consent at enrollment, re-consent triggered by protocol amendment, assent from a minor subject, consent by a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR), or withdrawal of consent.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25; GDPR Article 7

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the system (EDC or CTMS). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP data integrity standards.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

columns.name: econsent_platform
columns.description: Name or identifier of the eConsent platform used to capture electronic consent (e.g., Medidata Rave eConsent, Veeva Vault). Populated only when electronic_consent is True.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent (2016)

columns.name: electronic_consent
columns.description: Indicates whether the consent was obtained via an electronic consent (eConsent) platform rather than a traditional paper-based process. Relevant for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and audit trail requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2)

columns.name: etmf_document_reference
columns.glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Document ID
columns.description: Document identifier in the Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) system (e.g., Veeva Vault) for the scanned or electronically captured consent form. Enables direct linkage between the consent record and the regulatory-compliant document archive.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA eTMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF

columns.name: investigator_signed
columns.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator has signed the informed consent form, confirming the consent discussion was conducted per GCP requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27(a)

columns.name: irb_iec_approval_date
columns.description: Date on which the IRB or IEC approved the ICF version referenced in this consent event. Consent must not be obtained prior to this date to maintain GCP compliance.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1.2; 21 CFR Part 56.109; EU Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014

columns.name: irb_iec_approval_number
columns.glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Number
columns.description: Reference number of the IRB or IEC approval that authorized the specific ICF version used in this consent event. Ensures GCP-compliant traceability between the consent form version and its ethics committee approval.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014

columns.name: itt_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the subject is included in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population. Subjects who consented and received at least one dose of investigational product are typically included in the ITT population.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on ITT Principle

columns.name: lar_name
columns.description: Full legal name of the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) who provided consent on behalf of the subject. Populated only when lar_required is True.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); GDPR Article 9

columns.name: lar_relationship
columns.description: Relationship of the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to the trial subject (e.g., parent, legal guardian, spouse). Required when lar_required is True to establish legal authority to consent.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.3(l)

columns.name: lar_required
columns.description: Indicates whether a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) was required to provide consent on behalf of the subject, applicable for minors, cognitively impaired subjects, or other legally incapacitated individuals.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); GDPR Article 8

columns.name: lar_signed
columns.description: Indicates whether the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) has signed and dated the informed consent form. Applicable only when lar_required is True.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b)

columns.name: optional_consent_biobank
columns.description: Indicates whether the subject provided optional consent for long-term storage and future use of biological samples in a biobank. This is a separate optional consent element from the main trial consent.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 9; 21 CFR Part 50.25(b); ISBER Best Practices

columns.name: optional_consent_genetic
columns.description: Indicates whether the subject provided optional consent for genetic or genomic research using their biological samples. Separate from the main trial consent and biobank consent.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 9; 21 CFR Part 50.25(b); GINA (Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act)

columns.name: reconsent_date
columns.description: Date on which the subject provided re-consent following a protocol amendment or updated ICF version. Null if no re-consent has been required for this subject.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments

columns.name: reconsent_reason
columns.description: Reason that triggered the re-consent requirement, such as a protocol amendment, new safety information identified during the trial, or a regulatory authority request. Null if no re-consent was required.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

columns.name: source_document_location
columns.description: Location reference for the original signed consent form source document, such as the eTMF folder path in Veeva Vault or physical file location at the investigational site. Supports GCP source data verification (SDV) and audit trail requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 312.62; Veeva Vault eTMF

columns.name: subject_signed
columns.description: Indicates whether the subject has personally signed and dated the informed consent form. False if consent was provided solely by a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) without subject co-signature.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27(a)

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data integrity monitoring per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

columns.name: withdrawal_date
columns.description: Date on which the subject formally withdrew consent to participate in the trial. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Triggers subject discontinuation workflow in the CTMS.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25(a)(8); GDPR Article 7(3)

columns.name: withdrawal_reason
columns.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the subject or investigator for withdrawal of consent. Captured for regulatory reporting and subject safety follow-up purposes.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

columns.name: witness_required
columns.description: Indicates whether an impartial witness was required to be present during the consent process, applicable when the subject or LAR is unable to read or when a short-form consent is used.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b)(2)

tables.name: investigational_product
tables.description: Master record for each investigational medicinal product (IMP) and comparator used in clinical trials, including drug substance name (INN/USAN), formulation, dosage form, strength, route of administration, manufacturer, batch/lot number, expiry date, storage conditions (cold-chain requirements), blinding configuration (matching placebo details), IND/IMPD reference, dispensation tracking (quantity dispensed, return, destruction), and accountability log reference. Distinct from the commercial product catalog (owned by the product domain) — this entity is scoped to GCP-regulated IMP accountability, trial supply management, and regulatory compliance per ICH E6 R2 section 8.

columns.name: investigational_product_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each investigational medicinal product (IMP) or comparator record in the clinical trial supply master. Primary key for this entity.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Guideline; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: access_strategy_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to market.access_strategy. Business justification: Access strategies are product-specific, targeting market access for each investigational product/indication combination. Each strategy plans pricing, reimbursement pathway, and HTA approach for a spec

columns.name: adme_profile_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.adme_profile. Business justification: The ADME profile is a mandatory input to the IMP Dossier (IMPD) and IND clinical pharmacology sections. CMC and clinical pharmacology teams reference ADME data when defining dosing regimens, safety mo

columns.name: atc_classification_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: Investigational products are classified by ATC code for regulatory submissions (IND/IMPD), pharmacovigilance signal detection, and market access planning. atc_code is a denormalized plain-text attribu

columns.name: bill_of_materials_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.bill_of_materials.
