columns.description: Actual date and time when production order execution commenced. Captured from Manufacturing Execution System (MES) at first operation start. Critical for cycle time analysis and Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) batch record documentation.
columns.reference: Manufacturing Execution System (MES); 21 CFR Part 211.188 Batch Production Records

columns.name: batch_number
columns.description: Unique batch or lot number assigned to the production output. Critical identifier for traceability, quality control testing, Certificate of Analysis (CoA), and pharmacovigilance. Must be unique per material and comply with batch numbering conventions per 21 CFR Part 211.188.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188 Batch Production and Control Records; ICH Q7 Section 6 - Documentation and Records

columns.name: created_by_user
columns.description: User ID of the person who created the production order record. Required for audit trail and accountability per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the production order record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures; SAP PP Module Audit Trail

columns.name: expiry_date
columns.description: Calculated expiration date for the manufactured batch based on approved shelf life and manufacturing date. Critical for inventory management, distribution planning, and regulatory compliance. Must be printed on product labeling per 21 CFR Part 201.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 201.17 - Drugs for Human Use; ICH Q1A Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

columns.name: last_modified_by_user
columns.description: User ID of the person who last modified the production order record. Required for audit trail and accountability per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the production order record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes to order details, status transitions, or confirmations.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures; SAP PP Module Audit Trail

columns.name: order_number
columns.description: Externally-known business identifier for the production order. Human-readable order number used across manufacturing execution systems and batch records.
columns.reference: SAP PP Module - Production Order Header; 21 CFR Part 211.188 Batch Production Records

columns.name: order_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the production order in the manufacturing execution workflow. Created indicates order planning complete; released indicates order approved for execution; in_progress indicates active manufacturing; confirmed indicates production complete pending quality review; technically_complete indicates all operations and quality checks complete; closed indicates final settlement and batch record archived; cancelled indicates order terminated without execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|in_progress|confirmed|technically_complete|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP PP Module - Order Status Management; 21 CFR Part 211.188 Batch Production and Control Records

columns.name: order_type
columns.description: Classification of the production order indicating the type of manufacturing operation: process order for Drug Substance (DS) production, production order for Drug Product (DP) formulation, packaging order for fill-finish and labeling, rework order for reprocessing, validation batch for process qualification, or exhibit batch for regulatory submission samples.
columns.reference: SAP PP Module - Order Type Configuration; ICH Q7 Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

columns.name: pat_enabled_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools are used for real-time monitoring and control of Critical Process Parameters (CPP) and Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) during manufacturing. True for processes with inline/online/at-line analytical instrumentation per FDA PAT Guidance.
columns.reference: FDA Guidance for Industry - PAT Framework for Innovative Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing, and Quality Assurance

columns.name: planned_quantity
columns.description: Target quantity to be produced as specified in the production order. Represents the batch size defined in the master batch record or Bill of Materials (BOM).
columns.reference: SAP PP Module - Order Quantity; 21 CFR Part 211.188 Batch Size

columns.name: priority
columns.description: Scheduling priority for the production order. Urgent for critical supply shortages or regulatory commitments; high for commercial launch or clinical trial material; normal for routine replenishment; low for strategic inventory build.
columns.reference: SAP PP Module - Order Priority; Supply Chain Planning Priority Rules

columns.name: qbd_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the production order follows Quality by Design (QbD) principles with defined design space, Critical Process Parameters (CPP), and Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10. True for QbD-enabled processes with enhanced process understanding and control strategy.
columns.reference: ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development; ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

columns.name: reconciliation_status
columns.description: Status of material reconciliation comparing issued raw materials and components against actual consumption and finished goods produced. Reconciliation is required per 21 CFR Part 211.188 to detect significant unexplained discrepancies that may indicate diversion, contamination, or process issues.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188 Batch Production and Control Records; ICH Q7 Section 6.7 - Material Reconciliation

columns.name: regulatory_submission_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether material from this production order will be used for regulatory submission purposes such as stability studies, exhibit batches for New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA), or Marketing Authorization Application (MAA). Requires enhanced documentation and retention per regulatory requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314 - Applications for FDA Approval to Market a New Drug; ICH M4 Common Technical Document

columns.name: retest_date
columns.description: Date by which Drug Substance (DS) or Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications. Applicable primarily to bulk API and intermediates stored before further processing.
columns.reference: ICH Q7 Section 11.3 - Retest Date; 21 CFR Part 211.166 Stability Testing

columns.name: rework_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the production order involves rework or reprocessing of previously manufactured material that did not meet specifications. Rework must be performed according to approved procedures and documented per 21 CFR Part 211.115.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.115 Reprocessing; ICH Q7 Section 15 - Reprocessing and Reworking

columns.name: scheduled_finish_date
columns.description: Planned date for production order completion including all manufacturing operations and in-process quality checks.
columns.reference: SAP PP Module - Production Scheduling; Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Planning

columns.name: scheduled_start_date
columns.description: Planned date for production order execution to begin. Used for capacity planning and material staging.
columns.reference: SAP PP Module - Production Scheduling; Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Planning

columns.name: scrap_quantity
columns.description: Quantity of material scrapped or rejected during production due to Out of Specification (OOS) results, equipment failures, or process deviations. Scrap must be documented and investigated per Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.192 Production Record Review; SAP PP Module - Scrap Confirmation

columns.name: validation_batch_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the production order is a validation batch used for process qualification, process performance qualification (PPQ), or continued process verification. Validation batches require enhanced documentation and are used to demonstrate process capability and reproducibility.
columns.reference: FDA Guidance - Process Validation General Principles and Practices; ICH Q7 Section 12 - Validation

columns.name: yield_percentage
columns.description: Calculated yield percentage representing actual quantity produced divided by planned quantity, expressed as a percentage. Used for process performance monitoring and variance analysis. Deviations outside acceptable yield ranges may trigger investigation per Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.192 Production Record Review; ICH Q7 Section 12.7 - Yield Calculations

tables.name: batch_record
tables.description: Electronic batch record (eBR) representing the complete manufacturing history of a specific batch of drug substance or drug product, as required under 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and cGMP. Captures batch number, product code, batch size, manufacturing date, expiry date, retest date, manufacturing site, batch status (in-process, released, rejected, quarantine), master batch record reference, yield data (theoretical vs actual, yield percentage, reconciliation status), disposition decision (release/reject with approver and rationale), material consumption actuals, parent/child batch genealogy links, and campaign reference. Serves as the primary cGMP compliance document and SSOT for batch lifecycle from production through disposition. Sourced from MES and SAP PP/QM.

columns.name: batch_record_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the electronic batch record (eBR). Primary key for the batch record entity. This is the system-generated surrogate key for the batch manufacturing record.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

columns.name: investigator_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to hcp.investigator. Business justification: Clinical supply chain management requires tracking which principal investigator received each investigational batch. FDA 21 CFR Part 312 and ICH E6 GCP require traceability of investigational product

columns.description: Reference to the approved master batch record (MBR) that defines the standard manufacturing procedure, formula, and process parameters for this product. The MBR is the template from which this batch record is executed.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.186 - Master Production and Control Records

columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.medicinal_product. Business justification: Batch records are released against the approved medicinal product registration. QP certification, batch disposition, and regulatory batch certificates reference the medicinal product. Annual product q

columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Regulatory batch certificates and QP release

columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: SAP MM batch master records are plant-specific. Batch records require plant assignment for lot release decisions, GMP inspection scope, and regulatory lot distribution reporting. Plant-level batch tra

columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.process_validation. Each batch_record that is a validat

columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Batch records are the execution records for production orders. Each batch_record is created to document the manufacturing execution of a specific production_order. This is a standard child→parent rela

columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_site. Business justification: Batch records are executed at a specific manufacturing site. Currently batch_record has manufacturing_site_code and manufacturing_site_name (STRING) which are redundant with the manufacturing_site mas

columns.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: GMP regulatory requirement (21 CFR Part 211, EU GMP): every executed batch record must reference the approved product specification it was manufactured against. Essential for batch release, regulatory

columns.name: supply_inventory_lot_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Manufacturing batch records must link to supply inventory lots to enable end-to-end traceability from production to distribution. This is critical for product recalls, quality investigations, and supp

columns.name: transfer_price_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.transfer_price. Business justification: Inter-site/inter-entity batch manufacturing requires transfer pricing for OECD/tax compliance. Each batch record must reference the applicable transfer price to support intercompany valuation, tax fil

columns.name: actual_yield_quantity
columns.description: The actual quantity of product produced at the end of the manufacturing process. Compared against theoretical yield to calculate yield percentage and identify process inefficiencies or material losses.

columns.name: batch_number
columns.description: The unique business identifier assigned to the manufacturing batch. This is the externally-known batch identifier used across all manufacturing, quality, and regulatory documentation. Must be unique and traceable per cGMP requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

columns.name: batch_size_quantity
columns.description: The planned or target quantity of product to be manufactured in this batch. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in batch_size_uom. Used for yield calculations and material planning.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.186 - Master Production and Control Records

columns.name: batch_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the batch. In-process indicates active manufacturing; Released indicates QA approval for distribution; Rejected indicates failed quality specifications; Quarantine indicates pending investigation or testing; On-hold indicates temporary suspension; Expired indicates past shelf life.

columns.name: batch_type
columns.description: Classification of the batch by manufacturing stage. Drug Substance (DS) refers to API production; Drug Product (DP) refers to formulated finished dosage form (FDF). Intermediate refers to in-process materials.
columns.reference: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

columns.name: capa_required
columns.description: Indicates whether a formal CAPA investigation was required for this batch due to deviations, out-of-specification (OOS) results, or quality issues. True indicates CAPA was initiated; False indicates no CAPA required.

columns.name: deviation_count
columns.description: The number of manufacturing deviations or non-conformances documented during the production of this batch. Deviations require investigation and impact assessment per cGMP. Zero indicates no deviations occurred.

columns.name: disposition_approver_name
columns.description: The name of the qualified quality unit personnel who approved the final disposition decision. Must be an authorized individual per the quality management system (QMS).

columns.name: disposition_date
columns.description: The date on which the final disposition decision was made by the quality unit. Marks the completion of batch review and approval process.

columns.name: disposition_decision
columns.description: The final quality decision on the batch. Release indicates approval for distribution; Reject indicates failure to meet specifications; Rework indicates batch will be reprocessed; Destroy indicates batch will be disposed of. This is the authoritative disposition outcome.

columns.name: disposition_rationale
columns.description: The documented justification for the disposition decision. For rejections, includes the specific quality failures or deviations. For releases, confirms all specifications and cGMP requirements were met. Required for regulatory compliance and audit trail.

columns.name: environmental_monitoring_compliant
columns.description: Indicates whether environmental monitoring results (viable and non-viable particulates, temperature, humidity) were within acceptable limits throughout the manufacturing process. Critical for sterile and aseptic manufacturing per cGMP.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.42 - Design and Construction Features

columns.name: expiry_date
columns.description: The date after which the batch should not be used or distributed. Calculated based on manufacture date plus approved shelf life from stability studies. Required on all drug product labels per regulatory requirements.

columns.name: formulation_version
columns.description: The version number of the product formulation used for this batch. Tracks changes to the formula, process parameters, or specifications. Critical for change control and regulatory submissions (CMC section).
columns.reference: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

columns.name: gmp_classification
columns.description: The GMP classification under which this batch was manufactured. cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) is required for commercial and late-stage clinical batches. GMP applies to earlier development batches. Non-GMP may apply to research-only materials.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

columns.name: manufacture_date
columns.description: The calendar date on which the batch manufacturing was completed. Used for regulatory labeling, shelf-life calculations, and expiry date determination. Distinct from manufacturing_end_timestamp which includes time precision.

columns.name: manufacturing_end_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when manufacturing operations for this batch were completed. Marks the end of the production cycle before quality testing and release. Used to calculate cycle time and production efficiency.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

columns.name: manufacturing_start_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when manufacturing operations for this batch commenced. Marks the beginning of the batch production cycle. Critical for batch genealogy and process timeline documentation.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

columns.name: pat_monitoring_enabled
columns.description: Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools were used for real-time monitoring and control of critical quality attributes (CQA) during this batch. PAT enables continuous quality verification per FDA PAT guidance.
columns.reference: FDA PAT Guidance - Process Analytical Technology

columns.name: qbd_design_space_compliance
columns.glossary_term: Quality by Design (QbD) Design Space Compliance
columns.description: Indicates whether all critical process parameters (CPP) remained within the approved QbD design space during manufacturing. True indicates full compliance; False indicates deviation requiring investigation. Applicable for products developed under QbD principles per ICH Q8.

columns.name: reconciliation_status
columns.description: Status of the material reconciliation process comparing input materials consumed against output product and documented waste. Discrepancies require investigation per cGMP. Reconciled indicates all materials are accounted for within acceptable limits.

columns.name: record_created_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this batch record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance. Distinct from manufacturing_start_timestamp which reflects the physical production start.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

columns.name: record_updated_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this batch record was last modified in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance. Updated whenever any field in the batch record is changed.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

columns.name: regulatory_submission_reference
columns.description: Reference to the regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) under which this batch was manufactured. Links the batch to the approved regulatory dossier and ensures manufacturing is conducted per approved CMC specifications.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314 - Applications for FDA Approval to Market a New Drug

columns.name: retest_date
columns.description: The date by which the batch must be re-examined to ensure it still meets quality specifications. Primarily applicable to drug substances (API) and intermediates. If testing confirms specifications are met, the material may continue to be used.
columns.reference: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

columns.name: sterility_assurance_level
columns.description: The probability of a single viable microorganism being present on a product unit after sterilization. Expressed as SAL-10^-N (e.g., SAL-10^-6 means one in a million probability). Required for sterile products. Not applicable for non-sterile products.
columns.reference: ISO 11137 - Sterilization of Health Care Products

columns.name: sterilization_method
columns.description: The sterilization method applied to this batch, if applicable. Required for sterile drug products and certain medical devices. Not applicable for non-sterile products. Method must be validated per regulatory requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.113 - Control of Microbiological Contamination

columns.name: theoretical_yield_quantity
columns.description: The expected quantity of product that should be produced based on the master batch record formula and input materials, assuming 100% efficiency with no losses. Used as the baseline for yield percentage calculation.

columns.name: yield_percentage
columns.description: The ratio of actual yield to theoretical yield expressed as a percentage. Calculated as (actual_yield_quantity / theoretical_yield_quantity) * 100. Deviations from expected yield ranges trigger investigations per cGMP.

tables.name: master_batch_record
tables.description: The approved master batch record (MBR) template defining the standard manufacturing instructions, formulation, process steps, critical process parameters (CPPs) with target values and acceptance criteria, critical quality attributes (CQAs), in-process control specifications, equipment requirements, and expected yields for a specific product and batch size. Represents the recipe or master formula from which individual batch records are generated. Tracks version number, approval status, effective date, superseded date, product code, dosage form, batch size range, and regulatory approval linkage. Serves as the SSOT for all parameter specifications — parameter names, types, target values, control limits (upper/lower), specification limits, and acceptance criteria. Actual measured values during execution are recorded in process_parameter_result, not here. Managed in Veeva Vault QualityDocs or MasterControl.
tables.reference: Master Batch Record / Master Formula Record (21 CFR 211.186)

columns.description: Unique identifier for the master batch record. Primary key. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

columns.name: superseded_by_mbr_master_batch_record_id
columns.glossary_term: Superseded By Master Batch Record (MBR) ID
columns.description: Reference to the newer master batch record that supersedes this version, enabling version lineage tracking.

columns.name: approval_status
columns.description: The approval status of this master batch record: pending, approved, or rejected by quality assurance and regulatory affairs.

columns.name: approved_by
columns.description: The name or identifier of the quality assurance (QA) manager or authorized person who approved this master batch record.

columns.name: approved_date
columns.description: The date on which this master batch record was formally approved by quality assurance.

columns.name: batch_size_maximum
columns.description: The maximum allowable batch size that can be manufactured using this master batch record, supporting scale flexibility.

columns.name: batch_size_minimum
columns.description: The minimum allowable batch size that can be manufactured using this master batch record, supporting scale flexibility.

columns.name: batch_size_standard
columns.description: The standard or nominal batch size for which this master batch record is designed, expressed in the unit of measure defined in batch_size_uom.

columns.name: cgmp_compliance_flag
columns.glossary_term: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) Compliance Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this master batch record is compliant with current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) regulations per 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this master batch record was first created in the system.

columns.name: document_location
columns.description: The storage location or URI of the full master batch record document in the document management system (Veeva Vault QualityDocs or MasterControl).

columns.name: dosage_form
columns.description: The finished dosage form (FDF) of the product: tablet, capsule, injection, suspension, solution, cream, ointment, or powder. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|injection|suspension|solution|cream|ointment|powder — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: The date on which this master batch record becomes effective and can be used for manufacturing operations.

columns.name: equipment_requirements
columns.description: Description of the equipment required for executing this master batch record, including specific equipment types, models, or identifiers.

columns.name: expected_yield_percentage
columns.description: The expected theoretical yield for this batch as a percentage, used to calculate acceptable yield ranges and detect deviations.

columns.name: formulation_details
columns.description: Detailed formulation information including active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and excipient quantities, ratios, and specifications. Business-confidential intellectual property.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314.50 (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls - CMC)

columns.name: in_process_control_specifications
columns.description: Summary of in-process control specifications and acceptance criteria that must be met during batch execution, including critical quality attributes (CQAs).

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this master batch record was last modified or updated.

columns.name: lifecycle_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the master batch record: draft, under review, approved, active (in use), superseded (replaced by newer version), obsolete, or retired. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|active|superseded|obsolete|retired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: manufacturing_process_type
columns.description: The type of manufacturing process covered by this master batch record: API synthesis, formulation, fill-finish, packaging, blending, granulation, coating, or lyophilization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: api_synthesis|formulation|fill_finish|packaging|blending|granulation|coating|lyophilization — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: mbr_number
columns.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for this master batch record, used across manufacturing, quality, and regulatory systems.

columns.name: mbr_title
columns.description: Human-readable title or name of the master batch record, typically including product name and dosage form.

columns.name: minimum_yield_percentage
columns.description: The minimum acceptable yield percentage below which a batch is considered out of specification (OOS) and requires investigation.

columns.name: next_review_date
columns.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic review of this master batch record.

columns.name: pat_enabled_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) is implemented for real-time monitoring and control of critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs).

columns.name: process_description
columns.description: High-level description of the manufacturing process steps covered by this master batch record, including key operations and sequence.

columns.name: qbd_approach_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this master batch record was developed using Quality by Design (QbD) principles per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10.

columns.name: regulatory_approval_reference
columns.description: Reference to the regulatory approval document (NDA, BLA, MAA, or ANDA number) under which this master batch record is authorized for commercial manufacturing.

columns.name: review_cycle_months
columns.description: The periodic review cycle in months for this master batch record, ensuring ongoing compliance and relevance per quality management system (QMS) requirements.

columns.name: strength
columns.description: The strength or potency of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the finished dosage form, e.g., '500mg', '10mg/mL'.

columns.name: superseded_date

columns.name: version_number

Serves as the SSOT for manufacturing location master data within the manufacturing domain.

columns.description: Date when the manufacturing site became operational and began commercial production. Used for calculating site age, depreciation schedules, and historical performance analysis.

columns.name: capacity_units_per_year
columns.description: Annual production capacity of the site measured in units appropriate to the site type (e.g., kilograms of API, millions of tablets, thousands of vials). Used for capacity planning, supply chain optimization, and network strategy.

columns.name: closure_date
columns.description: Date when the manufacturing site ceased operations or was decommissioned. Null for active sites. Used for historical record keeping and regulatory reporting of discontinued manufacturing locations.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the manufacturing site record was first created in the master data system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

columns.name: ema_authorization_number
columns.description: EMA manufacturing authorization number or EudraGMP identifier for sites manufacturing medicinal products for the European market. Required for GMP compliance verification.

columns.name: ema_authorization_status
columns.description: Current status of the EMA manufacturing authorization indicating whether the site is actively authorized to manufacture for EU markets, authorization has expired, application is pending, authorization is not required, or has been suspended.

columns.name: email_address
columns.description: Primary email contact for the manufacturing site used for regulatory correspondence, quality notifications, and business communications.

columns.name: environmental_monitoring_program
columns.description: Indicates whether the site has an active environmental monitoring program for tracking viable and non-viable particulates, temperature, humidity, and other environmental conditions in classified manufacturing areas. Required for sterile and aseptic manufacturing operations.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.42, EU GMP Annex 1, ISO 14644

columns.name: fda_registration_expiry_date
columns.glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Expiry Date
columns.description: Date when the current FDA establishment registration expires. FDA registrations must be renewed annually between October 1 and December 31.

columns.name: fda_registration_number
columns.glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Number
columns.description: FDA establishment registration number assigned to the site. Required for all facilities manufacturing drugs for the US market per 21 CFR Part 207. Must be renewed annually.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 207 (Establishment Registration and Drug Listing)

columns.name: fda_registration_status
columns.glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Registration Status
columns.description: Current status of the FDA establishment registration indicating whether the site is actively registered, registration has expired, renewal is pending, registration is not required, or registration has been suspended.

columns.name: gmp_certification_status
columns.description: Overall current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) certification status of the site indicating compliance with pharmaceutical quality standards. Certified means site has passed recent GMP inspection, expired means certification has lapsed, pending means inspection scheduled, not certified means site has not been inspected or failed inspection, conditional means certification granted with specific conditions or CAPA requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, ICH Q7, PIC/S GMP Guidelines

columns.name: iso_9001_certification_date
columns.glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001 Certification Date
columns.description: Date when the site received ISO 9001 certification. ISO 9001 certificates are typically valid for three years with annual surveillance audits.

columns.name: iso_9001_certified
columns.description: Indicates whether the site holds ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. While not required for pharmaceutical manufacturing, ISO 9001 certification demonstrates commitment to quality management best practices.

columns.name: last_gmp_inspection_date
columns.glossary_term: Last Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Inspection Date
columns.description: Date of the most recent GMP inspection conducted by any regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, etc.). Used to track inspection frequency and predict next inspection window.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211, ICH Q10, PIC/S GMP Guidelines

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the manufacturing site record was last updated in the master data system. Critical for change tracking and data governance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5

columns.name: mes_site_identifier
columns.description: Unique identifier for the site in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Used to link batch records, equipment data, and process parameters to the physical manufacturing location.
columns.reference: ISA-95 Manufacturing Operations Management, 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: next_gmp_inspection_due_date
columns.glossary_term: Next Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Inspection Due Date
columns.description: Expected or scheduled date for the next GMP inspection. Typically inspections occur every 2-3 years for routine surveillance or more frequently for sites with compliance issues or new product approvals.
columns.reference: FDA Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) Guidelines, PIC/S GMP Guidelines

columns.name: operational_status
columns.description: Current operational state of the manufacturing site indicating whether the facility is actively producing, temporarily offline, permanently closed, being built, in validation phase, or suspended due to regulatory or quality issues.
columns.reference: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA Pre-Approval Inspection (PAI) Guidelines

columns.name: ownership_type
columns.description: Indicates whether the site is owned and operated internally by the company, operated by a Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO), a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), or a joint venture partnership.
columns.reference: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, FDA Guidance on Contract Manufacturing

columns.name: pat_capability
columns.description: Indicates whether the site has Process Analytical Technology (PAT) capabilities for real-time monitoring and control of critical process parameters (CPP) and critical quality attributes (CQA) during manufacturing. PAT enables continuous process verification and improved process understanding.
columns.reference: FDA PAT Guidance, ICH Q8/Q9/Q10, 21 CFR Part 211

columns.name: phone_number
columns.description: Primary contact telephone number for the manufacturing site. Used for regulatory authority communications, audit scheduling, and emergency contact.

columns.name: pics_membership_status
columns.glossary_term: Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S) Membership Status
columns.description: Indicates whether the site is located in a PIC/S member country, enabling mutual recognition of GMP inspections across participating regulatory authorities. Member status facilitates international regulatory acceptance.

columns.name: qbd_implementation_status
columns.description: Indicates the level of Quality by Design (QbD) principles implementation at the site. QbD is a systematic approach to pharmaceutical development that begins with predefined objectives and emphasizes product and process understanding based on sound science and quality risk management.
columns.reference: ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development, ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management, ICH Q10

columns.name: quality_management_system
columns.description: Primary Quality Management System platform deployed at the site for managing deviations, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), change control, and document management. Critical for compliance and audit readiness.

columns.name: site_code
columns.description: Unique business identifier code for the manufacturing site used across enterprise systems and regulatory submissions. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by corporate master data management.
columns.reference: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System, 21 CFR Part 211

columns.name: site_name
columns.description: Official legal or business name of the manufacturing facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 207 (Establishment Registration), EMA GMP Guidelines

columns.name: site_type
columns.description: Classification of the primary manufacturing capability of the site. API manufacturing produces active pharmaceutical ingredients (drug substance), formulation creates drug product, fill-finish performs sterile filling operations, packaging performs secondary packaging, combination sites perform multiple operations, and analytical testing sites perform quality control testing.
columns.reference: ICH Q7 Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, 21 CFR Part 210

tables.name: line

Captures line code, line name, line type (granulation, blending, compression, coating, filling, lyophilization, packaging), associated site, capacity (units/hour or kg/batch), equipment train composition, cleanroom classification, validated status, current operational status (available, in-use, under maintenance, decommissioned), and qualification expiry date. Enables production scheduling and capacity planning at the line level.

columns.name: automation_level

columns.name: capacity_kg_per_batch

columns.name: capacity_units_per_hour

columns.name: changeover_time_hours
columns.description: Average time in hours required to perform a product changeover on this manufacturing line, including cleaning, setup, and line clearance activities per Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.

columns.name: cleaning_validation_status
columns.description: Current status of cleaning validation for the manufacturing line. Critical for preventing cross-contamination and ensuring compliance with Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) per 21 CFR Part 211.

columns.reference: FDA PAT Guidance, ICH Q8 Quality by Design

tables.name: process_parameter
tables.description: Defines and records Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) and non-critical process parameters for manufacturing processes, including both the specification (target values, control limits, specification limits) from the master batch record and the actual measured values recorded during batch execution from MES, PAT instruments, or manual entry. Captures parameter name, type (CPP vs non-critical), process step, target value, control/specification limits, unit of measure, measurement frequency, PAT indicator, and per-batch actual measurements with timestamps, instrument IDs, and pass/fail status. Supports QbD principles, process validation, CPV trending, and regulatory inspection readiness per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10.

tables.name: process_parameter_result
tables.description: Actual measured values of critical process parameters (CPPs), non-critical process parameters, and in-process control (IPC) results recorded during batch manufacturing execution. Captured from MES, PAT instruments, SCADA systems, or manual entry in the electronic batch record. Captures batch reference, process step, parameter name, parameter type (CPP, non-critical, IPC), measured value, unit of measure, measurement timestamp, measurement method, instrument ID, operator ID, pass/fail evaluation against specification limits defined in the master batch record, deviation flag, and PAT indicator. This entity is the sole SSOT for all in-process parameter measurements — parameter specifications (targets, control limits, acceptance criteria) are owned by master_batch_record while this entity owns all actuals. Provides the complete CPP/CQA data trail for each batch, supporting QbD principles, process validation (Stage 2/3), continued process verification (CPV) trending, statistical process control, and regulatory inspection readiness per ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 and 21 CFR 211.188.

columns.name: occurrence_date

columns.name: process_step

columns.name: product_disposition

columns.name: regulatory_report_date

columns.name: regulatory_reportable_flag

columns.name: root_cause_category

columns.name: root_cause_description

columns.name: severity
columns.description: Impact classification of the deviation: critical (direct impact on product quality, safety, or efficacy), major (potential impact requiring investigation), minor (no expected impact on product quality).

tables.name: process_validation
tables.description: Records of process validation studies conducted to demonstrate that a manufacturing process consistently produces a product meeting its predetermined specifications and quality attributes, per FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011) and ICH Q8/Q10. Covers all validation types including process validation (Stages 1-3), cleaning validation (dirty hold time, clean hold time, swab/rinse recovery), and computer system validation (CSV/CSA for MES, SCADA, LIMS). Captures validation protocol number, product, process step or system, validation stage (Stage 1 prospective, Stage 2 process qualification, Stage 3 continued process verification), validation type (process, cleaning, computerized system, analytical method transfer), number of validation batches or runs, acceptance criteria, validation outcome (pass/fail/conditional), approval date, revalidation triggers, and next periodic review date. Supports lifecycle approach to validation per ICH Q12.
tables.reference: Process Validation / FDA Process Validation Guidance 2011 / ICH Q8

columns.name: acceptance_criteria
columns.description: Pre-defined acceptance criteria that the validation study must meet to be considered successful. Includes Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) specifications, Critical Process Parameters (CPP) ranges, yield targets, impurity limits, and other quality metrics. Must be established before validation execution.
columns.reference: ICH Q8, ICH Q6A, FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)

columns.name: batch_size_max
columns.description: Maximum batch size validated in the study, expressed in the unit of measure appropriate for the product. Defines the upper bound of the validated batch size range.

columns.name: batch_size_min
columns.description: Minimum batch size validated in the study, expressed in the unit of measure appropriate for the product (kg for API, number of units for finished dosage form). Defines the lower bound of the validated batch size range.

columns.name: change_control_number
columns.description: Reference to the change control record that authorized this validation or revalidation activity. Links validation to the change management process per ICH Q10.

columns.name: comments
columns.description: Additional comments, notes, or observations related to the validation study. May include summary of key findings, lessons learned, or special considerations.

columns.name: cpp_monitored
columns.description: List of Critical Process Parameters (CPP) monitored during the validation study. CPPs are process parameters whose variability has an impact on a CQA and therefore should be monitored or controlled to ensure the process produces the desired quality. Examples include temperature, pressure, mixing time, pH, flow rate.

columns.name: cqa_monitored
columns.description: List of Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) monitored during the validation study. CQAs are physical, chemical, biological, or microbiological properties that should be within an appropriate limit, range, or distribution to ensure the desired product quality. Examples include assay, impurities, dissolution, content uniformity, sterility, endotoxin.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this validation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.

columns.name: design_space_defined
columns.description: Indicates whether a design space was defined as part of the validation. Design space is the multidimensional combination and interaction of input variables and process parameters that have been demonstrated to provide assurance of quality per ICH Q8. True if design space was established through QbD approach.

columns.name: deviation_count
columns.description: Number of deviations from the validation protocol that occurred during execution. Deviations must be documented, investigated, and assessed for impact on validation outcome per cGMP requirements.

columns.name: execution_end_date
columns.description: Date when validation execution was completed (last validation batch or run completed and all testing finished).

columns.name: execution_start_date
columns.description: Date when validation execution began (first validation batch or run initiated).

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this validation record was last modified. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.

columns.name: next_review_date
columns.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the validation. Per ICH Q10 and continued process verification principles, validations must be periodically reviewed to ensure the process remains in a state of control. Typically reviewed annually or based on risk assessment.
columns.reference: ICH Q10, ICH Q12, FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)

columns.name: number_of_runs
columns.description: Number of validation batches or runs executed as part of the validation study. Typically minimum 3 consecutive successful batches for process validation per FDA guidance. May vary based on validation type and risk assessment.
columns.reference: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q7

columns.name: oos_count
columns.description: Number of Out of Specification (OOS) results encountered during validation execution. OOS results require investigation per FDA OOS guidance and may impact validation outcome.

columns.name: pat_implementation
columns.description: Indicates whether Process Analytical Technology (PAT) tools were implemented as part of the validation. PAT is a system for designing, analyzing, and controlling manufacturing through timely measurements of critical quality and performance attributes with the goal of ensuring final product quality. True if PAT tools (e.g., NIR, Raman, in-line sensors) were used.

columns.name: process_step
columns.description: Specific manufacturing process step or unit operation being validated (e.g., API synthesis, granulation, blending, compression, coating, fill-finish, lyophilization, sterilization, packaging). For cleaning validation, this is the equipment or system being cleaned. For CSV, this is the computerized system being validated.
columns.reference: ICH Q8, FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)

columns.name: protocol_approval_date
columns.description: Date when the validation protocol was approved by Quality Assurance and authorized for execution. Represents the start of the validation lifecycle.

columns.name: protocol_number
columns.description: Unique protocol number assigned to the validation study. Serves as the externally-known business identifier for this validation activity.

columns.name: qa_approver
columns.description: Name of the Quality Assurance representative who reviewed and approved the validation protocol and report. QA approval is required per cGMP regulations.

columns.name: regulatory_filing_reference
columns.description: Reference to the regulatory filing (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD section) where this validation data is or will be submitted. Validation data is typically included in Module 3 (Quality) of the Common Technical Document (CTD).

columns.name: report_approval_date
columns.description: Date when the validation report was reviewed and approved by Quality Assurance. This is the official validation completion date and triggers the validated state for the process.

columns.name: revalidation_trigger
columns.description: Event or condition that triggered the need for revalidation. Examples include: process changes, equipment changes, facility changes, raw material supplier changes, scale-up or scale-down, transfer to new site, out-of-specification results, quality issues, regulatory inspection findings, or periodic review schedule. Supports change control and lifecycle management per ICH Q12.
columns.reference: ICH Q10, ICH Q12, 21 CFR Part 211.100

columns.name: validation_approach
columns.description: Validation approach methodology. Traditional approach uses fixed process parameters and extensive testing. Quality by Design (QbD) approach uses design space and process understanding per ICH Q8. Hybrid combines traditional and QbD elements. Risk-based approach uses ICH Q9 risk management principles to focus validation efforts.
columns.reference: ICH Q8, ICH Q9, ICH Q10

columns.name: validation_lead
columns.description: Name of the person responsible for leading the validation study. Typically a validation engineer, process engineer, or quality assurance specialist.

columns.name: validation_outcome
columns.description: Overall outcome of the validation study. Pass indicates all acceptance criteria were met. Fail indicates one or more acceptance criteria were not met. Conditional indicates validation passed with minor deviations that require corrective action but do not invalidate the study. Inconclusive indicates validation could not be completed or results were ambiguous.
columns.reference: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q10

columns.name: validation_stage
columns.description: Stage of process validation per FDA lifecycle approach. Stage 1 (Process Design) establishes commercial manufacturing process based on development knowledge. Stage 2 (Process Qualification) confirms process design is capable of reproducible commercial manufacturing. Stage 3 (Continued Process Verification) provides ongoing assurance that process remains in control. Also includes legacy approaches: prospective (validation before routine production), concurrent (validation during routine production), and retrospective (validation using historical data).
columns.reference: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q10

columns.name: validation_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the validation study. Draft indicates protocol is being prepared. In Progress indicates validation execution is underway. Under Review indicates validation report is being reviewed by Quality Assurance. Approved indicates validation successfully completed and approved. Rejected indicates validation failed to meet acceptance criteria. Conditional indicates validation passed with minor deviations requiring follow-up. Expired indicates validation has exceeded its periodic review date and requires revalidation. Superseded indicates validation has been replaced by a newer study. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|under_review|approved|rejected|conditional|expired|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: validation_type
columns.description: Type of validation being performed. Process validation covers manufacturing processes, cleaning validation covers equipment cleaning procedures, computerized system validation covers MES/SCADA/LIMS systems per 21 CFR Part 11, analytical method validation covers laboratory test methods, equipment validation covers production equipment qualification, and sterilization validation covers sterilization cycles.
columns.reference: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), ICH Q7, 21 CFR Part 11

tables.name: environmental_monitoring
tables.description: Records of environmental monitoring (EM) results for cleanrooms and controlled manufacturing areas, capturing microbial and particulate data as required under cGMP for sterile and non-sterile manufacturing. Captures monitoring location, cleanroom classification (ISO 5/6/7/8, Grade A/B/C/D), monitoring type (viable air, surface, personnel, non-viable particulate), sample date/time, organism identified, colony forming units (CFU), action limit, alert limit, pass/fail status, and trend flag. Supports contamination control strategy per Annex 1 (EMA) and 21 CFR 211.42.
tables.reference: Environmental Monitoring / Contamination Control Strategy (Annex 1 / 21 CFR 211.42)

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Controls quality management system (QMS) including quality control testing, quality assurance oversight, CAPA (corrective and preventive action), deviation management, OOS (out of specification) investigations, OOT (out of trend) analysis, change controls, SOPs, and audit findings. Manages LIMS data, stability studies, method validation, and certificate of analysis (CoA) issuance. Integrates with MasterControl/TrackWise and SAP QM. Implements QbD and PAT principles across GMP, GLP, and GCP quality oversight.
domains.references: ICH Q8-Q11 / ICH Q10 / 21 CFR Part 211 / ISO 9001 / PIC/S

tables.name: capa

Captures root cause analysis methodology (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA), assigned owner, due dates, action plan details, regulatory commitment flag, effectiveness check criteria, closure status, and linkage to originating QMS events. Integrates with MasterControl/TrackWise CAPA module and SAP QM.

Governed by FDA OOS guidance and 21 CFR 211.192.

tables.name: validation
tables.description: Unified validation records managing the complete lifecycle of process, equipment, cleaning, and computer system validation under GMP — from protocol definition through execution to final report. Captures validation type (IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation stages 1-3, cleaning validation, CSV/21 CFR Part 11), protocol number, acceptance criteria, validation team, execution dates, individual test step results, deviations observed during execution, overall outcome (pass/fail/conditional), validation report reference, and linkage to change control. columns.name: target_value

columns.name: version
columns.description: Version number of the specification document, following organizational versioning conventions (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0). Incremented with each revision.

columns.description: Demand quantity after commercial, medical affairs, or supply chain planner adjustments to the statistical baseline. Reflects market intelligence, launch events, tender wins, or clinical trial enrollment changes applied on top of the baseline.
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; APICS S&OP

columns.name: baseline_forecast_qty
columns.description: Statistically generated baseline demand quantity for the SKU in the forecast period, produced by the statistical forecasting engine (Kinaxis/Blue Yonder) using historical sales, shipment, or consumption data without manual override.
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; APICS CPIM

columns.name: cold_chain_required
columns.description: Indicates whether this SKU requires cold chain (temperature-controlled) logistics and storage throughout the supply chain. Critical for biologics, vaccines, and temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products. Drives GDP-compliant distribution planning.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines (EU 2013/C 343/01); WHO Technical Report Series 961; FDA Guidance on Temperature-Sensitive Products

columns.name: consensus_approved_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the demand plan was formally approved through the S&OP consensus process. Marks the transition to frozen/authoritative demand signal for supply execution. Compliant with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10; SOX Compliance; APICS S&OP

columns.name: consensus_forecast_qty
columns.description: Final consensus-approved demand quantity agreed upon during the S&OP/IBP consensus meeting, representing the authoritative demand signal used for supply planning and inventory positioning. Populated only after plan_status reaches consensus_approved.
columns.reference: APICS S&OP Framework; Kinaxis RapidResponse; ICH Q10

columns.name: demand_classification
columns.description: Classification of the demand signal by supply chain purpose: commercial (market sales), clinical (investigational product for trials), compassionate use (expanded access programs), sample (promotional/medical samples), or launch (pre-launch inventory build). Drives planning rules and inventory segmentation.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; GDP Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA MM

columns.name: demand_signal_source
columns.description: Origin of the primary demand signal used to generate or adjust this forecast (e.g., Kinaxis RapidResponse statistical engine, Blue Yonder, SAP APO, manual planner input, CRM pipeline, market research, or tender/contract data). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kinaxis|blue_yonder|sap_apo|manual|crm|market_research|tender — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; SAP S/4HANA PP; APICS

columns.name: distribution_channel
columns.description: The trade channel through which the pharmaceutical product reaches the end customer (e.g., wholesale distributor, direct hospital supply, retail pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, government/tender, export). Influences demand pattern and supply routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wholesale|direct|hospital|retail_pharmacy|specialty_pharmacy|government|export|e_commerce — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GDP Guidelines; WHO GDP

columns.name: forecast_accuracy_pct
columns.description: Measured forecast accuracy for the prior equivalent period, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Calculated as 1 minus the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) for the SKU-period. Used to assess planning reliability and trigger model recalibration.
columns.reference: APICS CPIM; Kinaxis RapidResponse KPI Framework

columns.name: forecast_bias
columns.description: Systematic directional error in the forecast for the prior equivalent period, measured as actual minus forecast quantity. Positive bias indicates under-forecasting; negative bias indicates over-forecasting. Used for continuous improvement of demand planning accuracy.
columns.reference: APICS CPIM; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Analytics

columns.name: forecast_granularity
columns.description: The time granularity at which the demand forecast quantities are expressed (weekly, monthly, or quarterly buckets). Determines how forecast_period_date is interpreted.

columns.name: forecast_period_date
columns.description: The specific time bucket (month, week, or quarter start date) to which the demand quantities in this record apply. Each row represents one SKU-period combination within the planning horizon.
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA PP

columns.name: lot_size_qty
columns.description: Standard manufacturing lot or batch size quantity for the SKU, used to convert demand quantities into production orders and assess capacity requirements. Expressed in the same UOM as forecast quantities.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; ICH Q7; cGMP 21 CFR Part 211

columns.name: ndc_code
columns.description: FDA National Drug Code (NDC) for the pharmaceutical product/package, used for US market demand planning, regulatory reporting, and supply chain traceability. Format: labeler-product-package (5-4-2).
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 207; FDA NDC Directory

columns.name: override_reason_code
columns.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the adjusted forecast deviates from the statistical baseline (e.g., new tender win, product launch, competitor entry, clinical trial enrollment change, market withdrawal). Required when adjusted_forecast_qty differs from baseline_forecast_qty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tender_win|product_launch|competitor_entry|clinical_enrollment|market_withdrawal|promotional_event|regulatory_change — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; APICS S&OP; ICH Q10

columns.name: plan_created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this demand plan record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail start point for the planning record lifecycle.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10; SOX Compliance

columns.name: plan_last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this demand plan record, supporting audit trail requirements and change management tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH Q10.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH Q10; SOX Compliance

columns.name: plan_number
columns.description: Externally-known business identifier for the demand plan, used for cross-system reference in Kinaxis RapidResponse, Blue Yonder, and SAP S/4HANA. Follows the enterprise demand plan numbering convention.
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; SAP S/4HANA MM; Blue Yonder

columns.name: plan_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the demand plan record, tracking progression from initial statistical generation through consensus approval and freeze for supply execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|consensus_approved|frozen|superseded — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; APICS S&OP Framework; ICH Q10

columns.name: plan_version
columns.description: Version identifier of the demand plan, enabling tracking of iterative revisions within a planning cycle (e.g., v1.0, v2.1). Supports version-controlled consensus planning workflows.
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning

columns.name: planner_notes
columns.description: Free-text notes entered by the demand planner documenting assumptions, market intelligence, adjustment rationale, or risk factors influencing the forecast. Supports S&OP review and audit trail documentation.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; APICS S&OP Framework; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: planning_cycle
columns.description: The cadence of the demand planning cycle in which this plan was generated (e.g., monthly S&OP cycle, quarterly business review, weekly rolling horizon). Determines the review and approval schedule.
columns.reference: APICS S&OP Framework; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder

columns.name: planning_horizon_end_date
columns.description: The last date of the demand planning horizon covered by this plan. Defines the end of the forecast period, typically 12–24 months for pharmaceutical commercial planning.

columns.name: planning_horizon_start_date
columns.description: The first date of the demand planning horizon covered by this plan. Defines the start of the forecast period for supply planning and inventory positioning.

columns.name: reorder_point_qty
columns.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this SKU, calculated from lead time demand plus safety stock. Used in SAP S/4HANA MRP and Kinaxis supply planning.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/MRP; Kinaxis RapidResponse; APICS CPIM

columns.name: safety_stock_qty
columns.description: Minimum buffer inventory quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions for this SKU in the planning period. Expressed in the same UOM as forecast quantities. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM or Kinaxis.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse; APICS CPIM; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: shelf_life_days
columns.description: Approved shelf life of the pharmaceutical SKU in days from the date of manufacture. Critical for demand planning to ensure inventory is consumed within expiry, minimizing write-offs and ensuring patient safety compliance.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; EMA Guideline on Shelf Life

columns.name: statistical_model_type
columns.description: The statistical forecasting algorithm applied to generate the baseline forecast (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, Croston, moving average, machine learning ensemble). Sourced from Kinaxis RapidResponse or Blue Yonder model configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exponential_smoothing|arima|croston|moving_average|holt_winters|ml_ensemble — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder Demand Planning; APICS CPIM

columns.name: storage_temperature_max_c
columns.description: Maximum permitted storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this pharmaceutical SKU. Used in conjunction with minimum storage temperature to define the acceptable temperature range for GDP-compliant cold chain management.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines; ICH Q1A Stability; WHO Technical Report Series 961; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: storage_temperature_min_c
columns.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this pharmaceutical SKU. Used for cold chain planning, GDP compliance, and distribution network configuration (e.g., -80°C for mRNA vaccines, 2–8°C for biologics).
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines; ICH Q1A Stability; WHO Technical Report Series 961; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: supply_chain_tier
columns.description: Identifies the supply chain tier to which this demand plan applies: Drug Substance (DS/API), Drug Product (DP/FDF), Finished Goods (packaged product), or Packaging Components. Enables multi-tier demand disaggregation from finished goods back to API and raw materials.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; SAP S/4HANA PP/MM; cGMP 21 CFR Parts 210-211

columns.name: therapeutic_area
columns.description: The therapeutic area classification of the pharmaceutical product (e.g., oncology, immunology, rare diseases, cardiovascular, neurology). Used for demand segmentation and portfolio-level planning analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neurology|infectious_disease|metabolic — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ATC Classification (WHO); ICH E8; FDA Therapeutic Classification

columns.name: batch_size

columns.name: capacity_constraint_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this supply plan record is constrained by manufacturing capacity limitations (True) or represents an unconstrained theoretical plan (False). Distinguishes constrained from unconstrained plan scenarios.

columns.name: capacity_utilization_pct
columns.description: Percentage of available manufacturing capacity consumed by this supply plan at the designated manufacturing site. Used for capacity management, bottleneck identification, and CMO contract utilization tracking.

columns.name: cold_chain_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the planned material requires cold-chain storage and transportation (True) to maintain product integrity. Triggers cold-chain logistics requirements in GDP-compliant distribution planning.

columns.name: created_timestamp

columns.name: material_type

columns.name: ndc_code

columns.name: plan_status

columns.name: plan_type

columns.name: planning_horizon_start_date

columns.name: scenario

columns.name: version
columns.description: Version identifier of the supply plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports plan versioning and comparison between constrained and unconstrained scenarios across planning cycles.

columns.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued by the manufacturer or supplier for this lot, confirming that the lot meets all specified quality attributes and release criteria. Required for GMP compliance and regulatory inspections.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.84; EU GMP Chapter 6; ICH Q7; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: cold_chain_break_date
columns.description: Date on which a cold chain break or temperature excursion was first detected for this lot. Populated only when temperature_excursion_flag is True. Used to initiate quality impact assessment and determine lot disposition.
columns.reference: EU GDP Guidelines; USP <1079>; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit_cost valuation (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency inventory valuation reporting across global manufacturing and distribution sites.
columns.reference: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21

columns.name: days_until_expiry
columns.description: Number of days remaining until the lot's expiry date, calculated at the time of data extraction. Used for near-expiry inventory alerts, FEFO prioritization, and supply chain risk management. Negative values indicate expired lots.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder; ICH Q1A

columns.name: dea_schedule
columns.description: DEA controlled substance schedule classification (I through V) for this lot, if applicable. Determines the level of security, storage, and record-keeping requirements. Null for non-controlled substances.
columns.reference: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; Controlled Substances Act; DEA

columns.name: expiry_date
columns.description: Date after which the lot is no longer suitable for use, as determined by stability studies and approved shelf-life specifications. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, GDP compliance, and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to SAP batch expiry date (VFDAT field).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Chapter 4; ICH Q1A; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

columns.name: is_clinical_supply
columns.description: Flag indicating whether this lot is designated for use in clinical trials (investigational product supply) rather than commercial distribution. Clinical supply lots are subject to additional regulatory controls under GCP and IND/CTA requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6 (GCP); FDA

columns.name: is_controlled_substance
columns.description: Flag indicating whether this lot contains a DEA-scheduled controlled substance requiring additional security, storage, and regulatory reporting obligations under the Controlled Substances Act.
columns.reference: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; Controlled Substances Act; DEA

columns.name: is_gdp_compliant
columns.description: Flag indicating whether this lot's storage and handling at the current location is confirmed compliant with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, including temperature monitoring, security, and documentation standards.
columns.reference: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 957; PIC/S

columns.name: last_movement_date
columns.description: Date of the most recent inventory movement (goods receipt, goods issue, transfer posting, or stock transfer) recorded for this lot in SAP. Used for slow-moving inventory analysis and supply chain performance monitoring.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse

columns.name: lot_number
columns.description: Manufacturer-assigned alphanumeric identifier for the production lot or batch. Enables full lot/batch traceability from raw material receipt through finished goods distribution. Corresponds to SAP batch number (CHARG field). Required for GMP compliance and recall management.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA QM/WM Module

columns.name: lot_status
columns.description: Current quality and disposition status of the lot in the inventory management system. Drives whether the lot is available for use, shipment, or must be held pending quality review. Maps to SAP batch status (unrestricted-use, quality inspection, blocked). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unrestricted|quality_hold|quarantine|rejected|released|destroyed — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Chapter 4; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ICH Q7

columns.name: manufacture_date
columns.description: Date on which the lot was manufactured or the production process was initiated. Used for shelf-life calculation, lot traceability, and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to SAP batch manufacturing date (HSDAT field).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Chapter 4; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA PP/QM Module

columns.name: material_type
columns.description: Classification of the material held in this lot. Distinguishes between Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API), excipient, packaging component, drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and finished dosage form (FDF/finished good). Drives storage, handling, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: API|excipient|packaging_component|drug_substance|drug_product|finished_good — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH Q7; ICH Q11; 21 CFR Part 210; EU GMP

columns.name: ndc_code
columns.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code in 5-4-2 format uniquely identifying the drug product, including labeler, product, and package codes. Applicable to finished drug products and drug substances registered with the FDA. Null for raw materials and packaging components.
columns.reference: FDA NDC Directory; 21 CFR Part 207; FDA

columns.name: purchase_order_number
columns.description: SAP purchase order number associated with the procurement of this lot from an external supplier. Enables financial reconciliation, goods receipt matching, and procurement traceability.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: quantity_available
columns.description: Net quantity of the lot available for new allocations, calculated as quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved minus quantity_on_quality_hold. Represents the actionable inventory for supply planning and order fulfillment.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse; Blue Yonder

columns.name: quantity_on_hand
columns.description: Total physical quantity of the lot currently in stock at the storage location, expressed in the base unit of measure. Represents the gross inventory position before reservations. Sourced from SAP inventory management (MARD/MCHB tables).
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module; ICH Q7

columns.name: quantity_on_quality_hold
columns.description: Quantity of the lot currently blocked due to quality inspection, Out-of-Specification (OOS) investigation, or quality hold pending Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) resolution. Not available for use or shipment.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.192; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; MasterControl/TrackWise

columns.name: quantity_reserved
columns.description: Quantity of the lot that has been reserved for specific production orders, sales orders, or clinical trial supply requests but not yet physically consumed or shipped. Reduces available quantity for new allocations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse

columns.name: receipt_date
columns.description: Date on which the lot was received at the current storage location via goods receipt (GR) posting in SAP. Marks the start of the lot's residency at the site and triggers incoming quality inspection workflows.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module (MIGO GR); GDP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.84

columns.name: record_created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this inventory lot record was first created in the source system (SAP) or the data lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and data lineage tracking.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: record_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inventory lot record in the source system or data lakehouse. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, and data freshness monitoring.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: release_date
columns.description: Date on which the lot was formally released by Quality Assurance (QA) for use in manufacturing, clinical supply, or commercial distribution following successful completion of all required quality control testing and review.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Chapter 6; ICH Q7; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

columns.name: retest_date
columns.description: Date by which the lot must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications before further use or distribution. Applicable primarily to APIs, drug substances, and excipients with defined retest periods per ICH Q7 and approved specifications.
columns.reference: ICH Q7 Section 11.6; ICH Q1A; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Chapter 4

columns.name: site_code
columns.description: Code identifying the manufacturing site, distribution center, or third-party logistics (3PL) location where this lot is physically held. Enables multi-site inventory visibility and GDP compliance tracking.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GDP Guidelines; PIC/S; EU GMP Chapter 3

columns.name: storage_condition
columns.description: Required storage temperature condition for this lot as specified in the product's approved labeling and storage requirements. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and GDP compliance. Values: ambient (15–25°C), refrigerated (2–8°C), frozen (-20°C), controlled_room_temp (20–25°C), ultra_low (-60 to -80°C).
columns.reference: ICH Q1A; USP <1079>; GDP Guidelines; EU GMP Annex 13

columns.name: supplier_lot_number
