columns.description: Original lot or batch number assigned by the external supplier, Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO), or Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). Enables traceability back to the supplier's manufacturing records and Certificate of Analysis (CoA).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.84; EU GMP Chapter 5; ICH Q7; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: temperature_excursion_flag
columns.description: Flag indicating whether this lot has experienced a documented temperature excursion during storage or transit that may impact product quality and requires quality impact assessment per GDP and cold-chain management procedures.
columns.reference: EU GDP Guidelines; USP <1079>; ICH Q1A; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961

columns.name: unit_cost
columns.description: Standard or moving average cost per unit of measure for this lot as recorded in SAP. Used for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and financial reporting. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS IAS 2; SOX; GAAP

columns.name: valuation_type
columns.description: SAP inventory valuation method applied to this lot for financial costing purposes. Determines how the lot's value is calculated in the general ledger (standard price, moving average price, or actual cost). Relevant for COGS reporting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS IAS 2; SOX

tables.name: warehouse_receipt
tables.description: Record of physical receipt of materials at a pharmaceutical manufacturing site, warehouse, or distribution center against a purchase order or inbound delivery. Captures GR document number, posting date, material, lot number, received quantity, storage location, vendor, CoA reference, GDP compliance check status, temperature excursion flag, and quarantine status. Aligns with SAP MM goods receipt (MIGO). Triggers quality inspection and lot creation in LIMS.

columns.name: warehouse_receipt_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the warehouse receipt record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Goods Receipt (MIGO)

columns.name: clinical_supply_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.clinical_supply_order. Business justification: warehouse_receipt has a clinical_supply_flag boolean indicating clinical supply receipts, but no FK to the clinical_supply_order that triggered the receipt. Adding clinical_supply_order_id normalizes

columns.name: distribution_network_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: Warehouse receipts occur at specific distribution network nodes (plants, warehouses). The plant_code (STRING) should be replaced with distribution_network_id FK to distribution_network.distribution_ne

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: Goods receipt in pharma requires drug product identification for QP release decisions, storage condition assignment, and GMP-compliant inspection lot creation. A pharma supply chain expert expects war

columns.name: inventory_lot_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Warehouse receipts create or update inventory lot records upon material receipt. The batch_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Material attri

columns.name: material_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Goods receipt must validate against material master specifications (storage conditions, quality inspection requirements, batch management rules). Critical for GDP compliance, COA verification, and qua

columns.name: plant_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Goods receipts occur at specific plants requiring plant master data for GMP certification status, FDA establishment identifier, capacity validation. Essential for receipt authorization, quality inspec

columns.name: shipment_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: A warehouse receipt is the physical confirmation of an inbound shipment arriving at a pharmaceutical manufacturing site, warehouse, or distribution center. Linking warehouse_receipt.shipment_id → ship

columns.name: stock_transfer_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.stock_transfer_order. Business justification: A warehouse receipt at the receiving plant is the completion event for a stock transfer order. Linking warehouse_receipt.stock_transfer_order_id → stock_transfer_order.stock_transfer_order_id enables

columns.name: storage_location_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.storage_location. Business justification: warehouse_receipt.storage_location is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to masterdata.storage_location enables GMP-compliant goods receipt posting to validated storage zones and supports GDP co

columns.name: supplier_business_partner_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.business_partner. Business justification: Warehouse receipts must be traceable to the supplying business partner for GMP supplier qualification, incoming inspection management, and purchase order reconciliation. No supplier FK currently exist

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: warehouse_receipt.unit_of_measure is a denormalized plain-text UOM. Linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure enforces 3NF and ensures validated UOM master data for GMP goods receipt documentation and reg

columns.name: actual_receipt_timestamp
columns.description: The actual date and time the physical materials arrived at the receiving dock or facility. Distinct from the SAP posting date; captures the real-world event time for GDP compliance, cold-chain monitoring, and traceability. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
columns.reference: GDP – Good Distribution Practice; 21 CFR Part 211.68; ICH Q10

columns.name: bill_of_lading_number
columns.description: The carrier's bill of lading number for the inbound shipment. Provides the legal transport document reference linking the receipt to the logistics carrier record. Used for freight claims, GDP transport documentation, and supply chain traceability.

columns.name: carrier_name
columns.description: The name of the logistics carrier or third-party logistics provider (3PL) responsible for transporting the materials to the receiving site. Used for GDP carrier qualification tracking and freight performance management.

columns.name: clinical_supply_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the received material is designated for clinical trial supply (investigational product) rather than commercial supply. True = clinical trial supply subject to IND/GCP requirements; False = commercial supply. Determines applicable regulatory framework and handling procedures.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 312 – IND; GCP; ICH E6

columns.name: coa_reference
columns.description: The document reference number or identifier for the vendor's Certificate of Analysis (CoA) accompanying the shipment. The CoA confirms the material meets specification. Required for GMP compliance and regulatory traceability. Stored in Veeva Vault or LIMS document management.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.84; ICH Q7; GMP; GDP

columns.name: coc_reference
columns.description: The document reference number for the vendor's Certificate of Compliance (CoC), confirming the material was manufactured in accordance with GMP and applicable regulatory requirements. Distinct from the CoA which covers analytical test results.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.84; ICH Q7; GMP; GDP

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this warehouse receipt record was first created in the source system or data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

columns.name: delivery_note_number
columns.description: The vendor's delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the shipment. Used for physical receipt verification, discrepancy identification, and document archiving per GMP requirements.

columns.name: gdp_compliance_status
columns.description: The GDP compliance check status for this receipt, confirming that the material was transported and received in accordance with Good Distribution Practice guidelines. 'compliant' = all GDP checks passed; 'non_compliant' = one or more GDP deviations identified; 'pending_review' = GDP review in progress.
columns.reference: GDP – EU Guidelines 2013/C 68/01; WHO GDP; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: gr_document_number
columns.description: The SAP Material Document number generated upon posting the goods receipt in SAP S/4HANA MIGO (transaction MIGO/MB01). Serves as the primary business identifier linking this receipt to the source ERP transaction. Format follows SAP material document numbering (e.g., 5000012345).
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Document (MIGO); 21 CFR Part 211.68; GDP

columns.name: gr_document_year
columns.description: The fiscal year associated with the SAP GR material document number. Required because SAP material document numbers are unique only within a fiscal year. Combined with gr_document_number to form the unique SAP key.

columns.name: inbound_delivery_number
columns.description: SAP inbound delivery document number (transaction VL31N/VL32N) associated with this goods receipt, if applicable. Used when the receipt is triggered by an advance shipping notice (ASN) from the vendor. May be null for direct PO-based receipts.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM/EWM – Inbound Delivery; GDP

columns.name: inspection_lot_number
columns.description: The SAP Quality Management (QM) inspection lot number automatically created upon goods receipt posting for materials subject to quality inspection. Links the warehouse receipt to the quality inspection process in SAP QM and LIMS. Null if no inspection is required.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA QM – Inspection Lot; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GMP

columns.name: po_line_item
columns.description: The specific line item number within the purchase order against which this goods receipt is posted. A single PO may have multiple line items for different materials or delivery schedules.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchase Order Item

columns.name: po_quantity
columns.description: The ordered quantity as specified in the purchase order line item. Used to calculate receipt variance (received vs. ordered) and to identify over/under deliveries requiring vendor notification or tolerance check.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchase Order Quantity

columns.name: posting_date
columns.description: The accounting posting date of the goods receipt in SAP, determining the fiscal period in which the inventory and accounting entries are recorded. This is the principal business event date for this transaction.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO Posting Date; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: purchase_order_number
columns.description: The SAP purchase order number against which this goods receipt is posted. Links the physical receipt to the procurement commitment. Used for three-way matching (PO, GR, invoice) in accounts payable.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Purchase Order; 21 CFR Part 211.84

columns.name: quarantine_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the received material has been placed in quarantine status pending quality inspection or investigation. True = material is quarantined and not available for use; False = material is not in quarantine. Triggers quality inspection workflow in LIMS and QMS.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.84; ICH Q7; GMP; GDP

columns.name: receipt_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the warehouse receipt. 'posted' = GR document successfully posted in SAP; 'reversed' = GR has been reversed/cancelled; 'blocked' = receipt blocked pending resolution; 'under_inspection' = quality inspection in progress; 'released' = inspection complete and stock released for use.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Stock Status; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GDP

columns.name: received_quantity
columns.description: The actual quantity of material physically received and counted at the receiving dock, expressed in the base unit of measure. Used for inventory posting, three-way matching, and discrepancy reporting against the PO quantity.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO Quantity; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GDP

columns.name: stock_type
columns.description: The SAP stock type assigned to the received material upon posting. 'unrestricted' = available for use/sale; 'quality_inspection' = held pending QC inspection (default for GMP materials); 'blocked' = blocked stock due to quality issue or hold; 'returns' = returned goods stock.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Stock Type; 21 CFR Part 211.84; GMP

columns.name: storage_condition
columns.description: The required storage condition for the received material, determining the appropriate storage area and cold-chain handling requirements. 'ambient' = room temperature; 'refrigerated' = 2–8°C; 'frozen' = -20°C or below; 'controlled_room_temp' = 15–25°C; 'controlled_substance' = DEA-regulated controlled substance requiring secure storage.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A – Stability Testing; USP <659>; GDP; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301

columns.name: temperature_excursion_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion was detected during transport or at the time of receipt. True = temperature excursion occurred (requires investigation and potential rejection); False = no temperature excursion detected. Critical for cold-chain materials (biologics, vaccines, temperature-sensitive APIs).
columns.reference: GDP – Cold Chain Management; ICH Q1A; 21 CFR Part 211.68; WHO TRS 961

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this warehouse receipt record was last modified in the source system or data platform. Tracks changes to status, inspection results, or corrections. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

tables.name: goods_issue
tables.description: Record of material consumption or outbound movement from inventory including issuance to production orders, clinical trial supply kits, sample distribution, destruction, quality testing, or customer delivery. Captures GI document number, posting date, material, lot number, issued quantity, movement type (production consumption, sales delivery, sample, scrap, transfer posting), cost center or order reference, and issuing storage location. Aligns with SAP MM goods issue (MIGO). Reduces inventory on hand and triggers cost accounting entries. Supports GMP batch record material consumption documentation.

columns.name: goods_issue_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the goods issue record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the system-generated identifier for each material outbound movement or consumption event.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – MIGO Transaction

columns.name: clinical_supply_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.clinical_supply_order. Business justification: goods_issue has clinical_trial_number as a free-text string, but clinical supply issuances should be linked to the structured clinical_supply_order record. Adding clinical_supply_order_id → clinical_s

columns.name: cost_center_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: goods_issue.cost_center is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to masterdata.cost_center enables accurate financial posting of material movements to validated cost centers for manufacturing cost

columns.name: delivery_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.delivery_order. Business justification: Goods issue documents are created as part of delivery order fulfillment. The delivery_document_number (STRING) should be replaced with a proper FK to delivery_order.delivery_order_id. This establishes

columns.name: distribution_network_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: Goods issue transactions occur at specific distribution network nodes. The plant_code (STRING) should be replaced with distribution_network_id FK to distribution_network.distribution_network_id. This

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: GMP-relevant goods issues in pharma manufacturing must reference the drug product for batch traceability, cost accounting by product, and controlled substance movement reporting. Regulatory audits req

columns.name: inventory_lot_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Goods issue transactions consume inventory from specific lots. The batch_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Material identifiers and descrip

columns.name: issuing_storage_location_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.storage_location. Business justification: goods_issue.issuing_storage_location is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to masterdata.storage_location enables GMP-compliant goods issue posting from validated storage zones and supports GDP

columns.name: journal_entry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Goods issue automatic accounting: every goods issue (material consumption, intercompany transfer, destruction) generates a journal entry for inventory cost accounting (COGS, write-offs). SAP MM-FI int

columns.name: material_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Material issuance requires material master data for valuation, specifications, handling instructions, controlled substance schedules. Essential for inventory accounting, GMP compliance, and movement t

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: goods_issue.profit_center is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to masterdata.profit_center enables accurate P&L attribution of material movements for segment reporting and intercompany transfer

columns.name: receiving_plant_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Material issuances to receiving plants require plant master data for GMP status, capacity, regulatory authorization. Receiving_plant is denormalized code; FK enables plant qualification verification a

columns.name: stock_transfer_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.stock_transfer_order. Business justification: A goods issue is the sending-side event for a stock transfer order — when materials leave the source plant/warehouse as part of an inter-site transfer. goods_issue has order_reference_number (string)

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: goods_issue.unit_of_measure is a denormalized plain-text UOM. Linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure enforces 3NF and ensures validated UOM master data for GMP batch documentation and financial goods m

columns.name: cold_chain_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the issued material requires cold-chain temperature-controlled handling and transportation (e.g., 2-8°C refrigerated, -20°C frozen, -80°C ultra-cold for biologics and mRNA products). When True, GDP cold-chain documentation including temperature monitoring records must accompany the shipment.
columns.reference: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 (Cold Chain); 21 CFR Part 211.142

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when the goods issue document was first created and posted in SAP (CPUDT + CPUTM in MKPF). Provides the precise audit timestamp for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and GMP batch record documentation. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – CPUDT/CPUTM; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 11; ISO 8601

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the material cost amount (WAERS in SAP). Represents the local currency of the issuing plant. Required for multi-currency financial consolidation and cross-border supply chain cost reporting.
columns.reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI – WAERS; IFRS/US GAAP

columns.name: destruction_certificate_number
columns.description: The certificate of destruction document number issued by a licensed waste disposal or pharmaceutical destruction contractor when materials are scrapped or destroyed (movement type 551/552). Required for GMP compliance, DEA controlled substance destruction reporting, and environmental regulatory compliance. Populated only for destruction goods issues.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 1317 (Disposal of Controlled Substances); EU GMP Chapter 5; DEA Regulations; EPA RCRA

columns.name: document_date
columns.description: The date the goods issue document was physically created or the actual date of the material movement (BLDAT in SAP). May differ from posting_date when backdated postings occur. Used for audit trail and GMP documentation compliance.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – BLDAT; 21 CFR Part 211.68; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: gi_document_number
columns.description: The externally-known SAP material document number assigned to the goods issue posting (e.g., 4900012345). This is the primary business identifier referenced in GMP batch records, cost accounting entries, and supply chain traceability. Corresponds to MBLNR in SAP MSEG/MKPF tables.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO; 21 CFR Part 211.188 (Batch Production Records); ICH Q7

columns.name: gi_document_year
columns.description: The fiscal year in which the goods issue material document was posted in SAP (MJAHR). Required in combination with gi_document_number to uniquely identify a material document in SAP MM.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – MKPF Table; SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant

columns.name: gi_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods issue document. 'posted' indicates the GI is active and inventory has been reduced; 'reversed' indicates a reversal document has been posted (movement type 262/552/602); 'blocked' indicates the document is on quality hold; 'cancelled' indicates the document was voided prior to posting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – MIGO; 21 CFR Part 211.192 (Investigation of Discrepancies)

columns.name: is_controlled_substance
columns.description: Indicates whether the issued material is a DEA-scheduled controlled substance requiring additional regulatory documentation, DEA Form 222 or CSOS electronic ordering, and controlled substance inventory reconciliation. When True, the goods issue must comply with DEA 21 CFR Part 1304 record-keeping requirements.
columns.reference: DEA 21 CFR Part 1304 (Records and Reports); DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 211.188

columns.name: is_gmp_relevant
columns.description: Indicates whether this goods issue is subject to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation and traceability requirements. True for materials used in GMP-regulated manufacturing, clinical trial supply, or quality testing. False for non-GMP materials such as office supplies, maintenance items, or non-regulated consumables. Drives GMP batch record inclusion and regulatory audit scope.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Parts 210/211; EU GMP Guidelines; ICH Q7; PIC/S Guide to GMP

columns.name: issued_quantity
columns.description: The quantity of material issued in the base unit of measure (ERFMG in SAP MSEG). Represents the actual amount consumed, shipped, scrapped, or transferred. Drives inventory reduction, cost accounting entries, and GMP batch record material consumption documentation. Must reconcile with production order component requirements or delivery quantities.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – ERFMG; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7 Section 6; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when the goods issue record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Tracks subsequent changes such as reversal postings, status updates, or data corrections. Required for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail completeness per 21 CFR Part 11.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); EU GMP Annex 11; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

columns.name: material_cost_amount
columns.description: The total cost value of the goods issue calculated as issued_quantity multiplied by the material valuation price at time of posting (DMBTR in SAP MSEG in local currency). Represents the COGS or cost allocation amount posted to the consuming cost center or production order. Critical for financial reporting, profitability analysis, and manufacturing cost tracking.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – DMBTR; IFRS/US GAAP COGS Recognition; SOX Section 404

columns.name: movement_type
columns.description: SAP MM movement type code that classifies the nature of the goods issue (BWART in MSEG). Drives inventory valuation, account determination, and GMP documentation requirements. Key values: 261=Goods issue to production order (consumption), 551=Scrapping/destruction, 601=Goods issue for delivery/customer shipment, 311=Transfer posting within plant. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 261|262|551|552|601|602|311|312|901|902 — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – Movement Type Configuration; 21 CFR Part 211.188; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: movement_type_description
columns.description: Human-readable description of the SAP movement type (e.g., 'Goods Issue to Production Order', 'Goods Issue for Delivery', 'Scrapping', 'Sample Withdrawal', 'Transfer Posting'). Supports business reporting and GMP batch record documentation without requiring SAP configuration knowledge.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – T156T Table; 21 CFR Part 211.188

columns.name: order_reference_number
columns.description: The reference number of the consuming or receiving order associated with the goods issue. For production consumption (movement type 261), this is the SAP production order number (AUFNR). For clinical supply, this is the clinical trial supply order number. For customer delivery, this is the SAP sales order number (VBELN). Central to GMP batch record traceability and cost allocation.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/SD – AUFNR/VBELN; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7

columns.name: order_type
columns.description: Classification of the order type associated with the goods issue. Determines the business process context: production_order/process_order for manufacturing consumption, sales_order for commercial customer delivery, clinical_supply_order for investigational product distribution to trial sites, transfer_order for inter-plant movements, destruction_order for controlled substance or expired material disposal.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/SD/MM; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7; GCP Guidelines

columns.name: posting_date
columns.description: The accounting and inventory posting date of the goods issue (BUDAT in SAP). Determines the period in which inventory reduction and cost accounting entries are recorded. Critical for period-end closing, GMP batch record dating, and regulatory traceability.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI – BUDAT; 21 CFR Part 211.188; ICH Q7 Section 6

columns.name: reason_code
columns.description: The SAP reason code (GRUND) providing additional classification for the goods issue movement, particularly for scrapping, destruction, or non-standard consumption. Examples include: expired material destruction, quality rejection scrap, clinical trial sample, regulatory submission sample, stability testing sample. Supports GMP deviation tracking and regulatory reporting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – GRUND; 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Chapter 5; ICH Q7

columns.name: receiving_storage_location
columns.description: For intra-plant transfer postings (movement type 311), the destination storage location within the same plant. Tracks material movement between warehouse zones, e.g., from quarantine to released stock, from bulk storage to dispensing area, or from cold-chain to ambient staging.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM – UMLGO; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 1; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: reference_document_number
columns.description: External or cross-system reference document number associated with the goods issue (XBLNR in SAP). May reference a purchase order, clinical trial supply request, destruction certificate, quality disposition document, or regulatory sample request. Enables cross-system traceability between SAP and CTMS, LIMS, or QMS systems.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – XBLNR; 21 CFR Part 211.188; Veeva Vault QualityDocs; MasterControl

columns.name: reversal_document_number
columns.description: The SAP material document number of the reversal posting (STBLG) if this goods issue has been reversed. A reversal restores inventory and reverses cost accounting entries. Populated only when gi_status = 'reversed'. Required for GMP audit trail and financial period correction documentation.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – STBLG; 21 CFR Part 211.68 (Audit Trail); EU GMP Annex 11

columns.name: special_stock_indicator
columns.description: SAP special stock indicator (SOBKZ) identifying whether the issued material belongs to a special stock category. Key values: E=Sales order stock (customer-specific), Q=Project stock, K=Consignment stock at customer, W=Vendor consignment stock. Empty value indicates standard own stock. Critical for clinical trial supply (project stock) and consignment management.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM – SOBKZ; 21 CFR Part 211.150; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: stock_type
columns.glossary_term: Stock Type at Time of Issue
columns.description: The quality/availability stock type from which the material was issued (INSMK in SAP). Indicates whether material was issued from unrestricted (released) stock, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, or restricted-use stock. Critical for GMP compliance — goods issues from quality inspection or blocked stock require QA authorization and deviation documentation.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA QM – INSMK; 21 CFR Part 211.84 (Testing and Approval); EU GMP Chapter 4; ICH Q7

columns.name: valuation_type
columns.description: The inventory valuation method applied to the goods issue for cost accounting purposes (BWTAR in SAP). Determines how the material consumption cost is calculated: standard cost (standard price from material master), moving average price (MAP), or actual cost. Impacts COGS calculation and financial reporting accuracy.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM-IM Valuation; IFRS/US GAAP Inventory Valuation; SOX Section 404

tables.name: stock_transfer_order
tables.description: Inter-site or inter-plant stock transfer order for pharmaceutical materials between manufacturing sites, distribution centers, and 3PL locations. Captures transfer order number, sending plant/storage location, receiving plant/storage location, material, lot number, transfer quantity, transfer type (one-step, two-step), GDP compliance requirements, cold-chain requirements, and transfer status. Aligns with SAP MM/WM stock transfer order management.

columns.name: stock_transfer_order_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the stock transfer order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: STOs plan inter-site transfers of specific drug products for supply network optimization. Product-level link needed for capacity planning, cold chain requirement determination, and controlled substanc

columns.name: inventory_lot_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Stock transfer orders move specific inventory lots between locations. The batch_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Material attributes, expi

columns.name: material_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Stock transfers require material master for handling instructions, storage conditions, cold chain requirements, DEA schedules. Critical for GDP-compliant transfers, serialization verification, and rec

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.plan. Business justification: Stock transfer orders in pharmaceutical supply chains are typically generated from constrained supply plans (e.g., Kinaxis RapidResponse or SAP APO planned orders). Linking stock_transfer_order.plan_i

columns.name: receiving_plant_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Stock transfers to receiving plants require plant master data for GMP certification, capacity, DEA registration. Receiving_plant_code is denormalized; FK ensures receiving plant qualification, capacit

columns.name: sending_distribution_network_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: Stock transfer orders move materials between distribution network nodes. The sending_plant_code (STRING) should be replaced with sending_distribution_network_id FK to distribution_network.distribution

columns.name: sending_storage_location_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.storage_location. Business justification: stock_transfer_order.sending_storage_location is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to masterdata.storage_location ensures the sending location is a validated GMP/GDP storage zone, required for

columns.name: sku_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Stock transfer orders in pharma move market-specific SKUs between sites and distribution nodes. SKU-level identification is required for serialization chain-of-custody, market authorization compliance

columns.name: transfer_price_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.transfer_price. Business justification: Intercompany STO pricing: stock transfer orders between legal entities require an approved transfer price for intercompany billing and tax compliance. Finance and supply chain jointly manage STO-to-tr

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: stock_transfer_order.unit_of_measure is a denormalized plain-text UOM. Linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure enforces 3NF and ensures validated UOM master data for interplant transfer documentation an

columns.name: cancellation_reason
columns.description: Free-text or coded reason for cancellation of the stock transfer order. Populated only when transfer_status is 'cancelled'. Supports root cause analysis and supply chain performance improvement.
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice)

columns.name: carrier_name
columns.description: Name of the qualified logistics carrier or 3PL provider responsible for transporting the pharmaceutical materials between locations. Must be a GDP-qualified carrier for pharmaceutical shipments.
columns.reference: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011; EU Guidelines 2013/C 68/01

columns.name: cold_chain_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the pharmaceutical material requires cold-chain handling during transport (e.g., refrigerated 2-8°C or frozen -20°C/-80°C conditions). Triggers cold-chain logistics protocols, temperature monitoring requirements, and qualified carrier selection.
columns.reference: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011; WHO Technical Report Series 961 Annex 9; EU GMP Annex 15

columns.name: controlled_substance_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the material being transferred is a DEA-scheduled controlled substance. When true, additional regulatory controls apply including DEA Form 222 or CSOS electronic ordering, chain of custody documentation, and secure transport requirements.
columns.reference: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1301-1321; DEA Form 222

columns.name: dea_schedule
columns.description: Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) schedule classification for controlled substances (I through V). Null for non-controlled materials. Determines the level of regulatory control and documentation required for the transfer.
columns.reference: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

columns.name: delivery_document_number
columns.description: SAP outbound delivery document number (transaction VL10) created from the stock transfer order for goods issue processing. Links the STO to the physical shipment execution in SAP WM/SD.
columns.reference: SAP SD/WM Outbound Delivery; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

columns.name: gdp_compliant
columns.description: Indicates whether the stock transfer order has been executed in full compliance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, including qualified carrier use, temperature monitoring, chain of custody documentation, and deviation management.
columns.reference: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — EU Guidelines 2013/C 68/01; PIC/S PE 011; WHO TRS 957 Annex 5

columns.name: goods_issue_date
columns.description: Actual date on which goods issue was posted at the sending plant, marking the departure of materials from the source location. Triggers inventory reduction at the sending plant and initiates in-transit stock.
columns.reference: SAP MM Goods Issue; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

columns.name: goods_receipt_date
columns.description: Actual date on which goods receipt was posted at the receiving plant, confirming arrival and acceptance of the transferred materials. Triggers inventory increase at the receiving plant and closes the in-transit stock.
columns.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

columns.name: issued_quantity
columns.description: Actual quantity of material for which goods issue (GI) has been posted at the sending plant. May differ from transfer_quantity in cases of partial goods issue. Corresponds to SAP movement type 351/641 posted quantity.
columns.reference: SAP MM Goods Issue; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the stock transfer order record was last modified in the source system. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the lakehouse.
columns.reference: SAP MM Change Documents; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records)

columns.name: movement_type
columns.description: SAP inventory management movement type code used for the stock transfer. Key values: 301 (one-step plant-to-plant), 303/305 (two-step transfer order), 351 (goods issue for STO), 641/647 (goods issue with delivery). Determines accounting and inventory impact.
columns.reference: SAP MM Movement Types; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

columns.name: priority_level
columns.description: Business priority assigned to the stock transfer order. Critical transfers may relate to patient safety supply continuity, clinical trial supply, or shortage situations. Drives scheduling and resource allocation in supply chain planning.
columns.reference: Kinaxis RapidResponse Supply Chain Planning; Blue Yonder Supply Chain

columns.name: reason_code
columns.description: Business reason code explaining why the stock transfer was initiated. Examples include demand replenishment, safety stock replenishment, inter-company transfer, clinical trial supply, product recall, quality hold relocation, or returns processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: demand_replenishment|safety_stock|inter_company|clinical_supply|recall|quality_relocation|returns|balance_stock — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; Kinaxis RapidResponse

columns.name: received_quantity
columns.description: Actual quantity of material for which goods receipt (GR) has been posted at the receiving plant. May differ from issued_quantity due to transit losses, damage, or rejection. Corresponds to SAP movement type 101/105 posted quantity.
columns.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

columns.name: receiving_storage_location
columns.description: SAP storage location code within the receiving plant where the materials will be placed upon goods receipt. Identifies the specific warehouse area, cold-room, quarantine zone, or controlled substance vault at the destination site.
columns.reference: SAP WM Storage Location; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

columns.name: requested_delivery_date
columns.description: The date by which the receiving plant requires the materials to arrive. Used for supply chain planning, scheduling goods issue, and measuring on-time delivery performance. Corresponds to the SAP STO delivery date field.
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; Kinaxis RapidResponse Supply Chain Planning

columns.name: shipping_condition
columns.description: Shipping service level or condition required for the transfer. Determines carrier selection, transit time expectations, and special handling requirements. Corresponds to SAP SD shipping condition configuration.
columns.reference: SAP SD Shipping Condition; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

columns.name: sto_creation_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the stock transfer order was created in the source system (SAP MM). Represents the business event timestamp of order initiation. Used for lead time analysis and supply chain performance reporting.
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

columns.name: sto_number
columns.description: Externally-known business document number assigned by SAP MM for the inter-plant or inter-site stock transfer order. Corresponds to the SAP Purchase Order number used for STO processing (document type UB or NB).
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

columns.name: stock_type
columns.description: SAP stock type of the material at the sending location prior to transfer. Indicates whether the material is in unrestricted use, quality inspection (QI) stock, blocked stock, or restricted-use stock. Impacts GDP compliance and release status.
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Types; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Chapter 3

columns.name: storage_condition
columns.description: Required storage and transport temperature condition for the pharmaceutical material. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and carrier qualification. Values: ambient (15-25°C), refrigerated (2-8°C), frozen (-20°C), deep_frozen (-80°C), controlled_room_temp (20-25°C).
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices; GDP PIC/S PE 011

columns.name: supply_chain_type
columns.description: Distinguishes whether the stock transfer is part of the commercial supply chain or the clinical trial supply chain. Clinical trial transfers require additional traceability and compliance controls per GCP and IND/CTA requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); ICH E6 GCP; GDP (Good Distribution Practice)

columns.name: tracking_number
columns.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number or waybill number for the shipment associated with this stock transfer order. Enables real-time shipment visibility and chain of custody documentation for GDP compliance.
columns.reference: GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011; SAP MM/WM Shipment Tracking

columns.name: transfer_category
columns.description: Classifies the nature of the transfer based on the sending and receiving location types: plant-to-plant, distribution center to plant, plant to distribution center, DC-to-DC, or involving a third-party logistics (3PL) provider. Supports network-level supply chain analytics.
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

columns.name: transfer_quantity
columns.description: Quantity of the pharmaceutical material ordered for transfer in the base unit of measure. Represents the planned transfer quantity as specified in the STO line item.
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice)

columns.name: transfer_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock transfer order. Tracks progression from creation through goods issue, in-transit, goods receipt, and closure or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|goods_issued|in_transit|partially_received|received|cancelled|blocked — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — PIC/S PE 011

columns.name: transfer_type
columns.description: Indicates whether the transfer is a one-step transfer (goods issue and receipt posted simultaneously) or a two-step transfer (goods issue posted at sending plant, goods receipt posted separately at receiving plant). Aligns with SAP MM movement types 301/303/305.
columns.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

tables.name: shipment
tables.description: Physical movement record and SSOT for all pharmaceutical goods movements including outbound customer deliveries, inter-site stock transfers (one-step and two-step), 3PL movements, and returns. Captures shipment number, origin and destination (plant, DC, 3PL, distributor, wholesaler, hospital, pharmacy, clinical trial site), carrier, mode of transport, transfer type, NDC, lot numbers, shipped quantity, shipment date, estimated/actual delivery date, incoterms, cold-chain requirements (temperature range, monitoring device ID), GDP compliance status, customs/import documentation, and stock transfer processing status. Subsumes stock transfer order functionality — inter-site transfers are modeled as shipments with transfer_type indicating one-step or two-step processing. Aligns with SAP SD shipment management and SAP MM stock transfer processing.

columns.name: shipment_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the shipment record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the supply.shipment data product.

columns.name: business_partner_id
columns.description: Reference to the logistics carrier or freight forwarder responsible for transporting this shipment. Maps to SAP SD forwarding agent (TDLNR).

columns.name: clinical_supply_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.clinical_supply_order. Business justification: Shipments can fulfill clinical supply orders. This FK links shipments to the clinical orders they fulfill. No columns to remove as shipment doesn't currently have denormalized clinical order attribute

columns.name: delivery_order_id
columns.description: Reference to the outbound or inbound delivery document associated with this shipment. Maps to SAP SD Delivery (LIKP/LIPS) or SAP MM Stock Transfer Order delivery.

columns.name: destination_country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: shipment.destination_country_code is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to masterdata.country enables import permit validation, serialization requirement checks (DSCSA/EU FMD), and customs compl

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: Pharma shipments require drug product traceability for GDP compliance, DSCSA/FMD serialization verification, and import/export regulatory declarations. Shipments can exist without delivery orders (e.g

columns.name: investigational_site_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.investigational_site. Business justification: IMP shipments are delivered to specific investigational sites. Linking shipment to investigational_site enables GDP delivery confirmation per site, supports site-level IMP inventory reconciliation, an

columns.name: material_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Shipping requires material specifications for packaging, handling, regulatory compliance (hazmat, controlled substances), temperature requirements. Essential for carrier selection, customs documentati

columns.name: origin_distribution_network_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: Shipments originate from distribution network nodes (plants, warehouses, DCs). The origin_location_code (STRING) should be replaced with origin_distribution_network_id FK to distribution_network.distr

columns.name: patient_access_program_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to market.patient_access_program. Business justification: Shipments fulfilling compassionate use, expanded access, or free-goods patient access programs must be traceable to the program for cost accounting, regulatory reporting, and program budget reconcilia

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to patient.patient. Business justification: Decentralized clinical trials ship investigational products directly to patients' homes. Logistics systems must track destination patient for delivery coordination, temperature monitoring accountabili

columns.name: payer_account_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to market.payer_account. Business justification: Shipments to specialty pharmacies, PBMs, and direct payer channels must be tracked by payer account for contract compliance verification, chargeback reconciliation, and rebate claim validation. Essent

columns.name: sku_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Shipments in pharma are executed at SKU level for market-specific regulatory compliance (country-specific NDC, reimbursement codes). Direct clinical supply shipments may not have a delivery order, req

columns.name: stock_transfer_order_id
columns.description: Reference to the Stock Transfer Order (STO) when this shipment represents an inter-site transfer. Applicable for both one-step and two-step STO processing in SAP MM. Null for customer-facing outbound deliveries.

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.trial. Business justification: All IMP shipments are made under a specific trial. Linking shipment to trial enables supply operations to report total shipment activity per trial for IND annual reports, clinical supply cost reconcil

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: shipment.quantity_uom is a denormalized plain-text UOM. Linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure enforces 3NF and ensures validated UOM master data for customs declarations and GDP-compliant shipment doc

columns.name: actual_delivery_date
columns.description: Confirmed date the goods were received and accepted at the destination. Populated upon proof-of-delivery (POD) confirmation. Used for on-time delivery performance measurement and GDP compliance documentation.
columns.reference: SAP SD Module; GDP Guidelines (EMA); 21 CFR Part 211

columns.name: cold_chain_required
columns.description: Indicates whether this shipment requires temperature-controlled cold-chain logistics. True for biologics, vaccines, insulin, and other temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products. Triggers mandatory temperature monitoring and GDP cold-chain documentation requirements.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines (EMA/CHMP/QWP/336031/2017); WHO Technical Report Series 961; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: controlled_substance_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains DEA-scheduled controlled substances (e.g., opioids, Schedule II-V narcotics). Triggers DEA Form 222 or CSOS electronic order requirements and enhanced chain-of-custody documentation.
columns.reference: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301-1321; Controlled Substances Act (CSA); EU Directive 2011/62/EU

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was first created in the source system (SAP SD/MM). Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance. Corresponds to SAP ERDAT/ERZET fields.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); EU GMP Annex 11; SOX

columns.name: customs_declaration_number
columns.description: Official customs entry or export declaration number assigned by the customs authority for cross-border shipments. Required for import/export compliance tracking and regulatory audit trails. Null for domestic shipments.
columns.reference: EU Customs Code (UCC); US CBP Entry Number; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

columns.name: customs_required
columns.description: Indicates whether this shipment crosses international borders and requires customs import/export documentation (commercial invoice, packing list, import license, health certificate). True for cross-border shipments.
columns.reference: WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement; EU Customs Code; 21 CFR Part 312 (IND imports); FDA Import Alerts

columns.name: destination_location_code
columns.description: Business identifier (SAP Plant code, DC code, customer account, or clinical site number) of the destination receiving the shipment. Used for delivery confirmation and traceability.
columns.reference: SAP SD/MM Module; GDP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: destination_location_type
columns.description: Classifies the type of destination receiving the shipment. Drives GDP compliance requirements, cold-chain monitoring thresholds, and customs documentation needs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: plant|distribution_center|3pl_warehouse|distributor|wholesaler|hospital|pharmacy|clinical_trial_site — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines (EMA); 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q10

columns.name: estimated_delivery_date
columns.description: Planned or carrier-confirmed estimated date of arrival at the destination. Used for supply chain planning, cold-chain monitoring window calculations, and customer service commitments. Corresponds to SAP planned delivery date (LFDAT).
columns.reference: SAP SD Module; Kinaxis RapidResponse; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: gdp_compliance_status
columns.description: GDP compliance assessment status for this shipment. 'compliant' = no deviations detected; 'deviation_open' = temperature excursion or handling deviation under investigation; 'deviation_closed' = deviation resolved with CAPA; 'pending_review' = awaiting QA assessment of monitoring data.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines (EMA/CHMP/QWP/336031/2017); 21 CFR Part 211; WHO TRS 957

columns.name: gross_weight_kg
columns.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including packaging and pallets. Required for carrier freight billing, dangerous goods declarations (IATA/IMDG), and customs documentation.
columns.reference: SAP SD Module (BTGEW); IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IMDG Code

columns.name: hazardous_goods_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains dangerous goods (e.g., flammable solvents, cytotoxic agents, radioactive materials) subject to IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) or IMDG Code. Triggers mandatory DG documentation and packaging requirements.
columns.reference: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); IMDG Code; 49 CFR (US DOT); ADR (EU Road Transport)

columns.name: incoterms_code
columns.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between shipper and consignee. Determines who bears cost and risk during transit. Corresponds to SAP SD Incoterms (INCO1). Critical for customs valuation and insurance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Module; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

columns.name: incoterms_location
columns.description: Named place or port associated with the Incoterms code, specifying the exact point of risk/cost transfer (e.g., 'Rotterdam' for FOB Rotterdam). Corresponds to SAP SD Incoterms Part 2 (INCO2).

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the shipment record. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail compliance. Corresponds to SAP AEDAT/AEZET fields.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); EU GMP Annex 11; SOX

columns.name: lot_number
columns.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the pharmaceutical goods being shipped. Critical for GMP traceability, recall management, and CoA linkage. Corresponds to SAP batch number (CHARG). Enables end-to-end lot traceability from manufacturing to patient.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188; EU GMP Annex 11; ICH Q7; SAP MM Batch Management

columns.name: origin_country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country from which the shipment originates. Used for customs documentation, import/export compliance, and GDP lane qualification.
columns.reference: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; EU Customs Code; 21 CFR Part 312

columns.name: origin_location_type
columns.description: Classifies the type of origin location from which the shipment departs. Supports routing logic and GDP compliance tracking across the pharmaceutical distribution network.

columns.name: pro_number
columns.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number or airway bill number (AWB) / bill of lading (BOL) number used to track the shipment within the carrier's system. Primary reference for carrier communication and proof-of-delivery retrieval.
columns.reference: IATA Air Waybill Standards; FIATA Bill of Lading; SAP SD Shipment

columns.name: serialization_verified
columns.description: Indicates whether the drug product serialization data (2D DataMatrix barcodes at unit/case level) has been verified and reported to the applicable track-and-trace system (DSCSA in US, FMD in EU) prior to shipment. Required for commercial pharmaceutical distribution.
columns.reference: US DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act) 21 USC 360eee; EU Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD) 2011/62/EU; ISO/IEC 15418

columns.name: shipment_date
columns.description: Actual date the goods were physically dispatched from the origin location. The principal business event date for this transaction. Corresponds to SAP goods issue posting date (WADAT_IST). Used for GDP compliance, shelf-life calculations, and delivery performance KPIs.
columns.reference: SAP SD Module; GDP Guidelines (EMA); 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: shipment_number
columns.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shipment, sourced from SAP SD (transaction VT01N/VT02N). Used for cross-system traceability and carrier communication. Corresponds to SAP Shipment Number (TKNUM).
columns.reference: SAP SD Module; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

columns.name: shipment_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the shipment. 'planned' = shipment created but not yet dispatched; 'in_transit' = goods picked up by carrier; 'delivered' = confirmed receipt at destination; 'cancelled' = shipment voided; 'on_hold' = blocked pending resolution (e.g., GDP deviation, customs hold); 'returned' = goods returned to origin.
columns.reference: SAP SD Module; GDP Guidelines (EMA); 21 CFR Part 211

columns.name: shipped_quantity
columns.description: Quantity of goods dispatched in this shipment, expressed in the base unit of measure (UoM). For finished goods, typically in units (EA) or cases. For API/DS, typically in kg. Must reconcile with delivery document quantity.
columns.reference: SAP SD/MM Module; 21 CFR Part 211; GDP Guidelines

columns.name: temperature_max_c
columns.description: Maximum acceptable storage and transit temperature in degrees Celsius for this shipment. Defined by the drug product's approved storage conditions (e.g., 8°C for refrigerated, 25°C for controlled room temperature). Exceedances trigger GDP deviation investigations.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; GDP Guidelines (EMA); USP <1079>

columns.name: temperature_min_c
columns.description: Minimum acceptable storage and transit temperature in degrees Celsius for this shipment. Defined by the drug product's approved storage conditions (e.g., 2°C for refrigerated products, -20°C for frozen biologics). Used to configure temperature monitoring device alarms.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; GDP Guidelines (EMA); USP <1079>

columns.name: temperature_monitor_device_code
columns.description: Unique identifier of the temperature data logger or monitoring device (e.g., Sensitech TempTale, Berlinger ELPRO) placed within the shipment packaging. Used to retrieve temperature excursion data post-delivery for GDP compliance review.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines (EMA/CHMP/QWP/336031/2017); WHO TRS 961 Annex 9; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: transfer_type
columns.description: Classifies the nature of the goods movement. 'outbound_customer' = commercial delivery to distributor/wholesaler/hospital/pharmacy; 'inter_site_one_step' = direct stock transfer between plants; 'inter_site_two_step' = STO with intermediate goods receipt; '3pl_transfer' = movement to/from third-party logistics provider; 'returns' = reverse logistics; 'clinical_trial_supply' = IMP shipment to clinical trial site. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: outbound_customer|inter_site_one_step|inter_site_two_step|3pl_transfer|returns|clinical_trial_supply — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP SD/MM Module; GDP Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 211.68; ICH Q10

columns.name: transport_mode
columns.description: Primary mode of transport used for this shipment. Drives cold-chain packaging requirements, transit time expectations, and customs documentation. 'air' = air freight; 'road' = truck/van; 'sea' = ocean freight; 'rail' = rail freight; 'courier' = express parcel; 'multimodal' = combination of modes.
columns.reference: SAP SD Module (VSART); GDP Guidelines (EMA); IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

columns.name: un_number
columns.description: United Nations (UN) four-digit number identifying the hazardous substance or article being shipped (e.g., UN3373 for Biological Substance Category B, UN1170 for ethanol). Required on dangerous goods declarations when hazardous_goods_flag is True.
columns.reference: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR; IMDG Code

columns.name: volume_m3
columns.description: Total volumetric measurement of the shipment in cubic metres. Used for freight cost calculation (chargeable weight), container/truck capacity planning, and cold-chain packaging validation.
columns.reference: SAP SD Module (BTVOL); IATA Cargo Tariff; GDP Guidelines

tables.name: delivery_order
tables.description: Outbound delivery document representing the fulfillment instruction for pharmaceutical finished goods against commercial orders or stock transfer requests. Captures delivery number, delivery type (outbound, returns, stock transfer), ship-to party, delivery date, material, lot number, delivery quantity, picking status, packing status, goods issue status, carrier assignment, and FEFO (First Expiry First Out) compliance flag. Aligns with SAP SD outbound delivery (VL01N). Represents the warehouse execution instruction — distinct from shipment which tracks the physical movement after goods issue.

columns.name: delivery_order_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the outbound delivery order record in the pharmaceutical supply chain lakehouse (Silver Layer). Primary key for this entity.
columns.reference: SAP SD VL01N; ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

columns.name: business_partner_id
columns.description: Reference to the ship-to party (customer, distribution center, hospital, pharmacy, or clinical site) that is the physical destination of this delivery.
columns.reference: SAP SD Customer Master; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: commercial_contract_account_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.contract_account. Business justification: Supply delivery orders should link to commercial contract accounts for customer shipments and order fulfillment. This enables integrated order-to-cash process and customer account management across co

columns.name: distribution_network_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_network. Business justification: A delivery order is fulfilled from a specific distribution network node (warehouse or DC). No FK currently links delivery_order to distribution_network. Adding distribution_network_id → distribution_n

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: GDP-compliant delivery order processing requires direct drug product identification for controlled substance scheduling, FEFO compliance, and cold chain verification. A pharma logistics expert would e

columns.name: inventory_lot_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_lot. Business justification: Delivery orders are fulfilled from specific inventory lots. The batch_number (STRING) should be replaced with inventory_lot_id FK to inventory_lot.inventory_lot_id. Material identifiers, SKU, and expi

columns.name: material_id
columns.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical material (finished drug product, API, or packaging component) being delivered. Corresponds to SAP Material Master (MM60).
columns.reference: SAP MM; 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP Annex 15

columns.name: patient_access_program_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to market.patient_access_program. Business justification: Specialty pharmacy and free-goods delivery orders are fulfilled under patient access programs. Program cost accounting, compliance reporting, and benefit cap tracking require linking each delivery ord

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to supply.plan. Business justification: A delivery order is the fulfillment execution document for a supply plan. Linking delivery_order.plan_id → plan.plan_id connects the outbound delivery to the supply plan that drove it, enabling plan-v

columns.name: sku_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Delivery orders in pharma are fulfilled at SKU level (market-specific pack, strength, country). sku_code is a denormalized plain attribute; replacing with FK to sku enables market-specific stock alloc

columns.name: storage_location_id
columns.description: Reference to the warehouse or storage location from which goods are issued. Corresponds to SAP WM storage location.
columns.reference: SAP WM; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 1

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: delivery_order.unit_of_measure is a denormalized plain-text UOM. Linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure enforces 3NF and ensures validated UOM master data for delivery documentation, FEFO compliance, a

columns.name: actual_goods_issue_date
columns.description: The actual date on which goods issue was posted in SAP, representing the physical departure of pharmaceutical goods from the warehouse. Critical for lot traceability and GDP compliance.
columns.reference: SAP SD VL02N; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 211.150

columns.name: clinical_supply_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this delivery is for clinical trial investigational product (IP) supply rather than commercial distribution. Clinical supply deliveries require additional chain-of-custody and IND compliance documentation.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); ICH E6 GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

columns.name: cold_chain_required
columns.description: Indicates whether this delivery requires temperature-controlled cold-chain logistics (refrigerated or frozen transport). Triggers cold-chain carrier assignment and temperature monitoring requirements.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961; USP <1079>

columns.name: controlled_substance_schedule
columns.description: DEA schedule classification (I–V) for controlled substance pharmaceutical products in this delivery. Required for DEA 222 form compliance and controlled substance chain-of-custody tracking. 'not_applicable' for non-controlled products.
columns.reference: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308; 21 CFR Part 1301

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the delivery order record was first created in the source system (SAP SD). Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
columns.reference: SAP SD; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); GDPR Article 5

columns.name: delivery_number
columns.description: Externally-known SAP outbound delivery document number (e.g., 80XXXXXXXX) generated by SAP SD VL01N. Used as the primary business reference across warehouse, logistics, and customer-facing communications.
columns.reference: SAP SD VL01N; SAP MM/WM; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) — EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: delivery_priority
columns.description: Priority classification for warehouse and logistics execution of this delivery. Emergency and clinical priorities trigger expedited picking, packing, and carrier assignment for patient safety or clinical trial continuity.
columns.reference: SAP SD Delivery Priority; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH E6 GCP

columns.name: delivery_quantity
columns.description: Quantity of pharmaceutical product to be delivered as specified in the delivery order. Expressed in the base unit of measure (e.g., EA for each, BT for bottle, VL for vial).
columns.reference: SAP SD VL01N; 21 CFR Part 211.150; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: delivery_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery order reflecting warehouse execution progress. Progresses from created through picking, packing, and goods issue posting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|picking_in_progress|picked|packing_in_progress|packed|goods_issue_posted|cancelled — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP SD VL01N Overall Delivery Status; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: delivery_type
columns.description: Classification of the delivery document indicating the nature of the movement: outbound (commercial sale), returns (reverse logistics), stock_transfer (inter-site or inter-DC), clinical_supply (investigational product for clinical trials), or sample (promotional/medical samples). Aligns with SAP delivery type (LF, LR, NL, etc.).
columns.reference: SAP SD VL01N Delivery Type; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 312 (IND clinical supply)

columns.name: fefo_compliant
columns.glossary_term: First Expiry First Out (FEFO) Compliant Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the batch/lot selected for this delivery complies with FEFO (First Expiry First Out) inventory rotation policy, ensuring the earliest-expiring stock is shipped first. Mandatory for pharmaceutical GDP compliance.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; EU GMP Annex 1; 21 CFR Part 211.150

columns.name: goods_issue_quantity
columns.description: Actual quantity for which goods issue has been posted in SAP, representing the confirmed shipped quantity. Used for inventory reconciliation and revenue recognition.
columns.reference: SAP SD VL02N; SOX; 21 CFR Part 211.150

columns.name: goods_issue_status
columns.description: Status of the SAP goods issue (GI) posting for this delivery, which triggers inventory reduction and revenue recognition. Fully posted indicates stock has been legally transferred to the customer.
columns.reference: SAP SD VL02N Goods Issue; 21 CFR Part 211.150; SOX Financial Reporting

columns.name: goods_issue_timestamp
columns.description: Precise date and time when goods issue was posted in SAP SD, capturing the exact moment of inventory transfer. Required for cold-chain time-in-transit calculations and GDP audit trails.
columns.reference: SAP SD VL02N; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 211.68

columns.name: gross_weight_kg
columns.description: Total gross weight of the delivery in kilograms, including product, primary packaging, secondary packaging, and pallet. Required for freight booking, dangerous goods documentation, and carrier compliance.
columns.reference: SAP SD Weight Determination; IATA DGR; ADR Dangerous Goods; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: handling_unit_count
columns.description: Number of handling units (pallets, cartons, shipper boxes) packed for this delivery. Used for freight cost calculation, carrier booking, and GDP packing documentation.
columns.reference: SAP WM Handling Units; GS1 SSCC; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: hazardous_material_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the pharmaceutical product in this delivery is classified as a hazardous material (e.g., cytotoxic, controlled substance, radioactive pharmaceutical) requiring special handling, labeling, and transport documentation.
columns.reference: DEA Controlled Substances Act; IATA DGR; ADR/RID Dangerous Goods Regulations; 21 CFR Part 1301

columns.name: incoterms_code
columns.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between seller and buyer for this delivery. Determines who bears cost and risk during transport. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Incoterms; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the delivery order record in the source system. Supports incremental data loading and change data capture in the lakehouse pipeline.
columns.reference: SAP SD; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); GDPR Article 5

columns.name: packing_status
columns.description: Packing execution status indicating whether the picked pharmaceutical goods have been packed into shipping units (cartons, pallets, shipper boxes) for this delivery.
columns.reference: SAP SD Packing; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; 21 CFR Part 211.130

columns.name: picked_quantity
columns.description: Actual quantity of pharmaceutical product physically picked from warehouse storage bins. May differ from delivery quantity in cases of partial picks or stock discrepancies.
columns.reference: SAP WM Transfer Order; 21 CFR Part 211.68; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: picking_status
columns.description: Warehouse picking execution status indicating whether stock has been physically selected from storage bins for this delivery. Corresponds to SAP WM transfer order status.
columns.reference: SAP WM TO (Transfer Order); 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 1

columns.name: planned_delivery_date
columns.description: The scheduled date on which the pharmaceutical goods are planned to be delivered to the ship-to party. Used for supply chain planning and customer service level monitoring.
columns.reference: SAP SD Delivery Scheduling; Kinaxis RapidResponse; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: shipment_number
columns.description: SAP shipment document number (VT01N) associated with this delivery, representing the physical transport leg after goods issue. A single shipment may consolidate multiple delivery orders. Distinct from the delivery order which is the warehouse execution instruction.
columns.reference: SAP SD VT01N Shipment; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: storage_condition
columns.description: Required storage and transport temperature condition for the pharmaceutical product (e.g., refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -20°C, ambient 15-25°C). Critical for cold-chain logistics planning and GDP compliance.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; USP <1079>; 21 CFR Part 211.142

columns.name: temperature_excursion_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion (deviation from required storage condition) was recorded during the picking, packing, or pre-shipment staging of this delivery. Triggers quality investigation per GDP.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q1A; 21 CFR Part 211.142; WHO TRS 961

columns.name: tracking_number
columns.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number (e.g., UPS, FedEx, DHL tracking ID) for the physical shipment associated with this delivery. Used for last-mile visibility and customer delivery confirmation.

columns.name: volume_m3
columns.description: Total volume of the delivery in cubic metres. Used for freight capacity planning, cold-chain container sizing, and carrier booking.
columns.reference: SAP SD Volume Determination; GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

tables.name: distribution_network
tables.description: Master record defining the pharmaceutical distribution network topology including manufacturing sites, distribution centers, 3PL nodes, wholesalers, direct-to-pharmacy lanes, and warehouse storage zones with bin/rack/zone configuration. Captures node type, node name, geographic region, GDP authorization status, cold-chain capability (temperature zones: ambient, CRT, 2-8°C, -20°C, -80°C), controlled substance handling authorization, storage capacity, physical warehouse layout, lead times, and network lane definitions. Used for supply network planning in Kinaxis RapidResponse/Blue Yonder and SAP APO/IBP.

columns.name: distribution_network_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each node in the pharmaceutical distribution network topology. Serves as the primary key for this master resource record.

columns.name: address_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.address. Business justification: distribution_network has denormalized address, city, latitude, longitude plain-text fields. Linking to masterdata.address enforces 3NF and enables validated address master data for GDP site qualificat

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: distribution_network.country_code is a denormalized plain-text field. Linking to masterdata.country enables GDP authorization validation by country, distribution license requirement checks, and serial

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Distribution network nodes are operated by or contracted to a legal entity (own warehouse or 3PL entity). Pharma GDP compliance requires knowing the responsible legal entity for each node for regulato

columns.name: manufacturing_site_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.site. Business justification: Supply network design and S&OP planning require knowing which manufacturing site feeds each distribution node. GDP compliance routing and capacity allocation depend on this site-to-network relationshi

columns.name: operator_business_partner_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.business_partner. Business justification: Distribution network nodes operated by 3PL providers must be linked to the operator business_partner for GDP qualification management, contract compliance, and 3PL performance reporting. distribution_

columns.name: clinical_supply_capable
