columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: ICSRs are transmitted to health authorities via E2B gateway submissions. Linking icsr to regulatory.submission enables tracking of ICSR regulatory submission deadlines, transmission status, and compli

columns.name: submitting_legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: ICSRs are submitted by a specific MAH legal entity — a core E2B(R3) regulatory requirement. The sender_organisation plain-text field is a denormalization of legal_entity. A proper FK enables regulator

columns.name: ae_onset_date
columns.description: Date of onset of the adverse event/reaction as reported by the reporter. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) E.i.4. Used for time-to-onset analysis, dechallenge/rechallenge assessment, and signal detection.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) E.i.4; ICH E2A; GVP Module VI

columns.name: ae_outcome
columns.description: Outcome of the adverse event at the time of reporting. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) E.i.7. Fatal outcome triggers mandatory expedited reporting and mortality signal analysis.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) E.i.7; ICH E2A; GVP Module VI B.3

columns.name: case_narrative
columns.description: Free-text medical narrative summarizing the adverse event, patient history, suspect drug details, clinical course, and outcome. Authored by the medical reviewer. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) H.1. Classified confidential as it may contain de-identified but sensitive clinical information.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) H.1; GVP Module VI B.6; 21 CFR Part 314.81

columns.name: case_nullification_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this case version represents a nullification (retraction) of a previously submitted ICSR. True = nullification report submitted to health authorities. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) C.1.11.1.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.11.1; EMA EudraVigilance Technical Specification

columns.name: case_status
columns.description: Current workflow state of the ICSR within the pharmacovigilance case management system (Argus Safety). Drives SLA monitoring for 7-day and 15-day regulatory reporting deadlines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|in_triage|in_processing|pending_review|closed|archived|nullified — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: GVP Module VI; 21 CFR Part 314.81; ICH E2B(R3)

columns.name: case_version_number
columns.description: Sequential version counter for the ICSR record. Version 1 = initial report; subsequent integers represent follow-up reports with new or amended information. Nullification reports are tracked via case_nullification_flag. Supports full version history per ICH E2B(R3) C.1.2 and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.2; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E2A

columns.name: causality_assessment
columns.description: Assessment of the causal relationship between the suspect drug and the adverse event, using WHO-UMC causality categories. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i. Drives listedness and SUSAR determination. Assessed by the company's medical reviewer.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i; WHO-UMC Causality Assessment System; GVP Module VI B.3

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the ICSR record was first created in the pharmacovigilance system (Argus Safety / Oracle AERS). Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail and GDPR data processing records.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E2B(R3); GDPR Article 30

columns.name: dechallenge_result
columns.description: Outcome of dechallenge — whether the adverse event resolved or improved upon discontinuation of the suspect drug. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i.3a. Key input for causality assessment and benefit-risk evaluation.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i.3a; ICH E2A; WHO-UMC Causality Assessment

columns.name: duplicate_assessment_outcome
columns.description: Result of the duplicate case detection assessment performed during intake triage. Duplicate cases are linked to the master case and suppressed from regulatory submission counts. Critical for accurate signal detection and aggregate reporting.
columns.reference: GVP Module VI B.5; ICH E2B(R3); Argus Safety Duplicate Detection

columns.name: edc_reconciliation_status
columns.description: Status of SAE reconciliation between the pharmacovigilance database (Argus Safety) and the clinical trial EDC system (Medidata Rave). Applicable when report_type = 'clinical_trial'. Ensures consistency between safety database and clinical database per ICH E6(R2) GCP requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.17; 21 CFR Part 312.62; GVP Module VI

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the ICSR record in the source system. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance and Silver layer incremental data loading.

columns.name: listedness_assessment
columns.description: Assessment of whether the adverse drug reaction is listed (expected) in the current Reference Safety Information (RSI) — Company Core Data Sheet (CCDS) or approved product labeling. Unlisted + serious = SUSAR (Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction), triggering expedited reporting. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2D; ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i; GVP Module VI B.3; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: literature_reference
columns.description: PubMed Identifier (PMID) or Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for literature-sourced ICSRs. Populated when report_type = 'literature'. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) C.4.r.1. Supports systematic literature review (SLR) traceability.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.4.r.1; GVP Module VI B.2; ICH E2D

columns.name: minimum_criteria_met_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the ICSR meets the four ICH E2B minimum criteria for a valid case: (1) identifiable reporter, (2) identifiable patient, (3) suspect drug, (4) adverse event. Cases not meeting minimum criteria are tracked but not submitted. Corresponds to ICH E2D minimum information requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E2D; ICH E2B(R3); GVP Module VI B.1

columns.name: most_recent_info_date
columns.description: Date of the most recent follow-up information received for this case, resetting the regulatory clock for follow-up submissions. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) C.1.5.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.5; GVP Module VI B.4

columns.name: patient_age_unit
columns.description: Unit of measurement for patient_age_value. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) D.2.2b. Supports neonatal and pediatric cases where age is expressed in days, weeks, or months.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) D.2.2b; ICH E11 (Pediatric Studies)

columns.name: patient_age_value
columns.description: De-identified patient age at the time of the adverse event onset, expressed as a numeric value. Must be used in conjunction with patient_age_unit. Stored per GDPR/HIPAA de-identification standards. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) D.2.2a.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) D.2.2a; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GVP Module VI

columns.name: patient_sex
columns.description: Biological sex of the patient as reported. De-identified demographic field per GDPR/HIPAA. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) D.5. Used in signal detection and benefit-risk assessment stratification.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) D.5; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

columns.name: patient_weight_kg
columns.description: Patient body weight in kilograms at the time of the adverse event, as reported. De-identified per GDPR/HIPAA. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) D.3. Used for dose-weight relationship analysis in signal detection.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) D.3; GDPR Article 9; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

columns.name: primary_ae_meddra_pt
columns.glossary_term: Primary Adverse Event MedDRA Preferred Term (PT)
columns.description: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities) Preferred Term (PT) coding for the primary adverse event/reaction reported. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) E.i.2.1b. Standardized coding enables cross-case signal detection and regulatory submission.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) E.i.2.1b; MedDRA; ICH M1; GVP Module VI

columns.name: primary_ae_meddra_soc
columns.glossary_term: Primary Adverse Event MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC)
columns.description: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) for the primary adverse event, derived from the MedDRA PT hierarchy. Supports aggregate signal detection by organ system and PSUR/PBRER tabulation requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) E.i.2.1a; MedDRA; ICH E2C(R2) PBRER; GVP Module VII

columns.name: receipt_date
columns.description: Date the ICSR was first received by the company (MAH/sponsor), establishing the regulatory clock start date (Day 0) for 7-day expedited and 15-day expedited reporting obligations. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) C.1.4.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.4; 21 CFR Part 314.81(b)(1); GVP Module VI B.4

columns.name: rechallenge_result
columns.description: Outcome of rechallenge — whether the adverse event recurred upon re-administration of the suspect drug after dechallenge. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i.3b. Strengthens causality evidence and is critical for SUSAR assessment in clinical trials.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) G.k.9.i.3b; ICH E2A; WHO-UMC Causality Assessment

columns.name: regulatory_submission_deadline
columns.description: Calculated deadline date by which the ICSR must be submitted to the relevant health authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, TGA). Derived from receipt_date plus applicable reporting window (7 or 15 calendar days for expedited reports; 90 days for non-expedited). SLA-critical field for compliance monitoring.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314.81(b)(1); GVP Module VI B.4; ICH E2A; PMDA Pharmacovigilance Regulations

columns.name: regulatory_submission_status
columns.description: Current submission status of the ICSR to the applicable health authority. Tracks compliance against 7-day and 15-day expedited reporting deadlines. Overdue status triggers escalation per PV SLA management procedures.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314.81(b)(1); GVP Module VI B.4; ICH E2A; PMDA Pharmacovigilance Regulations

columns.name: report_type
columns.description: Classification of the ICSR source channel per ICH E2B(R3) C.1.3. Drives regulatory reporting obligations and processing workflows. Spontaneous reports from HCPs/patients, literature-sourced cases (PMID/DOI), clinical trial SAEs, solicited reports from patient support programs, and other sources.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.3; 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA Guideline on Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP) Module VI

columns.name: sender_case_number
columns.description: Internal case number assigned by the company (MAH/sponsor) in the source system (Argus Safety / Oracle AERS). Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) C.1.8.1. Used for internal tracking and reconciliation with the worldwide unique case ID.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.8.1; Argus Safety Case Number

columns.name: serious_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse event meets ICH E2A seriousness criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, or medically significant). True = Serious Adverse Event (SAE). Drives expedited 7-day or 15-day regulatory reporting obligation. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) E.i.3.2.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) E.i.3.2; 21 CFR Part 312.32; GVP Module VI B.3

columns.name: seriousness_criteria
columns.description: Specific ICH E2A seriousness criterion or criteria met by the adverse event. Multiple criteria may apply. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) E.i.3.2a-f. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death|life_threatening|hospitalization|disability|congenital_anomaly|medically_significant — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) E.i.3.2a-f; 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: source_country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the adverse event occurred. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) C.1.17.1. Determines applicable regulatory authority for submission routing (FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, TGA, MHRA).
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.17.1; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GVP Module VI

columns.name: susar_flag
columns.glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the case qualifies as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) — i.e., serious, unexpected (unlisted), and with a reasonable causal relationship to the investigational medicinal product. True = SUSAR requiring 7-day (fatal/life-threatening) or 15-day expedited reporting to health authorities and ethics committees.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EU Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014; GVP Module VI

columns.name: worldwide_unique_case_number
columns.description: Globally unique case identifier assigned at intake, conforming to ICH E2B(R3) C.1.1 format (sender identifier + case number). Used for cross-regional deduplication and regulatory submission tracking across FDA MedWatch, EudraVigilance, J-ICSR, and NMPA.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) C.1.1; 21 CFR Part 314.81; EMA EudraVigilance Technical Specification

tables.name: pv_adverse_reaction
tables.description: Granular adverse event record linked to an ICSR. Captures the specific event term (MedDRA coded at PT, HLT, HLGT, SOC levels with version tracking), verbatim reporter term, onset date, resolution date, outcome (recovered, not recovered, fatal, unknown), seriousness criteria, severity grade (CTCAE where applicable), and listedness determination against reference safety information. Includes coding metadata: auto-coded vs manual review, coding date. One ICSR may contain multiple adverse events. Supports signal detection aggregation by MedDRA term and regulatory line listing generation.
tables.reference: MedDRA Adverse Event Term / ICH E2A

columns.name: pv_adverse_reaction_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each adverse reaction record within the pharmacovigilance system. Primary key for the pv_adverse_reaction data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 314; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance

columns.name: adverse_event_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to patient.adverse_event. Business justification: PV-coded adverse reactions must be reconciled against EDC-captured adverse events per GVP Module VI. A direct FK from pv_adverse_reaction to patient.adverse_event enables reaction-level EDC reconcilia

columns.name: atc_classification_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: Linking adverse reactions to ATC therapeutic class enables signal detection by drug category, benefit-risk analysis, and PSUR aggregate reporting. Medical coding teams perform MedDRA-to-ATC cross-tabu

columns.name: brand_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: Adverse reactions aggregated by brand for safety surveillance, label update decisions, and competitive safety positioning. Essential for brand risk management committees and periodic benefit-risk eval

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: Reaction-to-product traceability: pv_adverse_reaction must reference the specific drug_product for signal detection across formulations, labeling update decisions, and expedited regulatory reporting.

columns.name: icsr_id
columns.description: Reference to the parent Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) to which this adverse reaction belongs. One ICSR may contain multiple adverse reaction records. Supports header-detail navigation for case processing.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3); FDA 21 CFR 314.81; EMA EudraVigilance; Argus Safety

columns.name: indication_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.indication. Business justification: Indication-level benefit-risk: adverse reactions must be evaluated against the approved indication for listedness determination and PSUR benefit-risk summaries. EMA/FDA require indication-specific saf

columns.name: inn_registry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: Adverse reactions are coded against specific active substances (INN) for signal detection and aggregate safety analysis. Linking pv_adverse_reaction to inn_registry enables substance-level disproporti

columns.name: label_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.label. Business justification: Listedness determination for each adverse reaction requires reference to the current approved label. Linking pv_adverse_reaction to regulatory.label enables automated listedness_determination against

columns.name: pv_product_id
columns.description: Reference to the suspect medicinal product (drug product) associated with this adverse reaction. Links to the master product record for the drug under pharmacovigilance surveillance.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.4; FDA NDA/BLA; EMA EudraVigilance product dictionary; Argus Safety product field

columns.name: action_taken
columns.description: Action taken with the suspect medicinal product in response to the adverse reaction: dose reduced, drug withdrawn, dose not changed, not applicable, unknown, or dose increased. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field B.4.k.8 and is required for regulatory ICSR submissions.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.4.k.8; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance; Argus Safety action taken

columns.name: case_narrative
columns.description: Free-text medical narrative describing the clinical course of this adverse reaction, including relevant medical history, concomitant medications, treatment, and outcome. Required for regulatory ICSR submissions and medical review. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field H.1.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) H.1; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance; Argus Safety narrative field

columns.name: causality_assessment
columns.description: Assessment of the causal relationship between the suspect drug and the adverse reaction, using WHO-UMC or company standard causality categories. Drives listedness determination, SUSAR classification, and signal detection weighting.
columns.reference: WHO-UMC Causality Assessment System; ICH E2B(R3) B.4.k.18; FDA MedWatch; Argus Safety causality

columns.name: causality_method
columns.description: The methodology or algorithm used to perform the causality assessment (e.g., WHO-UMC scale, Naranjo algorithm, company-specific algorithm). Supports audit trail and methodological consistency across cases.
columns.reference: WHO-UMC Causality Assessment; Naranjo Algorithm; ICH E2B(R3); Argus Safety

columns.name: coded_by
columns.description: User identifier of the medical coder or system process that performed or confirmed the MedDRA coding. Required for audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance. Stores the user login or system account name.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Argus Safety audit trail; EMA EudraVigilance

columns.name: coding_date
columns.description: Date on which the MedDRA coding was completed for this adverse reaction. Used for coding turnaround time metrics, audit trail, and compliance with regulatory submission timelines.
columns.reference: MedDRA Term Selection: Points to Consider; ICH E2B(R3); Argus Safety; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: coding_method
columns.description: Indicates whether the MedDRA coding was performed automatically by the safety system (auto-coded), manually by a medical coder (manual review), or auto-coded and subsequently confirmed by manual review. Supports coding quality metrics and audit trail requirements.
columns.reference: MedDRA Term Selection: Points to Consider; ICH E2B(R3); Argus Safety coding workflow; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this adverse reaction record was first created in the pharmacovigilance safety database. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and GVP Module VI. Supports case processing timeline metrics.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); EMA GVP Module VI; Argus Safety audit trail

columns.name: ctcae_grade
columns.glossary_term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) Grade
columns.description: Severity grade assigned per the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE), ranging from 1 (mild) to 5 (death). Applicable primarily for oncology clinical trial adverse events. Null for non-oncology or post-market cases where CTCAE grading is not applicable.
columns.reference: NCI CTCAE v5.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Oncology guidance; Medidata Rave CTCAE grading

columns.name: dechallenge_result
columns.description: Outcome of dechallenge (withdrawal of the suspect drug) on the adverse reaction. Positive dechallenge (reaction improved or resolved after withdrawal) supports causality. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field B.4.k.18.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.4.k.18; WHO-UMC Causality Assessment; Argus Safety dechallenge field

columns.name: is_serious
columns.description: Indicates whether this adverse reaction meets the regulatory definition of a Serious Adverse Event (SAE) per ICH E2A criteria. True if any seriousness criterion is met. Drives expedited reporting timelines (7-day or 15-day) to health authorities.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.3; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance; 21 CFR Part 314

columns.name: is_susar
columns.glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) Indicator
columns.description: Indicates whether this adverse reaction has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR). True when the reaction is serious, unexpected (unlisted), and there is a reasonable causal relationship to the investigational medicinal product. Triggers mandatory expedited reporting to health authorities and ethics committees.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; EU Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA SUSAR reporting guideline

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this adverse reaction record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11. Used to track follow-up updates and case amendments in the safety database.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); EMA GVP Module VI; Argus Safety audit trail

columns.name: listedness_determination
columns.description: Determination of whether this adverse reaction is listed (expected) or unlisted (unexpected) in the current Reference Safety Information (RSI), such as the Company Core Data Sheet (CCDS) or Investigator Brochure (IB). Unlisted serious reactions in clinical trials constitute Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions (SUSARs) requiring expedited reporting.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2D; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA SUSAR reporting guideline; Argus Safety listedness

columns.name: meddra_hlgt_code
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) High Level Group Term (HLGT) Code
columns.description: MedDRA High Level Group Term (HLGT) code, one level above HLT in the MedDRA hierarchy. Supports broader therapeutic area grouping for signal detection and regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH E2B(R3); ICH E2C(R2)

columns.name: meddra_hlt_code
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) High Level Term (HLT) Code
columns.description: MedDRA High Level Term (HLT) code representing the grouping level above the Preferred Term. Used for aggregate signal detection and periodic safety update report (PSUR) tabulations.
columns.reference: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH E2B(R3); ICH E2C(R2) PSUR

columns.name: meddra_pt_code
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Code
columns.description: MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) numeric code assigned to this adverse reaction after coding. The PT is the primary level used for regulatory reporting, signal detection, and line listing generation. Mandatory for ICSR submissions to FDA and EMA.
columns.reference: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.2a; EMA EudraVigilance; FDA MedWatch

columns.name: meddra_pt_name
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) Name
columns.description: Human-readable MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) label corresponding to the meddra_pt_code. Stored denormalized for reporting and line listing generation without requiring a join to the MedDRA reference table.
columns.reference: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.2b

columns.name: meddra_soc_code
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code
columns.description: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) code representing the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy. Used for regulatory line listings, PSUR summary tabulations, and risk management plan (RMP) categorization.
columns.reference: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.2c; ICH E2C(R2); EMA RMP guideline

columns.name: meddra_version
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Version
columns.description: Version of the MedDRA dictionary used to code this adverse reaction (e.g., 26.0, 26.1). Critical for regulatory submissions and recoding exercises when MedDRA versions are updated. Required for reproducibility of signal detection analyses.
columns.reference: MedDRA Introductory Guide; ICH E2B(R3); EMA EudraVigilance technical specification

columns.name: medical_confirmation
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse reaction has been medically confirmed by a healthcare professional (HCP). Medically confirmed cases carry greater weight in signal detection and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field A.1.7.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) A.1.7; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance; Argus Safety

columns.name: onset_date
columns.description: Date on which the adverse reaction first began. Used to calculate time-to-onset from drug exposure, supports causality assessment, and is required for ICSR regulatory submissions. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field B.2.i.4.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.4; FDA 21 CFR 314.81; EMA EudraVigilance; Argus Safety

columns.name: outcome_code
columns.description: Standardized outcome of the adverse reaction at the time of reporting. Values align with ICH E2B(R3) outcome codes: recovered/resolved, recovering/resolving, not recovered/not resolved, fatal, unknown, recovered with sequelae. Mandatory for regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.7; FDA MedWatch; EMA EudraVigilance; Argus Safety outcome field

columns.name: reaction_duration_days
columns.description: Duration of the adverse reaction in days, calculated from onset to resolution. Stored as a business attribute when explicitly reported by the reporter or calculated during case processing. Supports time-to-resolution analytics and benefit-risk assessments.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.5; Argus Safety duration field; ICH E2C(R2) PSUR

columns.name: reaction_sequence_number
columns.description: Sequential line number of this adverse reaction within the parent ICSR, enabling ordering and identification of multiple events within a single case. Corresponds to the reaction/event sequence in ICH E2B(R3) message structure.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section B.2; Argus Safety reaction sequence

columns.name: reaction_status
columns.description: Current workflow processing status of this adverse reaction record within the pharmacovigilance case management system: new (received, not yet processed), under review, coded (MedDRA coding complete), medically reviewed, closed (finalized), or deleted (voided). Drives case management workflow in Argus Safety.
columns.reference: EMA GVP Module VI; FDA 21 CFR 314.81; Argus Safety case workflow; ICH E2B(R3)

columns.name: rechallenge_result
columns.description: Outcome of rechallenge (re-administration of the suspect drug after withdrawal) if performed. Positive rechallenge (reaction recurred) strengthens causality. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field B.4.k.19.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.4.k.19; WHO-UMC Causality Assessment; Argus Safety rechallenge field

columns.name: regulatory_report_type
columns.description: Classification of the regulatory reporting obligation triggered by this adverse reaction: 7-day expedited (unexpected fatal/life-threatening SUSAR), 15-day expedited (other serious unexpected), periodic (PSUR/PBRER), non-expedited, or not reportable. Drives submission workflow and deadline tracking.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance; EU Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014; ICH E2C(R2)

columns.name: reporting_source_type
columns.description: Classification of the original source from which this adverse reaction was reported: spontaneous (unsolicited), clinical trial, published literature, regulatory authority, or other. Determines applicable reporting timelines and regulatory obligations. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field A.1.4.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) A.1.4; FDA 21 CFR 314.81; EMA EudraVigilance; ICH E2D

columns.name: resolution_date
columns.description: Date on which the adverse reaction resolved or ended. Null if the event is ongoing, fatal, or outcome is unknown. Used to calculate event duration and supports outcome determination. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) field B.2.i.6.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.6; FDA 21 CFR 314.81; Argus Safety

columns.name: seriousness_criteria
columns.description: Pipe-delimited list of applicable seriousness criteria met by this adverse reaction per ICH E2A: death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability/incapacity, congenital anomaly, medically significant. Supports regulatory reporting classification and expedited reporting decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death|life_threatening|hospitalization|prolonged_hospitalization|disability|congenital_anomaly|medically_significant — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3) B.1.i.3; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA EudraVigilance

columns.name: severity_description
columns.description: Narrative severity classification of the adverse reaction using standard WHO/ICH terminology: mild, moderate, severe, life-threatening, or fatal. Complements CTCAE grade for non-oncology cases and post-market surveillance where CTCAE grading is not used.
columns.reference: WHO Adverse Reaction Terminology; ICH E2B(R3); FDA MedWatch; Argus Safety severity field

columns.name: signal_detection_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this adverse reaction record has been flagged as contributing to a potential pharmacovigilance signal under review. Set by the signal detection process in the safety database. Supports signal management workflow and regulatory signal reporting obligations.
columns.reference: ICH E2C(R2); EMA Guideline on Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP) Module IX; FDA Pharmacovigilance guidance

columns.name: time_to_onset_days
columns.description: Number of days from the first dose of the suspect drug to the onset of the adverse reaction. A key pharmacovigilance metric used in signal detection, causality assessment, and benefit-risk evaluation. Derived from drug start date and reaction onset date during case processing.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3); WHO-UMC Signal Detection; FDA Pharmacovigilance guidance; Argus Safety

columns.name: verbatim_term
columns.description: The exact adverse event term as reported by the original reporter (patient, healthcare professional, or literature source) before MedDRA coding. Preserved verbatim for coding audit trail and signal detection. Required per ICH E2B(R3) field B.2.i.1.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) B.2.i.1; FDA 21 CFR 314.81; Argus Safety verbatim term

tables.name: susar
tables.description: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction record for clinical trial expedited reporting. Captures SUSARs identified from clinical trial ICSRs meeting expedited criteria: unexpected (not in IB/RSI), serious, and at least possibly causally related. Stores parent ICSR reference, trial phase, investigational product, expectedness determination against current IB, causality assessment by sponsor and investigator, 7-day (fatal/life-threatening) or 15-day reporting clock, and submission status to authorities (FDA IND safety report, EMA SUSAR, MHRA, PMDA). SLA-critical: 7-day and 15-day expedited reporting deadlines with criminal liability for non-compliance.

columns.name: susar_id
columns.glossary_term: Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) ID
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SUSAR record in the pharmacovigilance data product. Primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse entity.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on SUSAR Reporting

columns.name: adverse_event_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to patient.adverse_event. Business justification: A SUSAR classification originates from a clinical adverse event. Linking susar directly to patient.adverse_event enables expedited reporting traceability — regulators (EMA, FDA) require the source cli

columns.name: application_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: SUSARs are reported under a specific IND/CTA application. Linking susar to regulatory.application enables IND-level SUSAR tracking and annual IND safety report compilation per 21 CFR 312.33, tying eac

columns.name: brand_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: SUSARs tracked by brand for expedited regulatory reporting (FDA, EMA) and brand-specific safety monitoring during clinical development. Critical for development safety update reports (DSURs) and inves

columns.name: drug_substance_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_substance. Business justification: Substance-level SUSAR aggregation: SUSARs are reported per investigational product but aggregated by active substance across trials for development safety update reports (DSURs). Linking to drug_subst

columns.name: health_authority_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: SUSARs are reported to specific health authorities (FDA via IND, EMA via EudraCT/CTIS). A proper FK to health_authority enables authority-specific SUSAR reporting compliance tracking, deadline managem

columns.name: icsr_id
columns.description: Reference to the parent Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) from which this SUSAR was identified. Links the SUSAR to its originating safety case in Argus Safety / Oracle AERS.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: internal_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: SUSAR investigations in clinical trials generate specific costs for expedited assessments, unblinding procedures, and regulatory submissions. Finance tracks these via internal orders linked to trial b

columns.name: investigational_compound_id

columns.name: investigational_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.investigational_product. Business justification: SUSARs reference the specific IMP batch and formulation for causality assessment and regulatory submission. investigational_product_name, investigational_product_dose, investigational_product_route on

columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: SUSARs involving investigational products require manufacturing plant identification for quality/manufacturing investigations and batch recall decisions. Linking SUSAR to the manufacturing plant of th

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to patient.patient. Business justification: SUSARs (Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions) in clinical trials must be traceable to the specific trial subject for expedited regulatory reporting to FDA (IND safety reports), EMA (EudraVig

columns.name: processing_org_unit_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: SUSARs require expedited regulatory reporting (7/15-day clock) and are owned by specific PV org units. Org unit assignment supports submission deadline tracking, regulatory accountability, and GCP ins

columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.project. Business justification: SUSARs are filed under a specific IND which belongs to a discovery project. Regulatory teams must associate SUSARs with the development project for IND annual reports, DSUR preparation, and clinical p

columns.name: protocol_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.protocol. Business justification: SUSARs must be reported against the specific protocol version active at the time of the event per FDA 21 CFR 312.32 and EMA GVP Module VI. susar has trial_id but not protocol_id; the protocol version

columns.name: pv_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacovigilance.pv_product. Business justification: A SUSAR is always associated with a specific investigational medicinal product under PV surveillance. The susar table captures investigational_product_name as a free-text string but lacks a structured

columns.name: submission_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: SUSARs must be expedited-reported under the IND/CTA regulatory submission. Linking susar to regulatory.submission enables IND safety reporting compliance tracking per 21 CFR 312.32 and EudraCT require

columns.name: trial_id
columns.description: Reference to the clinical trial in which the SUSAR occurred. Used to associate the SUSAR with the relevant Investigational New Drug (IND) application and trial protocol.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trial Regulation (EU) No 536/2014

columns.name: argus_case_number
columns.description: The unique case number assigned by the Argus Safety / Oracle AERS pharmacovigilance system for this SUSAR. Serves as the system-of-record identifier for cross-system traceability.
columns.reference: Argus Safety System; ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 312.32

columns.name: assigned_treatment_arm
columns.description: The treatment arm to which the subject was assigned (e.g., investigational product, comparator, placebo), populated after unblinding. Required for causality assessment and regulatory reporting when unblinding has occurred.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: blinding_status
columns.glossary_term: Trial Blinding Status at Time of SUSAR
columns.description: Indicates whether the clinical trial was blinded at the time the SUSAR was identified, and if so, whether unblinding occurred for this case. Unblinding for SUSAR reporting is a critical regulatory and trial integrity decision.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this SUSAR record was first created in the pharmacovigilance system (Argus Safety / Oracle AERS). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GCP Audit Trail Requirements

columns.name: ema_eudravigilance_submission_date
columns.description: The date on which the SUSAR was submitted to the EMA via the EudraVigilance Clinical Trial Module (EVCTM). Null if not yet submitted or not applicable.
columns.reference: EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline; EU Clinical Trial Regulation No 536/2014; EudraVigilance EVCTM

columns.name: expectedness_determination
columns.description: The sponsor's determination of whether the adverse reaction is expected or unexpected based on comparison against the current Investigator's Brochure (IB) or Reference Safety Information (RSI). An 'unexpected' determination is a prerequisite for SUSAR classification.
columns.reference: ICH E2A Section I; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: fda_ind_submission_date
columns.glossary_term: FDA Investigational New Drug (IND) Safety Report Submission Date
columns.description: The date on which the SUSAR was submitted to the FDA as an IND safety report under 21 CFR Part 312.32. Null if not yet submitted or not applicable. Used for SLA compliance tracking.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); FDA Guidance on IND Safety Reporting

columns.name: follow_up_number
columns.description: Sequential number of the follow-up report for this SUSAR (e.g., 1 for first follow-up, 2 for second). Zero or null for initial reports. Used to track the version history of regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section A.1.12; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: initial_receipt_date
columns.description: The date on which the sponsor first received valid minimum information about the adverse reaction, triggering the start of the expedited reporting clock. Day 0 for 7-day and 15-day SLA calculations per ICH E2A.
columns.reference: ICH E2A Section III; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c)(1); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: investigator_causality
columns.description: The treating investigator's assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse reaction, as reported on the Case Report Form (CRF). Captured separately from sponsor causality per ICH E2A requirements.
columns.reference: ICH E2A Section I; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: is_fatal
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse reaction resulted in the death of the subject. A fatal outcome triggers the 7-day expedited reporting clock and is a primary driver of reporting urgency.
columns.reference: ICH E2A Section II; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c)(1)(i); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: is_life_threatening
columns.description: Indicates whether the adverse reaction was life-threatening at the time of occurrence (i.e., the subject was at immediate risk of death). Together with is_fatal, determines applicability of the 7-day reporting clock.
columns.reference: ICH E2A Section II; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c)(1)(i); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this SUSAR record was most recently modified in the pharmacovigilance system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and change tracking for regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GCP Audit Trail Requirements

columns.name: medical_review_date
columns.description: The date on which the qualified medical reviewer completed the medical assessment of this SUSAR. Part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: mhra_submission_date
columns.description: The date on which the SUSAR was submitted to the UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA). Null if not applicable.
columns.reference: MHRA Guidance on SUSAR Reporting; UK Clinical Trials Regulations 2004 (SI 2004/1031)

columns.name: narrative_text
columns.description: The free-text clinical narrative describing the SUSAR, including the sequence of events, medical history, treatment, and outcome. Required for all regulatory submissions per ICH E2B(R3). Classified as confidential due to sensitive clinical content.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section H.1; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: pmda_submission_date
columns.description: The date on which the SUSAR was submitted to the Japan Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA). Null if not applicable.
columns.reference: PMDA Pharmacovigilance Regulations; Japanese Pharmaceutical Affairs Law

columns.name: reaction_meddra_pt_code
columns.glossary_term: Adverse Reaction MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) Code
columns.description: The MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities) Preferred Term code representing the primary adverse reaction. Mandatory for regulatory submissions to FDA, EMA, MHRA, and PMDA.
columns.reference: MedDRA Version Current; ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: reaction_meddra_pt_name
columns.glossary_term: Adverse Reaction MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) Name
columns.description: The human-readable MedDRA Preferred Term name corresponding to the reaction_meddra_pt_code. Stored for reporting clarity and to avoid repeated lookups against the MedDRA dictionary.
columns.reference: MedDRA Version Current; ICH E2B(R3); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: reaction_meddra_soc_name
columns.glossary_term: Adverse Reaction MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) Name
columns.description: The MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) under which the primary adverse reaction is classified. Used for signal detection, aggregate analysis, and PSUR/PBRER reporting by therapeutic area.
columns.reference: MedDRA Version Current; ICH E2B(R3); ICH E2C(R2) PBRER

columns.name: reaction_onset_date
columns.description: The date on which the suspected unexpected serious adverse reaction first manifested in the subject. Used for temporal causality assessment and time-to-onset analysis.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section G.k.4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: reaction_outcome
columns.description: The outcome of the adverse reaction at the time of reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recovered|recovering|not_recovered|recovered_with_sequelae|fatal|unknown — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section G.i.8; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: report_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the SUSAR record within the pharmacovigilance workflow. Drives workflow routing in Argus Safety and regulatory submission tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|submitted|follow_up_pending|closed|invalidated — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2A; Argus Safety Workflow; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: reporting_clock_type
columns.description: Indicates whether this SUSAR is subject to a 7-day expedited reporting clock (fatal or life-threatening) or a 15-day reporting clock (all other serious unexpected reactions). Drives SLA enforcement and regulatory deadline calculation.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline; MHRA Guidance on SUSAR Reporting

columns.name: reporting_deadline_date
columns.description: The calculated calendar date by which the SUSAR must be submitted to all applicable health authorities, derived from initial_receipt_date plus the applicable reporting clock (7 or 15 calendar days). SLA-critical field with criminal liability for non-compliance.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32(c); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline; MHRA Guidance

columns.name: seriousness_criteria
columns.description: The ICH E2A seriousness criterion or criteria met by this adverse reaction, which qualifies it as serious. Multiple criteria may apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fatal|life_threatening|hospitalization_required|prolonged_hospitalization|persistent_disability|congenital_anomaly|medically_significant — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2A Section II; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: sponsor_causality
columns.description: The sponsor's assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse reaction. A causality of 'related' or 'not assessable' (where benefit of doubt applies) is required for SUSAR classification.
columns.reference: ICH E2A Section I; 21 CFR Part 312.32(a); EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: subject_age
columns.glossary_term: Subject Age at Time of Reaction
columns.description: The age of the clinical trial subject in years at the time the adverse reaction occurred. Required for regulatory submissions and demographic analysis. Classified as restricted PHI.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section D.2.2; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 9

columns.name: subject_sex
columns.description: The biological sex of the clinical trial subject as recorded in the case report. Required for ICH E2B(R3) regulatory submissions and demographic safety analysis. Classified as restricted PHI.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section D.5; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; GDPR Article 9

columns.name: submission_type
columns.description: Indicates whether this SUSAR record represents an initial report, a follow-up report with additional information, or a final report. Tracks the reporting lifecycle across multiple submissions to health authorities.
columns.reference: ICH E2A; ICH E2B(R3); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: trial_phase
columns.description: The phase of the clinical trial in which the SUSAR occurred (Phase I through Phase IV). Influences regulatory reporting obligations and signal assessment context.
columns.value_regex: Phase I|Phase II|Phase III|Phase IV|Not Applicable
columns.reference: ICH E8(R1); 21 CFR Part 312.21; EMA Clinical Trial Regulation (EU) No 536/2014

columns.name: unblinding_date
columns.description: The date on which the treatment assignment was unblinded for this SUSAR case, if applicable. Null for open-label trials or cases where unblinding was not performed. Critical for audit trail and trial integrity documentation.
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.6; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA SUSAR Reporting Guideline

columns.name: worldwide_unique_case_number
columns.description: The globally unique case identifier assigned per ICH E2B(R3) standards, formatted as country code + organisation identifier + local case number. Used for regulatory submissions and cross-authority deduplication.
columns.reference: ICH E2B(R3) Section A.1.0.1; EudraVigilance; FDA FAERS

tables.name: sae_report
tables.description: Serious Adverse Event report record capturing SAEs from clinical trials, post-market surveillance, and spontaneous sources. Stores SAE classification criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, medically important), time to onset, treatment given, dechallenge/rechallenge results, reporter information, site/investigator details, and reconciliation status with clinical trial EDC systems. Tracks the SAE from initial receipt through medical review, causality assessment, and regulatory submission. Supports reconciliation workflows between clinical database and PV safety database per ICH E2D guidance. SLA-critical: initial SAE notification within 24 hours of site awareness.

columns.name: sae_report_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SAE report record in the pharmacovigilance safety database. Primary key for this entity.
columns.reference: ICH E2D; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

columns.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.investigational_product.
