columns.description: Classification of the packaging configuration based on its intended use and distribution channel.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 312 - Investigational New Drug Application; 21 CFR Part 314 - Applications for FDA Approval to Market a New Drug

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this packaging configuration record was first created in the master data system.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

columns.name: discontinuation_date
columns.description: Date on which this packaging configuration was discontinued and is no longer manufactured or distributed.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 314.81 - Other postmarketing reports

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date from which this packaging configuration becomes active and available for manufacturing and distribution.

columns.name: fill_volume_ml
columns.description: Volume of drug product filled into the primary container, measured in milliliters. Critical for dosing accuracy and overfill calculations.
columns.reference: USP <698> Deliverable Volume; ICH Q6A - Specifications

columns.name: gtin
columns.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-14) used for supply chain identification and track-and-trace serialization.
columns.reference: GS1 General Specifications; DSCSA - Drug Supply Chain Security Act; EU FMD - Falsified Medicines Directive

columns.name: headspace_volume_ml
columns.description: Volume of air or inert gas in the primary container above the drug product, important for stability and oxidation control.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1207> Package Integrity

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this packaging configuration record.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

columns.name: lifecycle_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the packaging configuration indicating its availability for manufacturing and distribution.

columns.name: light_protection_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the packaging must protect the drug product from light exposure to prevent photodegradation.

columns.name: moisture_protection_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the packaging must provide moisture barrier protection to prevent hygroscopic degradation.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1136> Packaging and Storage Requirements

columns.name: ndc_code
columns.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code uniquely identifying this specific packaging configuration in the US market. Format: labeler-product-package.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 207 - Registration of Producers of Drugs and Listing of Drugs in Commercial Distribution; FDA NDC Directory

columns.name: nominal_fill_volume_ml
columns.description: Labeled or declared fill volume on the packaging, which may differ from actual fill volume due to overfill requirements.
columns.reference: USP <698> Deliverable Volume; 21 CFR Part 201 - Labeling

columns.name: package_insert_version
columns.description: Version identifier of the package insert or patient information leaflet included with this packaging configuration.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 201 - Labeling; EMA QRD Template - Quality Review of Documents

columns.name: primary_container_material
columns.description: Material composition of the primary container, critical for stability and compatibility with the drug substance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: glass_type_i|glass_type_ii|glass_type_iii|plastic_hdpe|plastic_ldpe|plastic_pet|plastic_pp|aluminum|laminate — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: USP <661> Containers - Plastics; USP <660> Containers - Glass; ICH Q1A - Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

columns.name: primary_container_type
columns.description: Type of primary container that is in direct contact with the drug product, part of the container closure system (CCS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vial|ampoule|blister|bottle|syringe|cartridge|pen|inhaler|sachet|tube|pouch — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ISO 11239 - Pharmaceutical dose forms; USP <1207> Package Integrity Evaluation

columns.name: regulatory_approval_date
columns.description: Date on which the packaging configuration received regulatory approval for commercial distribution.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314 - NDA Approval; EMA Marketing Authorization Procedures

columns.name: retest_period_months
columns.description: Period in months after which the drug product must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; ICH Q6A - Specifications

columns.name: serialization_level
columns.description: Level at which unique serialization is applied for track-and-trace compliance (unit, pack, case, or pallet level).
columns.reference: DSCSA - Drug Supply Chain Security Act (US); EU FMD 2011/62/EU; GS1 EPCIS

columns.name: shelf_life_months
columns.description: Approved shelf life duration in months from date of manufacture, based on stability study data.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; ICH Q1E - Evaluation of Stability Data

columns.name: storage_condition_description
columns.description: Detailed textual description of storage conditions including temperature range, humidity, light protection, and orientation requirements.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.142 - Warehousing procedures

columns.name: storage_temperature_max_c
columns.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain product stability and efficacy.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices

columns.name: storage_temperature_min_c
columns.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain product stability and efficacy.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing; USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices

columns.name: tamper_evident_feature
columns.description: Type of tamper-evident feature incorporated into the packaging to ensure product integrity and patient safety.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.132 - Tamper-evident packaging requirements; ISO 8317 - Child-resistant packaging

columns.name: tertiary_packaging_type
columns.description: Type of tertiary or shipper packaging used for bulk distribution and logistics, containing multiple secondary packs.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines - Good Distribution Practice; ISO 11239

columns.name: units_per_primary_pack
columns.description: Number of individual dosage units (tablets, capsules, vials) contained in the primary packaging.

columns.name: units_per_secondary_pack
columns.description: Number of primary containers included in one secondary package unit.

columns.name: units_per_tertiary_pack
columns.description: Number of secondary packages contained in one tertiary shipper or case for distribution.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines; Supply Chain Packaging Standards

tables.name: sku
tables.description: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) master record representing the commercially sellable unit of a drug product at a specific strength, dosage form, and packaging configuration. Captures GTIN/EAN barcode, SAP material number, trade name, market (country/region), launch date, discontinuation date, commercial status (active, discontinued, withdrawn), and channel designation (retail, hospital, specialty pharmacy). Serves as the SSOT for commercial product identity referenced by supply chain, commercial, and finance domains. NDC codes for US-market SKUs are managed via regulatory_identifier.

columns.name: sku_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the SKU record. Primary key for the SKU master data product.

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: SKUs are market-specific (country-level) for pricing, reimbursement, distribution, regulatory compliance. Replaces denormalized market_country_code with FK to country master for market access analytic

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: A SKU is the commercially sellable unit of a drug product. While sku already references medicinal_product and packaging_configuration, a direct FK to drug_product is essential for supply chain, manufa

columns.name: licensing_agreement_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: SKUs sold under co-promotion or distribution licensing agreements require this link for royalty calculation on net sales by SKU, territory rights enforcement, and financial reporting to licensors per

columns.name: mah_legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: SKU-level Marketing Authorization Holder tracking for market-specific regulatory compliance, product liability, pharmacovigilance case processing. Each market/SKU may have different MAH (local affilia

columns.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.ndc_code. Business justification: SKUs in US market must link to NDC for billing (pharmacy claims, 340B), reimbursement (Medicare Part D), serialization (DSCSA compliance). Replaces denormalized ndc_code with FK to NDC master for pric

columns.name: medicinal_product_id
columns.description: Reference to the parent drug product (DP) or finished dosage form (FDF) that this SKU represents at a specific packaging and market configuration.

columns.name: orange_book_listing_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.orange_book_listing. Business justification: Commercial SKUs must reference their Orange Book listing for pharmacy substitution decisions, therapeutic equivalence codes, and generic entry monitoring. Commercial and regulatory teams use this link

columns.name: packaging_configuration_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Business justification: SKU is the commercially sellable unit with specific packaging. The packaging details (package_size, package_type, storage_condition, cold_chain_required, shelf_life_months) on sku should reference the

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: SKUs are the commercial unit of sale and must be assigned to profit centers for revenue reporting, gross-to-net calculations, and commercial P&L. This is a standard requirement in pharma commercial fi

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Reference to the primary manufacturing site or CMO/CDMO facility responsible for producing this SKU. Used for supply chain planning, quality investigations, and regulatory inspections.

columns.name: therapeutic_area_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: sku has therapeutic_area as a STRING attribute that should reference the therapeutic_area master table for standardized classification.

columns.name: trademark_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.trademark. Business justification: Each market SKU is sold under trademark protection. Essential for commercial operations, brand enforcement, market-specific trademark registration tracking, and anti-counterfeiting programs.

columns.name: atc_code
columns.description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code for the active ingredient. Used for therapeutic classification and pharmacoepidemiological research.

columns.name: commercial_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU in the market. Active indicates commercially available; discontinued indicates no longer manufactured but may have remaining inventory; withdrawn indicates removed from market for safety or regulatory reasons.
columns.reference: ICH E2D - Post-Approval Safety Data Management

columns.name: controlled_substance_schedule
columns.description: DEA controlled substance schedule classification (I-V) for SKUs containing controlled substances. Non-controlled if not a controlled substance. Determines regulatory handling and reporting requirements.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the SKU master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the list price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Aligns with the market country.

columns.name: discontinuation_date
columns.description: Date on which the SKU was discontinued or withdrawn from the market. Null if the SKU is still active. Used for supply chain planning and pharmacovigilance reporting.

columns.name: distribution_channel
columns.description: Primary distribution channel or customer segment for this SKU (e.g., retail pharmacy, hospital, specialty pharmacy). Impacts pricing, contracting, and supply chain routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|hospital|specialty_pharmacy|mail_order|clinic|government|veterinary — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: dosage_form
columns.description: Physical form in which the drug product is presented (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, cream). Aligns with FDA dosage form terminology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|solution|suspension|injection|cream|ointment|patch|inhaler|suppository|powder|gel|emulsion|aerosol|implant|film|lozenge|spray — 18 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: generic_name
columns.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or United States Adopted Name (USAN) for the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in this SKU.

columns.name: gtin
columns.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14) barcode identifier for the SKU. Used for supply chain tracking, point-of-sale scanning, and serialization compliance.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Indicates whether the SKU record is currently active in the system. False if the record has been logically deleted or archived. Used for data filtering and reporting.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the SKU master record. Used for change tracking and data governance.

columns.name: launch_date
columns.description: Date on which the SKU was first made commercially available in the specified market. Used for lifecycle tracking and patent exclusivity calculations.

columns.name: list_price
columns.description: Manufacturer's suggested retail price or wholesale acquisition cost (WAC) for the SKU in the local currency. Used for pricing strategy, contracting, and financial planning.

columns.name: material_number
columns.description: SAP S/4HANA material master number uniquely identifying this SKU in the ERP system. Serves as the primary business identifier for procurement, manufacturing, and sales operations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

columns.name: modified_by_user
columns.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the SKU master record. Required for audit trail and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Signatures

columns.name: prescription_status
columns.description: Regulatory classification indicating whether the SKU requires a prescription (Rx), is available over-the-counter (OTC), or has restricted access. Varies by market jurisdiction.
columns.reference: FDA - Prescription Drug Marketing Act, EMA - Legal Status for Supply

columns.name: product_type
columns.description: Classification of the SKU by regulatory and commercial category (e.g., branded innovator drug, generic, biosimilar, vaccine, OTC). Impacts regulatory pathway, pricing, and market access strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: branded|generic|biosimilar|vaccine|otc|medical_device_combination|orphan_drug — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: FDA - Drug Categories, EMA - Product Classification

columns.name: regulatory_approval_number
columns.description: Market-specific regulatory approval or authorization number (e.g., NDA number in US, MA number in EU, approval number in Japan). Links the SKU to its regulatory dossier.

columns.name: reimbursement_code
columns.description: Market-specific reimbursement or pricing code used by payers and health authorities (e.g., HCPCS code in US, PZN in Germany). Enables claims processing and market access.
columns.reference: CMS - HCPCS Coding, National Reimbursement Authorities

columns.name: rems_program
columns.glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program
columns.description: Name or identifier of the FDA-mandated REMS program if applicable. Null if no REMS required. REMS programs impose additional safety requirements for high-risk products.
columns.reference: FDA - Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies

columns.name: route_of_administration
columns.description: Method by which the drug product is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical). Critical for prescribing and dispensing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|intravenous|intramuscular|subcutaneous|topical|transdermal|inhalation|rectal|ophthalmic|otic|nasal|sublingual|buccal — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: serialization_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the SKU is subject to serialization and track-and-trace requirements under DSCSA (US), FMD (EU), or other regional regulations. True if unique serial numbers must be applied at unit level.
columns.reference: FDA DSCSA - Drug Supply Chain Security Act, EU FMD - Falsified Medicines Directive

columns.name: strength
columns.description: Potency or concentration of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the finished dosage form, including unit of measure (e.g., 500mg, 10mg/mL, 0.5%).
columns.reference: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

columns.name: trade_name
columns.description: Commercial brand name or trade name under which the SKU is marketed and sold. May differ by market or therapeutic indication.

tables.name: product_ndc_code
tables.description: National Drug Code (NDC) registry record for each FDA-listed drug product. Captures the 10-digit NDC number (labeler, product, package segments), FDA listing status, listing date, application number linkage (NDA/ANDA/BLA), proprietary name, non-proprietary name, and DEA schedule. Serves as the authoritative NDC-to-product mapping for regulatory compliance, dispensing, and reimbursement.

columns.name: product_ndc_code_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the NDC registry record. Primary key for the product NDC code entity.

columns.name: atc_classification_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: NDC-to-ATC mapping is used in pharmacovigilance signal detection, market research, and payer formulary management. The atc_code plain-text column is a denormalized reference to the ATC classification

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: An NDC code is assigned to a specific drug product (finished dosage form with defined strength, route, and dosage form). The product_ndc_code already links to medicinal_product and packaging_configura

columns.name: inn_registry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: NDC codes map to INN for drug classification, interoperability (HL7, FHIR), data exchange (FDA SPL). Replaces denormalized inn_name with FK to INN registry for standardized substance identification, t

columns.name: labeler_legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: NDC labeler code must map to legal entity for FDA establishment registration, labeling compliance, product listing. Replaces denormalized labeler_name with FK for regulatory reporting (FDA SPL submiss

columns.name: medicinal_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key reference to the master product entity in the product domain. Links the NDC record to the internal product catalog.

columns.name: orange_book_listing_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.orange_book_listing. Business justification: NDC codes appear directly in Orange Book listings as the product identifier. Regulatory teams managing Orange Book listings need to link NDC records to their Orange Book entry for listing status updat

columns.name: packaging_configuration_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.packaging_configuration. Business justification: NDC codes are assigned to specific packaging configurations in the FDA listing system. The package_description, package_quantity, and package_unit on product_ndc_code should reference the packaging_co

columns.name: patent_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: NDC codes are associated with patents via Orange Book listings. Patent term extension calculations and SPC applications reference the specific NDC/product code. Regulatory and IP teams need this link

columns.name: active_ingredient
columns.description: The substance or substances in the drug product responsible for the therapeutic effect. May list multiple active ingredients for combination products.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207; ICH Q6A

columns.name: application_number
columns.description: The FDA-assigned application number for the drug product. Prefix indicates application type: NDA (New Drug Application), ANDA (Abbreviated New Drug Application for generics), or BLA (Biologics License Application).
columns.reference: FDA Orange Book; 21 CFR Parts 314 and 601

columns.name: application_type
columns.description: The type of FDA regulatory application under which the drug product is approved: NDA (New Drug Application for new molecular entities), ANDA (Abbreviated New Drug Application for generics), BLA (Biologics License Application), or OTC (Over-The-Counter, no application required).
columns.reference: FDA Regulatory Standards; 21 CFR Parts 314 and 601

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this NDC registry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

columns.name: dea_schedule
columns.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification if the drug product contains a controlled substance. CI (Schedule I) through CV (Schedule V) indicate increasing levels of accepted medical use and decreasing abuse potential. Unscheduled indicates no controlled substance.
columns.reference: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

columns.name: dosage_form
columns.description: The physical form of the drug product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream, patch). Describes how the drug is administered.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: labeler_code
columns.description: The first segment of the NDC identifying the labeler (manufacturer, repackager, or distributor). Assigned by FDA to the firm that manufactures, repacks, or distributes the drug product.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this NDC registry record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

columns.name: listing_date
columns.description: The date the drug product was first listed with the FDA National Drug Code Directory. Required for all marketed drug products.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: listing_expiration_date
columns.description: The date the FDA listing expires or was terminated. Null for active listings. Populated when a product is discontinued or delisted.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: listing_status
columns.description: Current status of the NDC listing with FDA. Active indicates the product is currently marketed; inactive indicates listing is no longer active; discontinued indicates the product has been permanently removed from the market.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: marketing_end_date
columns.description: The date the drug product was withdrawn from the market or discontinued. Null for products still being marketed.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: marketing_start_date
columns.description: The date the drug product was first commercially marketed in the United States. This is the date the product became available for sale.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: ndc_number
columns.description: The 10-digit or 11-digit FDA National Drug Code in standard format with hyphens separating labeler code, product code, and package code segments. This is the authoritative FDA-assigned identifier for the drug product.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: non_proprietary_name
columns.description: The established or generic name of the drug product, typically the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) name. May be the INN (International Nonproprietary Name) or USAN (United States Adopted Name).
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; WHO INN; USAN Council

columns.name: package_code
columns.description: The third segment of the NDC identifying the package size and type for the drug product.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: product_code
columns.description: The second segment of the NDC identifying the specific strength, dosage form, and formulation of the drug product for a particular firm.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: product_type
columns.description: The regulatory classification of the drug product indicating whether it is a prescription drug, over-the-counter (OTC) drug, biologic, vaccine, or plasma derivative.
columns.value_regex: human prescription drug|human otc drug|human prescription drug|biologics|vaccine|plasma derivative
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: proprietary_name
columns.description: The trademarked brand name under which the drug product is marketed. Also known as the trade name or brand name.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: reimbursement_code
columns.description: The code used for insurance reimbursement and billing purposes, often the 11-digit NDC format required by CMS and payers.

columns.name: route_of_administration
columns.description: The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, topical, subcutaneous, intramuscular).
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: rx_otc_indicator
columns.description: Indicates whether the drug product requires a prescription (Rx) or is available over-the-counter (OTC) without a prescription.
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: strength
columns.description: The concentration or potency of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) in the drug product, including unit of measure (e.g., 500mg, 10mg/mL, 0.5%).
columns.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory; 21 CFR Part 207

columns.name: therapeutic_equivalence_code
columns.description: The FDA Orange Book therapeutic equivalence code indicating whether the drug product is therapeutically equivalent to other pharmaceutically equivalent products. Codes starting with A are considered therapeutically equivalent; codes starting with B are not.

columns.name: usan_name
columns.description: The United States Adopted Name for the active pharmaceutical ingredient. This is the official generic name used in the United States, often aligned with the INN.

tables.name: lifecycle
tables.description: Tracks the lifecycle stage and status transitions of a medicinal product from discovery through post-market, including pipeline stage (discovery, preclinical, Phase I/II/III, NDA/BLA submission, approved, launched, LOE, discontinued). Captures stage entry date, exit date, milestone events, responsible team, and lifecycle gate criteria. Provides the authoritative product lifecycle timeline referenced by portfolio planning and regulatory domains.
tables.reference: ICH M4 / FDA Drug Development Lifecycle

columns.name: lifecycle_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the product lifecycle record. Primary key for tracking lifecycle stage transitions of a medicinal product from discovery through post-market discontinuation.

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Lifecycle stages are country-specific — a product may be in Phase III in the US while in Phase II in the EU. Country-specific lifecycle tracking is essential for global regulatory strategy, launch seq

columns.name: licensing_agreement_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: In-licensed or out-licensed assets have lifecycle stages governed by licensing agreement milestones and diligence obligations. BD and portfolio teams must link lifecycle records to the governing licen

columns.name: medicinal_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key reference to the medicinal product (Drug Product, Drug Substance, Finished Dosage Form, or SKU) whose lifecycle is being tracked. Links to the authoritative product master catalog.

columns.name: patent_family_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_family. Business justification: Lifecycle stage-gate reviews require knowing the patent family protecting the asset to assess LOE risk and exclusivity runway. Portfolio strategy and go/no-go decisions at each lifecycle stage depend

columns.name: responsible_org_unit_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Stage gate reviews and lifecycle milestone decisions are owned by specific organizational units (e.g., Global Development, Regulatory Affairs). The responsible_team plain-text column is a denormalized

columns.name: therapeutic_area_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: product_lifecycle has therapeutic_area as a STRING attribute that should reference the therapeutic_area master table for standardized classification.

columns.name: actual_launch_date
columns.description: Actual date when the product was commercially launched in the primary market. Null for products not yet launched. Used to calculate time-to-market and compare against target launch date.

columns.name: comments
columns.description: Free-text field for additional context, notes, or commentary regarding the lifecycle stage transition, gate review outcomes, or strategic considerations. Supports audit trail and knowledge management.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; Internal Data Governance Standards

columns.name: discontinuation_date
columns.description: Date when the product was formally discontinued from development or withdrawn from the market. Null for active products. Used for portfolio attrition analysis and lessons learned.
columns.reference: FDA Drug Shortages Database; EMA Withdrawal Procedures; Internal Portfolio Management Standards

columns.name: discontinuation_reason
columns.description: Primary reason for product discontinuation or development termination. Critical for portfolio risk analysis and strategic decision-making on future investments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety_concerns|efficacy_failure|commercial_viability|strategic_portfolio_decision|manufacturing_issues|regulatory_rejection|competitive_landscape — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH E2F Development Safety Update Report; Internal Portfolio Review Standards

columns.name: exclusivity_expiry_date
columns.description: Date when regulatory exclusivity periods (e.g., data exclusivity, market exclusivity, orphan exclusivity) expire. May differ from patent expiry and provides additional market protection.
columns.reference: FDA Orange Book; 21 CFR 314.108; EMA Regulatory Exclusivity Guidelines

columns.name: gate_criteria_met
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether all predefined gate criteria for the current lifecycle stage have been successfully met. Used in stage-gate governance processes to authorize progression to next stage.
columns.reference: Internal Stage-Gate Governance Framework; Portfolio Management Standards

columns.name: gate_decision
columns.description: Formal decision outcome from the gate review committee. 'Go' authorizes progression, 'conditional_go' requires specific actions, 'hold' pauses development, 'kill' terminates the program, 'recycle' returns to previous stage for additional work.
columns.reference: Internal Stage-Gate Governance Framework; Portfolio Management Standards

columns.name: gate_review_date
columns.description: Date when the formal gate review was conducted to assess readiness for stage transition. Part of the governance process ensuring disciplined portfolio management.

columns.name: indication
columns.description: Specific disease, condition, or medical indication that the product is being developed or marketed to treat. May evolve as new indications are pursued through lifecycle management strategies.
columns.reference: FDA Orange Book; EMA European Public Assessment Reports; INN WHO Drug Information

columns.name: investment_to_date
columns.description: Cumulative investment amount (in USD) spent on the product from inception through the current lifecycle stage. Includes R&D costs, clinical trial expenses, regulatory submission costs, and manufacturing setup. Used for ROI analysis and portfolio valuation.
columns.reference: Internal Financial Reporting Standards; R&D Capitalization Policy per ASC 730

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this lifecycle record is the current active record for the product. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis of lifecycle transitions.

columns.name: lifecycle_status

columns.description: Full text of the Adverse Reactions section from the label, summarizing the most common and serious adverse events observed in clinical trials and post-marketing surveillance.

columns.name: approval_date
columns.description: Date when the regulatory authority officially approved this label version.

columns.name: black_box_warning_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the label contains a black box warning (boxed warning) highlighting serious or life-threatening risks. True if present, False otherwise.

columns.name: clinical_pharmacology_text
columns.description: Full text of the Clinical Pharmacology section from the label, describing the mechanism of action (MOA), pharmacokinetics (PK), and pharmacodynamics (PD) of the drug product.
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR 201.57, EMA SmPC Section 5.1 and 5.2

columns.name: contraindications_text
columns.description: Full text of the Contraindications section from the label, listing situations where the drug product should not be used due to risk of harm.

columns.name: controlled_substance_schedule
columns.description: DEA controlled substance classification schedule if the drug product is a controlled substance. Schedule I through V indicate increasing levels of medical use and decreasing abuse potential. Not Controlled if the product is not a controlled substance.
columns.value_regex: Schedule I|Schedule II|Schedule III|Schedule IV|Schedule V|Not Controlled

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this product labeling record was first created in the system.

columns.name: dosage_administration_text
columns.description: Full text of the Dosage and Administration section from the label, providing instructions on how to prescribe, prepare, and administer the drug product.

columns.name: dosage_form
columns.description: The physical form of the finished drug product as it is administered (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream). Follows FDA or EMA standard terms for dosage forms.
columns.reference: FDA Dosage Form Terminology, EMA EDQM Standard Terms

columns.name: drug_interactions_text
columns.description: Full text of the Drug Interactions section from the label, describing known interactions with other drugs, foods, or substances that may affect efficacy or safety.

columns.name: ectd_sequence_number
columns.glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Sequence Number
columns.description: The eCTD sequence number associated with the regulatory submission that included this label version. Used for tracking regulatory submission history.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date when this label version becomes effective and must be used for all product distribution and prescribing information.
columns.reference: FDA Labeling Guidance, EMA QRD Template

columns.name: established_name
columns.description: The non-proprietary or generic name of the drug product, typically the International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or United States Adopted Name (USAN).
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR 299, WHO INN Programme, USAN Council

columns.name: expiration_date
columns.description: Date when this label version is superseded or no longer valid. Null if the label is currently active with no planned replacement.
columns.reference: FDA Labeling Guidance, EMA QRD Template

columns.name: indications_text
columns.description: Full text of the Indications and Usage section from the label, describing the approved therapeutic uses and patient populations for the drug product.

columns.name: label_language_code
columns.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the label is written (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish, ja for Japanese).

columns.name: label_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the label. Draft = under development, Submitted = filed with regulatory authority, Approved = authorized but not yet effective, Active = currently in use, Superseded = replaced by newer version, Withdrawn = removed from use.

columns.name: label_type
columns.description: Type of product label document. USPI = US Prescribing Information, SmPC = Summary of Product Characteristics (EU), PIL = Patient Information Leaflet, IFU = Instructions for Use.

columns.name: label_version
columns.description: Version number of the product label following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented with each regulatory update or revision.
columns.reference: FDA Labeling Guidance, EMA QRD Template

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this product labeling record was last modified or updated.

columns.name: pregnancy_category
columns.description: Legacy FDA pregnancy category (A, B, C, D, X) for products approved before the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLR). Not Applicable for products approved after PLLR implementation.

columns.name: proprietary_name
columns.description: The brand or trade name under which the drug product is marketed. This is the commercial name used in labeling and promotion.

columns.name: regulatory_approval_number
columns.description: Official approval or authorization number issued by the regulatory authority for this label. Examples: NDA number (FDA), MAA number (EMA), PMDA approval number.

columns.name: rems_required_flag
columns.glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) program is required for this product as mandated by FDA. True if REMS is required, False otherwise.

columns.name: route_of_administration
columns.description: The path by which the drug product is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, topical, inhalation). Follows FDA or EMA standard terms.
columns.reference: FDA Route of Administration Terminology, EMA EDQM Standard Terms

columns.name: rx_otc_status
columns.description: Indicates whether the product requires a prescription (Rx), is available over-the-counter (OTC), or is behind-the-counter (BTC) requiring pharmacist consultation.

columns.name: strength
columns.description: The amount of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) per dosage unit, expressed with unit of measure (e.g., 500 mg, 10 mg/mL, 5%).

columns.name: use_in_specific_populations_text
columns.description: Full text of the Use in Specific Populations section from the label, providing information on use in pregnancy, lactation, pediatric, geriatric, and patients with renal or hepatic impairment.

columns.name: warnings_precautions_text
columns.description: Full text of the Warnings and Precautions section from the label, describing serious adverse reactions, potential safety hazards, and steps to prevent or manage them.

tables.name: combination_product

Supports 21 CFR Part 4 compliance, regulatory strategy, and CMC documentation.

columns.name: biologic_constituent_classification
columns.description: Regulatory status of the biologic constituent under BLA (Biologics License Application) or biosimilar pathway.

columns.name: biologic_constituent_name
columns.description: Name of the biological product component if the combination product includes a biologic (e.g., monoclonal antibody, vaccine antigen, cell therapy).

columns.name: cmc_documentation_reference
columns.glossary_term: Chemistry Manufacturing and Controls (CMC) Documentation Reference
columns.description: Reference identifier to the CMC section of regulatory submissions documenting manufacturing processes, specifications, and controls for both drug and device constituents.

columns.name: combination_product_code
columns.description: Business identifier code assigned to the combination product for internal tracking and regulatory submissions.

columns.name: combination_type
columns.description: Classification of the combination product based on constituent components (e.g., drug-device for auto-injectors, drug-biologic for antibody-drug conjugates).

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the combination product record was first created in the master data system.

columns.name: cross_labeling_requirement_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the combination product requires coordinated labeling across drug and device constituents to ensure consistent safety and efficacy information.

columns.name: device_constituent_classification
columns.description: FDA device classification and regulatory pathway for the device constituent (510k=premarket notification, PMA=premarket approval, De Novo=novel device classification).

columns.name: device_constituent_name
columns.description: Name or description of the device component of the combination product (e.g., auto-injector, prefilled syringe, transdermal patch delivery system, drug-eluting stent).

columns.name: device_design_history_file_reference
columns.description: Reference identifier to the Design History File documenting the device constituent design, development, and verification activities per Quality System Regulation (QSR).

columns.name: drug_constituent_classification
columns.description: Regulatory status of the drug constituent (NDA=New Drug Application, ANDA=Abbreviated New Drug Application, BLA=Biologics License Application, IND=Investigational New Drug).

columns.name: drug_constituent_strength
columns.description: Quantitative composition of the drug constituent expressed with unit of measure (e.g., 50 mg, 0.3 mL of 1 mg/mL solution).

columns.name: gmp_compliance_status
columns.description: Current GMP compliance status for the combination product manufacturing operations based on FDA inspection outcomes.

columns.name: human_factors_study_status
columns.description: Status of human factors engineering and usability validation studies required for the device constituent to demonstrate safe and effective use by intended users.

columns.name: indication
columns.description: FDA-approved indication statement describing the disease or condition the combination product is intended to treat, prevent, or diagnose.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp

columns.name: lead_center

columns.name: lifecycle_status
columns.description: Current stage in the combination product lifecycle from development through post-market surveillance.

columns.name: primary_mode_of_action
columns.description: The single mode of action that provides the most important therapeutic action of the combination product, used to determine lead center assignment.

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: Commercial or proprietary name of the combination product as it appears on labeling and regulatory submissions.

columns.name: qbd_approach_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the combination product was developed using Quality by Design principles with defined design space and control strategy.

columns.name: regulatory_submission_number
columns.description: FDA-assigned submission number for the combination product application (NDA, BLA, PMA, or 510k number).

columns.name: rems_requirement_flag
columns.glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Requirement Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the combination product is subject to a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy to ensure benefits outweigh risks.

columns.name: rld_assignment_date
columns.glossary_term: Request for Lead Center Designation (RLD) Assignment Date
columns.description: Date when the FDA assigned the lead center designation for this combination product following RLD submission.

columns.name: shelf_life_months
columns.description: Approved shelf life of the combination product in months from date of manufacture, based on stability studies.

columns.name: storage_conditions
columns.description: Required storage conditions for the combination product to maintain stability and efficacy (e.g., refrigerated 2-8°C, room temperature, protect from light).

columns.name: usan_name
columns.description: United States Adopted Name for the active pharmaceutical ingredient in the drug constituent.

columns.description: Indicates whether products in this therapeutic area are typically eligible for accelerated approval based on surrogate or intermediate clinical endpoints.

columns.name: area_code
columns.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the therapeutic area (e.g., ONCO, IMMUNO, RARE). Used as business identifier across systems.

columns.name: area_description

columns.name: area_name

columns.name: commercial_priority_level

columns.name: controlled_substance_potential

columns.name: fast_track_eligible

columns.name: global_market_size_usd_millions

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Indicates whether this therapeutic area record is currently active and available for use in product classification, trial planning, and reporting.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this therapeutic area record was last modified in the system.

columns.name: lifecycle_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the therapeutic area within the company portfolio. Active areas have ongoing research or marketed products; emerging areas are new strategic focus; mature areas have established products; declining areas are being de-prioritized; discontinued areas are no longer pursued.

columns.name: mechanism_of_action_category
columns.description: High-level mechanism of action category for products in this therapeutic area (e.g., Targeted Therapy, Immunotherapy, Enzyme Replacement, Receptor Agonist).

columns.name: meddra_soc_code
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Code
columns.description: MedDRA System Organ Class code representing the primary organ system or etiology for this therapeutic area. Used for adverse event classification and regulatory reporting.

columns.name: meddra_soc_name
columns.glossary_term: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) Name
columns.description: MedDRA System Organ Class name (e.g., Neoplasms Benign Malignant and Unspecified, Cardiac Disorders, Nervous System Disorders).
columns.reference: ICH MedDRA - Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities

columns.name: orphan_designation_eligible
columns.description: Indicates whether products in this therapeutic area are typically eligible for orphan drug designation due to rare disease prevalence (affecting fewer than 200,000 patients in the US or fewer than 5 in 10,000 in the EU).
columns.reference: FDA Orphan Drug Act; EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000

columns.name: patient_population_estimate
columns.description: Estimated global patient population affected by diseases within this therapeutic area. Used for epidemiological analysis and market sizing.
columns.reference: WHO Global Health Estimates; Internal Epidemiology Data

columns.name: pediatric_focus
columns.description: Indicates whether this therapeutic area has a specific focus on pediatric populations, requiring pediatric investigation plans (PIP) or pediatric study plans (PSP).
columns.reference: FDA Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA); EMA Pediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006

columns.name: projected_cagr_percent

columns.reference: Internal Market Intelligence; Industry Analyst Reports

columns.name: regulatory_complexity_level
columns.description: Assessment of regulatory complexity for products in this therapeutic area based on approval pathway requirements, clinical endpoint challenges, and post-market obligations.

columns.name: rems_typically_required
columns.glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Typically Required Flag

columns.name: research_priority_level

columns.name: strategic_franchise

columns.name: unmet_medical_need_level
columns.description: Assessment of unmet medical need in this therapeutic area based on availability of effective treatments, disease burden, and patient outcomes.
columns.reference: FDA Guidance on Demonstrating Substantial Evidence of Effectiveness; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials in Small Populations

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp

columns.name: lifecycle_status

columns.name: molecular_formula
columns.description: Chemical molecular formula representing the elemental composition of the excipient.

columns.name: molecular_weight
columns.description: Molecular weight of the excipient in Daltons or grams per mole. Critical for formulation calculations and quality control.

columns.name: particle_size_specification

domains.name: patient
domains.description: Single source of truth for patient and clinical trial participant master data including demographics, enrollment status, informed consent, medical history, longitudinal treatment records, and patient-reported outcomes. Manages patient registries, patient support programs, adherence monitoring, and copay assistance programs. Ensures HIPAA and GDPR compliance for protected health information (PHI). Authoritative source for patient identity across clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, and market access programs.

tables.name: patient
tables.description: Core master entity representing a patient or clinical trial participant. Single source of truth for patient identity across clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, and market access programs. Captures demographics (date of birth, sex, gender, race, ethnicity), contact information, primary language, nationality, country of residence, patient status (active, deceased, lost-to-follow-up), global patient identifier (GPID), cross-system identifiers (CTMS subject number, EDC ID, PV case patient ID, specialty pharmacy ID, EHR MRN), pseudonymization token for HIPAA/GDPR compliance, master patient index (MPI) linkage, consent status flag, data privacy classification, and audit metadata. Authoritative record for all downstream patient-linked data products.

tables.name: patient_enrollment
tables.description: Transactional record capturing a participant's enrollment into a clinical trial, patient support program, or patient registry, including full disposition lifecycle. Tracks enrollment type (clinical_trial, support_program, registry), enrollment date, randomization date/number, assigned treatment arm, site/investigator identifiers, enrollment status lifecycle (screened, enrolled, randomized, completed, withdrawn, screen-failed), screen failure reason, protocol/ICF version at enrollment. Single source of truth for both enrollment and disposition — serves as authoritative source for CDISC SDTM DM/DS domain derivation and CSR population summaries.

tables.name: informed_consent
tables.description: Unified consent lifecycle management covering clinical informed consent (ICF), re-consent events, consent withdrawals, and all data privacy authorizations. Clinical consent: ICF version, consent/withdrawal dates, consenting investigator, witness, method (paper, eConsent), language, sub-study consent flags (genetic, biomarker, future use). Privacy consent: GDPR Article 6/9 lawful basis, HIPAA authorization, consent purpose (data processing, research, marketing, data sharing), data subject rights requests (access, erasure, portability, rectification), request/fulfillment dates, jurisdiction (EU, US, UK, JP), consent channel (web, paper, verbal). Captures consent category (clinical_icf, re-consent, withdrawal, privacy_gdpr, privacy_hipaa, data_sharing), LAR/caregiver reference for pediatric populations, and full audit trail. Single source of truth for ALL consent types — clinical and privacy. Mandatory for GCP compliance, regulatory inspection readiness, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and data subject rights fulfillment.
