columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: HTA dossiers cite patent protection status to demonstrate value proposition duration and justify pricing over the protected period. HTA bodies evaluate patent expiry when assessing long-term budget im

columns.name: patent_term_extension_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_term_extension. Business justification: HTA submissions reference patent term extensions as part of the product lifecycle context. The PTE-adjusted expiry date affects the economic model time horizon and the budget impact analysis period pr

columns.name: rmp_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacovigilance.rmp. Business justification: HTA bodies (EMA, NICE, HAS, G-BA) require the current approved RMP as a mandatory component of HTA dossier submissions. The specific RMP version submitted must be traceable to the HTA submission recor

columns.name: value_dossier_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to market.value_dossier. Business justification: An HTA submission is supported by a value dossier — the dossier contains the clinical and economic evidence package submitted to the HTA body. Multiple HTA submissions (different countries/bodies) can

columns.name: actual_submission_date
columns.description: Date on which the HTA dossier was formally submitted to the HTA body. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp for the submission transaction, used to calculate review timelines and clock-start for statutory deadlines.
columns.reference: NICE Process Guide; G-BA AMNOG §35a SGB V; HAS Transparency Commission Procedures

columns.name: appeal_filed
columns.description: Indicates whether the company has filed a formal appeal or clarification request against the HTA body's decision. Triggers the appeal lifecycle tracking and legal review process.
columns.reference: NICE Appeal Procedure; G-BA AMNOG Appeal Process; CADTH Reconsideration Process

columns.name: appeal_outcome
columns.description: Outcome of the formal appeal filed against the HTA body's initial decision. Populated only when appeal_filed is True. Drives revision of the decision_type and downstream contracting actions.
columns.reference: NICE Appeal Procedure; G-BA AMNOG Appeal Process

columns.name: benefit_rating
columns.description: The HTA body's formal rating of the added therapeutic benefit of the drug compared to the appropriate comparator. Terminology varies by body: G-BA uses 'major/considerable/minor/non-quantifiable/no added benefit'; NICE uses 'highly clinically effective/clinically effective'; HAS uses ASMR grades I-V. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: major|considerable|minor|non_quantifiable|no_added_benefit|asmr_i|asmr_ii|asmr_iii|asmr_iv|asmr_v — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: G-BA AMNOG §35a SGB V; HAS ASMR Classification; NICE Clinical Effectiveness Framework

columns.name: comparator_description
columns.description: Description of the comparator treatment(s) used in the clinical evidence package submitted to the HTA body. HTA bodies require comparison against the current standard of care or the most appropriate comparator (e.g., best supportive care, existing first-line therapy). Critical for benefit assessment.
columns.reference: NICE Single Technology Appraisal Guide; G-BA AMNOG Dossier Template; EMA Guideline on Choice of Non-Inferiority Margin

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this HTA submission record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5; ICH E6 GCP

columns.name: decision_date
columns.description: Date on which the HTA body issued its formal recommendation or decision. Used to calculate time-to-decision, trigger downstream payer contracting timelines, and manage reimbursement listing effective dates.
columns.reference: NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG; CADTH Recommendations

columns.name: decision_type
columns.description: The formal recommendation type issued by the HTA body following review of the submission: positive (recommended for reimbursement), negative (not recommended), restricted (recommended for a subset of the indicated population), conditional (recommended subject to managed access or further evidence), deferred (decision postponed), or not recommended.
columns.reference: NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG Benefit Assessment; HAS Transparency Commission; CADTH Recommendations; PBAC Outcomes

columns.name: economic_model_type
columns.description: Type of health economic model included in the HTA submission dossier. Cost-utility analysis (CUA) using QALYs is standard for NICE; cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) is used by other bodies. Determines the analytical framework for reimbursement recommendation.
columns.reference: NICE Reference Case; EUnetHTA Methods Guidelines; CADTH Guidelines for Economic Evaluations; PBAC Guidelines

columns.name: ectd_sequence_number
columns.glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Sequence Number
columns.description: The eCTD sequence number associated with the regulatory submission that supports this HTA dossier, linking the HTA submission to the corresponding marketing authorisation application (MAA/NDA/BLA) in the regulatory submission system.
columns.reference: ICH M8 eCTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance; Veeva Vault RIM

columns.name: evidence_package_type
columns.description: Classification of the primary clinical evidence package submitted to the HTA body: randomised controlled trial (RCT), observational study, indirect treatment comparison (ITC), mixed treatment comparison (MTC), single-arm trial, or real-world evidence (RWE). Influences the HTA body's confidence in the benefit assessment.
columns.reference: NICE Evidence Standards Framework; EMA Guideline on RWE; CADTH Methods Guidelines

columns.name: external_agency
columns.description: Name of any external agency, health economics consultancy, or contract research organisation (CRO) engaged to support dossier preparation, economic modelling, or submission management for this HTA engagement.
columns.reference: Internal Procurement Records; ICH E6 GCP

columns.name: hta_body_code
columns.description: Code identifying the national or regional HTA body to which this submission is directed (e.g., NICE for England, HAS for France, G-BA for Germany, CADTH for Canada, PBAC for Australia). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NICE|HAS|G-BA|CADTH|PBAC|SMC|AIFA|TLV|ZIN|NCPE|ANVISA|INFARMED — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; HAS Transparency Commission; G-BA AMNOG; CADTH Guidelines; PBAC Guidelines

columns.name: icer_currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the ICER value submitted (e.g., GBP for NICE, EUR for HAS/G-BA, CAD for CADTH, AUD for PBAC). Required to interpret the submitted ICER in the correct monetary context.

columns.name: icer_submitted
columns.description: The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) as submitted by the company in the economic model, expressed in cost per quality-adjusted life year (QALY) gained or cost per life year gained. Confidential as it reflects internal pricing and modelling assumptions used in payer negotiations.
columns.reference: NICE Reference Case; CADTH Guidelines for Economic Evaluations; PBAC Guidelines

columns.name: managed_access_scheme
columns.description: Indicates whether the HTA decision is conditional on a managed access scheme (MAS), such as NICE's Managed Access Agreements (MAA) or Cancer Drugs Fund (CDF) arrangements, requiring further real-world evidence collection during the access period.
columns.reference: NICE Cancer Drugs Fund; NICE Managed Access Agreements; EMA Adaptive Pathways

columns.name: patient_access_program
columns.description: Indicates whether a patient access program (PAP) or copay assistance program has been established in conjunction with this HTA submission to support patient affordability and access pending or following the reimbursement decision.
columns.reference: Internal Market Access Policy; NICE Commercial Framework

columns.name: planned_submission_date
columns.description: Target date on which the completed HTA dossier is planned to be formally submitted to the HTA body. Used for project planning, resource allocation, and commercial launch timeline alignment.
columns.reference: Internal Market Access Planning; NICE Submission Timelines

columns.name: price_currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the recommended price range values (e.g., GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD). Required to interpret price bounds in the correct monetary context for each jurisdiction.

columns.name: recommended_price_lower
columns.description: Lower bound of the price range recommended or implied by the HTA body's decision, expressed in the local currency. Used in payer contracting and gross-to-net revenue management. Confidential as it reflects sensitive pricing negotiation data.
columns.reference: G-BA AMNOG Price Negotiation; NICE Commercial Framework; CADTH Price Review

columns.name: recommended_price_upper
columns.description: Upper bound of the price range recommended or implied by the HTA body's decision, expressed in the local currency. Used alongside the lower bound to define the acceptable price corridor for payer negotiations and contracting.
columns.reference: G-BA AMNOG Price Negotiation; NICE Commercial Framework; CADTH Price Review

columns.name: regulatory_approval_date
columns.description: Date on which the marketing authorisation (MA) was granted by the relevant regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) for the indication covered by this HTA submission. HTA submissions typically follow regulatory approval; this date anchors the HTA timeline.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; MHRA Guidance

columns.name: reimbursement_conditions
columns.description: Free-text description of any conditions, restrictions, or requirements attached to the HTA body's reimbursement recommendation (e.g., restricted to second-line use, mandatory prior authorisation, patient registry requirement, managed access scheme). Drives contracting and access program design.
columns.reference: NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG; HAS Transparency Commission; PBAC Guidelines

columns.name: rwe_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the HTA body's decision requires the generation and submission of real-world evidence (RWE) or real-world data (RWD) as a condition of continued reimbursement or as part of a managed access arrangement.
columns.reference: NICE Real-World Evidence Framework; EMA RWE Guidance; CADTH RWE Methods

columns.name: submission_lead
columns.description: Name or identifier of the internal market access lead or HTA manager responsible for coordinating and owning this submission. Used for accountability, escalation, and stakeholder communication.

columns.name: submission_number
columns.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the HTA submission, used in correspondence with the HTA body and in regulatory information management systems (RIMS). Typically follows the HTA body's own dossier numbering convention.
columns.reference: Veeva Vault RIM; ICH CTD Structure

columns.name: submission_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the HTA submission, tracking progression from planning through dossier preparation, formal submission, review, and final decision or withdrawal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|in_preparation|submitted|under_review|decision_issued|withdrawn|resubmission — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: Veeva Vault RIM; NICE Process Guide; G-BA AMNOG Procedure

columns.name: submission_type
columns.description: Classifies the nature of the HTA submission: initial submission for a new indication, resubmission following a negative decision, renewal of an existing reimbursement listing, line extension for a new formulation or dose, or supplemental submission with new evidence.
columns.reference: NICE Process Guide; CADTH Procedures; PBAC Guidelines

columns.name: therapeutic_area
columns.description: The disease area or therapeutic category covered by this HTA submission (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Aligns with the company's internal therapeutic area taxonomy and the ATC classification system.
columns.reference: WHO ATC Classification; ICH E8; Internal Therapeutic Area Taxonomy

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this HTA submission record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5; ICH E6 GCP

columns.name: value_dossier_version
columns.description: Version identifier of the global value dossier (GVD) used as the basis for this HTA submission. Tracks which version of the evidence synthesis and value story was submitted, enabling audit trail and version control across multiple country submissions.
columns.reference: Veeva Vault MedComms; ISPOR Value Dossier Guidelines

columns.name: willingness_to_pay_threshold
columns.description: The HTA body's published or applied willingness-to-pay threshold per QALY (or equivalent outcome unit) for the relevant jurisdiction at the time of submission. Used to assess whether the submitted ICER falls within the acceptable range for reimbursement recommendation.
columns.reference: NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; CADTH Guidelines; PBAC Guidelines

columns.name: dossier_type

columns.name: economic_model_type
columns.description: Type of health economic model used as the primary analytical framework in the dossier (e.g., cost-effectiveness analysis, cost-utility analysis using QALYs, budget impact model).
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Research Practices; NICE Reference Case; EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282

columns.name: effective_from
columns.description: Date from which this version of the value dossier is considered active and valid for use in payer negotiations, HTA submissions, or formulary discussions.

columns.name: effective_until
columns.description: Date after which this version of the value dossier is no longer considered current and should be superseded by a newer version. Nullable for currently active dossiers.
columns.reference: Veeva Vault Document Lifecycle; Internal Market Access Governance Policy

columns.name: formulary_tier_target
columns.description: Desired formulary tier placement being sought from the payer or pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) based on the evidence presented in the dossier.
columns.reference: AMCP Format for Formulary Submissions v4.0; CMS Part D Formulary Guidelines

columns.name: heor_evidence_summary
columns.glossary_term: Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Evidence Summary
columns.description: Summary of the Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) evidence included in the dossier, covering cost-effectiveness analyses, cost-utility analyses, budget impact models, and quality-of-life (QoL) data.

columns.name: hta_body_name
columns.description: Name of the specific Health Technology Assessment (HTA) body or payer organization to which this dossier is submitted or targeted (e.g., NICE, G-BA, HAS, PBAC, ICER).
columns.reference: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; NICE Technology Appraisal Guidance; G-BA AMNOG Process

columns.name: icd_code
columns.description: ICD-10 or ICD-11 code corresponding to the target indication, used for standardized disease classification in HTA submissions and payer negotiations.

columns.name: icur_currency_code

columns.name: icur_value

columns.name: legal_reviewed
columns.description: Indicates whether the Legal and Compliance function has reviewed this dossier version for regulatory compliance, IP considerations, and promotional material standards.
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 202; EMA Guideline on Advertising; Internal Legal Review SOP

columns.name: line_of_therapy
columns.description: Intended line of therapy for which the product is being positioned in the dossier (e.g., first-line, second-line). Directly impacts formulary tier placement and reimbursement scope.
columns.reference: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines; EMA Summary of Product Characteristics; FDA Label

columns.name: medical_affairs_reviewed
columns.description: Indicates whether the Medical Affairs function has completed a formal scientific review and sign-off of the clinical evidence sections of this dossier version.
columns.reference: Internal Medical Review SOP; ICH E3; ISPOR Good Practices

columns.name: patient_population_size
columns.description: Estimated number of eligible patients in the target market who could benefit from the treatment, as used in the budget impact model and payer negotiations.
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Research Practices for Budget Impact Analysis; EMA Epidemiology Guidelines

columns.name: primary_endpoint
columns.description: Primary efficacy endpoint from the pivotal clinical trial(s) supporting the dossier (e.g., Overall Survival (OS), Progression-Free Survival (PFS), Objective Response Rate (ORR)). Directly informs the clinical value narrative.
columns.reference: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials

columns.name: qaly_gain
columns.description: Estimated Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY) gain attributed to the treatment versus the comparator, as reported in the health economic model submitted in the dossier.
columns.reference: NICE Reference Case; ISPOR Good Research Practices; EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282

columns.name: reimbursement_scope
columns.description: Scope of reimbursement coverage achieved or sought for the product based on the dossier submission, indicating whether full, restricted, or conditional reimbursement applies.
columns.reference: CMS Coverage Determination Process; NICE Technology Appraisal; G-BA AMNOG

columns.name: rwe_included
columns.description: Indicates whether Real-World Evidence (RWE) or Real-World Data (RWD) is included as supporting evidence in this dossier version, in addition to randomized controlled trial data.
columns.reference: FDA Framework for Real-World Evidence; EMA Guidance on RWE; ISPOR RWE Task Force

columns.name: submission_date
columns.description: Date on which the value dossier was formally submitted to the target HTA body, payer, or formulary committee.
columns.reference: EMA HTA Regulation (EU) 2021/2282; FDA PDUFA; NICE Process Guide

columns.name: target_payer_type
columns.description: Classification of the primary payer audience for whom the dossier is tailored. Determines the evidence framing and economic model emphasis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: national_hta|regional_hta|commercial_payer|pbm|gpo|government_formulary|hospital_formulary — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: AMCP Format for Formulary Submissions v4.0; ISPOR HTA Compendium

columns.name: therapeutic_area
columns.description: Broad disease area or medical specialty the dossier addresses (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular). Aligns with the company's therapeutic area taxonomy.
columns.reference: WHO International Classification of Diseases (ICD-11); ATC Classification System

columns.name: title
columns.description: Full descriptive title of the value dossier, typically including the product name, indication, and target audience (e.g., payer, HTA body).
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Practices for Value Dossier Development

columns.name: updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this value dossier record, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Section 404

columns.name: version_date
columns.description: Calendar date on which the current version of the dossier was finalized and approved for use.
columns.reference: Veeva Vault RIM; ISPOR Good Practices

columns.name: version_number
columns.description: Semantic version number of the dossier (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented with each substantive update to clinical evidence, HEOR data, or comparator landscape.
columns.reference: Veeva Vault Document Management; ICH E3

tables.name: payer_contract
tables.description: Master record for all managed care contracts, rebate agreements, and performance-based contracts negotiated with payers, PBMs (Express Scripts, CVS Caremark, OptumRx), GPOs, and other contracting entities. Captures contract type (base rebate, performance rebate, outcomes-based, value-based, PBM formulary rebate, GPO commitment), contracted product, rebate tiers, performance metrics, administrative fees, data sharing provisions, book-of-business structure, PBM-specific formulary management mechanics, contract term, and payment schedule. Central to gross-to-net revenue management and rebate accrual calculations. Covers all payer types including PBM-specific contract structures.

columns.name: payer_contract_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the payer contract record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this master agreement entity.

columns.name: access_strategy_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to market.access_strategy. Business justification: Payer contracts are negotiated within the context of market access strategies. One payer contract supports one access strategy (1:N from access_strategy perspective). No columns to remove as payer_con

columns.name: accounts_receivable_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Payer contracts generate receivables through administrative fees, upfront payments, and contract settlements. Finance must track AR by contract for reconciliation, payment collection, and revenue reco

columns.name: business_partner_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.business_partner. Business justification: Payer contracts are executed with legal counterparties registered as business partners in MDM for financial settlement, payment terms, and accounts receivable management. Linking enables contract-to-p

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Reference to the contracted pharmaceutical product (Drug Product / Finished Dosage Form) covered under this payer agreement.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; NDC Registry

columns.name: exclusivity_period_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.exclusivity_period. Business justification: Contracts reference regulatory exclusivity periods to establish pricing corridors, define renegotiation triggers at LOE, and structure managed entry agreements. Exclusivity timelines are contractual t

columns.name: internal_order_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Contract cost allocation: payer contract negotiation and execution costs are tracked against internal orders for market access spend reporting. Pharma finance requires this link for budget vs. actual

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Reference to the payer, Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM), Group Purchasing Organization (GPO), or managed care organization that is the counterparty to this contract.

columns.name: licensing_agreement_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.licensing_agreement. Business justification: Payer contracts for licensed-in products must respect licensing agreement terms. Sublicensing provisions, territory restrictions, and royalty obligations in the licensing agreement constrain rebate st

columns.name: orange_book_listing_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.orange_book_listing. Business justification: Payer contracts reference Orange Book listings to define rebate eligibility and brand/generic substitution provisions. Orange Book status determines whether a product qualifies for brand rebate tiers

columns.name: patent_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent. Business justification: Payer contracts include patent expiry clauses for price protection, rebate adjustment triggers at loss of exclusivity, and contract termination provisions. Patent status directly affects contract term

columns.name: patent_term_extension_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.patent_term_extension. Business justification: Payer contracts include exclusivity provisions and price protection clauses that reference the full patent term including extensions. Contract renewal and termination dates are aligned with PTE-adjust

columns.name: payer_account_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to market.payer_account. Business justification: Market payer contracts MUST reference which payer organization the contract is with. This is a fundamental relationship - every managed care contract, rebate agreement, or performance-based contract i

columns.name: admin_fee_pct
columns.description: Administrative fee percentage charged by the PBM or GPO for contract administration, data services, and formulary management, expressed as a percentage of net sales. Deducted in gross-to-net calculations.
columns.reference: PCMA Administrative Fee Disclosure Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Rebate Processing

columns.name: auto_renewal
columns.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews at the end of the effective period unless either party provides notice of termination within the specified notice period.

columns.name: base_rebate_pct
columns.description: The unconditional base rebate percentage of Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) or Average Manufacturer Price (AMP) owed to the payer regardless of performance metrics. Core input to gross-to-net revenue accrual calculations.
columns.reference: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (42 CFR Part 447); CMS AMP Reporting; Internal Gross-to-Net Policy

columns.name: book_of_business_lives
columns.description: The number of covered lives (plan members) within the payer's book of business that are subject to this contract. Used for rebate volume estimation, market access analytics, and payer segmentation.
columns.reference: PCMA; AMCP; Internal Market Access Analytics Standards

columns.name: contract_name
columns.description: Descriptive business name of the payer contract (e.g., 'CVS Caremark National Formulary Rebate Agreement FY2025'), used for identification in reporting and gross-to-net management.

columns.name: contract_number
columns.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this payer contract, used for cross-referencing with the payer, PBM, or GPO and in SAP SD/FI rebate agreement records.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Internal Contract Management Policy

columns.name: contract_owner
columns.description: Name or identifier of the internal Market Access or Managed Care team member responsible for managing and maintaining this payer contract relationship.
columns.reference: Internal Market Access Governance Policy; Salesforce Health Cloud CRM

columns.name: contract_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the payer contract. Governs whether rebate accruals are active, whether the contract is eligible for payment processing, and whether formulary positioning obligations are in effect. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_execution|active|suspended|terminated|expired|under_renegotiation — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Agreement Status; Internal Contract Lifecycle Policy

columns.name: contract_type
columns.description: Classification of the payer contract by its commercial structure. Determines rebate calculation methodology and accrual treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_rebate|performance_rebate|outcomes_based|value_based|pbm_formulary_rebate|gpo_commitment — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
columns.reference: ASHP; PCMA; Market Access Industry Standards

columns.name: copay_assistance_allowed
columns.description: Indicates whether the contract permits the manufacturer to offer copay assistance or patient support programs to members covered under this payer's plan. Some commercial contracts restrict copay card use.
columns.reference: OIG Copay Assistance Guidance; Internal Patient Access Policy; CMS Anti-Kickback Statute Guidance

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this payer contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance purposes.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2)

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all rebate amounts, fees, and financial obligations under this contract are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
columns.reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

columns.name: data_sharing_required
columns.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a data sharing provision requiring the payer or PBM to provide claims data, utilization data, or outcomes data to the manufacturer. Relevant for outcomes-based and value-based contracts.
columns.reference: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164); GDPR Article 28; Internal Data Governance Policy

columns.name: data_sharing_scope
columns.description: Specifies the type of data the payer or PBM is contractually obligated to share with the manufacturer under the data sharing provision. Null if data_sharing_required is False.
columns.reference: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164); PCMA Data Sharing Standards; GDPR Article 28

columns.name: effective_end_date
columns.description: The date on which the payer contract expires or is scheduled to terminate. Nullable for evergreen contracts. Used as the upper bound for rebate accrual period calculations and contract renewal tracking.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Agreement; Internal Market Access Policy

columns.name: effective_start_date
columns.description: The date on which the payer contract becomes legally binding and rebate obligations commence. Used as the lower bound for rebate accrual period calculations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Agreement; ICH E6 GCP (for any outcomes-based contracts referencing clinical data)

columns.name: estimated_annual_rebate_amount
columns.description: The estimated total rebate liability for a full contract year based on projected sales volume and contracted rebate rates. Used for gross-to-net accrual budgeting and financial planning. Not a calculated aggregate — represents the contractually agreed estimate.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Rebate Accrual; SOX Section 302 Revenue Recognition; ASC 606

columns.name: exclusivity_provision
columns.description: Indicates whether the contract grants the contracted product exclusive or preferred formulary positioning within its therapeutic class, excluding or restricting competitor products.
columns.reference: FTC Antitrust Guidelines; PCMA Formulary Management Standards; Internal Legal Policy

columns.name: execution_date
columns.description: The date on which the contract was formally signed and executed by all parties. May differ from the effective start date for retroactive agreements.
columns.reference: Internal Legal and Compliance Policy; SOX Section 302

columns.name: formulary_tier
columns.description: The formulary tier position secured for the contracted product under this payer agreement. Directly impacts patient access, copay levels, and rebate obligations. Central to PBM formulary management mechanics.
columns.reference: PCMA Formulary Management Guidelines; CMS Part D Formulary Requirements (42 CFR Part 423)

columns.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
columns.description: The legal jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/state code) whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this contract (e.g., US-DE for Delaware, USA).
columns.reference: Internal Legal Policy; GDPR Article 28; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: incremental_rebate_pct
columns.description: Additional rebate percentage earned above the base rebate upon achievement of performance or formulary tier thresholds. Used in tiered and performance-based contract structures.
columns.reference: PCMA Rebate Contracting Guidelines; Internal Gross-to-Net Policy

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this payer contract record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; SOX Section 302; GDPR Article 5(2)

columns.name: most_favored_nation_clause
columns.description: Indicates whether the contract contains a Most Favored Nation (MFN) clause requiring the manufacturer to offer this payer terms no less favorable than those offered to any other payer. Has significant pricing and compliance implications.
columns.reference: FTC Antitrust Guidelines; Internal Legal and Compliance Policy; Inflation Reduction Act MFN Provisions

columns.name: performance_metric_type
columns.description: The type of performance metric used to determine eligibility for incremental or performance-based rebates. Applicable for performance rebate, outcomes-based, and value-based contract types.
columns.reference: AMCP Value-Based Contracting Framework; ICER Evidence Standards

columns.name: performance_threshold_value
columns.description: The numeric threshold that must be achieved on the performance metric to trigger incremental rebate payments (e.g., minimum market share percentage, minimum formulary tier position, minimum adherence rate).
columns.reference: AMCP Value-Based Contracting Framework; Internal Market Access Policy

columns.name: price_protection_clause
columns.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a price protection provision that triggers additional rebates if the manufacturer raises the list price (WAC) above a specified threshold, typically tied to CPI or a fixed percentage.
columns.reference: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (42 CFR Part 447); Inflation Reduction Act; Internal Pricing Policy

columns.name: price_protection_threshold_pct
columns.description: The maximum allowable annual WAC price increase percentage before price protection rebates are triggered under the contract. Null if price_protection_clause is False.
columns.reference: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (42 CFR Part 447); Inflation Reduction Act; Internal Pricing Policy

columns.name: rebate_payment_frequency
columns.description: The agreed schedule for rebate payment remittance from the manufacturer to the payer or PBM. Drives rebate accrual timing and cash flow planning in SAP FI.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Rebate Settlement; Internal Treasury Policy

columns.name: rebate_payment_lag_days
columns.description: The number of days after the close of a rebate period within which the rebate invoice must be paid. Used for cash flow forecasting and accrual true-up calculations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Internal Treasury Policy

columns.name: renewal_notice_days
columns.description: The number of days prior to the effective end date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew the contract. Applicable when auto_renewal is True.
columns.reference: Internal Contract Management Policy; Internal Legal Policy

columns.name: source_system_contract_code
columns.description: The native contract identifier from the originating system of record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD rebate agreement number, Salesforce Health Cloud contract record ID). Enables traceability back to the operational source system.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce Health Cloud; Internal Data Lineage Policy

columns.name: termination_date
columns.description: The actual date on which the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Distinct from effective_end_date which represents the scheduled expiry. Null if the contract has not been terminated early.
columns.reference: Internal Contract Lifecycle Policy; SOX Section 302

columns.name: termination_reason
columns.description: Reason code for early contract termination. Required for gross-to-net true-up and audit trail purposes when a contract is ended before its scheduled expiry date. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mutual_agreement|breach|regulatory_action|product_withdrawal|formulary_exclusion|renegotiation|expiry — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: Internal Market Access Policy; SOX Audit Requirements

columns.name: utilization_management_restrictions
columns.description: Specifies the utilization management restrictions applied to the contracted product on the payer's formulary (e.g., prior authorization, step therapy, quantity limits). Impacts patient access and market share performance metrics.
columns.reference: CMS Part D Utilization Management Guidelines; AMCP Formulary Management Standards

tables.name: rebate_claim
tables.description: Transactional record of rebate claims submitted to or received from payers and PBMs under managed care contracts. Captures claim period, contracted product, eligible units, applicable rebate rate, calculated rebate amount, dispute status, and payment date. Feeds gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting and rebate liability accruals in the finance domain.

columns.name: rebate_claim_id
columns.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the rebate claim record. Primary key for the rebate_claim data product in the market domain.

columns.name: brand_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.brand. Business justification: Rebate claims track actual rebates paid for brand utilization under payer contracts. Financial reconciliation and GTN forecasting process requires linking rebate claims to brands for revenue recogniti

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Rebate claims are country-specific for Medicaid/government rebate programs and international rebate reporting. country_code is a plain denormalized attr; FK to country master enables statutory rebate

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_product. Business justification: Rebate claims are filed at the NDC/drug product level for Medicaid best price, chargeback, and commercial rebate reconciliation. ndc_code is a denormalized text column. Gross-to-net reporting and reba

columns.name: finance_accounts_receivable_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Market rebate claims should link to finance accounts receivable for rebate accrual and revenue recognition. This enables accurate gross-to-net calculations and financial reporting for pharmaceutical r

columns.name: hco_master_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to hcp.hco_master. Business justification: Rebate claims in pharma are frequently tied to specific health systems or hospital networks covered under GPO/IDN contracts. Linking rebate claims to the HCO enables institutional rebate tracking, 340

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.invoice. Business justification: Rebate settlement process: each rebate claim is settled via a credit memo or debit note invoice. Pharma finance teams require claim-to-invoice traceability for rebate reconciliation, audit, and SOX co

columns.name: journal_entry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Rebate accrual accounting: each rebate claim generates journal entries for gross-to-net accrual posting and settlement. Pharma revenue accounting requires direct claim-to-journal-entry linkage for per

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Rebate claims are filed by specific legal entities (affiliates) for Medicaid and commercial rebate programs. The legal entity determines applicable rebate rates, government price reporting obligations

columns.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.masterdata_ndc_code. Business justification: Rebate claims are filed at the NDC level for Medicaid best price calculations, CMS rebate reporting, and commercial rebate dispute resolution. ndc_code is a plain denormalized attr; the NDC master is

columns.name: material_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.material. Business justification: Rebate claims track eligible units and WAC price at the material level. The material master provides authoritative material number, unit of measure, and GMP classification required for rebate reconcil

columns.name: medicinal_product_id
columns.description: Reference to the contracted pharmaceutical product (Drug Product/Finished Dosage Form) for which the rebate claim is being processed.

columns.name: orange_book_listing_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to intellectual.orange_book_listing. Business justification: Rebate claims reference Orange Book listings to determine brand rebate eligibility and Medicaid best price calculations. Orange Book status determines whether a product qualifies for brand vs. generic

columns.name: payer_account_id
columns.description: Reference to the managed care payer or health plan entity against which this rebate claim is submitted or received. Links to the payer master record.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce Health Cloud

columns.name: payer_contract_id
columns.description: Reference to the managed care or payer contract under which this rebate claim is generated. Governs the applicable rebate tiers, rates, and eligible products.

columns.name: accrual_period
columns.description: Financial reporting quarter (e.g., 2024-Q3) in which the rebate liability or receivable is accrued in the general ledger. Aligns rebate expense recognition with the period of sale per ASC 606 and gross-to-net accounting policies.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; ASC 606; IFRS 15

columns.name: adjustment_amount
columns.description: Net adjustments applied to the gross rebate amount, including corrections for prior period true-ups, disputed unit reconciliations, or contractual offsets. Negative values represent reductions; positive values represent additions.

columns.name: claim_direction
columns.description: Indicates whether the rebate claim represents an amount payable by the manufacturer to the payer (outbound rebate) or receivable from a payer/GPO (inbound credit). Drives gross-to-net accounting treatment.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

columns.name: claim_number
columns.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the rebate claim. Used in payer correspondence, dispute resolution, and reconciliation. Format: RBC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Gross-to-Net Revenue Management Standards

columns.name: claim_period_end_date
columns.description: Last day of the measurement period for which eligible units and rebate amounts are being claimed. Together with claim_period_start_date defines the rebate accrual window.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: claim_period_start_date
columns.description: First day of the measurement period (quarter or month) for which eligible units and rebate amounts are being claimed. Aligns with the contractual reporting period.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: claim_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the rebate claim. Tracks progression from initial draft through submission, payer review, approval or dispute, and final payment settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|disputed|paid|voided — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Gross-to-Net Revenue Management Standards

columns.name: claim_type
columns.description: Classification of the rebate claim by the contractual mechanism that generated it. Base rebates are volume-driven; performance rebates are tied to market share or outcomes; formulary rebates are tied to formulary tier placement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_rebate|performance_rebate|market_share_rebate|formulary_rebate|administrative_fee — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: cost_center
columns.description: SAP cost center to which the rebate expense is allocated for internal management reporting and P&L attribution by therapeutic area or brand.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this rebate claim are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency gross-to-net reporting.

columns.name: dispute_reason
columns.description: Categorized reason for the dispute raised on this rebate claim. Used to identify systemic data quality or contracting issues and to prioritize resolution efforts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unit_count_discrepancy|rate_discrepancy|eligibility_dispute|period_mismatch|data_quality|other — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: dispute_status
columns.description: Current status of any dispute raised against this rebate claim by the payer, PBM, or manufacturer. Tracks the dispute lifecycle from initiation through resolution for audit and accrual adjustment purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: disputed_amount
columns.description: Monetary value of the portion of the rebate claim currently under dispute. May be less than or equal to net_rebate_amount. Used to calculate the undisputed payable amount and to set dispute reserves.

columns.name: eligible_units
columns.description: Total number of units (prescriptions, unit doses, or pack equivalents) dispensed during the claim period that qualify for rebate under the contract terms. Basis for rebate amount calculation.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: formulary_tier
columns.description: Formulary tier at which the product was listed during the claim period. Determines the applicable rebate rate and is used to validate formulary access commitments made in the managed care contract.
columns.reference: Managed Care Contracting Standards; CMS Formulary Guidelines

columns.name: gl_account_code
columns.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code to which the rebate liability or receivable is posted. Ensures correct financial statement classification of gross-to-net revenue deductions.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606; SOX

columns.name: gross_rebate_amount
columns.description: Total calculated rebate amount before any adjustments, offsets, or administrative fees. Computed as eligible_units × wac_price × rebate_rate. Primary input to gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; FASB ASC 808

columns.name: market_share_pct
columns.description: Product market share within the payer's covered lives during the claim period, expressed as a percentage. Used to validate performance tier achievement and to support market share rebate calculations.
columns.reference: Managed Care Contracting Standards; IQVIA/SYMPHONY Data Standards

columns.name: medicaid_rebate_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this claim is subject to the CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (MDRP) reporting and payment obligations. Drives separate regulatory reporting workflows and AMP/Best Price calculations.
columns.reference: CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program; 42 CFR Part 447; 21 CFR Part 314

columns.name: net_rebate_amount
columns.description: Final rebate amount after applying all adjustments and administrative fee deductions. Represents the actual liability or receivable recorded in the finance domain for rebate accrual and payment settlement.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; FASB ASC 808

columns.name: payment_date
columns.description: Actual date on which the rebate payment was received from or remitted to the payer. Null until payment is confirmed. Used for cash flow reconciliation and gross-to-net revenue deduction accounting.

columns.name: payment_due_date
columns.description: Contractually stipulated date by which the rebate payment must be made or received. Used to calculate days-past-due for outstanding claims and to trigger payment reminders.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: payment_reference
columns.description: Bank or ERP payment reference number (e.g., SAP payment document number or wire transfer reference) associated with the settlement of this rebate claim. Used for cash application and bank reconciliation.

columns.name: prior_period_adjustment_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this rebate claim includes a true-up or correction for a prior reporting period. When true, the adjustment_amount field captures the prior period correction value for audit trail purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASC 606; SOX

columns.name: rebate_rate
columns.description: Contractually agreed rebate rate expressed as a percentage of WAC or net price applicable to this claim. May reflect a base rate, a performance tier rate, or a blended rate depending on claim type.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: rebate_tier
columns.description: Contractual performance tier achieved during the claim period that determines the applicable rebate rate. Higher tiers typically correspond to greater market share or formulary access levels.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Managed Care Contracting Standards

columns.name: record_created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this rebate claim record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

tables.name: gross_to_net_adjustment
tables.description: Records all gross-to-net revenue deduction components applied to a pharmaceutical product's gross sales to arrive at net revenue. Captures adjustment type (base rebate, performance rebate, Medicaid best price, 340B, chargebacks, copay assistance, GPO fees, distribution fees, patient assistance), period, product, channel, and adjustment amount. For copay assistance adjustments, captures individual claim-level detail including dispensing pharmacy, claim date, patient identifier (de-identified), drug product, gross copay amount, assistance amount paid, and remaining patient liability. Enables net revenue reconciliation, deduction category analysis, copay program spend reporting, and patient affordability program financial tracking. SSOT for all GTN deduction records including copay assistance transactions.

columns.description: Time period over which the benefit cap applies and resets. Determines how program utilization is tracked and reported for gross-to-net revenue deductions.

Captures list price (WAC/ex-factory), government reference price, IRP constraints, price change type, effective date, approving authority, pricing rationale, and approved price corridors including floor price, target price, ceiling price, IRP basket countries, monitoring frequency, and corridor breach alert thresholds. Serves as the authoritative record of approved prices and price bands, enabling proactive management of cross-country price erosion risk and launch sequencing optimization.

Also manages the inventory of RWD/RWE datasets including data source type (claims database, EHR, registry, patient-reported outcomes), data vendor, data vintage, and data use agreements. SSOT for all HEOR evidence assets and RWD/RWE inventory within the market access domain.

columns.name: line_of_therapy

columns.reference: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines; ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines

columns.name: market_share_assumption_pct
columns.description: Assumed market share percentage for the drug product used as the base case input in the budget impact model, reflecting expected uptake within the eligible patient population.
columns.reference: ISPOR Budget Impact Analysis Good Practice Guidelines

columns.name: model_version
columns.description: Version identifier for the economic model or study protocol, tracking iterative updates submitted to payers or HTA bodies over the product lifecycle.
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; ICH E9(R1)

columns.name: model_version_date
columns.description: Date on which the current model version was finalized and approved for use in payer submissions or HTA dossiers.

columns.name: patient_population_description
columns.description: Narrative description of the patient population assumptions used in the model, including eligibility criteria, disease stage, line of therapy, and demographic assumptions.

columns.name: patient_population_size
columns.description: Estimated number of eligible patients in the target population used as the base case assumption in the economic model, relevant for budget impact models and market sizing.
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research; CMS Coverage Determination Guidelines

columns.name: publication_reference

columns.name: qaly_gain
columns.description: Estimated incremental Quality-Adjusted Life Years (QALYs) gained with the study treatment versus comparator, the primary effectiveness measure in cost-utility analyses for HTA submissions.

columns.name: rwd_data_source_type

columns.name: rwd_data_vendor

columns.name: rwd_data_vintage
columns.description: Date range or vintage period of the real-world dataset used in the study (e.g., '2018-2022'), indicating the temporal coverage of the underlying data and its currency for payer submissions.

columns.name: rwe_included
columns.description: Indicates whether real-world evidence (RWE) is incorporated into this HEOR study or model, a key differentiator for payer submissions and HTA dossiers.

columns.name: study_code

columns.name: study_completion_date
columns.description: Date on which the HEOR study or model was completed and results were finalized, marking the end of the primary evidence generation phase.
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

columns.name: study_owner
columns.description: Name or employee identifier of the HEOR team member or function responsible for the study, accountable for quality, timelines, and payer submission readiness.

columns.name: study_start_date
columns.description: Date on which the HEOR study or model development was formally initiated, used for project tracking and timeline management.
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

columns.name: study_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the HEOR study or evidence asset, tracking progression from planning through completion and publication.
columns.reference: ISPOR Good Practices for Outcomes Research

columns.name: study_title
columns.description: Full descriptive title of the HEOR study, model, or RWD/RWE dataset as it appears in publications, HTA submissions, or value dossiers.

columns.name: study_type
columns.description: Classification of the HEOR evidence asset by methodological type. Drives analytical approach, model structure, and payer audience targeting. columns.name: target_payer_audience
columns.description: Primary payer segment or audience for whom the HEOR evidence asset is designed, guiding value messaging and submission strategy. columns.name: therapeutic_area

columns.name: treatment_cost_input
columns.description: Annual per-patient treatment cost used as the primary cost input in the economic model, expressed in the currency defined by icur_currency_code. Reflects WAC, net price, or negotiated price as specified in the model assumptions.

columns.name: updated_timestamp

columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(2); SOX Section 404

tables.name: reimbursement_policy

Captures policy type, coverage status, covered indications, excluded populations, prior authorization criteria, step therapy requirements, quantity limits, coverage restrictions, decision authority, decision date, appeal status, policy effective dates, and individual coverage determination records. Records both the ongoing policy framework governing reimbursement and specific point-in-time coverage decisions at national, regional, or plan level. SSOT for all coverage and reimbursement policy data within the market access domain. Enables access gap analysis, policy change monitoring, coverage landscape tracking, and coverage decision audit trails.

tables.name: master
tables.description: Master record for individual healthcare professionals (HCPs) including physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and other licensed practitioners. Captures HCP identity (name, date of birth, gender), NPI number, professional credentials, all state medical licenses (license number, issuing authority, jurisdiction, issue/expiration dates, status, renewal history), DEA controlled substance registrations, board certifications, specialty classifications (primary/secondary, ATC/therapeutic area alignment), professional designations, practice addresses, and contact information. Authoritative single source of truth (SSOT) for HCP identity, credentials, licensing, and practice locations used across commercial, medical affairs, and clinical operations. Sourced from Veeva CRM, Salesforce Health Cloud, and third-party data providers (IQVIA OneKey, NPI Registry).

columns.name: compensation_arrangement_type

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this affiliation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

columns.reference: The Joint Commission Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Internal Credentialing Standard

columns.name: credentialing_status
columns.description: The current credentialing status of the HCP at this affiliated organization. Indicates whether the HCP has completed required credentialing processes.
columns.reference: The Joint Commission Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; Internal Credentialing Standard

columns.name: data_quality_score
columns.description: Quantitative measure of the completeness and accuracy of this affiliation record, typically ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Used for data stewardship prioritization.

columns.name: data_source_system
columns.description: The operational system or data source from which this affiliation record originated (e.g., Veeva CRM, Salesforce Health Cloud, manual entry, third-party data provider).

columns.name: dea_number
columns.description: The DEA registration number associated with this affiliation, if the HCP prescribes controlled substances at this location. Required for controlled substance prescribing authority verification.
columns.reference: DEA - Drug Enforcement Administration; 21 CFR Part 1301

columns.name: department_name
columns.description: The department, division, or practice unit within the HCO where the HCP holds this affiliation (e.g., Oncology Department, Cardiology Division).

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: The date when the affiliation relationship ended or is scheduled to end. Null for ongoing affiliations.

columns.name: formulary_influence_level
columns.description: Assessment of the HCP's level of influence over formulary decisions at this affiliated organization. Used for Key Opinion Leader (KOL) identification and targeting.

columns.name: full_time_equivalent
columns.description: The proportion of full-time work the HCP dedicates to this affiliation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.00 for full-time, 0.50 for half-time). Used for capacity planning and engagement prioritization.

columns.name: is_primary_affiliation
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the HCP's primary or main affiliation. True if this is the principal place of practice; False otherwise.

columns.name: kol_designation_flag
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the HCP is designated as a Key Opinion Leader (KOL) within this affiliation context. True if KOL status applies; False otherwise.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this affiliation record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

columns.name: last_verification_date
columns.description: The date when this affiliation record was last verified or validated. Used for data quality monitoring and re-verification scheduling.

columns.name: modified_by_user
columns.description: The username or identifier of the user or system process that last modified this affiliation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
columns.reference: Internal Data Governance Standard; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about this affiliation relationship. Used for qualitative information that does not fit structured fields.

columns.name: npi_at_affiliation
columns.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) the HCP uses at this specific affiliation. An HCP may have different NPIs for different practice locations or affiliations.
columns.reference: HIPAA - Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act; CMS National Provider Identifier Standard

columns.name: prescribing_authority_flag
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the HCP has prescribing authority at this affiliated organization. True if the HCP can prescribe medications; False otherwise.
columns.reference: DEA - Drug Enforcement Administration; State Medical Board Regulations

columns.name: referral_direction
columns.description: The direction of patient referrals in this affiliation relationship. Indicates whether the HCP receives referrals, sends referrals, or both.

columns.name: referral_relationship_flag
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this affiliation represents a referral relationship (HCP-to-HCP). True if the affiliation involves patient referrals; False otherwise.

columns.name: role_title
columns.description: The professional role or job title the HCP holds within this affiliation (e.g., Chief of Cardiology, Attending Physician, Clinical Director, Partner).

columns.name: specialty_at_affiliation
columns.description: The medical specialty or therapeutic area the HCP practices within this specific affiliation. May differ from the HCP's primary specialty if they hold multiple affiliations.
columns.reference: American Medical Association (AMA) Specialty Codes; Internal Commercial Operations Standard

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: The date when the affiliation relationship became effective. Represents the beginning of the professional relationship.

columns.name: state_license_number

columns.reference: State Medical Board Regulations; Internal Credentialing Standard

columns.name: strength_score
columns.description: Quantitative measure of the strength or influence of this affiliation relationship, typically ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Used for network mapping and prescribing influence analysis.

columns.name: sunshine_act_reportable_flag
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this affiliation relationship is subject to Sunshine Act transparency reporting requirements. True if reportable; False otherwise.
columns.reference: Sunshine Act Transparency Reporting Requirements; 42 CFR Part 403

columns.name: verification_status
columns.description: The verification status of this affiliation record. Indicates whether the affiliation has been confirmed through primary source verification or other validation processes.
columns.reference: Internal Data Governance Standard; NCQA Credentialing Standards

columns.name: verified_by
columns.description: The name or identifier of the person, system, or process that last verified this affiliation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

columns.description: The KOL's academic title or rank at their primary affiliated institution. Indicates seniority, teaching responsibilities, and academic influence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: professor|associate_professor|assistant_professor|clinical_instructor|adjunct_faculty|emeritus|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: advisory_board_participation_count
columns.description: Total number of advisory board meetings or panels the KOL has participated in. Indicates level of industry engagement and strategic advisory experience.
columns.reference: Medical Affairs Engagement Tracking, Sunshine Act Transparency Reporting

columns.name: clinical_trial_investigator_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the KOL has served as a principal investigator (PI) or sub-investigator on clinical trials. True if the HCP has investigator experience, false otherwise. Used to identify KOLs with hands-on clinical research expertise.
columns.reference: Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) E6

columns.name: compliance_clearance_date
columns.description: Date when the most recent compliance clearance was completed and approved. Used to track clearance currency and schedule re-verification.
columns.reference: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Screening Requirements

columns.name: compliance_clearance_expiry_date
columns.description: Date when the current compliance clearance expires and re-verification is required. Used to proactively manage compliance renewal workflows.
columns.reference: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Screening Requirements

columns.name: compliance_clearance_status
columns.description: Current compliance and credentialing clearance status for the KOL. Cleared indicates the KOL has passed all compliance checks and is eligible for engagement, pending indicates review in progress, flagged indicates potential compliance concerns requiring investigation, excluded indicates the KOL is on an exclusion list (OIG, SAM) and cannot be engaged, and expired indicates clearance has lapsed and requires renewal.
columns.reference: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion List, System for Award Management (SAM), Anti-Kickback Statute

columns.name: conflict_of_interest_disclosure
columns.description: Summary of disclosed conflicts of interest, including financial relationships with other pharmaceutical or medical device companies, equity holdings, consulting arrangements, or advisory roles. Used to manage transparency and mitigate bias in scientific engagements.
columns.reference: International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE) COI Standards, Sunshine Act

columns.name: congress_speaking_count
columns.description: Number of presentations, lectures, or speaking engagements the KOL has delivered at medical congresses, symposia, or scientific conferences. Reflects public visibility and thought leadership.
columns.reference: Medical Affairs Congress Tracking, Continuing Medical Education (CME) Standards

columns.name: data_source
columns.description: System or external data provider from which the KOL profile information was sourced or enriched. Examples include Veeva CRM, internal medical affairs databases, third-party KOL intelligence platforms, or manual entry. Used for data lineage and quality assessment.

columns.name: department_chair_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the KOL serves as a department chair or division head at their primary institution. True if the KOL holds a leadership position, false otherwise. Reflects institutional leadership and decision-making authority.

columns.name: fellowship_institution
columns.description: Name of the institution where the KOL completed their fellowship training. Indicates specialized training and institutional network.

columns.name: guideline_authorship_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the KOL has authored or co-authored clinical practice guidelines, consensus statements, or treatment recommendations. True if guideline authorship exists, false otherwise. Reflects standard-of-care influence.
columns.reference: Clinical Practice Guideline Standards, National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN)

columns.name: h_index
columns.description: Hirsch index measuring the productivity and citation impact of the KOL's published work. An h-index of n means the researcher has n publications with at least n citations each. Used to quantify scientific influence and publication quality.
columns.reference: Bibliometric Standards - Scopus, Web of Science

columns.name: kol_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the KOL profile. Active KOLs are eligible for engagement, under review indicates pending compliance or credentialing checks, suspended indicates temporary ineligibility, retired indicates the HCP is no longer practicing, and deceased indicates the HCP has passed away.

columns.name: kol_tier
columns.description: Strategic classification of the KOL's influence level and reach. National KOLs have broad industry impact, regional KOLs influence specific geographies or health systems, local KOLs impact individual institutions, emerging KOLs show rising influence, and inactive KOLs are no longer actively engaged.

columns.name: last_congress_speaking_date
columns.description: Date of the most recent congress or conference speaking engagement by the KOL. Used to assess recency of public thought leadership activity.

columns.name: last_msl_interaction_date
columns.glossary_term: Last Medical Science Liaison (MSL) Interaction Date
columns.description: Date of the most recent interaction or engagement between an MSL and the KOL. Used to track engagement recency and plan follow-up activities.

columns.name: last_publication_date
columns.description: Date of the KOL's most recent peer-reviewed publication. Indicates currency of scientific contribution and active research status.

columns.name: medical_school
columns.description: Name of the medical school or institution where the KOL obtained their medical degree. Provides context on educational background and institutional affiliations.

columns.name: msl_engagement_strategy
columns.description: Strategic priority level for Medical Science Liaison engagement with this KOL. High priority KOLs receive frequent proactive outreach, medium priority receive periodic engagement, low priority are engaged opportunistically, monitor only are tracked but not actively engaged, and do not contact indicates compliance or relationship restrictions.

columns.name: orcid_number
columns.description: Unique persistent digital identifier for the researcher, used to disambiguate authors and link research outputs. Format: 0000-0000-0000-0000.

columns.name: peer_reviewed_publication_count
columns.description: Total number of peer-reviewed journal articles, reviews, and original research publications authored or co-authored by the KOL. Reflects scientific productivity and contribution to medical literature.

columns.name: primary_affiliation
columns.description: The main hospital, academic medical center, research institution, or healthcare organization where the KOL holds a primary appointment or practices. Critical for understanding institutional influence and access.

columns.name: principal_investigator_trial_count
columns.description: Number of clinical trials where the KOL has served as the principal investigator. Reflects depth of clinical research leadership and trial management experience.

columns.name: profile_created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the KOL profile record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

columns.name: profile_updated_by
columns.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated the KOL profile record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

columns.name: profile_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the KOL profile record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data currency assessment.

columns.name: scopus_author_number
columns.description: Unique identifier assigned by Elsevier Scopus to track the KOL's publications and citation metrics. Used for bibliometric analysis and publication tracking.

columns.name: society_leadership_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the KOL holds or has held a leadership position (board member, committee chair, president) in a professional medical society. True if leadership role exists, false otherwise. Reflects industry influence and governance participation.

columns.name: society_membership_list
columns.description: List of professional medical societies, associations, or organizations where the KOL holds membership. Examples include American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO), American College of Cardiology (ACC), European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO). Stored as delimited text.

columns.name: sunshine_act_reportable_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether payments or transfers of value to this KOL must be reported under the Physician Payments Sunshine Act (Open Payments). True if reportable, false otherwise. Used to ensure transparency and compliance with US federal reporting requirements.
columns.reference: Physician Payments Sunshine Act, 42 USC 1320a-7h, Open Payments Program

columns.name: total_citation_count
columns.description: Cumulative number of citations received across all of the KOL's published works. Indicates the breadth of scientific impact and recognition within the research community.
columns.reference: Bibliometric Standards - Scopus, Web of Science

columns.name: total_msl_interaction_count
columns.glossary_term: Total Medical Science Liaison (MSL) Interaction Count
columns.description: Cumulative number of documented interactions between MSLs and the KOL. Reflects depth of relationship and engagement history.

Primary transactional record for HCP engagement history. Sourced from Veeva CRM.

Used for routing inquiries, coordinating multi-functional engagement, and preventing duplicate outreach. An HCP may have different primary contacts for different therapeutic areas.

columns.name: relationship_end_date
columns.description: Date when this employee-HCP engagement relationship was formally ended or reassigned. Null for active relationships. Used for tracking relationship handoffs during territory changes, employee transitions, or strategic deprioritization.

columns.name: relationship_start_date
columns.description: Date when this employee-HCP engagement relationship was formally established or assigned. Used for relationship tenure analysis, onboarding tracking, and historical relationship mapping.

columns.name: relationship_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of this HCP-employee engagement relationship. Active relationships require ongoing management and interaction tracking. Inactive or Suspended relationships are retained for historical analysis and potential reactivation.

columns.name: relationship_strength_score
columns.description: Quantitative metric (0-100 scale) assessing the strength and quality of this specific HCP-employee engagement relationship based on interaction frequency, responsiveness, collaboration depth, and strategic value. Used for prioritizing engagement efforts and measuring field team effectiveness.

columns.name: relationship_type

columns.name: samples_provided_flag

columns.name: signature_captured_flag

columns.name: transfer_of_value_currency

tables.name: consent_record
tables.description: Unified consent, opt-in/opt-out, do-not-contact (DNC), and no-see records governing all permissible and restricted communication with HCPs. Single source of truth for contact permissions and restrictions across all channels. Captures consent grants (promotional, medical, digital, email, phone), consent withdrawals, DNC requests, no-see restrictions, compliance-driven contact restrictions, legal holds, and channel-specific limitations. Tracks consent date, withdrawal date, restriction type, restriction reason, regulatory basis (GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA, state law), expiration, and enforcement status. Enforced across all field engagement systems including Veeva CRM, email platforms, and digital channels. Replaces any separate DNC or no-see lists as the single authoritative source.

Captures payment type (consulting fee, speaker honorarium, meal, travel, research grant, royalty), amount, currency, date, product association, nature of payment, and CMS reporting status. tables.name: contract
tables.description: Contracts, agreements, and associated fair market value (FMV) rate cards between the pharmaceutical company and HCPs for services including consulting, advisory boards, speaker programs, clinical research, and medical education. Captures contract type, effective dates, scope of services, FMV rate ranges by specialty/service/region, FMV methodology, hourly rate min/max, annual caps, honorarium rate, payment terms, compliance approval status, legal review status, and debarment/exclusion screening results (OIG, GSA SAM, FDA Debarment List checks). Supports anti-kickback compliance validation (ensuring compensation within FMV bounds), exclusion screening before financial transfers, and Sunshine Act reporting for all contracted HCP payments.

columns.name: hourly_rate_min

columns.name: legal_review_status

columns.name: specialty
columns.description: Medical specialty of the HCP relevant to this contract. Used for FMV rate benchmarking and compliance validation.

columns.description: Indicates whether payments under this contract must be reported under the Physician Payments Sunshine Act (Open Payments). True for most HCP contracts.

columns.name: termination_reason

tables.name: investigator

Captures investigator role, GCP training status, CV on file, financial disclosure (Form FDA 3455), IRB approval status, site affiliation, therapeutic area expertise, enrollment performance metrics, and trial participation history. Provides the HCP-domain view of investigator identity and qualifications; clinical trial operational data (protocol, enrollment, visits) resides in the clinical domain. Supports regulatory submissions (Form FDA 1572) and clinical operations planning.

columns.name: average_enrollment_rate

columns.name: kol_investigator_flag
