columns.description: Free-text description of the royalty agreement summarizing the key commercial terms, licensed rights, and strategic context. Used for business user reference and reporting narratives. Not a substitute for the legal agreement document.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302

columns.name: agreement_number
columns.description: Externally-known, human-readable agreement reference number assigned at execution (e.g., RA-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reconciliation with SAP FI/CO contract management and legal document repositories. Maps to the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: agreement_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the royalty agreement. Draft indicates the agreement is under negotiation; active indicates it is fully executed and binding; suspended indicates temporarily paused due to dispute or regulatory hold; terminated indicates early termination by either party; expired indicates the agreement reached its natural end date. Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: agreement_type
columns.description: Classification of the royalty agreement by direction and structure of the licensing relationship. In-license covers compounds or IP acquired from external parties; out-license covers IP granted to third parties; cross-license covers mutual IP sharing; sublicense covers rights granted by a licensee to a third party; co-development covers joint R&D arrangements with shared royalty obligations. Maps to CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; IP Licensing Best Practices; SOX Section 302

columns.name: audit_frequency_years
columns.description: Maximum frequency (in years) at which the licensor may exercise audit rights under the agreement (e.g., once every 2 years). Null when audit_rights_flag is False. Used to schedule and track audit obligations.

columns.name: audit_rights_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the licensor has the contractual right to audit the licensee's books and records to verify royalty calculations and net sales reporting. True if audit rights are granted; False otherwise. Relevant for SOX compliance and royalty audit defense.
columns.reference: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 808; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: base_royalty_rate_pct
columns.description: The primary or base royalty rate expressed as a percentage of net sales applicable to the first tier or flat rate structure. For tiered agreements, this represents the lowest tier rate. Stored with five decimal places to accommodate fractional rates common in pharmaceutical licensing (e.g., 3.50000%). Used as the default rate in accrual calculations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: cost_center_code
columns.description: SAP CO cost center code to which royalty costs are allocated for internal management reporting. Supports P&L analysis by therapeutic area, brand, or R&D program and ROI calculation for in-licensed compounds.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this royalty agreement record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
columns.reference: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which royalty obligations, net sales, and payments are denominated under this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). All monetary fields in this record are expressed in this currency. Used for multi-currency royalty accounting and FX translation in SAP FI/CO.
columns.reference: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 830

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date on which the royalty agreement becomes legally binding and royalty obligations commence. Used to determine the start of royalty accrual periods and minimum payment schedules. Maps to EFFECTIVE_FROM category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ICH Q10; SOX Section 302

columns.name: execution_date
columns.description: Date on which the royalty agreement was formally signed and executed by all parties. May differ from the effective date when agreements are backdated or have a future commencement clause. Critical for SOX audit trail and legal enforceability.

columns.name: expiration_date
columns.description: Date on which the royalty agreement is scheduled to expire and royalty obligations cease. Nullable for perpetual or open-ended agreements. Used for accrual cutoff and renewal planning. Maps to EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ICH Q10; SOX Section 302

columns.name: gl_account_code
columns.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code to which royalty expense or income is posted for this agreement. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, and geography. Aligns with the chart of accounts in SAP FI/CO for royalty accounting obligations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this royalty agreement record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
columns.reference: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: licensee_name
columns.description: Legal name of the entity receiving the license rights (licensee). For in-license agreements, this is typically the pharmaceutical company itself or a subsidiary. For out-license agreements, this is the external partner receiving rights.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Customer Master; GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 302

columns.name: minimum_annual_royalty_amount
columns.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum royalty payment due to the licensor per calendar or contract year, regardless of actual net sales. If actual royalties calculated on net sales fall below this floor, the minimum amount is payable. Critical for accrual adequacy assessment and cash flow planning.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: net_sales_definition
columns.description: Contractual definition of net sales as the royalty base, specifying which deductions are permitted (e.g., trade discounts, chargebacks, returns, freight, taxes, gross-to-net adjustments). Critical for accurate royalty calculation and audit defense. Stored as free text capturing the contractual language or a standardized reference code.
columns.reference: FASB ASC 808; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Section 302; FDA Guidance on Gross-to-Net

columns.name: payment_due_days
columns.description: Number of calendar days after the close of each reporting period within which the royalty payment must be remitted to the licensor (e.g., 45 days after quarter end). Used to calculate payment due dates for each accrual period and to assess timeliness of settlements.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/AP Module; FASB ASC 808

columns.name: payment_frequency
columns.description: Contractual frequency at which royalty payments must be remitted to the licensor. Drives the accrual period schedule and payment due date calculation in SAP FI accounts payable. Quarterly is the most common frequency in pharmaceutical licensing agreements.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/AP Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: royalty_rate_type
columns.description: Structure of the royalty rate calculation methodology. Flat applies a single fixed percentage to all net sales; tiered applies different rates to different net sales bands; stepped changes the rate at defined cumulative thresholds; running is a continuous percentage; milestone_based triggers payments upon achievement of defined development or commercial milestones.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 808

columns.name: sap_contract_number
columns.description: Source system contract or purchase order number from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO module that corresponds to this royalty agreement. Used for financial reconciliation, accounts payable matching, and audit trail between the data lakehouse and the ERP system of record.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: sublicense_royalty_rate_pct
columns.description: Royalty rate percentage applicable to sublicense revenues received by the licensee, payable to the original licensor. Applicable only when sublicensing_rights_flag is True. May differ from the standard net sales royalty rate. Null when sublicensing is not permitted.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: sublicensing_rights_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the licensee has the contractual right to grant sublicenses to third parties under this agreement. True if sublicensing is permitted; False if rights are non-sublicensable. Impacts royalty flow-through obligations and sublicense revenue sharing calculations.
columns.reference: ICH Q10; IP Licensing Best Practices; SOX Section 302

columns.name: termination_notice_days
columns.description: Number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate the agreement for convenience or material breach. Used for contract lifecycle management and accrual wind-down planning.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302

columns.name: territory
columns.description: Geographic scope of the royalty agreement defining the countries or regions where the licensee has rights to commercialize the licensed compound. Expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes (comma-separated for multi-country) or a named region (e.g., WORLDWIDE, EU, USA). Drives territory-specific royalty rate application and net sales calculation.
columns.reference: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 314

columns.name: tier1_threshold_amount
columns.description: Net sales threshold amount (in the agreement currency) at which the royalty rate transitions from the base rate to the tier 2 rate. For tiered agreements, net sales up to this amount are subject to base_royalty_rate_pct. Null for flat-rate agreements.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: tier2_royalty_rate_pct
columns.description: Royalty rate percentage applicable to the second net sales tier for tiered or stepped royalty structures. Null for flat-rate agreements. Applied when cumulative or annual net sales exceed the tier 1 threshold defined in tier1_threshold_amount.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: tier2_threshold_amount
columns.description: Net sales threshold amount (in the agreement currency) at which the royalty rate transitions from tier 2 to tier 3 rate. Null if the agreement has only two tiers or is flat-rate. Supports up to three-tier royalty structures common in pharmaceutical licensing.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: tier3_royalty_rate_pct
columns.description: Royalty rate percentage applicable to net sales exceeding the tier 2 threshold for three-tier royalty structures. Null for flat-rate or two-tier agreements. Typically the highest rate in escalating structures or lowest in de-escalating structures.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: upfront_license_fee_amount
columns.description: One-time non-refundable upfront payment made to the licensor upon execution of the agreement, separate from ongoing running royalties. Relevant for R&D capitalization assessment under FASB ASC 730 and IP cost tracking for in-licensed compounds.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; FASB ASC 730; FASB ASC 808; SOX Section 302

columns.name: withholding_tax_rate_pct
columns.description: Applicable withholding tax rate percentage on royalty payments as determined by the governing tax treaty between the licensor and licensee jurisdictions. Used for net payment calculation and tax reporting. Zero if no withholding tax applies under a treaty exemption.
columns.reference: OECD Model Tax Convention; FASB ASC 740; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Module; SOX Section 302

tables.name: milestone_payment
tables.description: Tracks contractual milestone-based payment obligations and receipts triggered by development, regulatory, or commercial events in pharmaceutical partnerships. Captures milestone type (e.g., IND filing, Phase II completion, NDA approval, first commercial sale, sales thresholds), triggering event date, contractual payment amount, currency, counterparty, associated internal order, payment status, and accounting treatment. Distinct from internal_order (which collects all costs for a program) — milestone_payment owns the individual contractual obligation record and its trigger-based lifecycle. Critical for R&D partnership financial management and contingent liability disclosure.

columns.name: milestone_payment_id
columns.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each milestone payment obligation or receipt record. Primary key for the milestone_payment data product.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Internal Document Number

columns.name: business_partner_id
columns.description: System identifier for the external counterparty (vendor or customer) in the SAP master data. Links to the vendor/customer master record for the partner organization.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI — Vendor Master (LFA1) / Customer Master (KNA1)

columns.name: chart_of_accounts_id
columns.description: Reference to the General Ledger account to which this milestone payment is posted in SAP FI. Determines the financial statement line item for the payment.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — G/L Account (SKA1); IFRS; US GAAP

columns.name: cost_center_id
columns.description: Reference to the SAP cost center responsible for this milestone payment obligation. Used for departmental cost allocation and management reporting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center (CSKS)

columns.name: indication_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.indication. Business justification: Pharma licensing deals structure milestone payments around specific indication approvals (e.g., first oncology approval triggers $50M payment). Finance and BD teams must link each milestone payment to

columns.name: journal_entry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Each milestone payment triggers a journal entry for the financial posting. The milestone_payment currently has sap_document_number (STRING) which should be replaced with a proper FK to journal_entry.

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Milestone payments are booked within a legal entity for statutory reporting, transfer pricing compliance, and contingent liability disclosure. Pharma deal accounting requires entity-level milestone tr

columns.name: licensing_agreement_id
columns.description: Reference to the parent licensing, collaboration, or partnership agreement under which this milestone payment obligation was established.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Contract Reference

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.description: Reference to the SAP profit center for P&L reporting of this milestone payment by business unit, brand, or therapeutic area.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Profit Center (CEPC)

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to discovery.discovery_project. Business justification: Milestone payments (in/out-licensing) are project-specific; linking enables accrual tracking, contingent liability management, portfolio valuation, and cash flow forecasting essential to pharmaceutica

columns.name: royalty_agreement_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to finance.royalty_agreement. Business justification: Milestone payments in pharma licensing deals are often governed by royalty and licensing agreements. A royalty agreement may specify milestone-based payments (upfront license fees, regulatory approval

columns.name: accounting_treatment
columns.description: Accounting classification applied to this milestone payment per applicable accounting standards: rd_expense (expensed as R&D), capitalize (capitalized as intangible asset), cogs (recognized as cost of goods sold), deferred_revenue (deferred until performance obligation met), contingent_liability (disclosed as contingent liability until triggered).
columns.reference: IFRS 15; IFRS 38; ASC 730 — Research and Development; ASC 808; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: approval_date
columns.description: Date on which the milestone payment was formally approved by the authorized approver. Part of the SOX-compliant audit trail for financial disbursements.
columns.reference: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI — Approval Workflow

columns.name: approval_status
columns.description: Internal approval workflow status for the milestone payment. Tracks whether the payment has been reviewed and authorized by the appropriate financial and legal stakeholders before processing.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Approval Workflow; SOX Section 302/404 — Internal Controls

columns.name: company_code
columns.description: Four-character SAP company code identifying the legal entity responsible for this milestone payment. Determines the applicable accounting standards, currency, and regulatory jurisdiction.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Company Code (T001); SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: contractual_amount
columns.description: The gross payment amount as specified in the partnership or licensing agreement for this milestone, in the contract currency. This is the base obligation before any adjustments, withholding taxes, or FX conversion.
columns.reference: IFRS 15 — Transaction Price; ASC 808; SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this milestone payment record was first created in the system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for SOX-compliant financial records.
columns.reference: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contractual milestone payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP). Defines the denomination of the contractual_amount field.
columns.reference: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: development_stage
columns.description: Development stage of the associated drug program at the time the milestone is triggered (e.g., preclinical, Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, NDA/BLA Filed). Used for R&D capitalization assessment and program tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discovery|preclinical|phase_1|phase_2|phase_3|nda_bla_filed|approved|commercial — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); ICH E8; IFRS 38 — Intangible Assets (R&D Capitalization)

columns.name: expected_trigger_date
columns.description: Projected date by which the triggering event is expected to occur, based on current program timelines. Used for contingent liability forecasting and cash flow planning.
columns.reference: IFRS 37 — Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets; ASC 450 — Contingencies

columns.name: functional_currency_amount
columns.description: Milestone payment amount converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the applicable exchange rate at the time of recognition or payment. Used for consolidated financial reporting.
columns.reference: IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters; SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: functional_currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the company's functional currency used in the functional_currency_amount field (e.g., USD).

columns.name: fx_rate
columns.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the contractual_amount from contract currency to functional currency at the time of recognition or payment. Sourced from SAP FI treasury rates.
columns.reference: IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI Treasury

columns.name: is_capitalized
columns.description: Indicates whether this milestone payment has been capitalized as an intangible asset on the balance sheet rather than expensed. Applicable when the payment relates to a product that has received regulatory approval and meets capitalization criteria.
columns.reference: IFRS 38 — Intangible Assets; ASC 350 — Intangibles; SAP S/4HANA FI Asset Accounting

columns.name: is_contingent_liability
columns.description: Indicates whether this milestone payment represents a contingent liability that must be disclosed in financial statements prior to the triggering event occurring. True if the payment obligation is contingent on a future uncertain event.
columns.reference: IFRS 37 — Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets; ASC 450 — Contingencies; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this milestone payment record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for SOX compliance.
columns.reference: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: milestone_name
columns.description: Descriptive name of the milestone payment as defined in the contractual agreement (e.g., 'Phase II Completion Payment', 'NDA Approval Milestone', 'First Commercial Sale Milestone').
columns.reference: ICH E6(R2) — Good Clinical Practice; SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: milestone_number
columns.description: Externally-known business identifier for this milestone payment, typically referenced in the partnership agreement schedule. Format: MS-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Reference Number

columns.name: milestone_type
columns.description: Classification of the milestone by the nature of the triggering event: development (e.g., IND filing, Phase completion), regulatory (e.g., NDA/BLA/MAA approval), commercial (e.g., first commercial sale), sales_threshold (e.g., net sales exceeding a defined threshold), or technical (e.g., target validation, candidate nomination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: development|regulatory|commercial|sales_threshold|technical|preclinical — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH M4 eCTD; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Guideline on Licensing Agreements

columns.name: net_payment_amount
columns.description: Actual net amount paid or received after deducting withholding taxes and any other contractual adjustments from the contractual_amount. Represents the cash flow impact.
columns.reference: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-text field for additional context, legal commentary, dispute details, or operational notes related to this milestone payment record.

columns.name: payment_date
columns.description: Actual date on which the milestone payment was settled (funds transferred or received). Null if payment has not yet been made.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Clearing Date; IFRS 15

columns.name: payment_direction
columns.description: Indicates whether this milestone payment is an obligation owed by the company to a counterparty (payable) or a receipt due from a counterparty (receivable). Critical for balance sheet classification and contingent liability disclosure.
columns.reference: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 808 — Collaborative Arrangements; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: payment_due_date
columns.description: Contractually defined date by which the milestone payment must be made or received following the triggering event. Typically calculated as triggering event date plus contractual payment terms (e.g., net 30/60 days).
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Due Date; IFRS 15

columns.name: payment_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the milestone payment obligation. Pending: milestone not yet achieved; Triggered: triggering event has occurred and payment is due; Approved: payment approved for processing; Paid: payment has been settled; Waived: contractually waived; Disputed: under dispute resolution.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Status; SOX Section 302/404

columns.name: source_system
columns.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this milestone payment record originated (e.g., SAP_FI for SAP Finance, VEEVA_VAULT for contract management, MANUAL for manually entered records).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records; SAP S/4HANA Data Lineage

columns.name: therapeutic_area
columns.description: Therapeutic area classification of the drug program associated with this milestone (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Neuroscience). Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area.
columns.reference: ATC Classification System (WHO); SAP S/4HANA CO — Profit Center

columns.name: triggering_event
columns.description: Description of the specific contractual event that triggers this milestone payment (e.g., 'IND Filing Accepted by FDA', 'Phase II Primary Endpoint Met', 'NDA Approval Received', 'First Commercial Sale in US', 'Annual Net Sales Exceed $500M').
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 (IND); FDA 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); ICH E8 — General Considerations for Clinical Studies

columns.name: triggering_event_date
columns.description: The actual date on which the contractual triggering event occurred, confirming the milestone has been achieved and the payment obligation is activated. Null if the milestone has not yet been triggered.
columns.reference: IFRS 15 — Revenue Recognition; ASC 808; SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: withholding_tax_amount
columns.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the milestone payment as required by applicable tax treaties or local tax regulations. Reduces the net payment amount received or paid.
columns.reference: OECD Model Tax Convention; IRS Publication 515; SAP S/4HANA FI — Withholding Tax

tables.name: transfer_price
tables.description: Transfer pricing master records governing the prices at which pharmaceutical products, APIs, and services are transacted between related legal entities across jurisdictions. Captures product or service, sending entity, receiving entity, transfer price method (CUP, cost-plus, TNMM), approved price, currency, effective date, and regulatory documentation reference. Supports OECD transfer pricing compliance and tax authority documentation.

columns.name: transfer_price_id
columns.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the transfer pricing master record governing intercompany transactions between related legal entities.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: cost_center_id
columns.description: Reference to the SAP cost center responsible for the intercompany transfer pricing arrangement. Used for internal P&L allocation and management reporting by therapeutic area or geography.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

columns.name: drug_product_id
columns.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical product, drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), or finished dosage form (FDF) subject to this transfer price.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ICH Q10

columns.name: manufacturing_site_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.site. Business justification: Transfer prices are set between specific manufacturing sites (sending entity) and receiving entities. Linking transfer_price to manufacturing.site enables intercompany pricing reports, tax authority d

columns.name: primary_transfer_legal_entity_id
columns.description: Reference to the legal entity that is the seller or supplier in the intercompany transaction (the entity transferring the product, API, or service).
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code

columns.name: prior_version_transfer_price_id
columns.description: Reference to the immediately preceding version of this transfer price record (self-referential). Enables reconstruction of the full price history chain for audit and tax authority documentation purposes.

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.description: Reference to the SAP profit center associated with the intercompany transaction. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area, brand, or geography in SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

columns.name: sending_country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Transfer pricing rules are country-pair specific; the sending country determines applicable tax treaties, APA requirements, and documentation standards. The plain sending_country_code is denormalized;

columns.name: therapeutic_area_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to product.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Transfer pricing analysis in pharma is segmented by therapeutic area for APA documentation, management reporting, and tax authority submissions. therapeutic_area on transfer_price is a plain text deno

columns.name: apa_reference
columns.description: Reference to an Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) or bilateral APA (BAPA) concluded with one or more tax authorities that pre-approves the transfer pricing methodology and price range for this transaction. Null if no APA is in place.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; 26 CFR §1.482; Rev. Proc. 2015-41

columns.name: approval_date
columns.description: The date on which the transfer price was formally approved by the authorized approver (e.g., Head of Tax, CFO, or Transfer Pricing Committee) in accordance with SOX-compliant approval workflows.
columns.reference: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow

columns.name: approved_price
columns.description: The arm's-length intercompany price approved for the transfer of the product or service per unit, expressed in the transaction currency. This is the operative price used in intercompany invoicing.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Record

columns.name: arm_length_range_max
columns.description: The upper bound of the arm's-length price range (interquartile range) established through benchmarking analysis. The approved transfer price must fall within this range to satisfy OECD and local tax authority requirements.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter III; 26 CFR §1.482

columns.name: arm_length_range_min
columns.description: The lower bound of the arm's-length price range (interquartile range) established through benchmarking analysis. The approved transfer price must fall within this range to satisfy OECD and local tax authority requirements.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter III; 26 CFR §1.482

columns.name: benchmarking_study_ref
columns.description: Document reference number or identifier for the economic benchmarking study (comparables analysis) that supports the arm's-length determination for this transfer price. Links to the transfer pricing documentation file.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter III; OECD BEPS Action 13

columns.name: cost_base_amount
columns.description: The total cost base (direct manufacturing cost, overhead, and allocated R&D) used as the starting point for cost-plus or TNMM pricing method calculations. Expressed in the transaction currency.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter II; SAP S/4HANA CO Product Costing

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this transfer price record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports SOX audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
columns.reference: SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the approved transfer price is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP).

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: The date from which this transfer price record becomes binding and operative for intercompany invoicing between the sending and receiving legal entities.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period

columns.name: expiry_date
columns.description: The date on which this transfer price record ceases to be operative. Null indicates an open-ended record with no defined expiry. Superseded records will have this date set to the day before the successor record's effective date.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period

columns.name: last_updated_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this transfer price record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports SOX audit trail and change management tracking.

columns.name: markup_pct
columns.description: The arm's-length markup percentage applied to the cost base to arrive at the approved transfer price under cost-plus or TNMM methodology. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.0000 = 15%).
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter II; 26 CFR §1.482-3

columns.name: next_review_date
columns.description: The date by which the next periodic review of this transfer price must be completed to maintain arm's-length compliance and update the supporting documentation.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; OECD BEPS Action 13

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, rationale, or context regarding the transfer price determination, including any deviations from standard methodology or special circumstances noted by the transfer pricing team.

columns.name: price_per_unit_of_measure
columns.description: The unit of measure to which the approved transfer price applies (e.g., per kg of API, per vial of drug product, per batch). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA base unit of measure on the material master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|mg|L|mL|unit|vial|tablet|capsule|batch — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ICH Q7

columns.name: pricing_method
columns.description: OECD-recognized transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arm's-length price. CUP = Comparable Uncontrolled Price; TNMM = Transactional Net Margin Method; RPM = Resale Price Method; PSM = Profit Split Method; cost_plus = Cost-Plus Method.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter II; 26 CFR §1.482

columns.name: product_lifecycle_stage
columns.description: The commercial lifecycle stage of the pharmaceutical product at the time this transfer price is established. Influences the pricing methodology and markup applied (e.g., pre-launch products may use cost-plus; commercial products may use CUP).
columns.reference: ICH Q10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

columns.name: product_type
columns.description: Classification of the item or service subject to the transfer price. Distinguishes between active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), drug substance (DS), finished drug product (DP), finished dosage form (FDF), contract manufacturing services, or intellectual property royalty arrangements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: API|drug_substance|drug_product|FDF|service|CMO_service|IP_royalty — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH Q7; ICH Q10; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

columns.name: record_number
columns.description: Externally-known business identifier for the transfer pricing record, used in intercompany agreements, tax authority documentation, and OECD compliance filings. Format: TP-YYYY-NNNNNN.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

columns.name: record_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle state of the transfer pricing record. Active records govern live intercompany transactions; superseded records have been replaced by a newer version. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|superseded|expired|cancelled — promote to reference product]
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; SOX Section 404

columns.name: regulatory_doc_ref
columns.description: Reference to the formal transfer pricing documentation package (local file, master file, or country-by-country report) filed with tax authorities in accordance with OECD BEPS Action 13 requirements. May reference a Veeva Vault document ID or SAP document number.
columns.reference: OECD BEPS Action 13; 26 CFR §1.6038A; EU ATAD

columns.name: review_frequency
columns.description: The scheduled frequency at which this transfer price is reviewed and potentially revised to ensure continued arm's-length compliance. Annual review is the OECD standard minimum.

columns.name: source_system
columns.description: The operational system of record from which this transfer price record originates (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI/CO, manual entry via spreadsheet, or a Regulatory Information Management System). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.

columns.name: tax_ruling_ref
columns.description: Reference to any binding tax ruling, private letter ruling, or competent authority agreement issued by a tax authority that specifically governs or validates this transfer pricing arrangement.
columns.reference: OECD BEPS Action 5; 26 CFR §1.482; EU ATAD

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.description: Nature of the intercompany transaction governed by this transfer price: tangible goods (products/APIs), services (manufacturing, R&D, distribution), IP licensing, cost-sharing arrangements, or intercompany loans.
columns.reference: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines Chapter VI; 26 CFR §1.482

columns.name: version_number
columns.description: Sequential version number of the transfer price record for a given product-entity pair. Incremented each time the price is revised. Enables audit trail and historical price reconstruction for tax authority inquiries.
columns.reference: OECD BEPS Action 13; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: withholding_tax_applicable
columns.description: Indicates whether withholding tax applies to the intercompany transaction governed by this transfer price (e.g., royalty payments or service fees may be subject to withholding tax under bilateral tax treaties).
columns.reference: OECD Model Tax Convention; 26 CFR §1.1441; EU Interest and Royalties Directive

columns.name: withholding_tax_rate_pct
columns.description: The applicable withholding tax rate (as a decimal percentage) on the intercompany payment, as determined by the bilateral tax treaty between the sending and receiving entity jurisdictions. Null if withholding_tax_applicable is False.

tables.name: payment_run
tables.description: Master reference table for payment_run. Referenced by payment_run_id.

columns.name: payment_run_id
columns.description: Primary key for payment_run

columns.name: bank_account_id
columns.description: Reference to the company bank account from which payments in this run will be disbursed.

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Reference to the legal entity (operating company or subsidiary) executing this payment run.

columns.name: prior_payment_run_id
columns.description: Self-referencing FK on payment_run (prior_payment_run_id)

columns.name: approval_status
columns.description: Current approval state of the payment run within the authorization workflow.

columns.name: approved_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the payment run received final approval to proceed.

columns.name: confirmation_number
columns.description: Confirmation or acknowledgment number received from the bank or payment processor upon successful file receipt.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the payment run record was first created in the system.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment run (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

columns.name: error_count
columns.description: Number of payment transactions within the run that encountered errors or failed validation.

columns.name: error_message
columns.description: Consolidated error messages or failure reasons for the payment run, used for troubleshooting and resolution.

columns.name: execution_timestamp
columns.description: The precise date and time when the payment run was executed and payments were initiated.

columns.name: fiscal_period
columns.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when this payment run is recorded.

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: The fiscal year in which this payment run is recorded for financial reporting purposes.

columns.name: gl_posting_date
columns.description: The accounting period date when the payment run transactions were posted to the general ledger.

columns.name: is_test_run
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a test or simulation run (true) or a live production payment run (false).

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the payment run record was last updated or modified.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the payment run for operational reference and audit trail.

columns.name: payment_category
columns.description: Classification of the payment run by recipient type or payment purpose for financial reporting and analysis.

columns.name: payment_count
columns.description: Total number of individual payment transactions included in this payment run.

columns.name: payment_file_name
columns.description: Name of the payment file generated for transmission to the bank or payment processor.

columns.name: payment_file_path
columns.description: Storage location or file path where the payment file is archived for audit and compliance purposes.

columns.name: payment_method
columns.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used for disbursements in this run (e.g., Automated Clearing House, wire transfer, physical check).

columns.name: payment_run_description
columns.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the purpose or scope of this payment run.

columns.name: payment_run_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment run in the payment processing workflow.

columns.name: processing_priority
columns.description: Priority level assigned to the payment run for queue management and execution sequencing.

columns.name: reconciled_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the payment run was successfully reconciled with banking records.

columns.name: reconciliation_status
columns.description: Status indicating whether the payment run has been reconciled with bank statements and general ledger postings.

columns.name: run_number
columns.description: Business identifier for the payment run, formatted as PR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external reference and audit tracking.

columns.name: run_type
columns.description: Classification of the payment run indicating its purpose and processing priority.

columns.name: scheduled_date
columns.description: The planned date when the payment run is scheduled to execute and disburse funds.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.description: The aggregate monetary value of all payments in this run before any adjustments or fees.

columns.name: transmission_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when the payment file was transmitted to the bank or payment processor.

columns.name: value_date
columns.description: The effective date when funds are to be available to payees, used for cash flow planning and bank reconciliation.

tables.name: bank_account

columns.name: billing_period_start_date
columns.description: The start date of the period covered by this invoice, relevant for subscription or recurring billing.

columns.name: business_unit

columns.name: created_by_user

columns.name: dispute_reason

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the invoice, used for customer communication and payment reference.

columns.name: invoice_status

columns.name: invoice_type

columns.name: modified_timestamp

columns.name: total_amount

domains.name: masterdata
domains.description: Governs enterprise master data including organization hierarchy, chart of accounts, vendor master, material master, geographic reference data, units of measure, and code sets (ATC, NDC). Serves as the cross-domain reference layer ensuring consistent identifiers across SAP S/4HANA, Veeva, LIMS, and other operational systems. Supports MDM governance, data stewardship, and data quality management.
domains.references: DAMA DMBOK / SAP MDG / ISO 8000 Data Quality

tables.name: legal_entity
tables.description: Master record for all legal entities within the pharmaceutical enterprise including subsidiaries, affiliates, joint ventures, and holding companies. Captures legal name, registration number, jurisdiction of incorporation, entity type (operating company, holding, JV), tax identification numbers, registered address, functional currency, consolidation group, and SAP company code mapping. Serves as the organizational backbone for financial consolidation, regulatory submissions, and cross-system entity resolution.

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the legal entity record. Primary key for the legal entity master data product.
columns.reference: ISO 17442 (Legal Entity Identifier), SAP S/4HANA Company Code Master

columns.name: jurisdiction_country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: legal_entity.jurisdiction_of_incorporation is a free-text STRING representing the country/jurisdiction where the entity is incorporated. The masterdata.country table is the authoritative reference for

columns.name: parent_entity_legal_entity_id
columns.description: Reference to the parent legal entity in the organizational hierarchy. Null for top-level holding companies. Used to construct the legal entity hierarchy for consolidation and reporting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure, IFRS 10 (Consolidated Financial Statements)

columns.name: primary_ultimate_parent_entity_legal_entity_id
columns.description: Reference to the ultimate parent legal entity at the top of the organizational hierarchy. Used for global consolidation and group-level reporting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure, IFRS 10 (Consolidated Financial Statements)

columns.name: registered_address_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.address. Business justification: legal_entity carries six inline registered address columns (registered_address_line1, registered_address_line2, registered_city, registered_state_province, registered_postal_code, registered_country)

columns.name: consolidation_group
columns.description: The consolidation group or reporting unit to which this legal entity belongs for financial consolidation purposes. Used to aggregate financial results across multiple legal entities.
columns.reference: IFRS 10 (Consolidated Financial Statements), SAP S/4HANA Financial Consolidation

columns.name: data_quality_score
columns.description: A calculated score representing the completeness and accuracy of this legal entity master data record, typically ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Used for data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives.
columns.reference: DAMA-DMBOK (Data Management Body of Knowledge), Internal Data Quality Framework

columns.name: data_steward_name
columns.description: The name of the individual or role responsible for maintaining the accuracy and completeness of this legal entity master data record. Part of the MDM governance framework.
columns.reference: DAMA-DMBOK (Data Management Body of Knowledge), Internal MDM Governance Policy

columns.name: dissolution_date
columns.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially dissolved or terminated. Null for active entities.

columns.name: duns_number
columns.description: The 9-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for global business identification and credit reporting.

columns.name: ema_organization_code
columns.description: The organization identifier assigned by the European Medicines Agency for entities involved in pharmaceutical activities in the European Union. Used in regulatory submissions and correspondence.

columns.name: entity_status
columns.description: The current operational and legal status of the entity. Active entities are currently operating, inactive entities are dormant but legally registered, dissolved entities have been legally terminated, merged entities have been combined with another entity, acquired entities have been purchased by another organization, and pending formation entities are in the process of incorporation.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Configuration, Local Company Registry Standards

columns.name: entity_type
columns.description: Classification of the legal entity based on its operational and ownership structure. Operating companies conduct business operations, holding companies own other entities, joint ventures are shared ownership arrangements, subsidiaries are majority-owned entities, branches are extensions of parent entities, and partnerships are shared ownership structures.
columns.reference: ISO 20275 (Entity Legal Forms), SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure

columns.name: fda_establishment_identifier
columns.glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Establishment Identifier (FEI)
columns.description: The FDA Establishment Identifier assigned to facilities that manufacture, repack, relabel, or salvage drugs, biologics, or devices for commercial distribution in the United States. Required for regulatory submissions and inspections.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 207 (FDA Establishment Registration), FDA Data Standards Council

columns.name: fiscal_year_end_month
columns.description: The month in which the legal entity's fiscal year ends, represented as an integer from 1 (January) to 12 (December). Used for financial reporting and tax purposes.
columns.reference: IAS 1 (Presentation of Financial Statements), SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant

columns.name: functional_currency
columns.description: The primary currency in which the legal entity conducts its business and maintains its books of account, represented as a 3-letter ISO currency code.
columns.reference: ISO 4217 (Currency Codes), IAS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates)

columns.name: gmp_certification_status
columns.description: The current status of GMP certification for this legal entity. GMP certification is required for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and demonstrates compliance with quality standards.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 (cGMP), ICH Q7 (GMP for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), PIC/S GMP Guide

columns.name: incorporation_date
columns.description: The date on which the legal entity was officially incorporated or registered in its jurisdiction.

columns.name: industry_classification_code
columns.description: The standard industry classification code for the legal entity's primary business activity. May use NAICS, SIC, or ISIC classification systems.
columns.reference: NAICS (North American Industry Classification System), ISIC Rev.4

columns.name: iso_certification_status
columns.description: The current ISO quality management system certifications held by this legal entity (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 13485). Multiple certifications may be listed.
columns.reference: ISO 9001 (Quality Management Systems), ISO 13485 (Medical Devices Quality Management)

columns.name: legal_form
columns.description: The legal form or structure of the entity as defined by the jurisdiction of incorporation (e.g., Corporation, Limited Liability Company, Public Limited Company, Private Limited Company, Partnership). Uses ISO 20275 Entity Legal Forms codes where applicable.

columns.name: legal_name
columns.description: The official registered legal name of the entity as recorded in the jurisdiction of incorporation. This is the name that appears on all regulatory filings, contracts, and official documents.
columns.reference: ISO 20275 (Entity Legal Forms), FDA Establishment Registration

columns.name: lei_code
columns.description: The 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier code used for global entity identification in financial transactions and regulatory reporting.

columns.name: primary_business_activity
columns.description: Description of the primary business activity or operations conducted by this legal entity (e.g., pharmaceutical manufacturing, research and development, distribution, holding company).
columns.reference: ISIC Rev.4 (International Standard Industrial Classification), NAICS (North American Industry Classification System)

columns.name: record_created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this legal entity master data record was first created in the system.
columns.reference: ISO 8601 (Date and Time Format), Internal Audit Standards

columns.name: record_updated_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this legal entity master data record was last modified.
columns.reference: ISO 8601 (Date and Time Format), Internal Audit Standards

columns.name: registration_number
columns.description: The official registration or incorporation number assigned by the jurisdiction of incorporation. This may be a company registration number, certificate of incorporation number, or equivalent identifier.

columns.name: reporting_currency
columns.description: The currency used for external financial reporting and consolidation, represented as a 3-letter ISO currency code. May differ from functional currency for subsidiaries.
columns.reference: ISO 4217 (Currency Codes), IAS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates)

columns.name: sap_company_code
columns.description: The 4-character SAP S/4HANA company code assigned to this legal entity. Company codes are the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for external reporting purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

columns.name: short_name
columns.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the legal entity used in internal systems and reporting.

columns.name: stock_exchange_listing
columns.description: The stock exchange(s) on which the legal entity's securities are listed, if publicly traded. Uses ISO 10383 Market Identifier Codes (MIC) where applicable.
columns.reference: ISO 10383 (Market Identifier Codes), SEC EDGAR System

columns.name: stock_ticker_symbol
columns.description: The ticker symbol or trading symbol for the legal entity's publicly traded securities, if applicable.

columns.name: tax_identification_number
columns.description: The primary tax identification number assigned by the tax authority in the jurisdiction of incorporation. In the US this is the Employer Identification Number (EIN), in other jurisdictions it may be a VAT number, corporate tax number, or equivalent.
columns.reference: IRS Publication 1635 (EIN), OECD Tax Identification Standards

columns.name: vat_registration_number
columns.description: The VAT registration number assigned by the tax authority for entities registered for VAT purposes. Applicable primarily in jurisdictions with VAT systems.
columns.reference: EU VAT Directive, Local VAT Registration Standards

tables.name: org_unit
tables.description: Master record for organizational units within the enterprise hierarchy including business units, divisions, departments, and functional groups. Captures unit name, unit type (business unit, division, department, function, team), parent unit reference for hierarchy traversal, effective dates, responsible manager, geographic location, headcount, and SAP organizational element mapping. Supports HR organizational structure, operational reporting hierarchies, and management accountability across SAP S/4HANA, Veeva, and LIMS.

columns.name: org_unit_id
columns.description: Primary key for org_unit

columns.name: address_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.address. Business justification: org_unit carries five inline address columns (address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state_province, postal_code) that duplicate the masterdata.address master record. Adding org_unit_address_id FK to a

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Org units located in countries. New FK country_id → country.country_id. Existing country_code (STRING) remains for code-level reference.

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Organizational units belong to legal entities. New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

columns.name: parent_org_unit_id
columns.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the enterprise hierarchy. Enables hierarchical traversal and roll-up reporting across business units, divisions, departments, and teams. Null for top-level units.

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: Org units roll up to profit centers for P&L reporting. New FK profit_center_id → profit_center.masterdata_profit_center_id. Remove profit_center_code as redundant.

columns.name: budget_amount
columns.description: Annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit in the reporting currency. Used for financial planning, variance analysis, and resource allocation decisions.

columns.name: budget_currency_code
columns.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amount. Used for multi-currency reporting and financial consolidation.

columns.name: business_area_code
columns.description: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) business area code for cross-company code reporting. Used for segment reporting and consolidated financial statements.

columns.name: cost_center_code
columns.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) cost center code associated with this organizational unit. Used for financial planning, budgeting, and expense allocation. Aligns with SAP CO module cost center master data.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the master data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

columns.name: effective_end_date
columns.description: Date when the organizational unit ceased or will cease operations. Null for currently active units. Used for historical reporting and organizational change tracking.

columns.name: effective_start_date
columns.description: Date when the organizational unit became or will become operational. Used for time-based hierarchy queries and historical organizational structure analysis.

columns.name: email_address
columns.description: Primary contact email address for the organizational unit. Used for official correspondence and system notifications.

columns.name: functional_area
columns.description: Broad functional classification of the organizational unit such as Research and Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Supply Chain, Finance, Human Resources, or Information Technology. Supports cross-functional analysis and resource allocation.

columns.name: gcp_regulated_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates under GCP (Good Clinical Practice) regulations. True for clinical development, medical affairs, and pharmacovigilance units conducting or supporting clinical trials.

columns.name: geographic_region
columns.description: Geographic region or market where this organizational unit operates (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America). Used for regional performance analysis and market segmentation.

columns.name: glp_regulated_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates under GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) regulations. True for preclinical research and toxicology laboratories conducting non-clinical safety studies.

columns.name: gmp_regulated_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit operates under GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) or cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) regulations. True for manufacturing, quality control, and quality assurance units handling drug substances or drug products.

columns.name: headcount_fte
columns.description: Total full-time equivalent employee count allocated to this organizational unit. Used for workforce planning, budget allocation, and productivity analysis. Includes full-time, part-time, and contractor resources normalized to FTE.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

columns.name: org_unit_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit. Active units are operational and staffed. Inactive units are temporarily suspended. Pending units are approved but not yet operational. Dissolved units have been permanently closed.

columns.name: phone_number
columns.description: Primary contact phone number for the organizational unit. Used for business communication and emergency contact.

columns.name: qms_scope_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit is within the scope of the enterprise Quality Management System (QMS). True for units subject to ISO 9001 certification and quality audits.

columns.name: sap_org_unit_code
columns.description: Native SAP S/4HANA organizational unit identifier from the Organizational Management (OM) module. Used for bidirectional synchronization and cross-system reconciliation.

columns.name: site_location
columns.description: Physical site or facility name where the organizational unit is primarily located. Used for facility management, space planning, and operational logistics.

columns.name: therapeutic_area
columns.description: Primary therapeutic area focus for research, clinical, or commercial organizational units (e.g., Oncology, Immunology, Rare Diseases, Cardiovascular, Neuroscience). Null for non-product-focused units.

columns.name: unit_code
columns.description: Business-assigned unique code for the organizational unit. Used for cross-system integration and reporting. Typically aligned with SAP S/4HANA organizational element codes (cost center, profit center, business area).

columns.name: unit_level
columns.description: Numeric level of the unit in the organizational hierarchy. Level 1 represents top-level enterprise units, with increasing numbers for deeper nesting. Supports hierarchy depth analysis and roll-up aggregation.

columns.name: unit_name
columns.description: Full official name of the organizational unit as recognized in corporate documentation and reporting systems. Used for display in reports, dashboards, and organizational charts.

columns.name: unit_short_name
columns.description: Abbreviated name or acronym for the organizational unit. Used in space-constrained displays and informal communication.

columns.name: unit_type
columns.description: Classification of the organizational unit by its role in the enterprise structure. Determines reporting hierarchy level and management accountability scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: business_unit|division|department|function|team|cost_center|profit_center — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

tables.name: cost_center
tables.description: Master record for SAP cost centers used in management accounting and financial controlling. Captures cost center code, description, cost center category (production, administration, R&D, sales), responsible person, valid-from and valid-to dates, controlling area, profit center assignment, and functional area classification. Serves as the primary financial dimension for cost allocation across manufacturing, clinical, and R&D operations.

columns.name: cost_center_id
columns.description: Primary key for cost_center

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Cost centers belong to legal entities (SAP company codes). New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

columns.name: org_unit_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Cost centers belong to organizational units. New FK org_unit_id → org_unit.masterdata_org_unit_id. Remove department_code as org_unit.unit_code provides authoritative reference.

columns.name: plant_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.plant. Business justification: Cost centers in pharmaceutical manufacturing are typically plant-specific (e.g., 'Plant 123 - QC Lab', 'Plant 456 - Packaging Line 2'). The existing 'location_code' STRING attribute should be normaliz

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.profit_center. Business justification: Cost centers roll up to profit centers for internal P&L reporting. New FK profit_center_id → profit_center.masterdata_profit_center_id. Remove profit_center_code as redundant.

columns.name: activity_type_indicator
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center performs activity-based costing and maintains activity types for internal cost allocation.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Activity Type (CSLA)

columns.name: budget_profile
columns.description: Budget control profile defining budget availability checking rules, tolerance limits, and budget management parameters for this cost center.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Budget Profile (FM)

columns.name: business_area_code
columns.description: Business area assignment for cross-company code reporting and segment analysis, enabling consolidated financial statements by business segment.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Business Area (TGSB)

columns.name: controlling_area_code
columns.description: The controlling area to which this cost center is assigned. Controlling area is the highest organizational unit in management accounting, representing a closed system for cost accounting purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Controlling Area (TKA01)

columns.name: cost_allocation_method
columns.description: The method used for allocating costs from this cost center to other cost objects (e.g., direct allocation, activity-based costing, assessment, distribution). Supports COGS calculation and transfer pricing.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Allocation Methods

columns.name: cost_center_category
columns.description: Classification of the cost center by functional area. Production includes manufacturing and API production; R&D includes drug discovery, preclinical, and clinical development; Quality Control includes QC labs and QA functions; Regulatory Affairs includes submission and compliance activities.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Category (KOSAR)

columns.name: cost_center_code
columns.description: The unique alphanumeric business identifier for the cost center used across SAP S/4HANA and financial reporting systems. This is the externally-known code used in general ledger postings, budget allocations, and management accounting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Table (Cost Center Master)

columns.name: cost_center_description
columns.description: Extended textual description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities within the organization.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKT Table (Cost Center Texts)

columns.name: cost_center_name
columns.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center, providing human-readable identification for reporting and analysis.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Table

columns.name: cost_center_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers accept postings; Inactive cost centers are closed; Blocked cost centers exist but cannot receive new postings; Planned cost centers are defined for future use.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Lock Indicator

columns.name: cost_center_type
columns.description: Granular classification of the cost center type within its category, enabling detailed cost analysis and allocation logic.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Type Field

columns.name: created_by_user
columns.description: User ID of the person who created this cost center master record in the system.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when this cost center master record was first created in the system.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which cost center transactions are recorded and reported.

columns.name: functional_area_code
columns.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting and external financial reporting per IFRS/GAAP requirements. Typical values include manufacturing, R&D, sales, administration.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Module - Functional Area (FMFINCODE)

columns.name: gmp_classification
columns.description: Classification indicating whether the cost center operates under GMP regulations. GMP-critical cost centers (e.g., API production, sterile manufacturing) require enhanced documentation and validation; GMP-non-critical support GMP operations; Non-GMP cost centers operate outside GMP scope.
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

columns.name: hierarchy_area
columns.description: Standard hierarchy assignment for cost center grouping and roll-up reporting in management accounting.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Standard Hierarchy (SETHEADER)

columns.name: last_modified_by_user
columns.description: User ID of the person who last modified this cost center master record.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when this cost center master record was last modified.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail - CDHDR Change Document Header

columns.name: lock_indicator
columns.description: Indicates which types of postings are locked for this cost center. Unlocked allows all postings; Locked_actual prevents actual cost postings; Locked_plan prevents planning postings; Locked_all prevents all postings.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Lock Indicator (SPERRK)

columns.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
columns.glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this record is the authoritative golden record in the MDM system, used for master data governance and data quality management.

columns.name: planning_group
columns.description: Planning group assignment for cost center planning and budgeting cycles, enabling coordinated planning across related cost centers.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Planning Parameters

columns.name: source_system_code
columns.description: Identifier of the source operational system from which this cost center master record originated, supporting multi-system MDM governance.
columns.reference: Master Data Management (MDM) - Source System Registry

columns.name: sox_relevant_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements, typically for cost centers involved in financial reporting processes.

columns.name: statistical_cost_center_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical cost center used for informational purposes only, without actual cost postings.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Statistical Indicator

columns.name: valid_from_date
columns.description: The date from which this cost center master record is valid and can accept cost postings. Part of the time-dependent master data structure.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Valid From (DATAB)

columns.name: valid_to_date
columns.description: The date until which this cost center master record is valid. After this date, no new postings are allowed. Nullable for open-ended validity.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - CSKS Valid To (DATBI)

tables.name: profit_center
tables.description: Master record for SAP profit centers representing autonomous business segments for internal profitability reporting. Captures profit center code, name, hierarchy node, responsible manager, segment classification (therapeutic area, product line, geography), controlling area, and dummy profit center flag. Enables P&L reporting by therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, rare diseases) and product portfolio.

columns.name: profit_center_id
columns.description: Primary key for profit_center

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: profit_center.geographic_region is a STRING field but does not map directly to a country. In pharmaceutical enterprises, profit centers are often structured by country for market access, reimbursement

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Profit centers belong to legal entities for consolidation. New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

columns.name: analysis_period
columns.description: The fiscal period for which this profit center configuration is effective, in YYYYMM format. Supports period-specific profit center assignments and reorganizations.

columns.name: business_area_code
columns.description: The business area for cross-company code reporting. Represents a business segment that spans multiple legal entities, used for consolidated management reporting.

columns.name: controlling_area_code
columns.description: The controlling area to which this profit center is assigned. Controlling area is the organizational unit in SAP CO that represents a closed system for cost accounting purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Controlling Area

columns.name: cost_center_group
columns.description: The cost center group or range associated with this profit center. Links profit center to underlying cost centers for cost allocation and variance analysis.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this profit center master record was created in the system. Supports audit trail and compliance requirements.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11, SOX

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: The functional currency in which this profit center's P&L is reported. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
columns.reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration

columns.name: department_code
columns.description: The department or organizational unit code associated with this profit center. Links profit center to the organizational hierarchy for reporting and governance.

columns.name: dummy_profit_center_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this is a dummy or placeholder profit center used for technical postings, system balancing, or temporary allocations. True if dummy, False if operational.

columns.name: functional_area_code
columns.description: The functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting. Represents business functions such as R&D, manufacturing, sales, marketing, or administration.

columns.name: geographic_region
columns.description: The primary geographic region or market that this profit center serves. Used for regional P&L reporting and market access strategy.

columns.name: hierarchy_node
columns.description: The node identifier in the profit center standard hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting and aggregation of P&L across organizational structures (e.g., by therapeutic area, geography, or product line).

columns.name: language_code
columns.description: The primary language code for profit center descriptions and reporting. Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., EN, DE, FR).

columns.name: lock_indicator
columns.description: Indicates whether the profit center is locked for posting. When True, no new transactions can be posted to this profit center. Used during period-end close or when deactivating a profit center.

columns.name: modified_by
columns.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this profit center master record. Used for change tracking and data stewardship accountability.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this profit center master record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and compliance requirements.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11, SOX

columns.name: product_line
columns.description: The product line or portfolio grouping associated with this profit center. May represent a brand family, drug class, or commercial franchise.

columns.name: profit_center_code
columns.description: The business identifier code for the profit center as defined in SAP Controlling. Typically alphanumeric, 4-10 characters. Used across financial reporting, P&L statements, and management accounting.

columns.name: profit_center_name
columns.description: The full business name or description of the profit center. Human-readable label used in financial reports and management dashboards.

columns.name: profit_center_status
columns.description: The current lifecycle status of the profit center. Active profit centers are operational and accept postings. Planned profit centers are set up but not yet operational. Closed profit centers are historical and no longer accept postings.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Master Data Lifecycle Management

columns.name: profit_center_type
columns.description: The classification type of the profit center indicating its primary business function. Operating profit centers generate revenue; support and corporate profit centers provide shared services.

columns.name: segment_code
columns.description: The segment classification for external segment reporting per IFRS 8 and US GAAP. Typically represents therapeutic area (oncology, immunology, rare diseases), product line, or geographic market.
columns.reference: IFRS 8 Operating Segments, SAP S/4HANA Segment Reporting

columns.name: short_name
