columns.description: Abbreviated name or short text for the profit center, used in condensed reports and user interfaces where space is limited.

columns.name: therapeutic_area
columns.description: The primary therapeutic area or disease category that this profit center focuses on. Used for portfolio analysis, R&D allocation, and commercial strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oncology|immunology|rare_diseases|cardiovascular|neuroscience|infectious_diseases|vaccines|consumer_health|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: valid_from_date
columns.description: The date from which this profit center master record is valid and can accept financial postings. Supports time-dependent master data changes.

columns.name: valid_to_date
columns.description: The date until which this profit center master record is valid. After this date, no new postings are allowed. Nullable for open-ended validity.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: The user ID of the person who created this profit center master record in the system. Used for audit trail and data governance.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, 21 CFR Part 11

tables.name: chart_of_accounts
tables.description: Master record defining all general ledger account codes used across the pharmaceutical enterprise. Captures GL account number, description, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account group, P&L vs balance sheet classification, tax category, reconciliation account indicator, IFRS/US-GAAP mapping, R&D capitalization eligibility flag, and controlling integration settings. Governs financial reporting consistency across all company codes, enabling compliant reporting under multiple accounting standards and supporting pharma-specific accounting requirements (R&D expense vs capitalization, milestone revenue recognition, royalty accruals).

columns.name: chart_of_accounts_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account record. Primary key for the chart of accounts master data.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key reference to the company code (legal entity) for which this GL account is defined. Chart of accounts can be shared across multiple company codes, but account properties may vary by company code.

columns.name: account_group
columns.description: The hierarchical grouping code that organizes GL accounts into logical categories for reporting and analysis (e.g., 'RDEXP' for R&D expenses, 'COGS' for cost of goods sold).
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Account Group Configuration

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: The full descriptive name of the GL account, providing clear business context for the account's purpose (e.g., 'Research and Development Expenses - Preclinical Studies').
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

columns.name: account_short_name
columns.description: Abbreviated name or label for the GL account used in reports and user interfaces where space is limited.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Standards

columns.name: account_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account. Active accounts are available for posting; inactive accounts are retained for historical reporting only; blocked accounts prevent new postings; pending closure accounts are scheduled for deactivation.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Governance

columns.name: account_type
columns.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the GL account, determining its placement in financial statements and its normal balance (debit or credit).
columns.reference: IFRS Framework, US GAAP ASC 210, SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: balance_sheet_classification
columns.description: For balance sheet accounts, specifies whether the account is classified as current or non-current asset/liability, or equity. Not applicable for P&L accounts.

columns.name: controlling_area_integration
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is integrated with the Controlling module for cost center, internal order, and profitability analysis postings.

columns.name: cost_element_category
columns.description: For accounts that are cost elements, specifies whether it is a primary cost element (posted from FI) or secondary cost element (used for internal allocations). Not applicable if cost_element_indicator is false.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Types

columns.name: cost_element_indicator
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this GL account is also defined as a cost element in Controlling (CO) module, enabling cost center and internal order postings.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Configuration

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this GL account master record was originally created in the system. Required for regulatory audit trails and data lineage.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: currency_type
columns.description: Specifies which currency perspective this account primarily operates in: local currency, group currency, hard currency, index-based currency, or global company currency. Supports multi-currency pharmaceutical operations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Configuration, IFRS IAS 21

columns.name: financial_statement_category
columns.description: Indicates which primary financial statement this account appears on: balance sheet (statement of financial position), profit and loss (income statement), cash flow statement, or statement of retained earnings.
columns.reference: IFRS IAS 1, US GAAP ASC 205, SAP S/4HANA FI

columns.name: functional_area
columns.description: The business function or department this account is primarily associated with (e.g., 'R&D', 'Manufacturing', 'Commercial', 'Regulatory Affairs'). Used for functional cost analysis in pharmaceutical operations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Functional Area, Pharmaceutical Industry Best Practices

columns.name: gl_account_number
columns.description: The unique account code used to identify this GL account across all financial transactions. Typically a 6-10 digit numeric code structured by account type and category.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts, IFRS, US GAAP

columns.name: ifrs_mapping_code
columns.glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Mapping Code
columns.description: The IFRS financial statement line item code that this account maps to for IFRS-compliant financial reporting. Enables parallel accounting and consolidated reporting under IFRS standards.
columns.reference: IFRS Financial Statement Presentation Standards, SAP S/4HANA Parallel Accounting

columns.name: line_item_display
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether individual line item details are stored and can be displayed for this account. Essential for accounts requiring detailed transaction audit trails.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Display Configuration

columns.name: milestone_revenue_indicator
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this revenue account is used for milestone-based revenue recognition common in pharmaceutical licensing and collaboration agreements (e.g., regulatory approval milestones, sales milestones).
columns.reference: IFRS 15, US GAAP ASC 606, Pharmaceutical Revenue Recognition Guidance

columns.name: modified_by
columns.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this GL account master record. Essential for change tracking and compliance.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this GL account master record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and governance purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: open_item_management
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account uses open item management, requiring line items to be explicitly cleared (e.g., for receivables, payables, clearing accounts).
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Open Item Management

columns.name: pl_classification
columns.description: For income statement accounts, specifies the detailed classification within the P&L structure (operating vs non-operating, revenue vs expense categories). Not applicable for balance sheet accounts.

columns.name: posting_block_indicator
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether direct postings to this account are currently blocked. When true, the account can only receive postings through specific controlled processes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Controls

columns.name: profit_center_update_indicator
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether postings to this account automatically update profit center accounting, enabling segment reporting and profitability analysis by therapeutic area or product line.

columns.name: rd_capitalization_eligible
columns.glossary_term: Research and Development (R&D) Capitalization Eligible Flag
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether costs posted to this account are eligible for capitalization as intangible assets under development (e.g., post-IND development costs). Critical for pharmaceutical R&D accounting under IAS 38 and ASC 730.
columns.reference: IFRS IAS 38, US GAAP ASC 730, Pharmaceutical R&D Accounting Policies

columns.name: reconciliation_account_indicator
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that summarizes detailed transactions from subsidiary ledgers such as Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, or Asset Accounting.

columns.name: royalty_accrual_indicator
columns.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is used for royalty expense accruals or royalty revenue recognition, common in pharmaceutical licensing arrangements and patent agreements.
columns.reference: IFRS 15, US GAAP ASC 606, Pharmaceutical Licensing Accounting

columns.name: sort_key
columns.description: The default sort key used for organizing and displaying line items within this account (e.g., by posting date, document number, reference). Improves usability for high-volume accounts.

columns.name: subledger_type
columns.description: For reconciliation accounts, specifies which subledger this account reconciles (AR, AP, Fixed Assets, MM). Not applicable for non-reconciliation accounts.

columns.name: tax_category
columns.description: The tax treatment category for this account, determining how transactions posted to this account are handled for tax reporting purposes (e.g., 'VAT_INPUT', 'VAT_OUTPUT', 'NON_TAXABLE', 'EXEMPT').
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration, Local Tax Regulations

columns.name: us_gaap_mapping_code
columns.glossary_term: United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP) Mapping Code
columns.description: The US GAAP financial statement line item code that this account maps to for US GAAP-compliant financial reporting. Supports dual reporting requirements for pharmaceutical companies with US operations.
columns.reference: US GAAP Accounting Standards Codification, SAP S/4HANA Parallel Accounting

columns.name: valid_from_date
columns.description: The date from which this GL account becomes active and available for transaction postings. Supports time-dependent account structures.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency

columns.name: valid_to_date
columns.description: The date until which this GL account remains active. Null indicates no planned end date. Used for account lifecycle management and historical cutover scenarios.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Master Data Time Dependency

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this GL account master record. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail, SOX Compliance, 21 CFR Part 11

tables.name: material
tables.description: Central master record for all materials managed within the pharmaceutical enterprise including APIs (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), excipients, drug substances (DS), drug products (DP), finished dosage forms (FDF), packaging materials, laboratory reagents, and raw materials. Captures material number, INN (International Nonproprietary Name), USAN, material type, base unit of measure, material group, gross/net weight, shelf life, storage conditions, hazardous material classification, GMP classification, and cross-system identifiers (SAP material number, LIMS material code). SSOT for material identity across SAP MM, LIMS, and MES.

columns.name: material_id
columns.description: Primary key for material

columns.name: atc_classification_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: Pharmaceutical materials classified by WHO ATC system. New FK atc_classification_id → atc_classification.masterdata_atc_classification_id. Remove atc_code as redundant.

columns.name: inn_registry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: Materials reference INN registry for active pharmaceutical ingredients. New FK inn_registry_id → inn_registry.masterdata_inn_registry_id. Remove inn_name as redundant.

columns.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.ndc_code. Business justification: Marketed pharmaceutical products have NDC codes. New FK ndc_code_id → ndc_code.masterdata_ndc_code_id. Remove ndc_code (STRING) as redundant.

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Materials measured in standard units of measure. New FK base_uom_id → unit_of_measure.uom_id for base UOM. Remove base_unit_of_measure (STRING) as redundant. Note: weight_unit and volume_unit remain a

columns.name: batch_managed_indicator
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires batch-level tracking and management for traceability and quality control purposes.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.188 - Batch Production and Control Records

columns.name: cas_number
columns.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by CAS to every chemical substance, used for regulatory submissions and scientific documentation.

columns.name: controlled_substance_schedule
columns.description: DEA schedule classification for controlled substances. Schedule I-V indicate varying levels of control requirements; non-controlled materials are not regulated under DEA.
columns.reference: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308 - Schedules of Controlled Substances

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the material master record was first created in the system.

columns.name: discontinuation_date
columns.description: Date on which the material is discontinued and no longer available for new orders or production, supporting product lifecycle management.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date from which the material master record becomes active and available for use in business transactions.

columns.name: gmp_classification
columns.description: Classification indicating the level of GMP control required for this material. GMP-critical materials require the highest level of quality control and documentation.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice for Finished Pharmaceuticals

columns.name: gross_weight
columns.description: Total weight of the material including packaging, expressed in the weight unit of measure.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Weight Fields

columns.name: hazard_class
columns.description: Classification of hazardous materials per GHS (Globally Harmonized System) or DOT hazard classes for transportation and safety management.
columns.reference: UN GHS - Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling

columns.name: hazardous_material_indicator
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the material is classified as hazardous per regulatory definitions, requiring special handling and documentation.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the material master record was last updated, supporting audit trail and change management requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures

columns.name: lims_material_code
columns.glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Material Code
columns.description: Material identifier used in the LIMS system for laboratory testing, quality control, and certificate of analysis tracking.

columns.name: manufacturer_part_number
columns.description: Manufacturer's unique part number or catalog number for the material, used for procurement and supplier management.

columns.name: material_description
columns.description: Short textual description of the material for identification and display purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Master Data Standards

columns.name: material_group
columns.description: Hierarchical grouping code for materials used for procurement, planning, and reporting purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group Hierarchy

columns.name: material_number
columns.description: Unique business identifier for the material across the enterprise. Typically the SAP material number used as the primary external reference code.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Master Data Standards

columns.name: material_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the material indicating its availability for use in operations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Status Management

columns.name: material_type
columns.description: Classification of the material by its role in pharmaceutical operations. API = Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient, DS = Drug Substance, DP = Drug Product, FDF = Finished Dosage Form. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: API|EXCIPIENT|DRUG_SUBSTANCE|DRUG_PRODUCT|FINISHED_DOSAGE_FORM|PACKAGING_PRIMARY|PACKAGING_SECONDARY|RAW_MATERIAL|REAGENT|REFERENCE_STANDARD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

columns.name: mes_material_code
columns.description: Material identifier used in the MES system for production tracking, batch records, and manufacturing operations.

columns.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
columns.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required at goods receipt or before use in production, ensuring adequate time for processing and distribution.

columns.name: net_weight
columns.description: Weight of the material excluding packaging, expressed in the weight unit of measure.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Weight Fields

columns.name: procurement_type
columns.description: Indicates how the material is obtained: externally purchased, internally manufactured, or both. Consignment indicates vendor-owned inventory.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Procurement Type Configuration

columns.name: quality_inspection_required
columns.description: Flag indicating whether incoming goods or production batches of this material require quality inspection before release for use.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211 Subpart E - Control of Components and Drug Product Containers

columns.name: retest_interval_days
columns.description: Number of days after which stored material must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications, applicable to APIs and intermediates.
columns.reference: ICH Q7 - Good Manufacturing Practice Guide for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

columns.name: serial_number_profile
columns.description: Configuration profile defining serial number management requirements for the material, used for unit-level traceability.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

columns.name: shelf_life_days
columns.description: Total shelf life of the material from manufacturing date to expiration, expressed in days. Critical for GMP compliance and inventory management.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A - Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products

columns.name: storage_conditions
columns.description: Required environmental conditions for material storage including temperature range, humidity, and light protection requirements per stability data.

columns.name: temperature_sensitive_indicator
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the material requires temperature-controlled storage and transportation (cold chain management).
columns.reference: WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 - Temperature Control Guidelines

columns.name: usan_name
columns.description: United States Adopted Name for pharmaceutical substances as designated by the USAN Council.

columns.name: volume
columns.description: Physical volume of the material, used for storage and transportation planning.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Volume Fields

columns.name: volume_unit
columns.description: Unit of measure for the volume field.

columns.name: weight_unit
columns.description: Unit of measure for gross and net weight fields.

tables.name: plant
tables.description: Master record for manufacturing plants, packaging sites, distribution centers, and R&D facilities within the pharmaceutical enterprise. Captures plant code, plant name, plant type (manufacturing, packaging, distribution, R&D, QC laboratory), address, country, GMP certification status, regulatory authority registrations (FDA establishment registration, EMA site number), capacity class, and SAP plant code. Supports manufacturing network planning, regulatory site management, and supply chain operations.

columns.name: plant_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the plant facility. Primary key.

columns.name: address_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.address. Business justification: plant carries five inline address columns (address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state_province, postal_code) that duplicate the masterdata.address master record. Adding plant_address_id FK to address

columns.name: capacity_unit_of_measure_id
columns.glossary_term: Capacity Unit Of Measure Id (Foreign Key)
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: plant.capacity_unit_of_measure is a free-text STRING representing the unit of measure for annual plant capacity (e.g., kg, liters, units). The masterdata.unit_of_measure table is the authoritative ref

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Plants located in countries for regulatory compliance (GMP, FDA, EMA). New FK country_id → country.country_id. Existing country_code (STRING) remains for code reference.

columns.name: legal_entity_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.legal_entity. Business justification: Plants owned/operated by legal entities. New FK legal_entity_id → legal_entity.legal_entity_id. Remove company_code as legal_entity.sap_company_code is authoritative.

columns.name: org_unit_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.org_unit. Business justification: Plants are operational facilities that should be part of the organizational hierarchy. Each plant belongs to an organizational unit (e.g., 'Manufacturing Operations', 'R&D Facilities'). This enables o

columns.name: annual_capacity_units
columns.description: Maximum annual production capacity of the plant expressed in standard units (e.g., kilograms of API, millions of dosage units), used for capacity planning and network design.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Production Planning, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

columns.name: capacity_class
columns.description: Classification of the plant's production or operational capacity relative to other facilities in the network, used for supply chain planning and network optimization.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Plant Master Data, Supply Chain Planning Standards

columns.name: commissioning_date
columns.description: Date when the plant facility was officially commissioned and began operational activities.

columns.name: cost_center
columns.description: Primary cost center code assigned to the plant facility for cost accounting and financial controlling purposes.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Cost Center Accounting

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the plant master record was first created in the system.

columns.name: dea_registration_number
columns.description: DEA registration number for facilities handling controlled substances, required for manufacturing, distribution, or research involving scheduled drugs.

columns.name: ema_site_number
columns.description: Unique site identifier assigned by the European Medicines Agency for manufacturing and testing facilities within the European Economic Area.
columns.reference: EMA Manufacturing and Import Authorisation Guidelines

columns.name: email_address
columns.description: Primary email contact address for the plant facility for official communications and regulatory correspondence.

columns.name: environmental_permit_status
columns.description: Current status of environmental operating permits required for pharmaceutical manufacturing operations at the plant facility.
columns.reference: EPA Environmental Regulations, EU Industrial Emissions Directive

columns.name: fda_establishment_identifier
columns.glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Establishment Identifier
columns.description: Unique registration number assigned by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for facilities engaged in the manufacture, preparation, propagation, compounding, or processing of drug products.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 207 Registration of Producers of Drugs and Listing of Drugs in Commercial Distribution

columns.name: gmp_certification_date
columns.description: Date when the plant received its current Good Manufacturing Practice certification from the relevant regulatory authority.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 210, 21 CFR Part 211, PIC/S GMP Guide

columns.name: gmp_certification_status
columns.description: Current status of the plant's Good Manufacturing Practice certification, indicating compliance with pharmaceutical manufacturing quality standards.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 210, 21 CFR Part 211, EMA GMP Guidelines, PIC/S GMP Guide

columns.name: gmp_expiry_date
columns.description: Date when the plant's current Good Manufacturing Practice certification expires and requires renewal or re-inspection.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 210, 21 CFR Part 211, PIC/S GMP Guide

columns.name: iso_certification_status
columns.description: Current status of the plant's ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification or other relevant ISO certifications (e.g., ISO 13485 for medical devices).
columns.reference: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, ISO 13485 Medical Devices

columns.name: last_inspection_date
columns.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection by FDA, EMA, or other competent authority at the plant facility.
columns.reference: FDA Inspection Guidelines, EMA GMP Inspection Programme

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the plant master record was most recently updated or modified.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the plant facility in decimal degrees, used for logistics planning and geographic analysis.

columns.name: lims_system
columns.description: Name and version of the Laboratory Information Management System used at the plant for sample tracking, testing, and Certificate of Analysis generation.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the plant facility in decimal degrees, used for logistics planning and geographic analysis.

columns.name: manufacturing_execution_system
columns.description: Name and version of the Manufacturing Execution System used at the plant for batch execution, electronic batch records, and production tracking.
columns.reference: ISA-95 Enterprise-Control System Integration, 21 CFR Part 11

columns.name: next_inspection_due_date
columns.description: Anticipated or scheduled date for the next regulatory inspection based on inspection frequency requirements and risk classification.
columns.reference: FDA Inspection Guidelines, EMA GMP Inspection Programme

columns.name: operational_status
columns.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the plant facility indicating whether it is actively producing, temporarily offline, or permanently closed.

columns.name: phone_number
columns.description: Primary contact telephone number for the plant facility including country and area codes.

columns.name: plant_code
columns.description: Business identifier code for the plant facility, typically used in SAP S/4HANA and other operational systems for cross-system reference.

columns.name: plant_name
columns.description: Full business name of the plant facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in official documentation.
columns.reference: FDA Establishment Registration, EMA Site Registration

columns.name: plant_type
columns.description: Classification of the plant facility based on its primary operational function within the pharmaceutical enterprise.

columns.name: quality_management_system
columns.description: Name and version of the Quality Management System software platform used at the plant (e.g., MasterControl, TrackWise, Veeva Vault QualityDocs).
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

columns.name: sap_plant_code
columns.description: Four-character plant code used in SAP S/4HANA ERP system for materials management, production planning, and financial controlling.

columns.name: time_zone
columns.description: IANA time zone identifier for the plant facility location, used for scheduling, shift planning, and cross-site coordination.

tables.name: storage_location
tables.description: Master record for storage locations within pharmaceutical manufacturing and distribution plants. Covers warehouses, cold rooms (2-8°C, -20°C, -80°C), controlled substance vaults (DEA Schedule II-V), quarantine zones, QC sampling areas, returns processing areas, and hazardous material storage. Captures storage location code, plant assignment, temperature range, humidity control requirements, DEA license number (for controlled substances), GMP zone classification (Grade A-D), GDP compliance status, capacity in storage units, and WMS integration flag. Critical for batch traceability, cold-chain integrity, controlled substance accountability, and regulatory inspection readiness.

columns.name: storage_location_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the storage location within the pharmaceutical manufacturing and distribution network. Primary key for the storage location master record.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Master Data Standards

columns.name: address_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.address. Business justification: storage_location carries five inline address columns (address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state_province, postal_code) that duplicate the masterdata.address master record. Adding storage_location_ad

columns.name: capacity_unit_of_measure_id
columns.glossary_term: Capacity Unit Of Measure Id (Foreign Key)
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: storage_location.capacity_unit_of_measure is a free-text STRING representing the unit of measure for storage capacity (e.g., pallets, cubic meters, liters). The masterdata.unit_of_measure table is the

columns.name: cost_center_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.cost_center. Business justification: Storage locations incur operational costs (utilities, climate control, labor, maintenance) that must be allocated to cost centers for management accounting. This is a standard cost allocation relation

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: storage_location.country_code is a free-text STRING representing the country of the storage location. The masterdata.country table is the authoritative reference. Adding country_id FK to country.count

columns.name: plant_id
columns.description: Reference to the manufacturing or distribution plant to which this storage location belongs. Links storage location to the organizational hierarchy for GMP compliance and regulatory reporting.

columns.name: capacity_storage_units
columns.description: Maximum storage capacity of this location measured in storage units (pallets, bins, cubic meters, or location-specific unit). Used for warehouse space planning and inventory optimization.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this storage location master record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

columns.name: dea_license_number
columns.description: DEA registration number for storage locations authorized to hold controlled substances (Schedule II-V). Format: 2 letters + 7 digits. Required for controlled substance accountability and regulatory inspections. Null for non-controlled substance storage.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 1301 DEA Registration, DEA Diversion Control Division

columns.name: dea_schedule_authorized
columns.description: Highest DEA controlled substance schedule this storage location is authorized to hold. Schedule II requires vault-level security. Not applicable for non-controlled substance storage.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 1301 DEA Registration, 21 CFR Part 1304 Records and Reports

columns.name: effective_end_date
columns.description: Date when this storage location was decommissioned or permanently closed. Null for active storage locations. Used for historical reporting and audit trail.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

columns.name: effective_start_date
columns.description: Date when this storage location became operational and available for goods movements. Marks the beginning of the storage locations lifecycle in the master data system.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

columns.name: gdp_compliant_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this storage location meets GDP requirements for pharmaceutical distribution. True for qualified distribution centers with temperature mapping, security, and traceability controls. False for non-GDP locations.
columns.reference: GDP Guidelines PIC/S, EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01

columns.name: gmp_zone_classification
columns.description: Cleanroom classification per EU GMP Annex 1 or ISO 14644. Grade A for aseptic processing, Grade D for general manufacturing. Unclassified for non-GMP warehouses. Drives gowning, environmental monitoring, and personnel flow requirements.
columns.reference: EU GMP Annex 1 Manufacture of Sterile Medicinal Products, ISO 14644 Cleanroom Standards

columns.name: hazmat_storage_class
columns.description: Classification of hazardous materials authorized for storage per OSHA and DOT regulations. Determines segregation requirements, fire suppression systems, and emergency response protocols. Non-hazardous for general storage.
columns.reference: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 Flammable Liquids, DOT 49 CFR Part 172 Hazardous Materials Table

columns.name: humidity_max_percent
columns.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage for this storage location. Excursions may impact product stability and require OOT investigation. Null if humidity control is not required.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, 21 CFR Part 211.142 Warehousing Procedures

columns.name: humidity_min_percent
columns.description: Minimum allowable relative humidity percentage for this storage location. Required for hygroscopic API and moisture-sensitive drug products. Null if humidity control is not required.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, 21 CFR Part 211.142 Warehousing Procedures

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this storage location master record was last updated. Tracks change history for audit trail and data stewardship.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

columns.name: last_qualification_date
columns.description: Date of the most recent qualification or requalification of this storage location per CSV and GMP requirements. Includes temperature mapping, humidity validation, and security system testing. Drives requalification scheduling.
columns.reference: GAMP 5 CSV Guidelines, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs, 21 CFR Part 211 GMP Requirements

columns.name: next_qualification_due_date
columns.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic requalification of this storage location. Typically annual or biennial based on risk assessment. Overdue qualifications may trigger storage location blocking.
columns.reference: GAMP 5 CSV Guidelines, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs

columns.name: quarantine_zone_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated as a quarantine zone for materials pending QC release, under investigation, or rejected. True for quarantine areas, false for released goods storage.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.80 General Requirements for Components, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs

columns.name: returns_processing_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for processing returned goods, including customer returns, expired products, and recalls. True for returns processing areas requiring segregation and disposition workflows.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.204 Returned Drug Products, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

columns.name: sampling_location_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for QC sampling activities. True for sampling areas where materials are temporarily held for sample collection per sampling plans.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.84 Testing and Approval or Rejection of Components

columns.name: security_level
columns.description: Physical security classification for this storage location. High for DEA vaults and high-value products requiring 24/7 surveillance, access control, and intrusion detection. Medium for controlled access areas. Standard for general warehouses.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 1301.71 DEA Security Requirements, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

columns.name: segregation_required_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether materials in this storage location must be physically segregated from other materials due to cross-contamination risk, regulatory requirements, or product incompatibility. True for quarantine zones, controlled substances, and hazmat.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 211.176 Penicillin Contamination, ICH Q7 GMP for APIs

columns.name: storage_location_code
columns.description: Business identifier for the storage location. Alphanumeric code used across SAP WM, LIMS, and MES systems for warehouse management and batch traceability. Typically 4-10 characters.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

columns.name: storage_location_name
columns.description: Human-readable name of the storage location. Examples: Cold Room 2-8C Building A, DEA Vault Schedule II, Quarantine Zone QC Lab 3, Hazmat Storage Flammables.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master

columns.name: storage_location_status
columns.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Blocked status prevents goods movements pending CAPA resolution or requalification. Under qualification indicates validation in progress per CSV requirements.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM Storage Location Master, GAMP 5 CSV Guidelines

columns.name: storage_type
columns.description: Classification of the storage location by functional purpose. Determines applicable GMP, GDP, and DEA controls. Critical for regulatory inspection readiness and batch traceability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warehouse|cold_room|freezer|controlled_substance_vault|quarantine_zone|qc_sampling_area|returns_processing|hazmat_storage|bulk_storage|finished_goods|raw_material|packaging_material|work_in_process — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ICH Q7 GMP for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, 21 CFR Part 211 GMP Requirements

columns.name: temperature_max_celsius
columns.description: Maximum allowable temperature for this storage location in degrees Celsius. Excursions beyond this threshold trigger deviation investigations and potential batch impact assessments.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

columns.name: temperature_min_celsius
columns.description: Minimum allowable temperature for this storage location in degrees Celsius. Critical for cold-chain integrity and stability compliance. Examples: 2.0 for refrigerated, -25.0 for freezer, -85.0 for ultra-low freezer.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, GDP Guidelines PIC/S

columns.name: temperature_monitoring_system
columns.description: Type of temperature monitoring system deployed at this storage location. Continuous automated systems provide real-time alerts for excursions. Periodic manual monitoring uses data loggers with batch review. Not monitored for ambient storage.
columns.reference: ICH Q1A Stability Testing, GDP Guidelines PIC/S, 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

columns.name: wms_integration_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this storage location is integrated with a WMS for automated goods movements, bin management, and real-time inventory tracking. True for WMS-managed locations, false for manual locations.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA WM Extended Warehouse Management

tables.name: unit_of_measure
tables.description: Reference master for units of measure used across pharmaceutical operations including mass (mg, g, kg), volume (mL, L), concentration (mg/mL, %w/v), potency (IU, mcg), packaging (vial, ampoule, blister, tablet, capsule), and analytical units (ppm, ppb, CFU/mL). Captures UOM code, UOM description, UOM category, ISO unit code, SAP internal UOM, conversion factors to SI base units, and applicable regulatory standards. Ensures consistent measurement across SAP, LIMS, and MES.
tables.reference: SAP S/4HANA Unit of Measure (MM) / ISO 80000

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Primary key for unit_of_measure

columns.name: base_unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Self-referencing FK on unit_of_measure (base_unit_of_measure_id)

columns.name: applicable_material_types
columns.description: Comma-separated list of SAP material types or substance categories for which this UOM is applicable. Examples: API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient), DS (Drug Substance), DP (Drug Product), FDF (Finished Dosage Form), excipient, raw material, packaging material. Guides UOM selection during material master creation and transaction processing.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) Material Type Configuration, ICH Q7 API GMP

columns.name: conversion_group
columns.description: Logical grouping of UOMs that can be converted among each other. UOMs within the same conversion group share a common dimension and can be mathematically converted (e.g., mass group: mg, g, kg; volume group: mL, L). Used to enforce conversion rules and prevent invalid cross-dimensional conversions.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA UOM Conversion Configuration, ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when this unit of measure master record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field supporting regulatory compliance and data lineage tracking.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

columns.name: data_quality_score
columns.description: Computed data quality score (0.00 to 100.00) reflecting completeness, accuracy, consistency, and conformance of this UOM master record to MDM data quality rules. Supports proactive data quality management and continuous improvement initiatives.
columns.reference: Master Data Management (MDM) Data Quality Framework, ISO 8000 Data Quality Standards

columns.name: data_source_system
columns.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this UOM master record originates. Examples: SAP S/4HANA MM, LIMS LabWare, MES, Veeva Vault QualityDocs. Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation in the lakehouse architecture.
columns.reference: Master Data Management (MDM) Data Lineage Standards, Data Governance Framework

columns.name: decimal_precision
columns.description: Number of decimal places typically used when recording measurements in this unit. Guides data entry validation and reporting formats. Example: 3 for milligrams (0.001), 6 for micrograms (0.000001), 0 for tablets (whole units).
columns.reference: ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures, USP General Chapter <1058> Analytical Instrument Qualification

columns.name: dimension_type
columns.description: The fundamental physical dimension represented by this unit of measure per dimensional analysis. Aligns with SI base quantities and derived quantities. Used for dimensional consistency validation in formulation calculations and process parameter specifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: length|mass|time|temperature|amount_of_substance|electric_current|luminous_intensity|area|volume|velocity|acceleration|force|pressure|energy|power|frequency|dimensionless — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units - General, BIPM SI Brochure

columns.name: effective_end_date
columns.description: Date after which this unit of measure is no longer valid for new transactions. Null for currently active UOMs. Supports phase-out of deprecated units while preserving historical data integrity.
columns.reference: Master Data Management (MDM) Temporal Data Standards, Data Retention Policies

columns.name: effective_start_date
columns.description: Date from which this unit of measure becomes valid and available for use in operational systems. Supports temporal master data management and regulatory change management (e.g., adoption of new pharmacopeial standards).
columns.reference: Master Data Management (MDM) Temporal Data Standards, ICH M4 Common Technical Document

columns.name: is_base_uom
columns.glossary_term: Is Base Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this UOM is the base unit for its material or substance in SAP Material Master. Base UOMs serve as the reference for all alternative UOM conversions within a material. True if base UOM, False otherwise.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) Material Master Configuration

columns.name: is_commercial_uom
columns.glossary_term: Is Commercial Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used for commercial transactions, sales orders, and distribution (SAP SD module). Commercial UOMs may differ from manufacturing or laboratory UOMs. True if used in commercial contexts, False otherwise.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution (SD) Configuration, GDP Good Distribution Practice

columns.name: is_laboratory_uom
columns.glossary_term: Is Laboratory Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in laboratory testing, quality control, and LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System). Laboratory UOMs support analytical testing, stability studies, and Certificate of Analysis (CoA) reporting. True if used in laboratory contexts, False otherwise.
columns.reference: LIMS Configuration Standards, ICH Q2(R1) Validation of Analytical Procedures, USP General Chapters, GLP Good Laboratory Practice

columns.name: is_manufacturing_uom
columns.glossary_term: Is Manufacturing Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in manufacturing operations, batch production, and MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Manufacturing UOMs align with production planning (PP) and shop floor data collection. True if used in manufacturing, False otherwise.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Production Planning (PP) Configuration, cGMP Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH Q7 Good Manufacturing Practice for Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API)

columns.name: iso_unit_code
columns.glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Unit Code
columns.description: Standardized unit code per ISO 80000 and UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20. Enables interoperability across international regulatory submissions (eCTD) and supply chain systems. Examples: GRM (gram), KGM (kilogram), MLT (milliliter), LTR (liter).
columns.reference: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20

columns.name: last_modified_by
columns.description: User ID or system account that last modified this unit of measure master record. Supports change control and data stewardship accountability per GxP requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, GAMP 5 Good Automated Manufacturing Practice, ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: Date and time when this unit of measure master record was last modified. Updated with each change to support audit trail and change control documentation.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles

columns.name: mdm_approval_status
columns.description: Approval workflow status for this unit of measure within the MDM governance process. Draft records are under construction; pending_review records await data steward approval; approved records are released for operational use; rejected records require rework. Enforces data quality gates before UOM activation.
columns.reference: Master Data Management (MDM) Governance Framework, Data Stewardship Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

columns.name: regulatory_standard
columns.description: Citation of the regulatory or pharmacopeial standard that defines or governs the use of this unit of measure. Examples: USP <1> Injections, Ph. Eur. 2.9.40 Uniformity of Dosage Units, FDA 21 CFR Part 210 Current Good Manufacturing Practice, ICH Q6A Specifications. Supports compliance traceability for regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA).
columns.reference: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, EMA Guidelines, ICH Quality Guidelines, USP General Chapters, Ph. Eur. Monographs

columns.name: sap_internal_uom
columns.description: SAP S/4HANA internal unit of measure code used in Material Master (MM), Production Planning (PP), Quality Management (QM), and Warehouse Management (WM) modules. Maps external UOM codes to SAP-specific representations for ERP transaction processing.
columns.reference: SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) Configuration Guide

columns.name: si_conversion_factor
columns.glossary_term: International System of Units (SI) Conversion Factor
columns.description: Numeric multiplier to convert this UOM to its SI base unit. Enables automated unit conversion across systems. Example: for milligram to kilogram, factor is 0.000001; for milliliter to liter, factor is 0.001. Null for dimensionless units.
columns.reference: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, NIST Special Publication 811

columns.name: unit_of_measure_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit of measure in the master data repository. Active UOMs are available for use in transactions; inactive UOMs are retained for historical data but not selectable for new entries; deprecated UOMs are phased out per regulatory or business changes; pending_approval UOMs await MDM governance review before activation.
columns.reference: Master Data Management (MDM) Governance Framework, Data Stewardship Procedures

columns.name: uom_category
columns.description: Classification of the unit of measure by measurement type. Segments UOMs into functional categories for pharmaceutical operations: mass (mg, g, kg), volume (mL, L), concentration (mg/mL, %w/v), potency (IU, mcg), packaging (vial, ampoule, blister, tablet, capsule), analytical (ppm, ppb, CFU/mL), time (hour, day), temperature (Celsius, Fahrenheit), pressure (bar, psi), count (each, piece). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mass|volume|concentration|potency|packaging|analytical|time|temperature|pressure|count — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
columns.reference: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, ICH Q6A Specifications

columns.name: uom_code
columns.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the unit of measure. Used as the business identifier across SAP S/4HANA, LIMS, and MES systems. Examples: MG, G, KG, ML, L, IU, MCG, PPM, PPB, CFU.
columns.reference: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, SAP Material Management (MM) UOM Master

columns.name: uom_description
columns.description: Full descriptive name of the unit of measure. Provides human-readable explanation of the UOM code. Examples: Milligram, Gram, Kilogram, Milliliter, Liter, International Unit, Microgram, Parts Per Million, Parts Per Billion, Colony Forming Unit per Milliliter.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: User ID or system account that created this unit of measure master record. Supports audit trail and data stewardship accountability per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
columns.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures, SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act, GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

tables.name: country
tables.description: Reference master for countries and territories relevant to pharmaceutical operations, regulatory submissions, and commercial activities. Captures ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, country name, region, sub-region, regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA), ICH region membership, currency code, language, and pharmaceutical market classification (regulated, semi-regulated, unregulated). Supports regulatory submission routing, market access planning, and supply chain geography.

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the country or territory record. Primary key for the country master data product.

columns.name: clinical_trial_registration_required_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the country mandates registration of clinical trials in a public registry (e.g., ClinicalTrials.gov, EU Clinical Trials Register, CTRI India) before trial initiation. True if registration required, False otherwise. Impacts CTMS workflows and regulatory compliance.
columns.reference: ICH E8, FDA 21 CFR Part 312, EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

columns.name: controlled_substance_schedule_system
columns.description: Name of the controlled substance classification system used in the country (e.g., DEA Schedules I-V for USA, UK Misuse of Drugs Act Classes A/B/C, Japan Narcotics and Psychotropics Control Law). Determines manufacturing, storage, distribution, and prescribing requirements for controlled APIs and drug products. Impacts supply chain security and regulatory submissions.
columns.reference: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308, UN Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs

columns.name: country_name
columns.description: Official English name of the country or territory as recognized by the United Nations and used in regulatory submissions, commercial documentation, and reporting (e.g., United States of America, United Kingdom, Japan, China, Germany).

columns.name: country_status
columns.description: Current operational status of the country for pharmaceutical business activities. Active: normal operations permitted. Inactive: no current operations or market presence. Restricted: limited operations due to regulatory or business constraints. Sanctioned: operations prohibited due to international sanctions or trade restrictions. Impacts supply chain routing, clinical trial site selection, and commercial activities.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this country master data record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance (21 CFR Part 11 electronic records).

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the country's official currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY). Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO modules for financial transactions, pricing, revenue recognition, and P&L reporting.

columns.name: data_privacy_regulation
columns.description: Name of the primary data privacy and protection regulation applicable in the country (e.g., GDPR for EU, HIPAA for USA, LGPD for Brazil, PDPA for Singapore). Governs handling of patient data in clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, and commercial activities. Critical for EDC system configuration, eTMF management, and data transfer agreements.

columns.name: distribution_license_required_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether a separate wholesale distribution license or GDP certification is required to distribute pharmaceutical products within the country. True if distribution license required, False otherwise. Impacts supply chain partner qualification and logistics planning.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date from which this country master data record is effective and valid for use in operational systems, regulatory submissions, and commercial transactions. Supports temporal master data management and historical reporting.

columns.name: expiration_date
columns.description: Date after which this country master data record is no longer valid for use. Null if the record is currently active with no planned expiration. Used for managing country code changes, territory splits, or operational discontinuation.

columns.name: gmp_inspection_authority
columns.description: Name of the authority responsible for conducting GMP inspections of pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities within the country (may differ from the primary regulatory authority in some jurisdictions). Critical for manufacturing site qualification, PAI scheduling, and quality compliance.

columns.name: hta_body_name
columns.description: Name of the national or regional health technology assessment body that evaluates clinical and economic value of new medicines for reimbursement decisions (e.g., NICE for UK, G-BA for Germany, PBAC for Australia, CADTH for Canada, HAS for France). Null if no formal HTA process exists.

columns.name: ich_region_flag
columns.glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Region Membership Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the country is a member of an ICH region (USA, EU, Japan, Canada, Switzerland). ICH membership determines applicability of harmonized technical requirements for pharmaceutical registration (CTD/eCTD format, stability testing, quality guidelines). True if ICH member, False otherwise.

columns.name: ich_region_name
columns.glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Region Name
columns.description: Name of the ICH region to which the country belongs, if applicable. Used to determine which ICH guidelines and harmonized standards apply to regulatory submissions and CMC documentation.

columns.name: iso_alpha_2_code
columns.description: Two-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard. Used for regulatory submissions, labeling, and system integrations (e.g., US, GB, JP, CN, DE).

columns.name: iso_alpha_3_code
columns.description: Three-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 standard. Used in eCTD submissions, regulatory documents, and SAP S/4HANA master data (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, CHN, DEU).

columns.name: iso_numeric_code
columns.description: Three-digit numeric country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 numeric standard. Used in systems requiring numeric-only identifiers (e.g., 840 for USA, 826 for GBR, 392 for JPN).

columns.name: market_access_tier
columns.description: Commercial prioritization tier for market access and launch planning. Tier 1: high-value markets with established reimbursement frameworks and large patient populations (e.g., USA, Germany, Japan). Tier 2: significant markets with moderate access complexity. Tier 3: smaller markets or those with challenging reimbursement. Emerging: developing markets with growth potential. Drives commercial strategy, HEOR investment, and launch sequencing.

columns.name: modified_by
columns.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this country master data record. Supports audit trail and change management.

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when this country master data record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

columns.name: patent_filing_authority
columns.description: Name of the national intellectual property office responsible for patent applications and grants (e.g., USPTO, EPO, JPO, CNIPA, UKIPO). Used for tracking patent filings, patent term extensions, and exclusivity periods for NCEs and NBEs.

columns.name: pharmaceutical_market_classification
columns.description: Classification of the country's pharmaceutical regulatory maturity and market structure. Regulated markets have stringent GMP, GCP, and pharmacovigilance requirements (e.g., USA, EU, Japan). Semi-Regulated markets have evolving frameworks. Emerging markets have developing regulatory infrastructure. Unregulated markets have minimal oversight. Drives market access strategy, clinical trial site selection, and supply chain compliance requirements.

columns.name: pharmacovigilance_requirement_level
columns.description: Classification of the country's pharmacovigilance and adverse event reporting requirements. Stringent: mandatory ICSR reporting, SUSAR expedited reporting, periodic safety update reports (e.g., USA, EU, Japan). Moderate: ICSR reporting required with longer timelines. Basic: minimal AE reporting. None: no formal PV requirements. Drives Argus Safety configuration and safety reporting workflows.
columns.reference: ICH E2A/E2B/E2D/E2E, FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP

columns.name: pics_member_flag
columns.glossary_term: Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S) Member Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the country's regulatory authority is a member of PIC/S, enabling mutual recognition of GMP inspections and reducing duplicate inspections for manufacturing sites. True if PIC/S member, False otherwise.

columns.name: primary_language_code
columns.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the country's primary official language (e.g., en, ja, zh, de, fr). Used for labeling requirements, patient information leaflets, regulatory submission language, and Veeva PromoMats localization.

columns.name: region
columns.description: High-level geographic region classification based on UN M49 standard. Used for regional sales reporting, supply chain planning, and market access strategy segmentation.

columns.name: regulatory_authority_code
columns.description: Standardized code or abbreviation for the primary regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA). Used in Veeva Vault RIM, RIMS systems, and regulatory submission workflows.

columns.name: regulatory_authority_name
columns.description: Name of the primary national regulatory authority responsible for pharmaceutical product approvals, post-market surveillance, and GMP inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, NMPA, Health Canada, TGA, Anvisa). Critical for routing regulatory submissions and managing compliance obligations.

columns.name: reimbursement_framework_type
columns.description: Description of the country's pharmaceutical reimbursement and pricing framework (e.g., government-negotiated pricing, health technology assessment (HTA) required, free pricing, reference pricing, value-based agreements). Impacts pricing strategy, market access timelines, and HEOR evidence requirements.

columns.name: serialization_requirement_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the country mandates unique serialization and track-and-trace for pharmaceutical products to prevent counterfeiting (e.g., EU FMD, US DSCSA, China NMPA serialization, South Korea PMDA serialization). True if serialization required, False otherwise. Drives packaging line configuration and supply chain system requirements.
columns.reference: EU FMD, US DSCSA, GS1 Standards

columns.name: short_name
columns.description: Commonly used short name for the country or territory, used in user interfaces, reports, and operational systems (e.g., United States, UK, Japan, China, Germany).

columns.name: sub_region
columns.description: Sub-region classification within the broader region (e.g., Northern America, Western Europe, Eastern Asia, South-Eastern Asia, Southern Asia). Used for granular market segmentation and supply chain optimization.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this country master data record. Supports audit trail and data governance requirements.

tables.name: atc_classification
tables.description: Reference master for the WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system used to classify pharmaceutical substances by organ/system and therapeutic, pharmacological, and chemical properties. Captures ATC code at all five levels (anatomical main group, therapeutic subgroup, pharmacological subgroup, chemical subgroup, chemical substance), ATC level description, DDD (Defined Daily Dose), DDD unit, and administration route. Serves as the global standard for drug classification across regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, and commercial analytics.

columns.name: atc_classification_id
columns.description: Primary key for atc_classification

columns.name: inn_registry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: ATC level 5 codes reference INN substances. New FK inn_registry_id → inn_registry.masterdata_inn_registry_id. Remove inn_name as redundant.

columns.name: parent_atc_classification_id
columns.description: Self-referencing FK on atc_classification (parent_atc_classification_id)

columns.name: unit_of_measure_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: Defined Daily Dose (DDD) measured in standard units of measure. New FK ddd_uom_id → unit_of_measure.uom_id. Remove ddd_unit (STRING) as redundant.

columns.name: administration_route
columns.description: The route by which the drug is administered: O=Oral, P=Parenteral, R=Rectal, V=Vaginal, N=Nasal, Implant=Implant, Inhal=Inhalation, Instill=Instillation, SL=Sublingual/Buccal, TD=Transdermal. Critical for DDD assignment and clinical use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: O|P|R|V|N|Implant|Inhal|Instill|SL|TD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

columns.name: atc_code
columns.description: The complete 7-character WHO ATC code representing the full classification hierarchy from anatomical main group to chemical substance level (e.g., A10BA02 for metformin).

columns.name: atc_level
columns.description: The hierarchical level of the ATC code: 1=Anatomical main group (1 character), 2=Therapeutic subgroup (3 characters), 3=Pharmacological subgroup (4 characters), 4=Chemical subgroup (5 characters), 5=Chemical substance (7 characters).

columns.name: atc_level_1_code
columns.description: First level anatomical main group code (single letter A-V) representing the organ or system on which the drug acts.

columns.name: atc_level_1_description
columns.description: Full description of the anatomical main group (e.g., 'Alimentary tract and metabolism', 'Blood and blood forming organs', 'Cardiovascular system').

columns.name: atc_level_2_code
columns.description: Second level therapeutic subgroup code (3 characters) representing the therapeutic main group.

columns.name: atc_level_2_description
columns.description: Full description of the therapeutic subgroup (e.g., 'Drugs used in diabetes', 'Antithrombotic agents').

columns.name: atc_level_3_code
columns.description: Third level pharmacological subgroup code (4 characters) representing the pharmacological or therapeutic subgroup.

columns.name: atc_level_3_description
columns.description: Full description of the pharmacological subgroup (e.g., 'Blood glucose lowering drugs, excl. insulins', 'Platelet aggregation inhibitors excl. heparin').

columns.name: atc_level_4_code
columns.description: Fourth level chemical subgroup code (5 characters) representing the chemical or therapeutic subgroup.

columns.name: atc_level_4_description
columns.description: Full description of the chemical subgroup (e.g., 'Biguanides', 'Adenosine diphosphate (ADP) receptor inhibitors').

columns.name: atc_level_5_code
columns.description: Fifth level chemical substance code (7 characters) representing the specific chemical substance or combination.

columns.name: atc_level_5_description
columns.description: Full description of the chemical substance, typically the INN (International Nonproprietary Name) or combination name (e.g., 'metformin', 'clopidogrel').
columns.reference: WHO ATC Classification System, WHO INN Programme

columns.name: atc_note
columns.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to the ATC classification, including usage restrictions, combination product details, or cross-references to related codes.

columns.name: atc_status
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the ATC code: active=currently in use, inactive=temporarily suspended, withdrawn=permanently removed from WHO ATC index, pending=under review for inclusion, deprecated=superseded by another code.

columns.name: biosimilar_reference_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this biological substance serves as a reference product for biosimilar development and approval (True) or not (False). Relevant for biologics license applications.
columns.reference: FDA BLA Guidance, EMA Biosimilar Guidelines

columns.name: combination_product_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this ATC code represents a fixed-dose combination product containing two or more active pharmaceutical ingredients (True) or a single active substance (False).

columns.name: controlled_substance_schedule
columns.glossary_term: DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) Controlled Substance Schedule
columns.description: The DEA schedule classification for controlled substances: I=High abuse potential no accepted medical use, II=High abuse potential with severe dependence, III=Moderate to low abuse potential, IV=Low abuse potential, V=Lowest abuse potential, Not Controlled=Not a controlled substance.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this ATC classification record was first created in the master data system.

columns.name: ddd_value
columns.description: The assumed average maintenance dose per day for a drug used for its main indication in adults, expressed as a numeric value. Used for drug utilization studies and pharmacoeconomic analysis.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: The timestamp when this ATC classification record was last updated or modified in the master data system.

columns.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
columns.glossary_term: MDM (Master Data Management) Golden Record Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this record is the master golden record (True) or a duplicate/historical version (False) in the enterprise master data management system.

columns.name: orphan_drug_designation_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this substance has received orphan drug designation from FDA or EMA for treatment of rare diseases affecting small patient populations (True) or not (False).
columns.reference: FDA Orphan Drug Act, EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000

columns.name: source_system_code
columns.description: Identifier of the source system from which this ATC classification record was loaded (e.g., SAP MM, Veeva Vault RIM, external WHO ATC reference feed).

columns.name: therapeutic_equivalence_group
columns.description: Grouping code for substances considered therapeutically equivalent or interchangeable for the same indication, used in formulary management and substitution policies.

columns.name: valid_from_date
columns.description: The date from which this ATC classification record becomes effective and valid for use in regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance reporting, and commercial analytics.

columns.name: valid_to_date
columns.description: The date until which this ATC classification record remains valid. Null indicates the record is currently active with no planned end date.

columns.name: who_publication_year
columns.description: The year this ATC code was officially published or last updated by the WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology.

tables.name: masterdata_ndc_code
tables.description: Reference master for National Drug Codes (NDC) assigned to pharmaceutical products marketed in the United States. Captures NDC number (10-digit or 11-digit format), labeler code, product code, package code, proprietary name, nonproprietary name (INN/USAN), dosage form, route of administration, strength, labeler name, marketing status, application number (NDA/ANDA/BLA), and DEA schedule. Serves as the US product identifier for commercial, supply chain, and pharmacovigilance operations.
tables.reference: FDA National Drug Code Directory (21 CFR 207)

columns.name: masterdata_ndc_code_id
columns.glossary_term: Master Data National Drug Code (NDC) ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the NDC code record in the master data system.

columns.name: atc_classification_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.atc_classification. Business justification: NDC products classified by ATC system. New FK atc_classification_id → atc_classification.masterdata_atc_classification_id. Remove atc_code as redundant.

columns.name: inn_registry_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.inn_registry. Business justification: NDC codes represent marketed pharmaceutical products in the US, which are based on active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) identified by International Nonproprietary Names (INN). The existing 'nonpro

columns.name: strength_unit_of_measure_id
columns.glossary_term: Strength Unit Of Measure Id (Foreign Key)
columns.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.unit_of_measure. Business justification: NDC codes have a 'strength' STRING attribute (e.g., '500mg', '10mg/mL') that combines a numeric value and a unit of measure. Best practice is to split this into strength_value (DECIMAL) and strength_u

columns.name: active_ingredient_count
columns.description: The number of distinct active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in the drug product. Most products have 1; combination products have 2 or more.

columns.name: application_number
columns.description: The FDA application number under which the drug product was approved. Format includes application type prefix (NDA for New Drug Application, ANDA for Abbreviated New Drug Application, BLA for Biologics License Application) followed by 6-digit number.
columns.reference: FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book

columns.name: biosimilar_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the biological product is a biosimilar (highly similar to an FDA-approved reference biological product). True if biosimilar, False otherwise.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this NDC master data record was first created in the MDM system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

columns.name: data_quality_score
columns.description: A calculated score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of the NDC master data record, used for data stewardship prioritization and reporting.

columns.name: dea_schedule
columns.description: The controlled substance schedule classification assigned by the DEA if the drug has abuse potential. CI (Schedule I) through CV (Schedule V), or None for non-controlled substances.
columns.reference: DEA Controlled Substances Act; 21 CFR Part 1308

columns.name: dosage_form
columns.description: The physical form of the drug product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, solution, cream, patch). Standardized per FDA dosage form terminology.

columns.name: effective_end_date
columns.description: The date on which this NDC master data record ceases to be effective. Null if the record is currently effective with no planned end date.

columns.name: effective_start_date
columns.description: The date from which this NDC master data record is effective and valid for use in operational systems and reporting.

columns.name: end_marketing_date
columns.description: The date on which the drug product was discontinued from commercial marketing in the United States. Null if the product is still actively marketed.

columns.name: interchangeable_biosimilar_flag
columns.description: Indicates whether the biosimilar product has been designated by the FDA as interchangeable with the reference biological product, allowing pharmacy-level substitution. True if interchangeable, False otherwise.

columns.name: labeler_code
columns.description: The first segment of the NDC identifying the labeler (manufacturer, repackager, or distributor) assigned by the FDA. Typically 4 or 5 digits.

columns.name: labeler_name
columns.description: The legal name of the company responsible for labeling and marketing the drug product (manufacturer, repackager, or distributor).

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.description: The date and time when this NDC master data record was last updated in the MDM system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

columns.name: listing_expiration_date
columns.description: The date on which the NDC listing expires or was discontinued in the FDA National Drug Code Directory. Products with expired listings are no longer actively marketed.

columns.name: marketing_status
columns.description: The current marketing and distribution status of the drug product in the United States. Indicates whether the product is actively marketed as prescription, over-the-counter, or has been discontinued.

columns.name: mdm_golden_record_flag
columns.glossary_term: Master Data Management (MDM) Golden Record Flag
columns.description: Indicates whether this NDC record is the authoritative golden record in the Master Data Management system, having passed data quality and stewardship validation. True if golden record, False if duplicate or unvalidated.

columns.name: ndc_number
columns.description: The 10-digit or 11-digit National Drug Code assigned by the FDA to uniquely identify a drug product marketed in the United States. Format may be 5-4-1, 5-4-2, 5-3-2, or 4-4-2 depending on labeler, product, and package code segments.

columns.name: package_code
columns.description: The third segment of the NDC identifying the package size and type. Typically 1 or 2 digits.

columns.name: package_description
